papers.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Video generative models commonly rely on latent spaces learned by 3D Variational Autoencoders (3D-VAEs). However, conventional 3D-VAEs are mainly optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, which can limit the semantic and spatio-temporal structure captured by their latents. Meanwhile, Video Foundation Models (VFMs) such as V-JEPA 2 and VideoMAEv2 show strong video understanding capabilities, yet whether their frozen representations can be transformed into compact, reconstruction-capable, and generation-friendly video latents remains largely unexplored. We answer this question with VideoRAE, a representation autoencoder that leverages multi-scale hierarchical features from a frozen video foundation encoder and compresses them with a lightweight 1D self-attention projector. VideoRAE supports both continuous latents for Diffusion Transformers and discrete tokens for autoregressive models via multi-codebook high-dimensional quantization. During decoding, a local-and-global representation alignment objective with the frozen VFM teacher improves semantic preservation and enables training without KL regularization. Experiments show that VideoRAE achieves strong reconstruction in both continuous and discrete regimes. On UCF-101, it obtains state-of-the-art class-to-video gFVDs of 40 and 93 with AR and DiT generators, respectively, while converging approximately 5x faster than competing autoencoder baselines. In a controlled 2B-scale text-to-video study, replacing LTX-VAE with VideoRAE leads to faster convergence under comparable settings. These results validate frozen VFM representations as versatile and generation-friendly video latents. The model and code will be released on https://zhxie0117.github.io/VideoRAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoRAE，一种表示自编码器，利用冻结的视频基础模型（如 V-JEPA 2）的多尺度层次特征，通过轻量级 1D 自注意力投影器压缩成紧凑、可重建、适合生成的视频隐空间。支持连续隐变量（用于扩散 Transformer）和离散 token（用于自回归模型），并通过局部-全局表示对齐目标改进语义保持。实验显示在 UCF-101 上取得 SOTA 生成 FVD，且收敛速度快约5倍。
Motivation: 传统的 3D-VAE 主要优化像素级重建，限制了隐变量捕获的语义和时空结构；而视频基础模型（VFM）具有强大理解能力，但其冻结表示能否转化为紧凑、可重建、生成友好的视频隐变量尚未充分探索。
Method: 提出 VideoRAE，使用冻结的视频基础编码器提取多尺度层次特征，通过轻量级 1D 自注意力投影器压缩；支持连续和离散两种隐变量，离散化采用多码书高维量化；解码时通过局部-全局表示对齐目标与冻结的 VFM 教师保持一致，无需 KL 正则化。
Result: 在 UCF-101 上，使用自回归生成器获得 gFVD 40，使用 DiT 获得 gFVD 93，达到 SOTA；收敛速度比竞争自编码器基线快约5倍；在 2B 规模的文本到视频研究中，用 VideoRAE 替换 LTX-VAE 在设置相近时收敛更快。
Conclusion: 冻结的 VFM 表示可以作为通用且生成友好的视频隐变量。

papers.title: Leveraging unlabelled data for generalizable neural population decoding
papers.abstract_en: Robust and accurate neural decoders are integral to neurotechnologies such as brain-computer interfaces and closed-loop experiments. Recent work has shown that tokenizing neural data at the spike level facilitates multi-session pretraining and delivers state-of-the-art decoding performance. However, current spike-based models are restricted to supervised learning (SL), limiting training to datasets with paired behavioural labels. To address this limitation, we introduce MOJO (Masked autOencoder-based JOint training), a training framework for spike-tokenizing models that jointly leverages self-supervised learning (SSL) via masked autoencoding and SL objectives. We evaluate MOJO on three spiking datasets spanning monkey motor cortex during reaching tasks and multi-regional mouse recordings during vision and decision making tasks, demonstrating superior performance over purely SL-trained models. This improvement is especially pronounced when training with limited labelled data, particularly in few-shot finetuning, where only a small amount of labelled data from a new session is available. Incorporating SSL also yields more interpretable neuronal representations, improving performance on brain region classification and spike-statistics prediction without explicit optimization for these tasks. We further show that MOJO generalizes beyond spiking data to human electrocorticography during speech, where it continues to outperform purely SL-trained models and achieves performance comparable to neuro-foundation models (NFMs) designed specifically for continuous signals. Overall, augmenting spike-tokenizing models with SSL improves performance in label-impoverished settings and enables the use of unlabelled data across various tasks and species, while generalizing to other neural modalities. These results suggest a path towards more flexible and scalable data usage when training NFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOJO（Masked autoencoder-based Joint training）框架，结合掩码自编码（自监督学习）和监督学习目标训练脉冲标记化（spike-tokenizing）模型，用于神经群体解码。在猴子运动皮层和鼠脑多区域记录等数据集上，MOJO优于纯监督学习模型，尤其在小样本微调场景下提升显著。此外，自监督学习还增强了神经元表征的可解释性，并能泛化到人脑皮层电图（ECoG）数据，性能与专门设计的神经基础模型（NFM）相当。
Motivation: 现有基于脉冲的模型仅限于监督学习，依赖具有行为标签的数据集，限制了训练规模。本文旨在利用未标记数据提升神经解码器的泛化能力和标签稀缺场景下的性能。
Method: 提出MOJO训练框架，对脉冲标记化模型同时进行掩码自编码（自监督学习）和监督学习目标的联合训练。
Result: 在猴子运动皮层和鼠脑多区域记录数据集上，MOJO优于纯监督学习模型；在标签数据有限的小样本微调场景下提升尤其显著。自监督学习还提高了脑区分类和脉冲统计预测的性能（无需显式优化）。在人类ECoG语音数据上，MOJO超越了纯监督学习模型，性能与专门为连续信号设计的神经基础模型相当。
Conclusion: 为脉冲标记化模型增加自监督学习提高了标签稀缺场景下的性能，并能够跨任务、跨物种利用未标记数据，同时泛化到其他神经模态。这为训练更灵活、可扩展的神经基础模型提供了路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear Independent Component Analysis via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Linear Independent Component Analysis (ICA) recovers jointly independent source signals from their linear mixtures. To achieve this, classical ICA algorithms attempt to maximize non-Gaussianity, measured by negentropy, which is linked to independence by information theory. Because exact negentropy optimization is intractable, they rely on proxy contrast functions, such as fourth-order cumulants, and parametric log-likelihoods. We propose instead to measure non-Gaussianity using the squared Wasserstein distance $W_2^2$ to a standard Gaussian. We prove that the Wasserstein distance between a standard normal distribution and linear projections of the data is maximized when the projection recovers an independent component. Based on this observation, we propose the OT-ICA algorithm which finds this projection by gradient-based optimization. Empirical evaluation on simulated data shows that OT-ICA outperforms proxy-based methods for different distributions of the latent variables. Application to EEG artifact removal and econometric price discovery confirm OT-ICA can be used for applied ICA tasks without distributional assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用最优传输理论中的平方Wasserstein距离来度量非高斯性，从而实现线性独立成分分析（ICA）。理论证明最大化投影分布与标准正态之间的Wasserstein距离等价于恢复独立成分。基于此提出OT-ICA算法，通过梯度优化寻找投影方向。模拟数据实验表明OT-ICA优于基于代理的对比函数方法，并在EEG伪迹去除和计量经济学价格发现任务中验证了其无需分布假设的实用性。
Motivation: 传统ICA算法依赖难以精确优化的负熵代理函数（如四阶累积量或参数化对数似然），导致性能受限。
Method: 使用平方Wasserstein距离W2^2作为非高斯性度量，证明最大化数据线性投影与标准正态分布间的Wasserstein距离可恢复独立成分，并设计梯度优化算法OT-ICA。
Result: 模拟实验中OT-ICA在不同潜在变量分布下均优于基于代理的方法；在实际应用中成功用于EEG伪迹去除和计量经济学价格发现。
Conclusion: OT-ICA提供了一种无需分布假设的ICA替代方案，通过最优传输理论避免了传统代理函数的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
papers.abstract_en: Building interactive worlds that respond coherently to player actions has long been a shared goal of computer graphics, games, and artificial intelligence. Recent video generative models provide a data-driven route toward this goal by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions, and are increasingly regarded as potential next-generation game engines. Realizing a genuinely interactive game world, however, requires interaction outcomes that follow rules over evolving game conditions, consequences that persist over long horizons, and a generation loop that operates in real time. Conventional game engines realize these properties through a recurrent action-state-observation loop, in which player actions update an explicit game state according to predefined rules and observations are rendered from the resulting state. Taking this loop as an organizing lens, this paper examines interactive game world modeling along four dimensions: player action control, game state dynamics, state-observation persistence, and real-time interactive generation. For each dimension, we start from the capabilities required by an interactive game world, group existing approaches into representative families, and discuss the strengths and trade-offs of each family. Complementing this analysis, we present a scalable data engine for Black Myth: Wukong that collects over 90 hours of gameplay with frame-aligned player actions, ground-truth game states, and visual observations, together with structured and semantic annotations, as a resource for state-aware game world modeling. We hope this paper offers a clear picture of where the field stands and fosters progress toward interactive game worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从游戏引擎的视角重新思考交互式世界模型，提出将动作-状态-观测循环作为组织框架，从玩家动作控制、游戏状态动态、状态-观测持久性和实时交互生成四个维度分析现有方法，并介绍了《黑神话：悟空》的大规模数据引擎（90+小时游戏数据），旨在推动交互式游戏世界建模的发展。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型被视为潜在的游戏引擎，但难以实现遵循规则的交互结果、长期持久性和实时生成。
Method: 以游戏引擎的循环（动作→状态→观测）为框架，从四个维度综述现有方法，并构建包含帧对齐玩家动作、真实游戏状态和视觉观测的《黑神话：悟空》数据集。
Result: 收集了超过90小时的《黑神话：悟空》游戏数据，包含结构化与语义标注，支持状态感知的世界模型研究。
Conclusion: 提供了交互式游戏世界建模的现状图谱，并希望促进该领域进步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MetaPerch: Learning from metadata for bioacoustics foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Bioacoustic foundation models rely on large-scale citizen science platforms like Xeno-Canto for geographically and ecologically diverse data. Recent work has shown that supervision alone can produce SotA species detection models when trained on this large-scale data -- however, there remains unutilized potential in the form of recording metadata readily available within these community-driven data hubs. In this work, we explore the use of metadata -- such as location and time -- as auxiliary supervision signals, allowing the model to leverage species-metadata correlations in its learned representation. Auxiliary metadata losses provide additional information beyond vocalizations alone that can encourage a richer, more robust representation that generalizes better to species distribution and acoustic domain shifts -- important challenges for deployment in real-world passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) settings. We introduce MetaPerch, a new foundation model that achieves strong species identification performance across multiple challenging domains and present an extensive empirical study of the effects of 9 diverse metadata sources on 17 bioacoustic datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用公民科学平台Xeno-Canto中的记录元数据（如位置、时间）作为辅助监督信号，训练生物声学基础模型MetaPerch。实验表明，辅助元数据损失能提升模型对物种分布和声学领域偏移的泛化能力，在多个挑战性数据集上取得强物种识别性能，并系统研究了9种元数据源对17个数据集的影响。
Motivation: 现有生物声学基础模型仅利用音频监督，忽略了社区数据平台中丰富的元数据，这些元数据蕴含物种-环境关联，有助于提升模型在实际被动声学监测（PAM）中的泛化能力。
Method: 提出MetaPerch模型，在训练时引入基于位置、时间等元数据的辅助损失函数，使模型学习物种与元数据之间的相关性，从而获得更丰富、鲁棒的表示。
Result: MetaPerch在多个挑战性领域（如物种分布和声学领域偏移）上实现了强物种识别性能，并通过对9种元数据源和17个生物声学数据集的广泛实证研究验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用元数据作为辅助监督信号可有效提升生物声学基础模型对真实世界分布偏移的鲁棒性，对于实际被动声学监测部署具有重要意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Screening of Biosecurity Features in Metagenomic Data with Evo 2 Probes
papers.abstract_en: Genomic foundation models such as Evo 2 learn rich sequence representations, but their value for biosecurity screening is largely unexplored. We ask how much biosecurity-relevant signal is linearly accessible in these representations by training minimal linear and attention probes on frozen Evo 2 layer-26 activations, without fine-tuning the underlying model. Across held-out metagenomic test sets, the probes detect antimicrobial resistance (AMR) with strong discrimination: a linear probe reaches a region-level ROC-AUC of 0.888 (mean-pool), rising to 0.977 with a single-head attention probe. The probes resolve finer-grained AMR drug-class subcategories and separate them from unrelated functional genes, providing additional evidence that the learned signal is not explained solely by generic functional-gene status. Bacterial virulence is also decodable, though more weakly (region-level ROC-AUC 0.833). The AMR probe retains comparable ranking performance on simulated short reads without retraining, enabling evaluation before assembly in settings where assembly is computationally costly or unreliable. It achieves a read-level ROC-AUC of 0.898 (mean-pool), comparable to the mean-pooled full-region result. Within SynGenome, AMR-associated prompt labels are only weakly recoverable from Evo 1.5-generated sequences; these prompt-derived labels do not establish the function of the generated response sequences. A complementary sparse-autoencoder analysis recovers interpretable resistance-associated features but proves less consistent than the supervised probes. Together, these results position lightweight embedding-based probes as a fast, inexpensive first-pass detection layer for metagenomic biosurveillance and map both strengths and current limits of the approach. This work was conducted as part of the AIxBio Hackathon 2026 hosted by BlueDot Impact, Apart Research, and Cambridge Biosecurity Hub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Evo 2基因组基础模型的冻结层激活，训练线性探针和注意力探针，用于宏基因组数据中的生物安全特征筛查。探针在抗菌素耐药性（AMR）检测上达到区域级ROC-AUC 0.888（均值池化）和0.977（单头注意力），并能区分AMR药物子类别。细菌毒力检测较弱（ROC-AUC 0.833）。AMR探针在不重新训练的情况下对模拟短读序列保持可比性能。
Motivation: 基因组基础模型（如Evo 2）学习丰富的序列表示，但其在生物安全筛查中的价值尚未被充分探索。需要评估从这些表示中线性可提取的生物安全相关信号的强度。
Method: 在冻结的Evo 2第26层激活上训练最小线性探针和注意力探针，不微调底层模型。使用均值池化和单头注意力池化，在保留的宏基因组测试集上评估。还进行了稀疏自编码器分析。
Result: 线性探针在AMR区域级ROC-AUC达到0.888（均值池化），单头注意力探针升至0.977。细菌毒力区域级ROC-AUC为0.833。AMR探针在模拟短读序列上达到读级别ROC-AUC 0.898（均值池化）。
Conclusion: 基于轻量嵌入的探针可作为宏基因组生物监测中快速、廉价的一级检测层，但存在局限性，如从Evo 1.5生成序列中恢复AMR提示标签的效果较弱。

papers.title: Minimax Theory of Likelihood-Based Deep Learning for Speckle Regression
papers.abstract_en: Speckle noise is a multiplicative noise commonly encountered in coherent imaging modalities such as synthetic aperture radar, optical coherence tomography, and digital holography. Although deep learning methods, in practice, have achieved state-of-the-art performance for speckle denoising, their fundamental statistical limits remain largely unexplored. Unlike additive noise models, multiplicative speckle noise makes the regression function unidentifiable from the conditional mean, rendering conventional least-squares-based deep learning approaches inapplicable. We study the minimax estimation of smooth nonparametric regression functions using likelihood-based deep neural network (DNN) estimators under a model with both multiplicative speckle noise and additive Gaussian noise. Our framework accommodates both low-dimensional and sparse high-dimensional features. We establish finite-sample upper bounds on the estimation error of the proposed DNN estimators and derive minimax lower bounds for nonparametric function recovery under our model, showing that they match up to logarithmic factors in the sample size. Moreover, these minimax rates coincide, up to logarithmic factors, with those for nonparametric regression under additive Gaussian noise alone, demonstrating that the intrinsic difficulty of estimation remains essentially unchanged despite the challenges posed by multiplicative speckle noise. Numerical experiments further supports consistency of our DNN-based despeckling methods and demonstrate their effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于似然的深度神经网络估计器在乘性散斑噪声和加性高斯噪声混合模型下的极小极大最优性。作者证明了所提DNN估计器的有限样本上界，并推导出匹配的对数因子极小极大下界。结果表明，尽管乘性散斑噪声带来挑战，但估计的内在难度与仅含加性高斯噪声的非参数回归相比几乎不变。数值实验支持所提去斑方法的一致性。
Motivation: 散斑噪声是相干成像中的常见乘性噪声，深度学习方法在实际中表现优异，但其统计极限尚未被充分探索。由于散斑噪声使回归函数在条件均值下不可识别，传统最小二乘方法不适用，需要从似然角度建立理论框架。
Method: 考虑乘性散斑噪声与加性高斯噪声混合模型，使用基于似然的深度神经网络（DNN）估计器，覆盖低维和稀疏高维特征。
Result: 建立了DNN估计误差的有限样本上界，并推导出非参数函数恢复的极小极大下界，两者在样本量的对数因子内匹配。这些极小极大速率与仅含加性高斯噪声的非参数回归的速率在对数因子内一致。
Conclusion: 研究表明乘性散斑噪声并未从根本上增加估计难度，基于似然的DNN方法在理论上是最优的。数值实验验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: Deep Interaction: An Efficient Human-AI Interaction Method for Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, when errors occur, current interaction approaches typically involve re-generating another response that may make mistakes again, or users laboriously flag the faulty step in follow-up turns that may get responses <You are right, I made a mistake here> followed by similar errors recurring. To address this issue, we propose an efficient human intervention mechanism for precisely correcting reasoning errors in LLMs, termed Deep Interaction. Our approach enables direct editing of the original response, allowing erroneous parts to be corrected while preserving accurate reasoning steps. We refine the edited CoT into a distilled prompt, which then steers the LLM along the corrected reasoning path. Experimental results show that our method achieves over a 25% improvement in correction success rate and reduces token usage by approximately 40% on STEM tasks reasoning compared to baseline approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Interaction方法，允许用户直接编辑大语言模型的Chain-of-Thought推理中的错误步骤，保留正确部分，并将编辑后的推理路径提炼为提示来引导模型。在STEM推理任务上，该方法相比基线将修正成功率提高25%以上，并减少约40%的token消耗。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型在复杂多步推理中容易出错，现有交互方法要么重生成整个回答（可能重复犯错），要么要求用户逐轮指出错误但模型常表面认错后依旧重复错误。缺少高效、精准的纠错干预机制。
Method: 提出Deep Interaction：用户直接在原始模型输出上编辑错误的推理步骤，修正错误的同时保留正确步骤；然后将编辑后的CoT提炼为精简提示，用于引导模型沿正确路径继续推理。
Result: 在STEM推理任务上，该方法相比基线将纠正成功率提升超过25%，并且token使用量减少约40%。
Conclusion: 直接编辑原始响应并提炼正确推理路径是一种有效的人机协作纠错方式，可显著提高修正效率并降低计算开销。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Earthquaker-AI: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework with Rubric-Based Assessment for Primary School Earthquake Education
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Earthquaker-AI, a hybrid educational framework building upon a previously implemented educational robotics project by integrating a conversational AI assistant based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation. It aims to enhance earthquake preparedness and conscious action among primary-school students. The system extends the award-winning STEM project Earthquaker moving from mechanical simulation with Lego WeDo2 to cognitive and metacognitive processing. The robotics component uses Lego WeDo2 automation to simulate seismic response, letting students interact with sensors and actuators as tangible representations of protective actions. The assistant operates as a guided learning mechanism aligning student responses with safety guidelines, while providing rubric-based verbal feedback that supports self-regulated learning and calmness under emergency conditions. Earthquaker-AI follows a progressive learning trajectory aligned with cognitive development. In early grades, the focus is on basic recognition of safety actions through multiple-choice questions, assessed via a two-dimensional rubric. In middle grades, students identify correct action sequences through multiple-choice questions, evaluated via a three-axis rubric. In upper grades, the approach shifts to verbal production, requiring short written responses assessed via a four-dimensional rubric that includes clarity of expression. The dialogic module uses RAG to match student queries semantically with official guidelines, generating safe, accurate responses. Experimental evaluation shows high groundedness and accuracy, with a low hallucination rate. Overall, Earthquaker-AI combines hands-on engagement, information processing, and reflective practice. Combining robotics, rubrics, and AI promotes technological literacy, self-regulation, and responsible use of digital systems, contributing to early crisis-management skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Earthquaker-AI 是一个结合检索增强生成（RAG）和基于量规的评估框架，用于小学地震教育。系统扩展了之前的 Lego WeDo2 机器人项目，通过机器人模拟地震响应，并利用对话式 AI 助手根据官方安全指南提供语义匹配的反馈。实验评估显示高准确性和低幻觉率。
Motivation: 现有地震教育多依赖静态教材或纯机器人模拟，缺乏认知和元认知层面的互动指导，难以培养学生在紧急情况下的自我调节学习能力。
Method: 提出 Earthquaker-AI 混合框架，包含 Lego WeDo2 机器人组件和基于 RAG 的对话助手。机器人模拟地震响应，助手通过语义匹配学生查询与官方安全指南，并采用三维维度量规（早期二维、中期三维、高年级四维）评估学生回答，提供口头反馈。
Result: 实验表明系统具有高接地性和准确性，低幻觉率。
Conclusion: Earthquaker-AI 通过结合动手操作、信息处理和反思实践，促进了技术素养、自我调节和危机管理技能的早期培养。

papers.title: AI-accelerated End-to-End Framework for Rapid Professional Upskilling
papers.abstract_en: By 2030, 59 of every 100 workers will need reskilling or upskilling, yet the average time to close an enterprise skills gap grew from roughly 3 days in 2014 to 36 days in 2018. Most current frameworks accelerate single stages of upskilling programs and generally lack industry validation. We present an end-to-end framework that applies AI acceleration across five stages of knowledge acquisition, content development, content review and verification, teaching, and assessment development; with a strong focus on both production and learning efficiency. Three strong external signals validates the framework: the US National Association of State Boards of Accountancy reviewed and approved an upskilling program built on the framework for continuing-professional-education credits; 3 learners followed the program and passed the NVIDIA Certified Professional in Agentic AI exam in a significantly short amount of time, with 14 more in progress; the program's knowledge base supports complex downstream analysis such as the production of a robust 1,267 risk item dataset for managing multi-agent AI system risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端的AI加速框架，覆盖知识获取、内容开发、审核验证、教学和评估开发五个阶段，旨在快速提升专业技能。该框架已获得美国州会计委员会对继续教育项目的认可，并有3名学习者通过NVIDIA认证考试，展示了其有效性。
Motivation: 到2030年，每100名工人中有59人需要重新培训或提升技能，但企业技能差距的关闭时间从2014年的约3天增长到2018年的36天，现有框架大多只加速单阶段且缺乏行业验证。
Method: 提出一个端到端框架，在五个阶段（知识获取、内容开发、内容审核与验证、教学、评估开发）中应用AI加速，兼顾生产效率和学习效率。
Result: 该框架得到三个外部信号验证：美国州会计委员会批准了基于该框架的继续教育项目；3名学习者通过NVIDIA认证考试（另有14人在学）；知识库支持生成了包含1267个风险项的用于管理多智能体AI系统风险的数据集。
Conclusion: 框架在缩短技能提升时间方面显示出潜力，但摘要未提及局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: Multi-Expert Routing for Multi-Domain Low-Resource OCR: A Manchu Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Historical Manchu OCR must accommodate various visually distinct writing styles, including regular script, running script, and the semi-cursive chancery hand used in palace memorials, despite limited labeled data. We study a multi-expert system that reuses checkpoints from an iterative fine-tuning process as domain specialists and uses a lightweight page-level image classifier to dispatch pages by visual style. When the checkpoint pool lacks a suitable specialist, we train an additional expert for that domain. On three frozen test sets, the routed system matches the selected specialist for each style at two-decimal precision: 0.30 percent CER on regular script, 1.57 percent on memorials, and 4.83 percent on running script. The router achieves 99.3 percent page-level domain accuracy and matches the domain-label oracle at the same precision. Two of the three selected specialists were not trained specifically for their final domain; only the running-script expert was trained with that domain as its target. We report the evaluation protocol, router design, and per-page predictions to make the comparison reproducible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多领域低资源OCR中的多专家路由，以满语历史文献为例。针对满语不同书写风格（楷书、行书、半草书）且标注数据有限的问题，提出复用迭代微调过程中的检查点作为领域专家，并使用轻量级页面级图像分类器按视觉风格分配页面。当专家池缺少合适专家时，额外训练该领域专家。在三个冻结测试集上，路由系统在两位小数精度上匹配所选专家：楷书CER 0.30%，奏折1.57%，行书4.83%。路由器达到99.3%的页面级领域准确率，且与领域标签oracle精度相同。报告了评估协议、路由器设计和逐页面预测以实现可复现比较。
Motivation: 历史满语OCR面临多种视觉上不同的书写风格，且标注数据有限，需要一种能利用少量数据适应不同风格的方法。
Method: 提出多专家路由系统，复用迭代微调过程中的检查点作为领域专家，训练轻量级页面级图像分类器来按视觉风格分配页面，必要时额外训练专家。
Result: 在三个测试集上，路由系统以两位小数精度匹配所选专家：楷书CER 0.30%，奏折1.57%，行书4.83%；路由器页面级领域准确率99.3%，与oracle精度相同。
Conclusion: 多专家路由方法能有效处理低资源多领域OCR任务，且路由器性能接近oracle，使系统可扩展至新领域。

papers.title: Early Adoption of Agentic Coding Tools by GitHub Projects
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding tools are increasingly capable of generating and submitting pull requests (PRs) to software projects, introducing new forms of human-agent collaboration in software development. While prior studies have examined PR-level outcomes of agent-generated contributions, less is known about how agentic coding tools are adopted and managed at the project level. In this paper, we analyze 25,264 agentic PRs from 2,361 popular GitHub repositories to investigate (1) the adoption of agentic coding tools, (2) project-level agentic PR productivity, and (3) human-agent collaboration patterns. Our results show that the median repository generates only one to two agentic PRs during a three-month period, indicating that intensive adoption remains concentrated in a small subset of projects. At the same time, small projects (1-5 contributors) exhibit higher participation ratios and average levels of agentic PR activity than medium-sized and large projects. We also observe substantial variation in project-level agentic PR productivity. While a small number of projects exceed an industry-reported estimate of 36 PRs per participant during the three-month observation period, most projects remain below this threshold. Finally, human-agent collaboration is dominated by a single-human oversight model, in which one developer reviews and/or modifies the agent's contributions, while multi-human collaboration patterns remain uncommon. These findings provide early empirical evidence on how open-source projects organize human oversight around agentic coding tools and suggest that successful integration of agent-generated contributions depends not only on advances in agent capabilities but also on the human and organizational processes that govern their use. Because this study captures an early snapshot of agent adoption, future work should continue to track how adoption patterns evolve over time.
papers.comment: Accepted at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析 GitHub 上 2,361 个流行仓库中的 25,264 个智能体拉取请求，研究智能体编码工具的采用情况、项目级智能体 PR 生产力和人机协作模式。结果发现，多数仓库在三个月内仅产生 1-2 个智能体 PR，采用率集中在小部分项目；小项目参与比例和 PR 活动水平高于中大型项目；人机协作以单人监督模式为主。
Motivation: 尽管已有研究关注智能体生成的 PR 结果，但较少从项目层面了解智能体编码工具的采用和管理方式，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 收集 2,361 个流行 GitHub 仓库中 25,264 个智能体 PR，进行统计分析，考察采用率、PR 生产率和协作模式。
Result: 中位仓库在三个月内仅产生 1-2 个智能体 PR；小项目（1-5 贡献者）的参与比例和平均 PR 活动高于中大型项目；多数项目 PR 生产力低于行业估计（36 PRs/参与者）；协作模式以单人监督为主。
Conclusion: 成功整合智能体生成的贡献不仅依赖智能体能力提升，还取决于管理其使用的人工和组织流程；本研究为早期采用提供了实证，未来应追踪采用模式的演变。

papers.title: Improving Wind and Solar Power Prediction with Efficient Wrapper-based Feature Selection: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: With rising global energy demand and growing awareness of climate change and its impacts, the share of renewable energies in the global energy mix continues to grow. Unlike conventional power generation, the output of renewable energy sources cannot be controlled as consistently due to their dependence on environmental conditions. Therefore, reliable prediction of current and future energy production is essential. In this paper, we report findings from two structured literature reviews on real-world renewable energy prediction tasks: wind turbine power curve modeling and photovoltaic power prediction. For the former, we conducted a comprehensive literature review ourselves, while for the latter, we synthesize the key findings regarding frequently selected input features based on an existing survey. Across both domains, our analysis reveals that despite the large number of available monitoring and environmental variables, only limited or unsystematic methods for feature selection exist. To address this gap, we propose Cluster-based Sequential Feature Selection (CSFS), a novel, model-agnostic, clustering-based wrapper method for automatic, efficient, and reliable feature selection in renewable energy prediction pipelines. To support reproducibility and reuse, we provide an open-source implementation of CSFS on GitHub. We empirically evaluate the proposed approach on both use cases and compare it with established feature selection techniques such as wrapper-based sequential feature selection (SFS), filter-based methods, and Random Forest's embedded feature importance. The results show that the wrapper-based methods overall provide better-performing selections of features. CSFS achieves a predictive performance comparable to SFS while reducing computational cost by an average of 21%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对风能和太阳能预测中特征选择方法缺失的问题，提出基于聚类的序列特征选择（CSFS）方法，在两篇文献综述基础上进行实证研究。CSFS是一种模型无关的包装器方法，旨在实现自动、高效且可靠的特征选择。实验表明，CSFS在预测性能上与传统的序列特征选择（SFS）相当，同时平均计算成本降低21%。
Motivation: 现有可再生能源预测中，尽管有大量监测和环境变量，但特征选择方法有限且缺乏系统性，导致预测效率低下。
Method: 提出Cluster-based Sequential Feature Selection (CSFS)，一种基于聚类的包装器特征选择方法，通过聚类减少搜索空间，提高效率。同时提供开源实现。
Result: CSFS在风电机组功率曲线建模和光伏功率预测两个用例中，与SFS相比预测性能相当，计算成本平均降低21%。
Conclusion: 包装器方法整体上能提供更好的特征选择，CSFS在保证预测性能的同时显著降低计算开销。

papers.title: Transforming Rank: How Architecture Navigates the Spectral Pathologies of Depth
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how each component of the Transformer feedforward block architecture design determines how much rank survives across depth at initialization. We reinterpret skip connections and normalization, long understood as controlling magnitude, as mechanisms for preserving gradient rank across depth, since the very matrix multiplications and nonlinear activations that make the network expressive also reduce the rank. We show that skip connections trade off rank collapse against ensemble-like behavior, controlled by the relative scales of the branch and the skip: skip connections route the gradient around the residual branch, where rank is lost, rather than along the long gradient paths that encourage the layers to compose. The placement of the normalization layer controls this same tradeoff by setting the branch-to-skip ratio across depth, unifying much of the normalization placement and depth scaling literature, in particular why rank collapses for Post-Norm but plateaus for Pre-Norm. Other aspects of the architecture, like the two-matrix structure that expands and contracts the width, use additional parameters to preserve the representation or branch Jacobian rank. The second matrix decorrelates a coherent mean spike that would grow across blocks with a single matrix and uncentered activation, preventing the residual representation from collapsing. The width expansion between the two matrices keeps the branch Jacobian full rank: applying the rank-reducing activation in this expanded space leaves enough directions to span the original, at a width that follows a Marchenko--Pastur law. The initialization rank of the input--output Jacobian predicts which networks train on CIFAR-10. Taken together, we recast architecture design for deep networks as navigating an intrinsic tradeoff among rank collapse, ensemble-like behavior, and parameter count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer前馈块中每个架构组件如何影响初始化时秩随深度保留的程度。作者将跳跃连接和归一化重新解释为保持梯度秩的机制，并展示跳跃连接在秩坍缩与集成行为之间权衡，而归一层放置通过设置分支与跳跃的比率控制该权衡。两矩阵结构（宽度扩展与收缩）以及激活函数在扩展空间中的应用，进一步保持表示或分支雅可比矩阵的满秩。输入-输出雅可比矩阵的初始化秩可预测CIFAR-10上的训练性能。
Motivation: 深层网络中的矩阵乘法和非线性激活会降低秩，导致秩坍缩，而跳跃连接和归一化等组件被理解为控制幅度，但其对秩的影响尚未系统研究。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，重新审视Transformer前馈块中各组件（跳跃连接、归一化、两矩阵结构、激活函数、宽度扩展）对初始化秩的影响，将架构设计视为在秩坍缩、集成行为和参数数量之间的权衡。
Result: 跳跃连接通过绕过残差分支保留梯度秩；归一层放置通过设置分支与跳跃比率统一解释Post-Norm秩坍缩和Pre-Norm秩平台；第二矩阵去相干单矩阵时的均值尖峰；宽度扩展遵循Marchenko-Pastur定律保持分支雅可比满秩；输入-输出雅可比初始化秩预测CIFAR-10训练能力。
Conclusion: 深层网络架构设计本质上是导航秩坍缩、集成行为与参数数量之间的内在权衡，跳跃连接和归一化的作用可统一理解为调控梯度秩的保存。

papers.title: Lighthouse RL: Sample-Efficient Circuit Optimization via Strategic Reset Points
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Lighthouse RL, a sample-efficient reinforcement learning (RL) approach for analog circuit sizing. Traditional methods lack generalization across different performance targets, while standard RL approaches waste resources exploring unpromising regions. Our method addresses these inefficiencies through a strategic reset strategy that initializes episodes from high-performing configurations discovered during training, called "lighthouses". These states, which are closer to the target objectives, guide exploration toward promising regions. When compared to RL and Bayesian optimization methods from the literature, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a 2D benchmark problem and on two analog circuits, showing significant improvements in sample efficiency (up to 1.72x faster), optimization performance (100% vs. 0-87% success rate), generalization (75% vs. 0-50% extrapolation success), and objective maximization. This efficiency is particularly valuable for computationally expensive black-box optimization problems, and our reset strategy can be used as a plug-and-play enhancement for any RL-based optimization approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Lighthouse RL，一种基于战略重置点的样本高效强化学习方法，用于模拟电路尺寸优化。该方法从训练中发现的高性能配置（称为“灯塔”）初始化回合，引导探索向有前景的区域，从而避免在无希望区域浪费资源。在2D基准问题和两个模拟电路上，该方法相较于传统RL和贝叶斯优化方法，实现了样本效率提升（最高1.72倍）、优化成功率100%（对比0-87%）、泛化成功率75%（对比0-50%）和目标最大化方面的显著改进。该重置策略可作为即插即用增强模块用于任何基于RL的优化方法。
Motivation: 传统模拟电路尺寸优化方法缺乏跨性能目标的泛化能力，而标准RL方法在探索无希望区域时浪费资源，导致样本效率低下。
Method: 提出一种战略重置策略，从训练过程中发现的高性能状态（“灯塔”）初始化每个回合，使探索更接近目标区域，并可作为即插即用模块集成到任意RL优化方法中。
Result: 在实验中，该方法相比文献中的RL和贝叶斯优化方法，样本效率提升高达1.72倍，优化成功率从0-87%提升至100%，泛化成功率从0-50%提升至75%，同时实现目标最大化。
Conclusion: 该重置策略能显著提高样本效率和优化性能，尤其适用于计算昂贵的黑箱优化问题，并且可推广至其他基于RL的优化方法。

papers.title: Rethinking Penetration Testing for AI-Enabled Systems: From Resource Compromise to Behavioral Objective Violation
papers.abstract_en: Penetration testing traditionally evaluates whether adversaries can exploit weaknesses in software, infrastructure, configurations, or operational controls to achieve security-relevant compromise. This paradigm remains necessary for AI-enabled systems, but it is no longer sufficient. In such systems, adversaries may influence prompts, retrieved content, sensor inputs, training data, memory, tools, or human-AI interaction loops to alter system behavior without directly compromising the underlying infrastructure. This paper reframes penetration testing for AI-enabled systems as objective-driven behavioral evaluation. We define an AI-enabled system as one in which learned models materially influence behavior affecting operational outcomes, and we define AI-enabled penetration as the feasible induction of AI-governed behavior that violates one or more operational objectives under an explicit threat model. This definition preserves conventional penetration testing while extending it to adversarial pathways such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, data poisoning, sensor manipulation, retrieval poisoning, tool misuse, and agentic misalignment. We further propose a testing workflow that identifies operational objectives, maps AI-governed behavior, analyzes adversarial influence surfaces, defines behavioral failure criteria, executes scenario-based tests, and reports evidence linking adversarial action to objective violation. A running example involving an AI-enabled security operations center assistant illustrates how penetration may occur through behavioral influence rather than infrastructure compromise. Together, the definitions, workflow, and example provide a technical framework for evaluating adversarial success in deployed AI-enabled systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定义了AI系统的渗透测试，从传统的资源妥协转向评估对手是否能够通过操纵输入（如提示、传感器数据等）使AI行为违反操作目标。提出了一个测试工作流，并举例说明。
Motivation: 传统渗透测试对AI系统不足，因为对手可能不直接攻击基础设施，而是通过影响AI行为来违反目标。
Method: 提出了一个测试工作流，包括识别操作目标、映射AI主导行为、分析对抗影响面、定义行为失败标准、执行场景测试、报告证据。
Result: 论文提供了定义、工作流和例子，构成评估AI系统对抗成功的技术框架。
Conclusion: 强调渗透测试需要扩展到行为目标违反，并提供了框架。

summary_sections.result: 论文提供了定义、工作流和例子，构成评估AI系统对抗成功的技术框架。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强调渗透测试需要扩展到行为目标违反，并提供了框架。

papers.title: M$^\text{4}$World: A Multi-view Multimodal Driving World Model for Interactive Object Manipulation and Minute-long Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Driving-world generation has emerged as a core capability for scalable autonomous-driving simulation, yet existing methods remain limited in object-level controllability and long-horizon stability. We present M$^\text{4}$World, a Multi-view and Multimodal generative driving world model that synthesizes future surround-view video streams and synchronized LiDAR scans while supporting interactive object Manipulation and stable Minute-long streaming. Fine-grained object manipulation is realized through a flexible conditioning interface that supports explicit control over both the spatial layout and visual appearance of individual objects. Stable minute-long streaming, on the other hand, is achieved through a multi-stage training framework that enables online causal generation in only four denoising steps while maintaining coherent world dynamics throughout extended rollouts. Building on these components, we introduce an efficient few-clip post-training as well as a suite of visual reference-conditioned generation models, preserving general generation ability while allowing rare-case customization for long-tail controllability. To assess controllability beyond realism, we further introduce an automated VLM-based judging pipeline that evaluates scene-level condition adherence, view-wise object controllability, and cross-view object consistency. Comprehensive experiments show that M$^\text{4}$World consistently delivers high generation quality, precise controllability, and stable minute-long streaming. Together with downstream long-tail augmentation and scene editing, these results demonstrate the potential of M$^\text{4}$World for controllable, scalable driving simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 M⁴World，一个多视角多模态驾驶世界模型，能够合成未来的环绕视图视频流和同步的 LiDAR 扫描，支持交互式对象操控和分钟级稳定流生成。通过灵活的 conditioning 接口实现细粒度对象操控，并通过多阶段训练框架在仅四个去噪步骤中实现在线因果生成，保持长时间滚动的连贯世界动态。还引入了少量剪辑的后训练和视觉参考条件生成模型，以支持长尾可控性。实验表明，M⁴World 在生成质量、精确可控性和分钟级稳定流方面表现出色。
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界生成方法在对象级可控性和长时稳定性方面存在局限，难以支持可扩展的自动驾驶仿真。
Method: 提出多视角多模态生成式驾驶世界模型，通过灵活的 conditioning 接口支持对象空间布局和外观的显式控制；采用多阶段训练框架，在四个去噪步骤中实现在线因果生成并保持连贯世界动态；引入少量剪辑后训练和视觉参考条件生成模型以增强长尾可控性。
Result: 综合实验表明，M⁴World 在生成质量、精确可控性和分钟级稳定流方面持续表现出色，并通过 VLM 评估证明了场景级条件遵守、视角对象可控性和跨视角对象一致性。
Conclusion: M⁴World 展示了在可控、可扩展的驾驶仿真方面的潜力，适用于长尾增强和场景编辑等下游任务。

papers.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
papers.abstract_en: Most reported gains from agent-optimization methods are one-shot: an agent is optimized against a fixed benchmark and the resulting improvement is reported as if it were a stable property of the method. This does not test the setting that matters for deployed agents, where optimization is applied recursively as new failures and new tasks appear over time. The central question this raises is whether optimizer-driven gains compound: after an agent has been optimized once, can it be optimized again on newly arrived tasks without eroding the gains the first round produced? We study this question with a two-phase continual-learning evaluation built from hard tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.0, comparing three approaches to agent-harness optimization (GEPA, Meta Harness, and RELAI's Verifiable Continual Learning, RELAI-VCL) under identical optimization budgets. All three methods improve over the baseline agent in the conventional, static, single-phase setting. However, once new tasks are introduced, the methods diverge sharply: GEPA's optimized agent transfers below the unoptimized baseline, Meta Harness transfers well but fails to improve further once given a second optimization budget, and RELAI-VCL is the only method that both transfers positively to unseen tasks and continues improving after those tasks are folded into the optimization objective, reaching the highest pass rate at every evaluated stage and the highest lifelong average pass rate overall (76.4% vs. 66.0% for GEPA, 64.6% for Meta Harness, and 58.7% for the baseline). Our key observation was that optimization gains compounded only when regression control was built into the optimization loop, providing an inductive bias against shortcut solutions that fail to generalize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体优化方法的持续学习能力提出评估框架，发现大多数方法在单次优化后面对新任务时无法保持增益。通过在Terminal-Bench 2.0上的两阶段实验（三种优化方法GEPA、Meta Harness、RELAI-VCL），只有内置回归控制的RELAI-VCL能在新任务上正向迁移并继续提升，达到最高终身平均通过率76.4%，而其他方法效果下降。
Motivation: 现有智能体优化评估多为单次静态测试，不反映实际部署中反复优化、新任务涌现的真实场景，缺少对优化增益是否可持续（复合）的研究。
Method: 设计两阶段持续学习评估：第一阶段在固定任务集上优化智能体，第二阶段引入新任务并允许再次优化；对比GEPA、Meta Harness和RELAI-VCL三种优化器，控制相同预算。
Result: RELAI-VCL在终身平均通过率上达到76.4%，显著高于GEPA（66.0%）、Meta Harness（64.6%）和基线（58.7%），且是唯一能在新任务上正向转移并继续提升的方法。
Conclusion: 优化增益的复合需要将回归控制内建于优化循环，以抑制无法泛化的捷径解；否则单次增益可能被后续优化侵蚀。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lyapunov Exponent as Physics-Informed Dense Reward: RL Discovery of Stabilization Beyond the Kapitza Pendulum
papers.abstract_en: We suggest using the Lyapunov characteristic exponent (LCE) as a dense reward signal for the reinforcement learning problem of stabilizing the inverted pendulum with vertical motion. With LCE, the agent not only successfully found the oscillatory motion known as the Kapitza pendulum but also damped the pendulum's pivoting, leaving it in a strictly upright position.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将李雅普诺夫特征指数（LCE）作为密集奖励信号用于强化学习稳定倒立摆问题。该方法不仅成功复现了Kapitza摆的振荡运动，还能进一步抑制摆动使摆锤严格保持竖直。
Motivation: 强化学习在倒立摆稳定问题中通常缺乏有效的奖励设计。本文尝试利用LCE作为物理启发的密集奖励来指导智能体发现更优的稳定策略。
Method: 使用李雅普诺夫特征指数（LCE）作为强化学习中的密集奖励信号，训练智能体稳定带有竖直运动的倒立摆。
Result: 智能体不仅发现了Kapitza摆的振荡稳定模式，还找到了将摆锤直接稳定在竖直位置的阻尼策略。
Conclusion: LCE作为物理信息奖励可以有效引导强化学习发现超出经典Kapitza摆的稳定行为。

papers.title: The Dynamic Verifiable Multi-Agent Human Agentic Loyalty Loop (DVM-HALL) Model and the Net Human-Agent Score (NHAS) in Autonomous Commerce
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of Agentic Artificial Intelligence fundamentally disrupts traditional customer loyalty paradigms. As AI evolves from passive recommendation algorithms to autonomous, goal-directed agents capable of executing purchasing decisions, the conventional understanding of consumer-brand relationships requires a structural reevaluation. By synthesizing extant literature across human-machine teaming, consumer decision-making, and algorithmic trust dynamics, we demonstrate that traditional loyalty models fail to account for algorithmic bounded rationality and constructed autonomy. To address this, we introduce the Dynamic Verifiable Multi-Agent Human Agentic Loyalty Loop (DVM-HALL) model. We formalize brand choice via a softmax probability formulation where human emotional equity, agentic machine-experience utility, calibrated trust, delegated authority, and verifiable execution jointly determine selection. The model features recursive updating mechanisms to dynamically calibrate trust and delegation after each interaction. Crucially, the framework integrates a verifiable execution layer for Decentralized Finance (DeFi) and tokenized loyalty settings, incorporating execution risks -- such as gas costs, slippage, MEV exposure, and smart-contract vulnerabilities -- as core predictors of agentic brand preference. Furthermore, we introduce the Net Human-Agent Score (NHAS), an auditable, risk-weighted metric designed to measure human-agent alignment using human feedback, execution logs, benchmark comparisons, and verifiable receipts. Finally, we propose a comprehensive three-stage empirical validation plan spanning controlled shopping experiments, multi-agent market simulations, and DeFi testbeds. This framework provides the foundational theory required for brands to navigate the impending transition toward machine customers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主AI代理颠覆传统客户忠诚度范式的挑战，提出动态可验证多智能体人类代理忠诚度循环（DVM-HALL）模型。该模型通过软最大概率形式化品牌选择，融合人类情感权益、代理机器体验效用、校准信任、授权和可验证执行，并引入净人类代理评分（NHAS）作为可审计风险加权指标。目前为理论框架，规划了三阶段实证验证。
Motivation: 传统客户忠诚度模型未能考虑AI代理的算法有限理性和构造自主性，无法适应从被动推荐到自主决策代理的转变。
Method: 提出DVM-HALL模型，包括：基于软最大概率的品牌选择形式、递归信任校准机制、集成DeFi执行风险的可验证执行层，以及NHAS指标。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，仅提出三阶段验证计划：受控购物实验、多智能体市场模拟和DeFi测试台。
Conclusion: 该框架为品牌在机器客户时代管理忠诚度提供理论基础，强调可验证执行和风险加权评价的重要性。

papers.title: TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn agents solve complex tasks through extended sequences of tool interactions before producing a final answer, making credit assignment a fundamental challenge during post-training. Outcome rewards provide reliable supervision for short-horizon reasoning, but become sparse and high-variance as trajectories grow to tens or hundreds of tool calls. They can also be misleading: a failed rollout may contain many useful actions that move the agent closer to the goal, yet outcome-only training assigns them the same negative advantage as the eventual mistake. We propose TRACE (Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation), a dense credit-assignment method for agentic reinforcement learning. TRACE represents rollouts as state transitions at tool-call boundaries, obtains gold-answer log-probabilities from a frozen reference model, transforms them into log-ratio state values, and derives per-action rewards as Temporal-Difference changes in those values. This requires no additional critic or process-label training, and its one-step log-ratio TD component telescopes across redundant tool calls. On long-horizon complex search, TRACE substantially improves base-model tool-use ability using pure RL, without a cold-start supervised fine-tuning stage, an agentic mid-training stage, or training on live-web data. On the closed-web BrowseComp-Plus benchmark, it raises Qwen3-4B from $7.2$ to $35.6$ and Qwen3-30B-A3B from $8.4$ to $42.6$. The learned search behavior also transfers to open-web benchmarks, and the learning curves show earlier improvement and faster convergence during RL training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE，一种无需额外critic或过程标签的密集信用分配方法，用于多轮工具交互的智能体强化学习。TRACE利用冻结参考模型的对数概率生成状态值，并通过时序差分误差为每一步动作分配奖励。在复杂搜索任务中，TRACE显著提升了Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-30B-A3B在BrowseComp-Plus基准上的性能，且学习曲线显示更早的改进和更快的收敛。
Motivation: 在长程智能体任务中，轨迹包含数十或数百次工具调用，结果奖励稀疏、方差大，且可能误导：失败轨迹中许多有用动作被赋予与最终错误相同的负优势。
Method: TRACE将轨迹表示为工具调用边界处的状态转移，从冻结参考模型获取答案的对数概率，转换为对数比值状态值，再使用时序差分（TD）变化导出每个动作的奖励。该方法无需额外critic或过程标签训练，且单步对数比值TD分量在冗余工具调用中可递推消除。
Result: 在闭网BrowseComp-Plus基准上，TRACE将Qwen3-4B从7.2提升至35.6，将Qwen3-30B-A3B从8.4提升至42.6。学习曲线显示更早的改进和更快的收敛，且学习到的搜索行为可转移到开放网络基准。
Conclusion: TRACE提供了一种高效的信用分配方法，使得纯强化学习即可显著提升基础模型的工具使用能力，无需冷启动监督微调、智能体中间训练或实时网络数据。

papers.title: Task-Specific Feature Fusion Method for Multi-Task Affective Behavior Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The 11th Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-wild (ABAW11) Multi-Task Learning Challenge requires a unified system to predict valence-arousal, categorical expressions, and facial action units from the official s-Aff-Wild2 images. Although these tasks are naturally related through facial behavior, our validation experiments show that they benefit from different visual features, temporal processing strategies, fusion mechanisms, and calibration procedures. In this paper, we study task-adaptive feature fusion for ABAW11 multi-task affective behavior analysis. We first adapt two pretrained visual backbones, DINOv2 ViT-L and DINOv3 ConvNeXt-base, on an external expression-oriented facial image set and then freeze them to extract complementary frame-level features from the official ABAW11 data. On top of these frozen features, we systematically compare frame-level prediction heads, temporal convolutional heads, post-hoc temporal smoothing, LightGBM models, feature concatenation, gated fusion, residual fusion, late logit fusion, threshold calibration, and shared MTL structures. The final system selects task-specific fusion and prediction strategies rather than forcing all tasks to share a single architecture. On the ABAW11 validation set, the selected system achieves an EXPR macro-F1 of 0.4222, an AU macro-F1 of 0.5402, and a mean VA CCC of 0.6717, resulting in an overall validation score of 1.6341. The results suggest that task-adaptive fusion of frozen visual features is a simple and effective strategy for ABAW-style multi-task affective behavior analysis.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ABAW11多任务情感行为分析挑战，提出了任务特定的特征融合方法。作者比较了多种视觉骨干网络、时间处理策略、融合机制和校准方法，最终为每个任务选择特定的融合和预测策略，而不是强制所有任务共享同一架构。在验证集上，系统在EXPR、AU和VA任务上取得了一定分数，表明任务自适应融合冻结视觉特征是有效策略。
Motivation: ABAW11挑战要求统一系统预测多个情感相关任务，但验证实验显示不同任务受益于不同的视觉特征、时间处理策略、融合机制和校准过程，因而需要任务自适应特征融合方法。
Method: 首先在两个预训练视觉骨干DINOv2 ViT-L和DINOv3 ConvNeXt-base上，用外部表情图像集进行微调后冻结，提取互补的帧级特征。然后系统比较多种帧级预测头、时间卷积头、后处理时序平滑、LightGBM模型、特征拼接、门控融合、残差融合、后期logit融合、阈值校准和共享MTL结构。最终为每个任务选择特定的融合和预测策略。
Result: 在ABAW11验证集上，最终系统EXPR macro-F1为0.4222，AU macro-F1为0.5402，VA CCC平均为0.6717，总体验证分数为1.6341。
Conclusion: 作者指出任务自适应融合冻结视觉特征是简单有效的ABAW式多任务情感行为分析策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multimodal Empirical Bayes Variational Autoencoders for Joint Longitudinal and Time-to-Event Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal tumor measurements, dropout information, and genetic covariates provide complementary information about treatment response, but integrating these data sources within a single population modeling framework remains challenging. We extend the empirical Bayes variational autoencoder (EB-VAE) framework to joint longitudinal and time-to-event modeling and evaluate it on tumor growth data. The framework represents inter-individual variability using latent individual effects regularized by a covariate-conditioned empirical Bayes prior, while a decoder maps these latent effects to tumor-volume trajectories. To account for informative dropout, the decoder was augmented with a hazard model, yielding joint predictions of tumor growth and time to dropout. We further compared fully neural and hybrid semi-mechanistic decoder formulations and incorporated genomic covariates through a genetics-conditioned prior adaptation. The hybrid decoder recovered treatment-effect parameters broadly consistent with previously reported nonlinear mixed-effects estimates, while achieving prior predictive performance comparable to the neural decoder. The joint model reproduced both tumor-volume distributions and dropout patterns in held-out individuals, and genetic conditioning improved individual-level prior predictions in both cutaneous melanoma and breast cancer experiments. Stability selection identified several biologically plausible genetic indicators, including alterations in BRAF, NRAS, NF1, and MDM2. These results demonstrate that EB-VAE provides a flexible probabilistic framework for combining neural dynamics, mechanistic structure, time-to-event modeling, and high-dimensional covariates in pharmacometric applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了经验贝叶斯变分自编码器（EB-VAE）框架，用于联合建模纵向肿瘤测量和事件时间数据（如脱落时间）。框架通过潜在个体效应表示个体间变异，并用协变量条件的经验贝叶斯先验进行正则化，解码器同时预测肿瘤体积轨迹和脱落风险。在黑色素瘤和乳腺癌数据上，混合半机理解码器恢复了与非线性混合效应模型一致的治疗效应参数，且联合模型能复现个体外患者的肿瘤体积分布和脱落模式。遗传条件化改进了个体水平先验预测，稳定性选择识别出BRAF、NRAS等生物学合理的遗传指标。
Motivation: 纵向肿瘤测量、脱落信息和遗传协变量提供了互补的治疗反应信息，但在单一群体建模框架中整合这些数据源仍具挑战。
Method: 提出多模态EB-VAE框架，使用经验贝叶斯先验正则化潜在个体效应，解码器结合肿瘤体积轨迹预测和危害模型处理信息性脱落，并引入遗传条件化先验适应。比较了全神经网络和混合半机理解码器。
Result: 混合解码器恢复的治疗效应参数与先前非线性混合效应估计一致，先验预测性能与神经网络解码器相当。联合模型在个体外患者中复现了肿瘤体积分布和脱落模式，遗传条件化改善了先验预测。稳定性选择识别出BRAF、NRAS、NF1、MDM2等遗传指标。
Conclusion: EB-VAE为药理学应用中结合神经动力学、机理结构、事件时间建模和高维协变量提供了灵活的概率框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Screening Is Effective for Visual Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformer (ViT) has been widely used as a powerful framework for modeling global dependencies among image patches. However, its core component, self-attention assigns softmax-normalized relative weights to all patches, making it difficult to evaluate the relevance between patches independently. In visual recognition, images often contain many background or redundant patches, yet self-attention cannot explicitly reject such irrelevant patches, which may introduce unnecessary information into feature aggregation. To address this limitation, Screening has been proposed in the field of language modeling, where the relevance of each token is independently evaluated based on query-key similarity and low-relevance tokens are explicitly excluded through thresholding. In this work, we propose VisionScreen, a new vision model that extends Screening mechanism to visual recognition. VisionScreen treats image patches as tokens arranged on a two-dimensional grid and extends absolute relevance estimation based on query-key similarity to the two-dimensional spatial domain. This allows each patch to selectively aggregate only content-wise and spatially relevant patches without relying on competition among patches. Experiments on image classification benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional ViT. These results suggest that Screening can be effective for visual recognition, offering an alternative to relative feature aggregation based on softmax attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VisionScreen，将语言建模中的Screening机制扩展到视觉识别，通过独立评估每个图像块与查询的相似性并显式排除低相关块，替代了传统ViT中基于softmax的相对特征聚合。在图像分类基准上，该方法优于传统ViT。
Motivation: ViT的自注意力机制为所有块分配softmax归一化权重，难以独立评估块间相关性，且无法显式排除背景或冗余块，可能引入无关信息影响特征聚合。
Method: VisionScreen将图像块视为二维网格上的token，基于查询-键相似性进行绝对相关性评估，并通过阈值显式排除低相关块，使每个块仅聚合内容与空间上相关的块，避免块间竞争。
Result: 在图像分类基准上，VisionScreen优于传统ViT。
Conclusion: Screening机制对于视觉识别有效，可作为基于softmax注意力的相对特征聚合的替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Music-to-Dance Generation via Atomic Movements
papers.abstract_en: Music-driven dance generation aims to produce human motion that is both rhythmically synchronized and semantically consistent with music. While recent neural approaches have achieved impressive visual realism, they typically model motion as a continuous signal and neglect its compositional nature, making generated dances structurally incoherent and difficult to control. In this work, we introduce a structure-aware framework that models choreography as a sequence of atomic movements-semantically interpretable motion events that serve as the building blocks of dance. To construct this atomic movement vocabulary, we first segment large-scale dance data and cluster them into atomic movement groups. We then employ a large language model to semantically relabel and refine the clusters, yielding a set of interpretable and reusable atomic movements. Based on these atomic movement annotations, we design a two-stage generation framework that mirrors the human choreography process. In the atomic movement planning stage, the model predicts the type, duration, and timing of atomic movements conditioned on the input music, forming a symbolic dance allocation. In the completion stage, a transition-aware generator synthesizes smooth and stylistically coherent motion conditioned on the planned structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces dances with significantly improved structural coherence, rhythmic alignment, and perceptual naturalness compared to existing baselines, while providing enhanced interpretability and controllable editing through explicit structural representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构感知的舞蹈生成框架，将编舞建模为一系列原子动作（atomic movements）序列。首先从大规模舞蹈数据中分割并聚类出原子动作词汇，再利用大语言模型语义标注和精炼。然后设计两阶段生成流程：先规划原子动作的类型、时长和时序，再生成平滑连贯的运动。实验表明该方法在结构连贯性、节奏对齐和感知自然度上优于现有方法，并提供了更好的可解释性和可控编辑。
Motivation: 现有舞蹈生成方法将运动建模为连续信号，忽略了其组合性质，导致生成舞蹈结构不连贯且难以控制。
Method: 构建原子动作词汇：通过分割和聚类舞蹈数据得到原子动作组，再用大语言模型语义标注。两阶段生成：先根据音乐规划原子动作序列，再生成过渡平滑的舞蹈运动。
Result: 实验显示该方法在结构连贯性、节奏对齐和感知自然度上显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 基于原子动作的显式结构表示提升了舞蹈生成的可解释性和可控编辑能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CF-Net: Conflict Fusion with Speaker Normalisation and Certainty Weighting for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Detecting ambivalence and hesitancy (AH) in unconstrained video is challenging because the target signal is inherently ambiguous and expressed through subtle cross-modal incongruence rather than prototypical affect. We present CF-Net, a deep multimodal network submitted to the 3rd Edition of the AH Video Recognition Challenge (ABAW 11th, ECCV 2026), targeting the BAH dataset. CF-Net encodes visual, audio, and transcript streams with frozen SigLIP2, HuBERT, and DistilBERT backbones, normalises backbone features per speaker to reduce identity leakage, and fuses them via a ConflictFusion module that explicitly computes pairwise cross-modal incongruence. Training combines certainty-weighted focal loss, manifold mixup, and modality dropout; an auxiliary certainty-regression head leverages ambiguity annotations to stabilise learning on genuinely borderline samples. CF-Net achieves a Macro F1 of 0.7155 on the BAH validation set and 0.7364 (AP = 0.7492) on the private challenge test set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CF-Net，一个用于非约束视频中矛盾/犹豫（AH）识别的深度多模态网络，参赛于 ABAW 2026 挑战赛。模型利用冻结的 SigLIP2、HuBERT 和 DistilBERT 骨干提取视觉、音频和文本特征，通过说话人归一化减少身份泄漏，并设计冲突融合模块计算跨模态不一致性。训练采用确定性加权焦点损失、流形混合和模态丢弃，辅助确定性回归头利用模糊标注稳定学习。在 BAH 验证集上达到 0.7155 Macro F1，在私有挑战测试集上达到 0.7364 Macro F1。
Motivation: 非约束视频中的矛盾/犹豫（AH）检测具有挑战性，因为目标信号本质模糊，通过微妙的跨模态不一致而非典型情感表达。现有方法往往忽视说话人身份泄漏和样本的模糊性。
Method: CF-Net 编码视觉、音频和文本流，使用冻结的 SigLIP2、HuBERT 和 DistilBERT 骨干；对骨干特征进行说话人归一化以减少身份泄漏；通过 ConflictFusion 模块显式计算成对跨模态不一致性进行融合。训练结合确定性加权焦点损失、流形混合和模态丢弃；引入辅助确定性回归头利用模糊标注稳定学习。
Result: 在 BAH 验证集上 Macro F1 为 0.7155，在私有挑战测试集上 Macro F1 为 0.7364（AP = 0.7492）。
Conclusion: 作者认为说话人归一化和冲突融合模块对跨模态不一致性建模有效，确定性回归头有助于处理边界模糊样本。方法在挑战赛上取得有竞争力的结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PlumeQuant: Uncertainty-aware consistency assessment of methane plume masks and emission-rate estimates
papers.abstract_en: Imaging spectrometers increasingly distribute source-resolved methane plume products in which the plume mask, integrated mass enhancement (IME), plume length, emission rate, and uncertainty are physically and algorithmically linked. Using 63 EMIT-derived Carbon Mapper plume records from 27 scenes, we show that these published scalar quantities do not uniquely constrain the plume boundary: substantially different yet plausible masks reproduce the same IME, plume length, and emission rate. Genetic-algorithm (GA) ensembles conditioned on the published IME and plume length make this equifinality explicit: the high-confidence core selected by nearly all target-consistent masks covers a median of 13% of the plausible footprint envelope, and ambiguity is largest for weak, low-overlap plumes. The diagnostics come from PlumeQuant, which recomputes IME, plume length, emission rate, and five-term uncertainty from distributed product components under stated conventions and evaluates four mask representations: the distributed reference mask, a transparent Carbon Mapper-informed analogue (CM-like), the GA ensemble, and optional expert edits. The CM-like mask is generated per plume without access to the reference mask or published quantities, with settings fixed once on a scene-disjoint 44-plume development split. It reproduced published IME with +0.72% median difference and emission rate with +0.16% (6.98% mean absolute), reached 0.843 median intersection-over-union against the reference masks, and matched the published uncertainty scale (median ratio 1.01). Holdout mean absolute errors were 7.6% (IME), 9.5% (length), and 6.1% (rate). These are product-level consistency diagnostics, not independent validation. They flag weak, offset, or ambiguous plumes for expert review.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 9 figures. Supplementary material provided as an ancillary file. Code and derived data archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21282534
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlumeQuant 框架，用于评估成像光谱仪产出的甲烷羽流掩膜和排放率估计的一致性。通过 63 个 EMIT 碳映射器羽流记录，作者发现不同的掩膜可以产生相同的积分质量增强（IME）、羽流长度和排放率，表明存在等终性（equifinality）。遗传算法（GA）集合使这种不确定性显式化：高置信度核心仅占可能足迹包络的中位数的 13%，弱羽流的不确定性最大。
Motivation: 成像光谱仪提供的甲烷羽流产品中，掩膜、IME、长度、排放率及其不确定性在物理和算法上相互关联，但这些标量值并不能唯一约束羽流边界，导致一致性评估困难。
Method: PlumeQuant 从分布式产品组件中重新计算 IME、长度、排放率和五项不确定性，并评估四种掩膜表示：分布式参考掩膜、透明碳映射器模拟掩膜（CM-like）、GA 集合和可选专家编辑。GA 集合在给定 IME 和长度的条件下生成满足一致性的掩膜集合。
Result: CM-like 掩膜再现了 IME（中位差异 +0.72%）和排放率（中位差异 +0.16%，平均绝对误差 6.98%），与参考掩膜的中位交并比为 0.843，不确定性尺度匹配（中位比率 1.01）。留出测试的平均绝对误差：IME 7.6%，长度 9.5%，速率 6.1%。
Conclusion: PlumeQuant 提供产品级一致性诊断，而非独立验证。它标识出弱、偏移或模糊的羽流以供专家复审，强调了当前羽流产品中未被充分认识的不确定性来源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Beyond the $d^{2.5}$-mixing bound for Dikin walks on polytopes
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by interior-point methods (IPM) for structured convex optimization, Kannan and Narayanan introduced the Dikin walk for sampling uniformly from polytopes in 2009. As in IPMs, the Dikin walk is affine-invariant, and its convergence is governed by the barrier geometry used to define its local proposal. They showed that the Dikin walk with the logarithmic barrier for a polytope in $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ with $m$ linear inequalities mixes in $md$ iterations. In 2017, Chen, Dwivedi, Wainwright, and Yu improved this to $d^{2.5}$ using a Lewis-weight barrier, and conjectured that the correct mixing time should be $d^{2}$. We make progress toward this conjecture by improving the previous $d^{2.5}$-mixing bound. For exponential sampling over a polytope, we prove that the Dikin walk with a scaled Lee--Sidford metric mixes from a warm start in $d^{2.25}$ iterations. This also yields an improved cold-start complexity via a known annealing framework. The main technical ingredient is improved average self-concordance of the Lee--Sidford metric, which gives high acceptance probability for the Metropolis filter along a random Dikin proposal. While previous analyses were effectively limited to second-order control due to technical difficulties, we develop a principled higher-order analysis. The proof combines a selective higher-order expansion of recursive bottleneck terms, a moving orthonormal-frame calculus for higher derivatives of the Lewis weights, and Wiener-chaos decompositions via multiple stochastic integrals to control the resulting Gaussian polynomials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文改进了Dikin walk在凸多面体上均匀采样的混合时间上界，从已知的d^{2.5}降低到d^{2.25}。主要技术贡献包括改进的Lee–Sidford度量的平均自和谐性以及高阶分析方法，结合了选择性高阶展开、移动正交标架计算和高斯多项式的Wiener混沌分解。
Motivation: Kannan和Narayanan引入Dikin walk用于多面体均匀采样，但其混合时间的理论界仍有改进空间。Chen等人于2017年得到d^{2.5}的界并猜想最优为d^{2}，本文旨在缩小这一差距。
Method: 采用缩放后的Lee–Sidford度量定义Dikin walk，并通过Metropolis滤波器保证接受概率。通过改进平均自和谐性分析，发展了一套高阶分析方法，包括递归瓶颈项的选择性高阶展开、Lewis权重高阶导数的移动正交标架演算以及多重随机积分的Wiener混沌分解。
Result: 证明从热启动出发，Dikin walk在d^{2.25}次迭代内混合，改进了之前d^{2.5}的界。该结果也通过退火框架给出了改进的冷启动复杂度。
Conclusion: 本文在Dikin walk混合时间的理论上取得了进展，但尚未达到猜想的最优d^{2}。技术上的高阶分析框架可能对相关采样算法有借鉴意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Peak-End-Net: A Peak-End Rule Inspired Framework for Generalizable Video Aesthetic Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Video aesthetic assessment (VAA) aims to predict how aesthetically pleasing a video is, yet remains far less explored than other visual assessment tasks. Its progress is hindered not only by the scarcity of large-scale benchmarks, but also by the intrinsic subjectivity of aesthetic judgment, which is shaped by human perception. In this paper, we revisit VAA from a psychological perspective and propose \textit{Peak-End-Net}, a lightweight and interpretable framework inspired by the \textit{peak-end rule}, which suggests that people tend to judge a temporal experience mainly according to its salient moments and the ending. Building on this intuition, we first transfer knowledge from image aesthetic assessment (IAA) to VAA by introducing a pretrained IAA head to produce frame-wise aesthetic priors, which serve as surrogate signals for identifying aesthetically salient moments and guiding \textit{peak-end rule}-based temporal aggregation. To further capture how a video evolves aesthetically over time, we design an aesthetic rhythm encoder that models temporal progression beyond isolated moments. Additionally, we refine the overall assessment through a dynamic gated fusion mechanism to improve robustness under distribution shift. Our method is built on a frozen vision transformer (ViT) and requires only a small number of trainable parameters, making it scalable and parameter-efficient. Extensive experiments on two existing VAA benchmarks, including in-domain evaluation on VADB and cross-domain testing on DIVIDE-3K, demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, affirming the value of psychologically grounded modeling for VAA. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/Peak-End-Net.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026, Code: https://github.com/AMAP-ML/Peak-End-Net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受心理学中的峰终定律 (peak-end rule) 启发，提出 Peak-End-Net 框架用于视频美学评估。该方法从图像美学评估迁移知识生成帧级美学先验，通过美学节奏编码器建模视频随时间的美学演变，并利用动态门控融合提升跨域鲁棒性。在 VADB 和 DIVIDE-3K 基准上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 视频美学评估受限于大规模基准稀缺和审美判断的主观性，探索远少于其他视觉评估任务。
Method: 冻结视觉 Transformer (ViT) 主干，引入预训练的图像美学评估头生成帧级美学先验；设计美学节奏编码器建模时间演化；通过动态门控融合机制实现鲁棒聚合。整体仅需少量可训练参数。
Result: 在 VADB 域内评估和 DIVIDE-3K 跨域测试上均取得当前最优结果。
Conclusion: 基于峰终定律的心理建模方法能有效提升视频美学评估的泛化性能，验证了从心理学角度建模该问题的价值。

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Agent for Longitudinal Personal Health Management
papers.abstract_en: Personal health management unfolds over repeated encounters, yet most health AI systems treat each request in isolation. We developed HealthClaw, an open-source agent architecture that updates support as a person's routines, preferences, measurements and risks change. It separates shared safety rules and medical knowledge from private longitudinal memory containing profile facts, reusable procedures and episodic traces. After each episode, induction determines what should update the profile, revise a procedure, remain episodic or be excluded. We evaluated HealthClaw with a synthetic year-long benchmark and nine 200-case biomedical tasks. Across 900 longitudinal support probes, answer accuracy increased from 0.2% with current-query prompting to 45.7% with HealthClaw, while prompt-side context exposure was 71.7% lower than with full-history prompting. In 100 privacy probes, HealthClaw produced higher privacy-aware answer quality and fewer unsafe disclosures than both baselines. Across the biomedical tasks, the mean absolute gain in the task-specific primary metric was 27.0 percentage points, and seven gains remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. These offline benchmarks support governed, self-evolving memory for longitudinal personal health agents, although clinical effectiveness requires prospective evaluation. HealthClaw is publicly available at https://github.com/HC-Guo/HealthClaw.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 6 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/HC-Guo/HealthClaw
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HealthClaw，一个开源智能体架构，用于纵向个人健康管理。它通过分离共享安全规则和医疗知识与私有纵向记忆，在每次交互后自我演化记忆，从而在900次纵向支持探针中实现了从0.2%到45.7%的准确率提升，同时在100次隐私探针中表现出更高的隐私意识答案质量和更少的风险披露。
Motivation: 目前的健康AI系统将每次请求孤立处理，无法适应个人随时间变化的日常、偏好和风险。HealthClaw旨在通过自我演化记忆来解决这一问题。
Method: 提出HealthClaw架构，包含共享安全规则/医疗知识模块和私有纵向记忆模块（包括个人档案、可重用程序和事件记录）。每次交互后通过归纳决定更新档案、修订程序、保留事件或排除信息。
Result: 在合成的一年期基准和9个200例生物医学任务中，HealthClaw在900次纵向支持探针上将答案准确率从0.2%提升至45.7%，提示侧上下文暴露比全历史提示降低了71.7%。在100次隐私探针中，HealthClaw产生了更高的隐私意识答案质量和更少的不安全披露。生物医学任务中，主要指标平均绝对增益为27.0个百分点，其中7个增益在FDR校正后仍显著。
Conclusion: 离线基准测试支持了具有自我演化记忆的纵向个人健康智能体，但临床有效性需要未来评估。

papers.title: A novel unsupervised machine learning strategy to handle multimodal cardiac PET/MRI data
papers.abstract_en: Arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy is a genetic myocardial disease difficult to diagnose due to the lack of gold standard criteria. Simultaneous PET/MR imaging, combined with multiparametric quantitative analysis, could facilitate the identification of different profiles related to the phenotype and progression of cardiomyopathy. This preliminary study focuses on a methodological strategy for dealing with PET/MRI data, including inter-patient data linkage and regional analysis. Two-step clustering was applied to T1 and T2 maps, LGE, and 18F-FDG-PET images of 99 patients genetically diagnosed with arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy. Each patient's images were independently z-scored and summed into a single volume, which was clustered into supervoxels. Thirty-two inter-patient groups of supervoxels were obtained by spectral clustering. An "abnormality" score was assigned to each cluster and modality, and used to visualise abnormal regions likely associated with disease. They enabled the generation of automated textual and bullseye health reports for each patient, which were compared with cardiac imager assessments using balanced accuracy in repeated nested cross-validation. This approach was further validated on a larger cohort of 167 numerical phantoms. The reports generated by clustering accurately identified most of the cardiac physicians' observations (BA = 0.76 $\pm$ 0.04 in repeated nested cross-validation on patients, and BA $\ge$ 0.8 on phantoms). Furthermore, the identified abnormal clusters closely matched their visual observations, facilitating the identification of varying degrees of fibrosis or inflammation on the images. This approach enables a more systematic handling of multimodal PET/MRI data to characterise myocardial heterogeneity in arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy patients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督聚类策略处理心律失常性左室心肌病（ALVC）患者的多模态心脏PET/MRI数据。该方法对T1、T2 mapping、LGE和18F-FDG-PET图像进行两步聚类（先患者内超体素聚类，再患者间谱聚类），为每个聚类分配异常分数，自动生成文本和牛眼图报告。在99例患者和167个数值体模上验证，报告与心脏影像医师评估的平衡准确率（BA）分别为0.76±0.04和≥0.8。
Motivation: 心律失常性左室心肌病缺乏金标准诊断标准，多模态PET/MRI定量分析有助于识别不同表型，但多模态数据缺乏系统的处理方法。
Method: 对每位患者的T1、T2、LGE和FDG-PET图像分别进行z-score标准化并相加为单个体积，通过两步聚类（先k-means超体素，再谱聚类）得到32个患者间聚类。为每个聚类-模态组合分配异常分数，并据此生成自动化文本和牛眼图报告。
Result: 在99例患者中，报告与医师评估的平衡准确率为0.76±0.04；在167个数值体模上BA≥0.8。识别出的异常聚类与视觉观察高度一致，有助于区分不同严重程度的纤维化或炎症。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了多模态PET/MRI数据的系统性处理，可表征心肌异质性，但未提及对非ALVC疾病或与其他方法的对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SIVA-RL: Sensitivity-Invariance Visual Alignment for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives multimodal reasoning, but answer-level correctness does not guarantee that a vision-language model grounds its predictions in visual evidence. Existing visual-intervention methods contrast policy behavior on original and modified images, yet assign supervision by the type of intervention rather than its observed effect. This assumption fails: identical operators produce heterogeneous outcomes across samples. We propose SIVA-RL, a Sensitivity-Invariance Visual Alignment framework that replaces operator-conditioned regularization with sample-wise, outcome-conditioned supervision. SIVA-RL constructs localized interventions through token-aligned, distance-constrained within-image PatchSwap. A frozen audit policy then scores each clean-intervention pair, and the observed reward drop becomes soft routing weights. Large-drop pairs drive sensitivity alignment, low-drop pairs drive clean-anchored invariance alignment, and ambiguous pairs are down-weighted. This design decouples intervention construction from supervision assignment and is compatible with both GRPO and DAPO backbones. Across nine multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning mathematical, logical, and vision-dependent tasks, SIVA-RL improves 3B and 7B models over matched RL baselines in every setting. It yields an 8.79 percentage-point gain on vision-dependent reasoning and up to 14.9% relative overall improvement across all four GRPO- and DAPO-based configurations.

papers.title: VAIOM: Continuous-Input, Discrete-Output Decoder-Only Financial Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Financial observations are continuous, heterogeneous, and noisy, whereas decoder-only next-token models are usually built around discrete symbolic inputs. We introduce Vector-Input Autoregressive Inference for Ordinal-Return Modeling (VAIOM), a decoder-only Transformer for probabilistic next-return modeling on one-hour foreign-exchange bars. VAIOM separates input representation from output likelihood: continuous multivariate financial-event vectors preserve numerical structure at the input, while a categorical distribution over the next volatility-normalized return bucket supports cross-entropy training and likelihood evaluation. The selected 0.9M Hybrid Continuous Input model combines continuous event features with categorical asset metadata, a Mixture-of-Market-States return head, Gap, volatility-regime, and Ordinal auxiliary objectives, and full-sequence supervision. Models and preprocessing are fit using pre-2024 Train data; models are selected on 2024H2 Validation and evaluated without refitting on two 2025 Test periods. Across three independent training seeds, every model outperforms fixed single-bar LightGBM baseline in both Test halves. For the canonical checkpoint, paired gains over LightGBM are 0.029 and 0.043 bits per event. Validation experiments show that continuous input improves over discrete-token input under the same categorical return objective, full-sequence supervision improves over last-position training, and auxiliary representation shaping together with a mixture-structured return head improves return likelihood in controlled comparisons. A supporting capacity study finds that the smallest evaluated complete architecture rung achieves the strongest Validation likelihood on the present corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VAIOM，一种解码器-only Transformer，用于概率性下一收益率建模，适用于一小时外汇数据。它采用连续输入向量与离散输出类别分布，结合混合市场状态收益率头和辅助目标，在2025年测试期上持续优于LightGBM基线，每事件提升约0.03比特。
Motivation: 金融观测是连续、异质且带噪声的，而现有解码器-only next-token模型通常基于离散符号输入，难以直接处理连续数值结构。
Method: VAIOM分离输入表示与输出似然：输入使用连续多元金融事件向量保留数值结构，输出采用类别分布预测下一波动率归一化收益率桶。模型架构包括混合连续输入（事件特征+类别元数据）、混合市场状态收益率头、差距、波动率体制和顺序辅助目标，以及全序列监督。
Result: 在三个独立训练种子下，所有模型均优于固定单根LightGBM基线；规范检查点相比LightGBM每事件提升0.029和0.043比特。消融实验验证了连续输入优于离散输入、全序列监督优于最后位置训练、辅助目标与混合收益率头提升似然。
Conclusion: VAIOM通过分离输入输出表示有效处理连续金融数据，设计选择（连续输入、全序列监督、辅助目标等）均被验证有效。容量研究发现最小完整架构在当前语料上取得最佳验证似然。

papers.title: Plausible Deniability Guarantees for Whistleblowers
papers.abstract_en: Whistleblowers are a key safeguard against organizational wrongdoing, but the threat of retaliation deters reporting. Existing whistleblower-protection proposals lack formal privacy guarantees, and existing differential privacy mechanisms do not directly target the natural threat model -- one in which the audited organization itself observes auditor selection decisions and uses them to identify reporters. We formalize protection against a strong-adversary threat model as per-report $(0, δ)$-differential privacy on the transcript of audit selections. Within this framework we prove that a natural approach -- randomized response applied at the selection step -- can never outperform uniform random auditing by more than $δ$ at any horizon. We then give a generic mechanism that reduces private auditing to private continual counting: any $(0, δ)$-DP continual counter plugs in by post-processing, and the audit transcript inherits the same per-report guarantee. Instantiating the reduction with a recent work in continual counting yields per-report $(0, δ)$-DP with noise scaling as $O(\sqrt{\log T})$ across a horizon of $T$ audit decisions. A utility theorem shows that the selection error vanishes whenever the noisy report gap between the most-reported organization and the runner-up grows faster than $\sqrt{\log T}$. Simulations show a substantial improvement over randomized response.
papers.comment: Accepted at three ICML 2026 workshops, including the ICML Workshop on Technical AI Governance Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对告密者（whistleblower）保护问题，提出了一种形式化的可否认性保证框架，将其建模为审计选择记录上的(0,δ)-差分隐私。作者证明随机响应方法在任意时间范围内最多比均匀随机审计好δ，并给出一个基于私有持续计数（continual counting）的通用机制，噪声规模为O(√log T)。模拟表明该机制显著优于随机响应。
Motivation: 现有告密者保护方案缺乏正式的隐私保证，且差分隐私机制未针对组织通过观察审计选择来识别报告者的威胁模型。
Method: 将保护形式化为审计选择话语的逐记录(0,δ)-差分隐私；证明随机响应无法实质优于均匀随机审计；提出通过后处理将私有审计归约为私有持续计数，并实例化一个持续计数工作实现(0,δ)-DP，噪声为O(√log T)。
Result: 噪声规模为O(√log T)（T个审计决策）；选择误差在最常见组织与次常见组织的报告差距增长快于√log T时消失；模拟显示显著优于随机响应。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个形式化告密者保护框架和可证明的机制，但实际应用仍需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cyclone: Diffusion Model for Cycle-Consistent Weather Editing from Unpaired Driving Data
papers.abstract_en: Reliable perception under diverse weather conditions remains a major challenge for autonomous driving systems. A common strategy to improve robustness is either to synthesize adverse weather conditions for training perception models or to apply weather-removal techniques to recover clean inputs. However, existing approaches typically rely on synthetic data augmentation or physics-based, task-specific models that require paired training data and often struggle to generate realistic weather effects or generalize robustly to out-of-domain scenarios. Toward this problem, we present Cyclone, a unified framework for weather editing based on latent diffusion, equipped with cycle-consistent constraints and knowledge from image-text models. Cyclone enables the generation of multiple weather conditions across diverse scenes while eliminating the need for paired data. Experimental results show that our approach produces more realistic, structure-preserving outputs than existing baselines and leads to consistent improvements across several downstream driving perception tasks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that Cyclone can be distilled to a video diffusion model for temporally consistent weather editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cyclone，一个基于潜在扩散模型 (latent diffusion) 的天气编辑框架，利用循环一致性约束和图像-文本模型知识，无需配对数据即可生成多种天气条件下的场景。实验表明，该方法在保持结构的同时生成更真实的天气效果，并提升下游驾驶感知任务的性能。此外，模型可蒸馏为视频扩散模型以实现时间一致的天气编辑。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖合成数据增强或基于物理的模型，需要配对训练数据，且难以生成真实天气效果或泛化到域外场景。
Method: 采用潜在扩散模型 (latent diffusion)，结合循环一致性约束 (cycle-consistent constraints) 和从图像-文本模型 (如 CLIP) 中提取的知识，实现无配对数据的多天气条件编辑。
Result: 生成的天气效果比现有基线更真实、更保持结构完整性，并在多个下游驾驶感知任务上带来一致提升。可蒸馏为视频扩散模型以实现时间一致性。
Conclusion: 无需配对数据的统一天气编辑框架，适用于自动驾驶中的鲁棒感知，但专注于天气编辑而非预报或降水预测。

papers.title: Thresholded Cross-Attention for Reliable Intensity-Chromaticity Fusion in Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) requires a careful balance among noise suppression, color fidelity, and efficiency. Recent HVI-based methods alleviate color entanglement by decoupling intensity and chromaticity, yet how reliably the two streams are fused again is an overlooked factor that largely determines the final quality. We observe that the confidence of cross-stream attention is strongly layer-dependent, so the fixed-quota selection of Top-K sparse attention is mismatched to it, discarding informative dependencies in some layers while retaining noisy ones in others. Motivated by this observation, we propose TCA-Net, a network built around Thresholded Cross-Attention that targets reliable intensity-chromaticity fusion in the HVI space rather than introducing yet another color representation. At its core, TCA replaces the rigid Top-K quota with a fixed confidence threshold whose retained cardinality is input- and layer-adaptive, retaining only high-confidence cross-stream interactions while suppressing unreliable ones. Around this core, two complementary designs clean up the fusion before and after it: a Phase-guided Fourier Interaction Module provides a structure-aware brightness initialization for the intensity stream prior to fusion, and a Decoupled Dual-Stream Guidance Module constructs residual intensity features to suppress chromaticity leakage during reconstruction. A Scale-Aware Consistency Regularization further improves structural robustness under scale perturbations during training. Extensive experiments on LOL-v1, LOL-v2, Sony-Total-Dark, and LSRW-Huawei demonstrate that TCA-Net delivers competitive restoration accuracy, improved color fidelity, and a compact parameter size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低光照图像增强（LLIE）中亮度和色度融合不可靠的问题，提出TCA-Net，其核心是阈值交叉注意力（Thresholded Cross-Attention），用固定置信度阈值替代Top-K固定配额，实现输入和层自适应的交叉流交互选择。此外，相位引导傅里叶交互模块和去耦双流引导模块分别用于融合前后的清理，尺度一致性正则化增强鲁棒性。在LOL-v1、LOL-v2、Sony-Total-Dark和LSRW-Huawei数据集上，TCA-Net在保持紧凑参数量的同时取得了有竞争力的复原精度和更好的色彩保真度。
Motivation: 现有基于HVI的方法通过分离强度与色度来缓解颜色纠缠，但两流融合的可靠性被忽视。观察发现交叉注意力置信度高度依赖层，Top-K固定配额不匹配，导致丢弃有用信息或保留噪声。
Method: 提出TCA-Net，核心是阈值交叉注意力，用固定置信度阈值替代Top-K，保留高置信交互并抑制不可靠交互。融合前使用相位引导傅里叶交互模块为强度流提供结构感知亮度初始化；融合后使用去耦双流引导模块构建残差强度特征抑制色度泄漏。训练时加入尺度一致性正则化。
Result: 在LOL-v1、LOL-v2、Sony-Total-Dark和LSRW-Huawei上，TCA-Net达到竞争性复原精度，改善色彩保真度，且参数量紧凑。
Conclusion: 阈值交叉注意力能有效适配层间置信度变化，实现可靠的亮度和色度融合，无需引入新颜色空间。
Relevance: 0
