papers.title: Generative Compilation: On-the-Fly Compiler Feedback as AI Generates Code
papers.abstract_en: Languages with rich static semantics, such as Rust, provide stronger guarantees for AI-generated code, but their strictness makes generation more difficult. Off-the-shelf compilers can provide useful feedback post-generation, but does not guide intermediate generation steps, such as those during autoregressive LLM decoding. Constrained decoding intervenes earlier by rejecting invalid tokens during sampling, but requires white-box model access and costly reimplementation for semantic constraints.We introduce generative compilation, the first approach to obtaining compiler feedback on partial programs during generation. The core technical device is a sealor: a lightweight, mostly syntax-guided transformation that converts partial programs into complete ones that standard compilers can diagnose. It is designed such that possible-to-complete partial programs are never rejected, while preserving enough code context to catch genuine dead ends early. We construct such a sealor on a core Rust-like calculus and prove that it satisfies these properties, all mechanized in Lean. We extend it to the first partial-program checker for real Rust. We evaluate our method on challenging repository-level Rust coding tasks, across both frontier black-box and open-weight models. We show that generative compilation reduces non-compiling outputs and improves functional correctness, relative to standard post-generation feedback. It does so by detecting a broad range of errors close to their source and early during generation, thereby reducing errors cascades and enabling focused diagnostics. More broadly, generative compilation is a step toward making compilers a first-class citizen of AI-assisted programming active during generation, rather than a separate post-generation check.

papers.title: An Efficient Newton Algorithm for Nonnegative Matrix Factorization with the Kullback-Leibler Divergence
papers.abstract_en: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) is a fundamental tool in unsupervised learning, which approximates a nonnegative matrix by the product of two low-rank nonnegative factors. The Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence is best suited to measure the data to model discrepancy when the decomposed data sample follows a Poisson distribution, which is the case for count datasets such as term-document matrices or images. Most KL-NMF algorithms in the literature minimize a separable majorant of the loss to find their next iterate. We argue that this method has reached its limits and propose to use instead the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss, leading to a Newton-type method. We minimize this non-separable surrogate by proposing a generalization of the well-known HALS algorithm. This yields an efficient KL-NMF algorithm which provably converges and which competes favorably with state-of-the-art algorithms on a large variety of datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Kullback-Leibler散度下的非负矩阵分解（KL-NMF），提出一种基于二阶泰勒展开的牛顿型算法，通过推广HALS算法最小化非可分离替代函数，实现高效且收敛的求解。实验表明该方法在多种数据集上优于现有算法。
Motivation: 现有KL-NMF算法多采用可分离替代函数最小化，该方法已接近性能极限，需要更高效的优化策略。

Result: 摘要称该算法在多种数据集上与现有最优算法竞争并表现更好，且具有收敛性保证。
Conclusion: 该牛顿型方法为KL-NMF提供了更高效的优化途径，但未提及在特定应用领域（如降水预报）的效果。

papers.title: Partially Correlated Verifier Cascades in LLM Harnesses: Concave Log-Odds, Polynomial Reliability, and Blind-Spot Ceilings
papers.abstract_en: Serial verification gates are a core reliability primitive in LLM harnesses: a candidate answer is returned only if $k$ verifier calls all accept it. Under conditionally independent gates, the recent Odds Law (arXiv:2606.15712) shows that posterior log-odds grow linearly in $k$, so failure decays exponentially, and states that "a tight theory of partially correlated verifier cascades remains open." This note gives a minimal such theory. Modeling the per-instance false-accept rate on the generator's own errors as a latent variable $α\sim G$ (de Finetti), the exact cascade posterior is $\ell_k = \ell_0 - \ln m_k$, with $m_k$ the $k$-th moment of $G$. Then: (i) $\ell_k$ is concave in $k$ for every non-degenerate $G$ -- the Odds Law is its tangent at the first gate and an upper bound; (ii) for Beta$(a,b)$ latents, failure decays polynomially, $1-r_k \asymp k^{-b}$, with correlation parameter $ρ_v = 1/(a+b+1)$; (iii) a blind-spot atom of mass $1-π$ at $α=1$ caps the evidence extractable from any number of gates at $-\ln(1-π)$ nats, so reliability saturates below 1; (iv) letting the true-accept rate also vary ($β\sim H$) yields a trichotomy -- gates eventually always help, plateau, or actively harm -- decided by the upper-tail exponents of $G$ and $H$, with closed-form crossover $k^\dagger$. The mechanism is survivorship: errors surviving gates are the high-$α$ ones. The theory is measurable: $R$ repeated verdicts per instance identify the first $R$ moments of $G$, so two verdicts identify $ρ_v$; beta-binomial likelihood and NPMLE recover the reliability curve and the ill-posed ceiling. In synthetic tests, independence-based extrapolation underestimates failure by 20x at $k=5$ and ~3000x at $k=10$; the correlated fit at $R=8$ tracks held-out depths. The practical lever is decorrelation -- changing model family, modality, or evidence source -- not adding gates.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. Code and synthetic-recovery experiments: https://github.com/jianganghan/harness-verifier-cascades
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM harnesses中串行验证门的可靠性问题，在部分相关条件下建立了最小理论。通过将每个实例的假接受率建模为潜变量α~G（de Finetti），推导出后验log-odds的凹性、Beta潜变量下的多项式衰减以及盲点原子导致的可靠性饱和。合成实验显示，基于独立性假设的外推在k=5时低估失败20倍，k=10时低估约3000倍，而相关拟合能准确跟踪。
Motivation: 现有Odds Law假设验证门条件独立，但部分相关情况的理论尚属空白。实际中验证门常存在相关性，亟需一个严谨的理论框架。
Method: 引入de Finetti表示，将每个实例的假接受率视为来自分布G的随机变量α，得到精确的后验log-odds公式ℓ_k = ℓ_0 - ln m_k（m_k为G的k阶矩）。进一步考虑真接受率也变化（β~H），给出了三分类结果。
Result: 理论上证明：对于任何非退化G，ℓ_k是凹的（Odds Law是其切线且为上界）；当α~Beta(a,b)时，失败率多项式衰减1-r_k ∝ k^{-b}，相关系数ρ_v=1/(a+b+1)；若α=1有原子质量1-π，则任何门数下证据上限为-ln(1-π) nats。合成实验中，独立性外推严重低估失败，相关拟合在R=8次重复判决时能准确预测更深层的可靠性。
Conclusion: 提高可靠性的实际杠杆是去相关（改变模型家族、模态或证据源），而非单纯增加验证门数量。

papers.title: The 2nd International StepUP Competition for Biometric Footstep Recognition: From Steps to Strides
papers.abstract_en: The International StepUP Competition Series was launched to advance research in pressure-based footstep biometrics through a standardized and challenging evaluation framework. Using the large-scale StepUP-P150 dataset (with more than 200,000 high-resolution dynamic footsteps from 150 individuals) and a previously unreleased test set, the 2nd edition of the competition addressed three key challenges: (1) generalization to unseen users with limited enrollment data, (2) robustness to domain shift caused by variations in footwear and walking speed and (3) effective fusion of paired left-right footsteps. While the first two challenges built on the inaugural competition, this edition introduced more extreme cross-domain conditions and moved beyond isolated footsteps to stride-level verification, enabling new opportunities for representation learning and inter-step information fusion. The competition attracted 26 registrants from academia and industry, with a best equal error rate of 8.00% achieved by the ArogyaPandit Research Team using a spatiotemporal CNN combined with an ensemble-based scoring strategy. The top solutions showcase the value of harnessing temporal patterns and of incorporating inference-time normalization and calibration strategies to improve scoring. However, the results also reveal that recognizing users in unseen personal footwear remains a challenge, especially in the presence of distractors with similar characteristics.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 第二届International StepUP Competition专注于基于压力的脚步生物识别，使用StepUP-P150数据集（150人，超过20万个高分辨率动态脚步）和未公开测试集，评估三个挑战：跨用户泛化、鞋类和速度域偏移、左右脚步融合。最佳系统（ArogyaPandit Research Team）达到8.00%等错误率，采用时空CNN和集成评分策略。结果表明个人穿着鞋类下的识别仍是难点。
Motivation: 推动压力式脚步生物识别的标准化评估，解决跨用户泛化、域偏移和脚步融合等关键问题。
Method: 竞赛设计三个挑战：未见用户少量注册数据泛化、鞋类和速度变化引起的域偏移、左右脚步信息融合。使用大规模数据集StepUP-P150和未发布测试集，引入更极端的跨域条件，从孤立脚步转向步幅级验证。
Result: 最佳等错误率8.00%，由ArogyaPandit Research Team使用时空CNN和集成评分策略实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调个人穿着非公用鞋类下的识别仍是挑战，尤其存在相似特征干扰时；同时指出利用时间模式、推理时归一化和校准策略的提升价值。

papers.title: AIMO Interpretability Challenge
papers.abstract_en: We propose the AIMO Interpretability Challenge, a competition on distinguishing robust from spurious reasoning in frontier mathematical language models based on the models' internal mechanisms. The challenge is motivated by a central limitation of standard reasoning benchmarks: strong final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a model relies on stable reasoning mechanisms or exploits brittle reasoning shortcuts. Building on AI Mathematical Olympiad (AIMO) problems and submissions, together with resources from the Fields Model Initiative, the competition will provide (1) newly-published olympiad-level math reasoning problems and their symbolic representations, allowing generation of novel functional variants, (2) access to frontier reasoning models, and (3) assessments of models' adversarial robustness on these problems. Participants will use these resources, along with our computing infrastructure support, to develop methods for identifying which models solve problems robustly. Our competition will also create a new, open robustness benchmark and baseline systems, aiming to provide a lasting foundation for standard benchmarking in mathematical reasoning and interpretability. Scientifically, the competition connects interpretability and generalization research around a central question in AI research: can we determine if, and to what extent, the decision-making of frontier AI models is generalizable and thus, reliable?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了AIMO可解释性挑战赛，旨在通过分析模型内部机制来区分前沿数学语言模型中的稳健推理与虚假推理。该挑战基于AI数学奥林匹克问题，提供新的奥数级推理问题、符号表示、前沿推理模型访问以及对抗鲁棒性评估，推动可解释性和泛化研究。
Motivation: 标准推理基准仅关注最终答案准确性，无法揭示模型依赖的是稳健推理机制还是脆弱的推理捷径，需要新的评估方法。
Method: 构建竞赛平台，提供新发布的奥数级别推理问题及其符号表示，允许生成功能性变体，并提供前沿推理模型访问和计算基础设施支持，参与者需开发识别模型稳健推理的方法。
Result: 竞赛将创建开放的鲁棒性基准和基线系统，为数学推理和可解释性提供标准化评估基础。
Conclusion: 该竞赛连接可解释性与泛化研究，旨在解答前沿AI模型的决策是否可泛化且可靠这一核心问题。

papers.title: RF Spectrogram Anomaly Detection with Quantum Kitchen Sinks: Architecture, Representation, and Hardware Validation
papers.abstract_en: The broadcast nature of wireless channels exposes radio-frequency (RF) networks to anomalous and malicious transmissions, making anomaly detection a fundamental requirement for secure spectrum management. Quantum Kitchen Sinks (QKS) offer a lightweight hybrid quantum feature map suitable for near-term quantum devices, yet their behavior on structured signal data remains poorly understood. In this paper, we extend the standard QKS template with multi-depth data re-uploading and ring entanglement, and evaluate the resulting pipeline on controlled RF spectrogram anomaly detection. We introduce a validation-locked five-stage ablation protocol that systematically separates the effects of shallow architecture, re-uploading depth, episode budget, input representation, and classical readout. Across the completed benchmark, Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) representations consistently dominate raw and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) inputs, moderate-depth entangled QKS configurations form the strongest operating regime, and QKS improves over matched classical direct-readout baselines across all evaluated representation-readout pairs on the held-out test set, with the best configuration reaching a test Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.8778 and a test F1 of 0.7995. The study bridges two levels of realism: real measured sub-6\,GHz cellular signals on the data side and real-device validation on the ibm_quebec Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) on the computing side, with AUROC deviations below 0.013 relative to simulation. These results provide a practical, reproducible framework for deploying QKS-based anomaly detection in wireless networks.
papers.comment: Paper accepted to IEEE quantum week 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用量子厨房水槽（QKS）进行RF频谱图异常检测，引入多深度数据重上传和环纠缠，并在ibm_quebec量子处理器上验证。DCT表示优于原始和PCA输入，中等深度纠缠QKS配置表现最佳，测试AUROC达0.8778，F1为0.7995，模拟与硬件偏差低于0.013。
Motivation: 无线信道的广播特性使RF网络易受异常和恶意传输影响，而现有QKS方法对结构化信号数据的行为理解不足，缺乏系统的消融分析。
Method: 扩展标准QKS模板，采用多深度数据重上传和环纠缠；设计五阶段消融协议，分离浅层架构、重上传深度、样本预算、输入表示和经典读出器的影响。
Result: DCT表示在所有表示-读出器对中占优；中等深度纠缠QKS配置在测试集上达到AUROC 0.8778和F1 0.7995；实际量子处理器上的AUROC偏差低于0.013。
Conclusion: 该框架为在无线网络中部署基于QKS的异常检测提供了实用、可重复的参考，并验证了模拟与硬件之间的一致性。

summary_sections.motivation: 无线信道的广播特性使RF网络易受异常和恶意传输影响，而现有QKS方法对结构化信号数据的行为理解不足，缺乏系统的消融分析。
summary_sections.method: 扩展标准QKS模板，采用多深度数据重上传和环纠缠；设计五阶段消融协议，分离浅层架构、重上传深度、样本预算、输入表示和经典读出器的影响。
summary_sections.result: DCT表示在所有表示-读出器对中占优；中等深度纠缠QKS配置在测试集上达到AUROC 0.8778和F1 0.7995；实际量子处理器上的AUROC偏差低于0.013。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为在无线网络中部署基于QKS的异常检测提供了实用、可重复的参考，并验证了模拟与硬件之间的一致性。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Vision-Language Pretraining with Organ-Conditioned Pattern Tokens for CT Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) vision-language pretraining from paired volumes and radiology reports is a scalable yet challenging task. Existing methods commonly adopt global scan-report contrast, which is scalable but obscures heterogeneous organ evidence. Meanwhile, direct organ-level alignment remains coarse, since the same anatomy can exhibit multiple distinct radiological appearances. Therefore, pretraining requires a finer alignment unit: the organ-conditioned radiological pattern. In this work, we propose OCP-CT, an organ-conditioned pattern-token alignment framework for CT vision-language pretraining. Specifically, OCP-CT preserves a stable global CT-report contrastive branch and introduces an organ pattern interface: sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routes image and text tokens according to latent radiological patterns, learnable slots query the routed tokens into continuous pattern tokens, and paired token contrast aligns image-text pattern tokens with structured soft targets built from report-derived clinical similarity. On the publicly available CT-RATE and RAD-ChestCT benchmarks, OCP-CT achieves average AUROCs of 84.5% and 69.9% for zero-shot abnormality diagnosis, respectively. Compared with the strongest prior reported results, these results yield absolute AUROC gains of 6.7 and 0.8 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CT影像-语言预训练中全局对比丢失器官级细节、直接器官对齐又过于粗糙的问题，提出器官条件模式令牌（OCP-CT）框架。该方法保留全局CT-报告对比分支，并引入稀疏MoE路由和可学习槽将图文令牌对齐到器官条件下的放射学模式，使用结构化软目标进行成对令牌对比。在CT-RATE和RAD-ChestCT基准上，零样本异常诊断平均AUROC分别达到84.5%和69.9%，较此前最优结果提升6.7和0.8个百分点。
Motivation: 现有CT视觉语言预训练方法采用全局扫描-报告对比，可扩展但掩盖了不同器官的异质证据；直接器官级对齐则因同一解剖结构可能有多种放射学表现而仍然粗糙，需要更细粒度的对齐单元——器官条件下的放射学模式。
Method: 提出OCP-CT框架，包含稳定的全局CT-报告对比分支和器官模式接口：稀疏MoE根据潜在放射学模式将图像和文本令牌路由到不同专家，可学习槽查询路由后的令牌生成连续模式令牌，并利用报告推导的临床相似性构建结构化软目标进行成对令牌对比。
Result: 在CT-RATE和RAD-ChestCT基准上，零样本异常诊断平均AUROC分别为84.5%和69.9%，较此前最强结果分别绝对提升6.7和0.8个百分点。
Conclusion: 本文表明器官条件模式令牌对齐能有效提升CT影像-语言预训练在零样本诊断任务上的性能。

papers.title: PiVoT: A Variational Solution for Real-time Large-scale Multi-object Detection and Tracking under Heavy Clutter
papers.abstract_en: Multi-object detection and tracking from noisy point clouds remain challenging in many data-scarce radar applications. Current Bayesian trackers based on Poisson measurement models offer a training-free solution but struggle to achieve accuracy and efficiency under severe clutter, large object populations, and full-resolution Doppler point clouds. We address this with PiVoT, a fast, clutter-resilient multi-object tracker for both positional and Doppler measurements. PiVoT performs end-to-end detection and tracking of a large and time-varying number of objects without external clustering or detectors, through joint inference of object states, shapes, existence probabilities, data association, and measurement rates. Its efficiency is driven by several variational inference innovations, such as theoretically justified birth pruning, quadratic-to-linear complexity reductions for exact updates, and a computationally efficient Doppler Poisson model. Experiments show that PiVoT substantially outperforms existing Bayesian trackers in challenging scenes, while also demonstrating exceptional scalability to a thousand objects, robustness to clutter visually inseparable from objects, and real-time operation on full-scale modern automotive radar datasets, where it attains performance comparable to a deep-learning detection benchmark as a training-free joint detector and tracker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PiVoT，一种基于变分推理的快速、抗杂波的多目标检测与跟踪方法，针对噪声点云（尤其是雷达应用）设计。PiVoT 联合推断目标状态、形状、存在概率、数据关联和测量率，无需外部聚类或检测器，通过理论推导的出生剪枝、二次到线性复杂度约简及高效多普勒泊松模型实现效率。实验表明，PiVoT 在挑战性场景下显著优于现有贝叶斯跟踪器，可扩展至一千个目标，对视觉上不可分的杂波鲁棒，并在全尺寸现代汽车雷达数据集上实时运行，性能与深度学习检测基准相当，且无需训练。
Motivation: 现有基于泊松测量模型的贝叶斯跟踪器在严重杂波、大目标数量和高分辨率多普勒点云下准确性和效率不足，需要一种无需训练的联合检测与跟踪方案来应对。
Method: PiVoT 通过变分推理（variational inference）进行端到端检测与跟踪，联合推断目标状态、形状、存在概率、数据关联和测量率；其效率来源于理论证明的出生剪枝（birth pruning）、精确更新中二次到线性复杂度约简以及高效多普勒泊松模型。
Result: 在挑战性场景下，PiVoT 显著优于现有贝叶斯跟踪器；可扩展至一千个目标，对视觉上不可分的杂波鲁棒；在全尺寸现代汽车雷达数据集上实时运行，性能与深度学习检测基准相当。
Conclusion: PiVoT 作为一种无需训练、抗杂乱的联合检测与跟踪器，在实时大规模多目标跟踪中实现了高精度、鲁棒性和可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Experience Memory Graph: One-Shot Error Correction for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable capabilities in autonomous decision-making by generating sequential trajectories of states, actions, and observations. However, in complex, long-horizon tasks, these agents frequently suffer from compounding errors and struggle to recover from failures. Existing self-correction mechanisms rely on prompt-based reflection, which is inherently brittle, incurs heavy time and API costs due to iterative trial-and-error loops, and produces task-specific memory that may be hard to generalize to new scenarios. To address this, we propose Experience Memory Graph (EMG), a framework that reformulates agent failure recovery as a graph matching problem. At training time, we convert both failed exploration trajectories and successful expert trajectories into directed action decision graphs. By matching these graphs, we extract common subgraphs (successful workflows) and graph edit paths that explicitly indicate how to correct failures (e.g., which actions to add, delete, or relabel under a given observation), and store them in a memory graph with intra-task nodes and cross-task edges. At test time, EMG retrieves relevant insights and guides the agent in a single, loop-free execution. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that EMG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art reflection baselines in success rate and average reward, while requiring no test-time trial-and-error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Experience Memory Graph (EMG)，一种将LLM代理故障恢复转化为图匹配问题的框架。通过将失败探索轨迹和成功专家轨迹转换为有向动作决策图，并提取公共子图（成功工作流）和编辑路径（添加/删除/重标动作），EMG在测试时无需试错循环即可检索并应用纠正。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，EMG在成功率和平均奖励上持续优于现有反思基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在复杂长时任务中易出现复合错误且难以恢复；自我纠正机制依赖基于提示的反思，脆弱、耗时且产生难以泛化的任务特定记忆。
Method: 将失败和成功轨迹转化为有向动作决策图，通过图匹配提取公共子图和图编辑路径，作为纠正信息存入记忆图（包含任务内节点和跨任务边）；测试时单次检索执行，无需试错循环。
Result: 在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上，EMG在成功率和平均奖励上均优于现有最先进的反思基线，且无需测试时试错。
Conclusion: 图匹配方法能有效提取并复用失败纠正模式，使代理在单次执行中完成错误恢复，避免迭代试错成本。

papers.title: Verifying formulas for interventional distributions
papers.abstract_en: We formalize verification in causal graphical models: deciding whether a given observational formula identifies a target interventional distribution. This opens a problem complementary to identification, asking not whether any identifying formula exists, but whether the given formula is identifying. We show that even sound and complete solutions to identification do not solve verification. We propose a falsifier as a first practical route forward, prove that it induces an almost-surely correct verifier for regular exponential-family models, and use the resulting verifier to develop the gateway test, which finds all sets admissible for use in a front-door formula.
papers.comment: Equal contribution between Leonard Henckel and Sebastian Weichwald
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了因果图模型中的验证问题：判断一个给定的观测公式是否能识别目标干预分布。这一问题与已有的识别问题互补，但即使识别问题的完备解决方案也无法直接解决验证问题。作者提出一个反证器（falsifier），证明其在正则指数族模型上几乎必然正确，并基于此开发了网关测试（gateway test），用于找出所有可用于前门公式的集合。
Motivation: 现有因果推断文献主要关注识别问题（是否存在某种公式），但缺乏对给定公式是否确实识别目标分布的验证方法。本文填补了这一空白，提出了验证问题。
Method: 形式化验证问题，提出一个反证器，证明它在正则指数族模型下几乎必然正确；基于该空反证器进一步构建了网关测试，可系统性地找到所有满足前门公式条件的变量集合。
Result: 证明即使使用完备的识别算法也无法解决验证问题；提出的反证器在正则指数族模型上几乎必然正确，网关测试能够有效枚举前门公式中的可允许集合。
Conclusion: 本文开辟了因果图模型中验证问题的研究方向，提供了实用的验证工具，但验证问题的一般解法仍待探索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unleashing Multimodal Large Language Models for Training-free HOI Detection in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Human-object interaction detection (HOID) has traditionally been formulated as a supervised detection problem over predefined interaction categories. While such paradigms achieve strong performance on closed-set benchmarks, they fundamentally entangle interaction understanding with dataset-specific supervision, limiting their ability to generalize to open-world and compositional scenarios. Recent HOI detectors attempt to leverage MLLMs through prompting strategies to transfer interaction-specific knowledge. However, such prompt-based approaches primarily focus on extracting discriminative representations from pretrained models, while underexploring their inherent multimodal reasoning capabilities. As a result, they struggle to provide informative contextual reasoning for ambiguous and open-world interaction scenarios. In this work, we present AgentHOI, a training-free, agentic framework that transfers the generalist multimodal reasoning capabilities of foundation models to HOI detection in the wild. Instead of learning interaction classifiers, AgentHOI modularly orchestrates complementary vision foundation modules to perform open-ended semantic reasoning and spatial grounding in a coordinated manner. To address the challenges of incomplete interaction discovery and ambiguous localization in complex scenes, we introduce two key mechanisms: (1) Context-aware Multi-round Reasoning, which progressively refines interaction hypotheses to ensure exhaustive and compositional HOI discovery, and (2) Multifaceted Interaction Localization, which enhances grounding precision by generating instance-specific descriptions that integrate semantic, spatial, and appearance cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AgentHOI achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art supervised and weakly supervised methods in real-world settings, despite requiring no HOID data for training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentHOI，一个无需训练、基于智能体（agentic）的框架，将基础模型的多模态推理能力迁移到开放世界的人-物交互检测（HOI detection）中。该框架通过模块化编排视觉基础模块，实现开放式语义推理和空间定位，并引入上下文感知的多轮推理与多面交互定位机制。实验表明，在无需HOI训练数据的情况下，AgentHOI在真实场景中优于现有的有监督和弱监督方法。
Motivation: 传统HOI检测依赖预定义类别和数据集监督，泛化能力有限；现有基于MLLM的提示策略未充分利用其内在多模态推理能力，难以处理开放世界和组合场景。
Method: 提出训练免费的智能体框架AgentHOI，模块化调度视觉基础模型，进行开放语义推理和空间定位。包含两个机制：上下文感知多轮推理逐步细化交互假设，以及多面交互定位通过实例级描述整合语义、空间和外观线索。
Result: 在真实世界设置下，无需任何HOI训练数据，AgentHOI在性能上超越了当前最先进的有监督和弱监督方法。
Conclusion: 证明了无需监督训练，仅依靠基础模型的多模态推理能力即可在开放世界HOI检测中取得领先性能，为无训练HOI检测提供了新范式。

summary_sections.motivation: 传统HOI检测依赖预定义类别和数据集监督，泛化能力有限；现有基于MLLM的提示策略未充分利用其内在多模态推理能力，难以处理开放世界和组合场景。
summary_sections.method: 提出训练免费的智能体框架AgentHOI，模块化调度视觉基础模型，进行开放语义推理和空间定位。包含两个机制：上下文感知多轮推理逐步细化交互假设，以及多面交互定位通过实例级描述整合语义、空间和外观线索。
summary_sections.result: 在真实世界设置下，无需任何HOI训练数据，AgentHOI在性能上超越了当前最先进的有监督和弱监督方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 证明了无需监督训练，仅依靠基础模型的多模态推理能力即可在开放世界HOI检测中取得领先性能，为无训练HOI检测提供了新范式。

papers.title: Task-Oriented Sensing and Covert Transmissions for Collaborative Multi-AUV Systems
papers.abstract_en: In underwater covert cooperative missions, autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) often cannot rely on active sonar to continuously obtain complete information, since active sensing and frequent communications increase the risk of exposure. As a result, AUVs primarily rely on passive observation, an approach that yields incomplete local perception and limited task efficiency. Although underwater acoustic communications can mitigate this limitation through information sharing, they are simultaneously constrained by long delays, severe interference, low reliability, and the risk of covert exposure. Existing communications-oriented multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) studies often model communication as an ideal information flow, whereas traditional communication optimization primarily focuses on link-level performance. However, both are insufficient to characterize the actual contribution of perceptual information to cooperative tasks under realistic conditions of covert physical communications. This paper proposes a Sensed Information Value Realization Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SVR-MARL) framework that leverages practical information to characterize the utility of information for cooperative tasks and learns distributed cooperative policies under realistic communication and covert constraints. Through a case study of covert multi-AUV cooperative localization and tracking, the potential of the proposed framework to improve collaborative task efficiency while reducing unnecessary communication and exposure risks is demonstrated.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: AI-Augmented Adaptive Digital Twin Modeling for Brain Tumor Evolution Prediction and Treatment Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Brain tumor progression exhibits spatially heterogeneous growth, patient-specific treatment response, and complex interactions with surrounding anatomy, making accurate long-term prediction challenging. We propose an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin (DT) framework for brain tumor evolution prediction and treatment scheduling. The framework integrates an interpretable reaction--diffusion (RD) model, a 3D residual learning module for model-form correction, patient-specific DT updating during recursive rollout, and model predictive control (MPC) for constrained chemotherapy and radiotherapy scheduling. Experiments on 387 synthetic tumor trajectories with 120-step evolution show that the baseline RD model captures tumor location and overall temporal behavior but underestimates heterogeneous tumor burden during long-horizon prediction. Hybrid RD--residual modeling reduces masked voxel-wise mean squared error by 84.3% and increases Dice overlap by 43.5% relative to the RD baseline under dense simulated observations. Online DT updating further reduces mean squared error by 45.9% and improves Dice overlap by 9.6% compared with the non-updated hybrid model. In MPC-based scheduling simulations, the updated DT controller reduces final tumor burden by 22.4% relative to a fixed treatment schedule under the terminal-burden objective. Together, these results demonstrate a unified framework for patient-specific initialization, mechanistic modeling, adaptive learning, and constrained treatment optimization. Although validated using patient-data-informed synthetic trajectories rather than clinical longitudinal data, the proposed framework establishes a foundation for future translation to real-world adaptive treatment planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个AI增强的自适应数字孪生框架，用于脑肿瘤演化预测和治疗调度。该框架结合可解释的反应-扩散模型、3D残差学习模块、患者特定数字孪生在线更新和模型预测控制。在387条合成肿瘤轨迹上，混合残差建模将掩膜体素均方误差降低84.3%，Dice重叠提高43.5%；在线更新进一步改善误差和Dice；基于MPC的调度将最终肿瘤负担降低22.4%。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤进展具有空间异质性、患者特异性治疗反应和复杂的解剖相互作用，现有模型难以准确预测长期演化。需要统一框架实现个性化初始化、机制建模、自适应学习和约束治疗优化。
Method: 集成可解释反应-扩散模型、3D残差学习模块（用于模型形式校正）、患者特定数字孪生递归滚动在线更新，以及模型预测控制（用于化疗和放疗的约束调度）。
Result: 与基线反应-扩散模型相比，混合残差建模降低掩膜体素均方误差84.3%，提高Dice重叠43.5%；在线更新进一步降低均方误差45.9%，提高Dice重叠9.6%。MPC调度下，更新后的数字孪生控制器将最终肿瘤负担降低22.4%。
Conclusion: 该框架在合成数据上展示了将机制模型与数据驱动校正结合的有效性，为未来向真实临床自适应治疗规划转化奠定基础。局限性在于仅基于患者数据合成的轨迹，而非真实临床纵向数据。

papers.title: Relevance-Aware Rule: Structural Deletion of Irrelevant Conditions in Decision Trees
papers.abstract_en: Decision trees generate interpretable if--then rules, yet they contain irrelevant conditions (IRCs). These IRCs arise from the structural mechanism of tree splitting and persist even in modern optimal sparse tree induction algorithms. Existing IRC deletion methods overlook this structural mechanism; therefore, they either preserve the original tree too loosely to remain reliable, or too strictly to achieve meaningful simplification. This study provides theoretical foundations for reliable IRC deletion by establishing theorems and propositions related to the underlying IRC mechanism. The key finding is that a binary split shifts class proportions in opposite directions relative to the parent. Specifically, an increase in the class-1 proportion along one branch necessitates an increase in the class-0 proportion along its sibling, thereby generating a C1-link and a C0-link. Based on this structural fact, we propose a structural IRC deletion framework. Relative to each leaf, links that increase the leaf-class proportion are matched, whereas links that increase the proportion of the opposite leaf-class are mismatched. These mismatched links are flagged as structurally suspicious IRC candidates. Rather than deleting them outright, the framework rigorously diagnoses their relevance by assessing prediction reliability. It selectively deletes conditions that are structurally and empirically irrelevant, while strictly protecting those whose deletion would reduce the rule's reliability. Experimental results confirm that the proposed framework achieves substantial rule simplification without sacrificing the reliability of the original tree.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究决策树规则中无关条件（IRCs）的删除问题。现有方法未能考虑IRCs的结构性成因，导致简化后的规则可靠性下降。作者通过理论分析发现，二叉分裂会使子节点类比例相对于父节点反向变化，并据此提出一种结构性IRC删除框架，通过匹配与不匹配链接识别可疑条件，再基于预测可靠性进行诊断性删除。实验表明，该框架能在显著简化规则的同时保持原始树的可靠性。
Motivation: 决策树生成的if-then规则中常含有无关条件（IRCs），即使是最优稀疏树归纳算法也无法避免。现有删除方法要么过度保留原树导致简化不足，要么过度删除导致可靠性下降。
Method: 提出结构性IRC删除框架：基于二叉分裂使子节点类比例反向变化的事实，定义链路匹配（增加本叶类比例）与不匹配（增加对立叶类比例），将不匹配链路标记为结构可疑IRC候选。然后通过评估预测可靠性进行诊断，选择性删除结构上和经验上均无关的条件，保护删除会降低可靠性的条件。
Result: 实验确认该框架在实现显著规则简化的同时，未牺牲原树的可靠性。
Conclusion: 本文提供的理论基础和结构性删除方法平衡了规则简化与可靠性，提示未来可进一步应用于可解释AI中的规则压缩。

papers.title: Towards Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in 2D medical image understanding, their extension to 3D volumetric imaging remains hindered by prohibitive annotation costs and dataset opacity. Current data formats, predominantly consisting of rigid Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs or unstructured final clinical reports, typically fail to capture explicit clinical reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce a large-scale structured reasoning dataset constructed via a novel slice-wise data synthesis paradigm. Inspired by the genuine diagnostic workflow of radiologists, this paradigm models visual cognition by decomposing the complex 3D reading process, translating global clinical priors into fine-grained, per-slice observations that are subsequently synthesized into an interpretable Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Crucially, this synthesized reasoning framework enforces essential clinical principles: sequential spatial tracking, multi-slice spatial awareness for artifact mitigation, and differential exclusion. To validate this approach, we instruction-tune a standard 2D-pretrained MLLM baseline using the synthesized data to enhance its volumetric comprehension. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple 3D medical benchmarks demonstrate that our method yields significant performance improvements over the 2D baseline. Furthermore, the resulting model exhibits robust spatial reasoning capabilities and rivals resource-intensive native 3D architectures, effectively bridging the performance gap. Ultimately, this data-centric strategy unlocks deep volumetric understanding and highly interpretable clinical logic without requiring computationally expensive 3D-specific pre-training. The complete repository, including datasets and training workflows, is publicly available at https://github.com/2020420145009/hounsfield.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学多模态大语言模型在3D体素图像理解中的挑战，提出了一种基于切片式数据合成范式的结构化推理数据集构建方法。该方法模拟放射科医生诊断流程，将全局临床先验分解为逐切片观察并合成可解释的思维链（CoT），从而让2D预训练的MLLM无需3D专用预训练即可提升3D空间推理能力。在多个3D医学基准上的实验表明，该方法显著优于2D基线，并接近资源密集的3D原生架构。
Motivation: 现有医学MLLM主要处理2D图像，扩展到3D体素图像面临标注成本高、数据集不透明以及现有VQA对或临床报告缺乏显式临床推理等限制。
Method: 提出切片式数据合成范式，模拟放射科医生诊断流程，将复杂3D阅读过程分解为逐切片细粒度观察，并合成可解释的思维链（CoT），强制包含顺序空间跟踪、多切片空间感知以减少伪影以及鉴别排除等临床原则。
Result: 在多个3D医学基准上，经过指令微调的2D预训练MLLM相比2D基线有显著性能提升，展现出稳健的空间推理能力，并接近资源密集的3D原生架构，有效缩小了性能差距。
Conclusion: 该数据驱动的策略无需昂贵的3D专用预训练即可实现深度体素理解和高度可解释的临床逻辑，相关数据和训练流程已开源。

papers.title: Quantum Topological Data Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Many datasets encountered across a wide range of domains possess rich geometric and topological structure that is difficult to capture using conventional vector-based representations. Quantum machine learning offers the possibility of processing high-dimensional data in Hilbert spaces, but its practical success depends critically on how classical data is encoded into quantum states. We introduce \emph{quantum topological data encoding} (QTDE), a general framework for encoding topological information into quantum states via topology-driven quantum evolution. Our method generalises an existing topology-driven quantum encoding framework to higher-dimensional data. We test the proposed method on clique-complexes classification tasks, and provide preliminary evidence that topology-driven quantum representations can capture discriminative information beyond that available through direct comparisons of classical topological descriptors. The proposed quantum representations consistently outperform a baseline based on direct comparisons of the combinatorial Laplacians describing the underlying topological structure. We indicate several areas of application where the framework can be used to provide a more efficient and reliable data representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子拓扑数据编码（QTDE）框架，通过拓扑驱动的量子演化将拓扑信息编码到量子态中，并推广到高维数据。在单纯复形分类任务上，该方法优于基于组合拉普拉斯算子的基线，表明拓扑驱动量子表示能捕获超越经典拓扑描述符的判别信息。
Motivation: 许多数据集具有丰富的几何和拓扑结构，传统向量表示难以捕捉，而量子机器学习中经典数据如何有效编码到量子态是关键问题。
Method: 提出QTDE框架，通过拓扑驱动的量子演化将拓扑信息编码到量子态，并推广到高维数据，在单纯复形分类任务上测试。
Result: 在单纯复形分类任务上，QTDE优于基于直接比较组合拉普拉斯算子的基线方法，初步证明拓扑驱动量子表示能捕获经典拓扑描述符之外的判别信息。
Conclusion: QTDE框架可应用于多种领域，提供更高效可靠的数据表示，但摘要未提及局限性。

summary_sections.result: 在单纯复形分类任务上，QTDE优于基于直接比较组合拉普拉斯算子的基线方法，初步证明拓扑驱动量子表示能捕获经典拓扑描述符之外的判别信息。
summary_sections.conclusion: QTDE框架可应用于多种领域，提供更高效可靠的数据表示，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Heavy-Tailed Flow Matching via Random Clocks
papers.abstract_en: Heavy-tailed data arise in many domains where rare events carry disproportionate importance, such as imbalanced image datasets, financial returns, and weather extremes. Standard diffusion and flow-matching models typically begin from Gaussian noise or Gaussian source distributions, which yield tractable training targets but provide a poor inductive match for heavy-tailed data. We propose Heavy-Tailed Flow Matching via Random Clocks (HTFM), a framework that portrays heavy-tailed sources as mixtures of clock-conditioned Gaussian sources. Conditioning on a given clock path, the source distribution and flow are Gaussian; marginalizing over the clock gives a Gaussian scale mixture covering Gaussian, $α$-stable, and Student-t families. To make the clock-conditioned vector field practical, we encode the path-valued clock using truncated logsignature features, allowing the velocity field to adapt to the realized conditional space with negligible overhead. Empirically, on 2D imbalanced $α$-stable mixtures, CIFAR10-LT, and HRRR weather fields, HTFM improves mode coverage, sample quality, and tail-statistic recovery over Gaussian flow matching and competitive heavy-tailed baselines, while retaining the low-NFE sampling advantage of flow matching. Moreover, the random-clock formulation further provides a practical tail-control interface: by varying only the clock law or tail parameter, the same architecture can calibrate the ``heaviness'' of generated tails across different distribution families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出重尾流匹配（HTFM）框架，通过随机时钟将重尾源分布建模为时钟条件高斯分布的混合，从而扩展了流匹配模型对重尾数据的适用性。实验表明，在不增加采样步数的前提下，HTFM在二维不平衡α-稳定混合、CIFAR10-LT和HRRR天气场数据集上改善了模式覆盖、样本质量和尾部统计恢复。
Motivation: 标准扩散和流匹配模型通常从高斯噪声开始，不适合重尾数据（如极端天气、金融回报）。现有方法缺乏针对重尾分布的生成建模框架。
Method: 将重尾源分布视为随机时钟条件的高斯混合，利用截断对数签名编码时钟路径，使速度场适应条件分布，同时保持训练和采样效率。
Result: 在HRRR天气场等数据集上，HTFM优于高斯流匹配和竞争的重尾基线，改善了尾部统计恢复；通过改变时钟律或尾参数可控制生成分布的“重尾程度”。
Conclusion: 随机时钟公式为流匹配模型提供了实用的尾部控制接口，可适应不同分布族，且不增加采样开销。

papers.title: AI-Augmented Human Resource Management? Insights from German companies
papers.abstract_en: This study examines the integration of AI into Human Resource Management in German companies. We ask if and how AI-based technologies are \enquote{augmenting} human resource management. Organisations employ generative AI or predictive analytics to transform traditional human resource functions, to streamline routine tasks and to reallocate resources toward strategic, people-centred activities. Our findings from interviews and group discussions and a survey (N=410) reveal that while AI tools enhance HR analytics capabilities, their adoption mainly serves efficiency and rationalising goals. The introduction of AI tools is shaped by organisational transformation factors such as digital infrastructure, co-determination frameworks, and ethical implications. The research highlights both the strategic potential for improved talent development and the challenges posed by data governance and algorithmic transparency. Overall, this work contributes to understanding the ambiguous role of technological change in HR, which promises to augment predictive capabilities yet serves the ends of efficiency and rationalisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究德国公司中AI在人力资源管理中的整合情况。通过访谈、小组讨论和调查（N=410），发现AI工具主要用于提升效率和合理化目标，而非真正增强人力资源战略职能。研究强调了数字基础设施、共同决定框架和伦理影响等组织转型因素的作用。
Motivation: 现有文献对AI在HRM中是否真正实现“增强”存在争议，本文通过实证研究德国企业的AI应用情况，揭示其实际目标与效果。
Method: 采用混合方法：定性（访谈和小组讨论）与定量（N=410的问卷调查）相结合，分析组织转型因素对AI采纳的影响。
Result: 发现AI工具增强了HR分析能力，但采纳主要服务于效率和合理化目标，而非战略性人员发展。数据治理和算法透明度是主要挑战。
Conclusion: 研究贡献于理解技术变革在HR中的模糊角色：虽承诺增强预测能力，却服务于效率和合理化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NodeImport: Imbalanced Node Classification with Node Importance Assessment
papers.abstract_en: In real-world applications, node classification on graphs often faces the challenge of class imbalance, where majority classes dominate training, resulting in biased model performance. Traditional GNNs often struggle in such scenarios, as they tend to overfit to majority classes while underrepresenting minority classes. Existing solutions, which either prioritize nodes based on class size or synthesize new nodes for minority classes, often fall short of effectively addressing this imbalance issue. This paper introduces an approach to class-imbalanced node classification by utilizing a balanced meta-set for importance measurement, where a training node is considered significant if it enhances model performance under an unbiased setting. Our method identifies important nodes that can counteract class imbalance and utilizes them for model training, allowing for fine-grained and dynamic node selection throughout the training process. We theoretically derive a formula to directly assess node importance, reducing computational overhead and providing an intuitive threshold for node selection. Guided by this metric, we develop a novel framework that filters valuable labeled, unlabeled, and synthetic nodes that enhance model performance in an unbiased context. A key advantage of this framework is its separation of the synthetic node generation process from the filtering process, ensuring compatibility with various node generation methods. Furthermore, we introduce a strategy to construct a high-quality meta-set that closely approximates the overall feature distribution, ensuring robust representation of each class. We evaluate our framework, NodeImport, across multiple datasets using popular GNN architectures, demonstrating its superiority over existing baselines. Our results highlight the flexibility and effectiveness of the framework in mitigating class imbalance, leading to improved outcomes.
papers.journal_ref: KDD '25: Proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.1, 2025, Pages 94 - 105
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NodeImport框架，通过节点重要性评估和平衡元集解决图节点分类中的类别不平衡问题。该方法推导出节点重要性的直接计算公式，并据此筛选有价值的标记、未标记和合成节点用于训练，在多个数据集上使用流行GNN架构取得了优于现有基线的结果。
Motivation: 现有GNN在类别不平衡时倾向于多数类，而传统方法如基于类别大小或合成新节点难以有效缓解偏差。
Method: 利用平衡元集评估节点重要性，推导出直接计算公式以降低计算开销，并开发框架动态筛选标记、未标记和合成节点，将合成过程与筛选过程分离以兼容多种生成方法。
Result: 在多个数据集上使用流行GNN架构，实验表明NodeImport优于现有基线，有效缓解类别不平衡并提升分类性能。
Conclusion: 该框架灵活且有效，通过节点重要性评估和元集构造可显著改善类别不平衡下的节点分类效果。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Recursive ArUco Markers: A Scalable Fiducial Marker Design for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Landing Pads
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) increasingly rely on visual fiducial markers for autonomous navigation and precision landing. However, standard markers suffer from limited operational ranges, becoming undetectable when the camera is either too far or too close. While recursive and fractal markers have been proposed to address this issue, existing approaches either require the marker's center to remain visible, making them vulnerable to occlusion, or are limited in their recursion depth and placement. We propose a novel Recursive ArUco marker design. Our method allows any standard fiducial marker to be transformed into a recursive marker with an arbitrary depth. By employing a modified bit-sampling strategy during detection, we embed complete markers within both the black and white bits of the parent marker. This approach guarantees unlimited recursion depth and robust detection even with partial occlusion, as it does not rely on the marker's center being visible. Furthermore, by maintaining a single, unique identifier across all recursive scales, our proposal provides an extensive dictionary of multiple unique landing pads. This capability allows fleets of UAVs to operate simultaneously, with each drone landing at its designated location -- a feature not supported by existing Fractal and Harco markers due to their structural and dictionary constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种递归ArUco标记设计，使标准标记可以转换为任意深度的递归标记，通过改进位采样策略实现无限递归深度和鲁棒检测，支持部分遮挡，并提供大量唯一标识，适合多无人机同时着陆。
Motivation: 现有视觉标记在无人机着陆中工作范围有限，远或近时难以检测；现有递归或分形标记要么依赖中心可见（易被遮挡），要么递归深度和放置受限。
Method: 提出递归ArUco标记，将完整标记嵌入父标记的黑色和白色位中，使用改进的位采样策略进行检测，无需中心可见，可实现无限递归深度。
Result: 摘要声称该方法实现无限递归深度，部分遮挡下鲁棒检测，并提供大量唯一着陆垫标识，支持多无人机同时操作，优于现有的Fractal和Harco标记。
Conclusion: 该设计使任何标准标记可转化为递归标记，克服了现有方法的遮挡和字典限制。

papers.title: Multimodal Assessment of Pancreatic Cancer Resectability Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate determination of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) resectability relies on evaluating how the tumor interacts with major peripancreatic vessels on CT imaging, yet expert assessment often shows substantial variability. We introduce a fully automated multimodal deep learning framework that jointly analyzes 3D contrast enhanced CT and structured clinical information to classify patients into the three National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) resectability categories (upfront resectable, borderline resectable, locally advanced). The approach uses a Swin-UNETR backbone to obtain anatomy aware image representations through auxiliary segmentation of pancreas, tumor, and vascular structures. These features are fused with a compact clinical embedding derived from 17 routinely collected variables and processed by a lightweight classification head. Model training is guided by a dynamic multitask objective that adapts the balance between segmentation and classification based on current tumor Dice performance, promoting feature representations that remain both anatomically informed and discriminative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全自动多模态深度学习框架，联合分析3D增强CT影像和结构化临床信息，根据NCCN指南将胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）患者分为可切除、交界可切除和局部晚期三类。框架使用Swin-UNETR骨干网络通过胰腺、肿瘤和血管结构的辅助分割获取解剖感知的图像表示，并与17个常规临床变量生成的紧凑嵌入融合，由轻量分类头处理。训练采用动态多任务目标，根据当前肿瘤Dice性能自适应调整分割和分类的权重，促进解剖信息丰富且判别性强的特征表示。
Motivation: 胰腺癌可切除性的精确判断依赖于CT影像上肿瘤与主要胰周血管的关系，但专家评估存在显著变异性，亟需自动化方法减少主观差异并提升一致性。
Method: 基于Swin-UNETR的编码器提取3D增强CT的解剖感知特征（通过胰腺、肿瘤和血管的辅助分割），与17项常规临床变量的紧凑嵌入拼接，经轻量分类头输出NCCN可切除性分类。训练使用动态多任务损失，根据当前分割Dice系数自动调整分割和分类任务的权重。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅描述了框架设计。
Conclusion: 该框架通过多模态融合和多任务学习有望提高胰腺癌可切除性评估的准确性和一致性，但需进一步实验验证。

papers.title: TCAM-Diff: Triplane-Aware Cross-Attention Medical Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: We introduce TCAM-Diff, a novel 3D medical image generation model that reduces the memory requirements to encode and generate high-resolution 3D data. This model utilizes a decoder-only autoencoder method to learn triplane representation from dense volume and leverages generalization operations to prevent overfitting. Subsequently, it uses a triplane-aware cross-attention diffusion model to learn and integrate these features effectively. Furthermore, the features generated by the diffusion model can be rapidly transformed into 3D volumes using a pre-trained decoder module. Our experiments on three different scales of medical datasets, BrainTumour 128 x 128 x 128, Pancreas 256 x 256 x 256, and Colon 512 x 512 x 512, demonstrate outstanding results. We utilized MSE and SSIM to assess reconstruction quality and leveraged the Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (W-GAN) critic to assess generative quality. Comparisons with existing approaches show that our method gives better reconstruction and generation results than other encoder-decoder methods with similar-sized latent spaces.
papers.comment: Accepted at AAAI 2025. Code is available at https://github.com/Fredy-Zhang/TCAM-Diff
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 39(21): 22732-22740, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TCAM-Diff，一种3D医学图像生成模型，通过解码器-自编码器学习三平面表示，并采用三平面感知交叉注意力扩散模型生成高质量3D体数据。在三个不同尺度的医学数据集上（BrainTumour 128^3, Pancreas 256^3, Colon 512^3）验证了重建质量和生成质量，相比类似潜空间大小的编码器-解码器方法更好。
Motivation: 现有3D医学图像生成模型需要大量内存来编码高分辨率3D数据，本文旨在减少内存需求。
Method: 使用解码器-自编码器从密集体素学习三平面表示，并通过泛化操作防止过拟合；然后采用三平面感知交叉注意力扩散模型整合特征；最后用预训练解码器将扩散生成的特征快速转换为3D体素。
Result: 在三个数据集上，使用MSE和SSIM评估重建质量，使用W-GAN批评器评估生成质量，结果表明该方法优于其他类似潜空间大小的编码器-解码器方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了该方法的有效性，但未明确提及局限性。

summary_sections.result: 在三个数据集上，使用MSE和SSIM评估重建质量，使用W-GAN批评器评估生成质量，结果表明该方法优于其他类似潜空间大小的编码器-解码器方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调了该方法的有效性，但未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Bake It Till You Make It: Ultrafast Spatial Texture-Atlas Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent extensions of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture fine color details using hash-grid-based appearance parameterization but incur high computational cost during fragment rendering. We introduce a decoupled radiance representation that models low-frequency geometry and view dependent appearance features with 2D surfels while representing high-frequency textures via a view-independent spatial hash grid that is baked into a compact texture atlas. By including sparsity-enhancing optimizations that penalize semi-transparency and per-primitive falloff, our method aggressively prunes insignificant surfels and achieves significantly faster and sparser reconstructions than prior work. Exploiting geometric sparsity and efficient GPU texture mapping, our approach achieves up to a fivefold speedup over 3DGS while preserving state-of-the-art visual fidelity, enabling real-time 4K rendering at 60 FPS on consumer hardware.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Project page with videos and interactive demos: https://nilkel.github.io/bitymi/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种解耦的辐射表示方法，将低频几何与视点相关外观特征用二维曲面元建模，高频纹理通过空间哈希网格烘焙到紧凑纹理图集中。通过半透明惩罚和逐基元衰减等稀疏性优化，显著剪枝不重要的曲面元，相比3DGS实现五倍加速，并在消费级硬件上实现4K 60fps实时渲染。
Motivation: 现有3DGS改进方法使用哈希网格外观参数化捕获精细颜色细节，但在片段渲染阶段计算成本高，难以实现超高速渲染。
Method: 将辐射表示解耦为低频几何/视点相关特征（由2D surfels表示）和高频纹理（由视图无关的空间哈希网格表示，再烘焙到紧凑纹理图集）。引入稀疏性增强优化（半透明惩罚、逐基元衰减）以剪枝不重要的surfels。
Result: 相比3DGS，该方法在保持最先进视觉保真度的同时，实现最高五倍加速，并在消费级硬件上以60 FPS实时渲染4K分辨率。
Conclusion: 利用几何稀疏性和高效GPU纹理映射，该方法在3DGS基础上实现了显著的加速和稀疏化重建，适用于实时高分辨率渲染。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AspectCLIP: Optimizing CLIP Representation Space via Aspect-Guided Consistency Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining learns a shared representation space through large-scale contrastive learning. However, existing methods that enforce global consistency regularization overlook a key challenge: the inherent information asymmetry between images and text: captions typically describe only one specific aspect of an image, thus images with similar visual content can be paired with completely divergent textual content and semantic information. Consequently, global regularizers inadvertently impose constraints between visually similar images whose captions describe divergent aspects, introducing semantic distortion into the representation space. We propose AspectCLIP, a framework that reformulates consistency regularization to respect this one-to-many structure. AspectCLIP first partitions training samples into attribute clusters based on textual similarity to identify aspect-coherent groups, then applies full cyclic consistency within each cluster while restricting cross-cluster regularization to prototype-level comparisons. This aspect-guided regularization enforces strict geometric alignment only when images and texts describe a consistent facet, while allowing flexibility across divergent aspects. Extensive experiments on downstream tasks demonstrate that AspectCLIP consistently outperforms traditional methods and achieves a more structured representation space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AspectCLIP，针对CLIP全局一致性正则化忽略图像与文本信息不对称的问题，通过文本相似性聚类将样本划分为方面一致的组，在组内施加完整循环一致性，组间仅进行原型级比较，从而减少语义扭曲，得到更结构化的表示空间。
Motivation: 现有CLIP全局一致性正则化未考虑图像与文本信息不对称：同一图像可对应描述不同方面的文本。全局约束在视觉相似但文本方面不同的样本间引入语义扭曲，损害表示空间质量。
Method: 提出AspectCLIP框架：先基于文本相似性将训练样本聚类为属性簇，形成方面一致的组；然后在簇内执行完整循环一致性，簇间仅进行原型级对比，实现方面引导的正则化。
Result: 在多个下游任务上，AspectCLIP一致优于传统方法，并获得了更结构化的表示空间。
Conclusion: 方面引导的正则化能尊重图像-文本的一对多结构，仅在一致方面强制几何对齐，跨方面保持灵活性，从而提升表示性能。

papers.title: RainDancer: RGB-Event Video Deraining with Rain-Oriented Spiking Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Video deraining aims to recover clean visual content from rainy videos for reliable perception under adverse weather. Existing methods mainly rely on RGB sequences and temporal redundancy, but RGB-only restoration remains ambiguous in dynamic rainy scenes, where rain streaks, textures, boundaries, motion, and occlusions may share similar visual patterns. Event cameras provide complementary motion-sensitive cues with high temporal resolution, but event streams also contain sensor noise and background-triggered responses, so direct RGB-Event fusion may introduce cross-modal interference. To address this issue, we propose RainDancer, a progressive RGB-Event video deraining framework based on a decompose-before-interact paradigm. The core idea is to separate rain and background components within each modality before cross-modal interaction. In the RGB branch, frame features are progressively decomposed into rain and background representations. In the event branch, a rain-oriented spiking neural network module captures sparse and bursty event dynamics associated with rain motion. Component-level fusion is then performed between semantically aligned representations for structure preservation and rain suppression. We further introduce event-domain supervision to regularize sparse event reconstruction, structural consistency, and gradient orientation. Experiments on synthetic and real RGB-Event video deraining datasets demonstrate superior quantitative performance, visual quality, and downstream perception robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/AE86-plus/RainDancer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对动态雨天场景中RGB视频去雨的模糊性以及直接RGB-事件融合带来的跨模态干扰，本文提出RainDancer框架。该框架采用先分解后交互的范式，在RGB分支逐步解耦雨和背景特征，在事件分支利用面向雨的脉冲神经网络捕获与雨相关的稀疏动态，再通过组件级融合实现结构保持和雨去除。实验表明该方法在合成和真实RGB-事件去雨数据集上取得了优越的量化指标、视觉质量和下游感知鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有RGB视频去雨方法在动态场景下难以区分雨纹与纹理、边界、运动等相似视觉模式，而直接融合事件流会引入传感器噪声和背景触发响应，导致跨模态干扰。
Method: 提出RainDancer框架：（1）RGB分支渐进分解帧特征为雨和背景表示；（2）事件分支采用面向雨的脉冲神经网络模块，提取雨运动相关的稀疏和突发动态；（3）在语义对齐后执行组件级融合，并引入事件域监督以约束稀疏事件重建、结构一致性和梯度方向。
Result: 在合成和真实RGB-事件视频去雨数据集上，RainDancer取得了优于现有方法的量化性能和视觉效果，并提升了下游感知任务的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 先分解后交互的跨模态融合策略能有效抑制雨纹并保留背景结构，事件域监督进一步提升了去雨质量。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: Traffic-Aware Randomized Smoothing for LLM-Based Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are increasingly studied for security monitoring, yet their robustness against feasible traffic manipulation remains largely empirical. We present Traffic-Aware Randomized Smoothing (TA-RS), a classifier-agnostic certified defense that injects Gaussian noise exclusively into the directly controllable (DC) subspace -- features a remote attacker can modify -- during both fine-tuning and certification, aligning the smoothing distribution with the attacker-controllable subspace. We identify a critical prerequisite: applying standard randomized smoothing to clean-trained LLM-IDS yields weak certified accuracy in three of four (model, dataset) pairs tested (14-33%, at or below random) and only 57% in the fourth (43 pp below the noise-augmented result); noise-augmented fine-tuning recovers to 68-100% on two of three benchmark datasets (at sigma=0.25). At the L_inf-equivalent threshold R_inf = epsilon*sqrt(|DC|) (epsilon=0.05), TA-RS achieves 55-100% certified accuracy on CIC-IDS-2018 and HIKARI-2021, with median certified radii (R approx 0.45-0.96) exceeding R_inf by 1.8-5x (across sigma=0.25-1.00). Against a fairly trained iso-trained RS baseline the residual advantage is dataset-dependent (4-19 pp on CIC-IDS-2018). The larger gap -- up to 72 pp against an isotropic RS baseline that shares the DC-noise-augmented training recipe -- primarily reflects the training-certification mismatch rather than DC alignment alone: isotropic test-time noise perturbs uncontrollable features the attacker cannot exploit, triggering abstention rates up to 68%. RT-IoT2022 probes the limits of the method: it fails under the default fine-tuning recipe but recovers to 76%/69% certified accuracy (LLaMA3-8B/Qwen3-8B) when noise augmentation is increased.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 14 figures, 14 tables. Submitted to Expert Systems with Applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种流量感知随机平滑（Traffic-Aware Randomized Smoothing, TA-RS）方法，用于提升基于大语言模型的入侵检测系统（LLM-IDS）对流量操纵攻击的鲁棒性。该方法仅在攻击者可控制的子空间中注入高斯噪声，并在微调和认证阶段对齐噪声分布。实验表明，TA-RS在CIC-IDS-2018和HIKARI-2021数据集上达到55-100%的认证准确率，但RT-IoT2022数据集需要增加噪声增强才能恢复性能。
Motivation: 基于LLM的入侵检测系统在安全监控中日益受到关注，但对其针对流量操纵的鲁棒性研究仍主要停留在经验层面，缺乏形式化的认证防御。
Method: 提出TA-RS，一种分类器无关的认证防御方法：仅在攻击者可直接控制的特征子空间（DC subspace）注入高斯噪声，并在微调和认证阶段保持一致的噪声分布，从而对齐平滑分布与攻击者可控子空间。
Result: 在CIC-IDS-2018和HIKARI-2021上，TA-RS在L_inf等效阈值R_inf下实现55-100%的认证准确率，中位认证半径超过R_inf的1.8-5倍。与基础随机平滑基线相比，优势最高达72个百分点，但部分差异来自训练-认证不匹配。RT-IoT2022上默认配方失败，增加噪声增强后恢复至76%/69%。
Conclusion: TA-RS通过注入DC子空间噪声提升LLM-IDS的认证鲁棒性，但效果依赖于数据集和噪声增强策略，且存在训练-认证不匹配问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prospective clinical indication, post-hoc report leakage, and fusion design in multi-image chest radiograph classification: a patient-clustered evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Chest radiograph datasets often combine multiple images with Clinical Indication, Findings, and Impression, although these inputs are produced at different stages of care. We evaluated 15,000 ReXGradient-160K studies with two readable images and five CheXbert-derived report observations. Frozen DenseNet-121 and Bio+ClinicalBERT encoders were used to compare image-only, Indication-only, fixed-order multimodal, random-swap, DeepSets, and SectionGuard-MI models. Findings and Impression were evaluated only as post-hoc leakage controls. Models were trained with five seeds, and public-test uncertainty was estimated with 2,000 patient-cluster bootstrap replicates. Under U-Ones, macro AUROC was 0.643 for the primary image, 0.694 for two images, 0.749 for Indication, and 0.780 for ordinary two-image-plus-Indication fusion. SectionGuard-MI achieved AUROC 0.783 and AUPRC 0.260. Relative to ordinary fusion, its paired AUROC difference was 0.0031 (95% CI, -0.0042 to 0.0104; adjusted p=0.374), while its AUPRC difference was 0.0289 (95% CI, 0.0095 to 0.0413; adjusted p=0.004). DeepSets had the highest prospective AUROC point estimate (0.787), and random-swap fusion had the highest prospective AUPRC point estimate (0.265) with better calibration than SectionGuard-MI. Full report text alone reached AUROC 0.979 and AUPRC 0.836; AUROC remained above 0.973 after exact or expanded masking. These results show that prospective Indication is strongly associated with report-derived targets, permutation-aware fusion is competitive, and post-hoc report text creates substantial report-label circularity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多图像胸部X光片分类中的三个关键问题：前瞻性临床指征（Clinical Indication）与事后报告（Findings/Impression）的泄漏风险、多图像融合设计的评估方法，以及患者聚类验证的重要性。基于15,000例ReXGradient-160K研究，比较了多种模型（纯图像、仅指征、固定顺序多模态、随机交换、DeepSets、SectionGuard-MI等），发现仅使用指征即可达到AUROC 0.749，而事后报告文本会导致严重的报告-标签循环（AUROC高达0.979），表明利用前瞻性指征的融合设计（如SectionGuard-MI）在公平评估下并不显著优于普通融合。
Motivation: 胸部X光数据集常将不同护理阶段产生的多张图像与临床指征、发现和印象合并，但事后报告可能引入标签泄漏。需严格区分前瞻性输入与事后泄漏源，并提供患者聚类级别的统计评估。
Method: 使用15,000个研究（每例两张可读图像+CheXbert提取的5个观察），编码器为冻结DenseNet-121与Bio+ClinicalBERT。比较图像仅、指征仅、固定顺序多模态、随机交换、DeepSets和SectionGuard-MI模型。事后报告（发现和印象）仅作为泄漏对照。训练5个种子，通过2,000个患者聚类bootstrap估计不确定性。
Result: U-Ones下，单图像macro AUROC 0.643，双图像0.694，仅指征0.749，普通双图像+指征融合0.780。SectionGuard-MI达0.783 AUROC和0.260 AUPRC；与普通融合相比AUROC差异不显著（p=0.374），AUPRC差异显著（0.0289，p=0.004）。DeepSets前瞻性AUROC点估计最高（0.787），随机交换融合AUPRC点估计最高（0.265）且校准更好。事后报告文本单独AUROC 0.979，AUPRC 0.836，即使掩码后AUROC仍>0.973。
Conclusion: 前瞻性指征与报告衍生目标高度相关；感知置换的融合方法具有竞争力；事后报告文本造成严重报告-标签循环。

papers.title: CAS I: A Geometric Coding Theorem
papers.abstract_en: This paper establishes a direct analogue of the classical Coding Theorem in the setting of symmetry groups. We consider computable bijections on the set of binary strings, called symmetries and define the symmetry prior of a string as the probability that a randomly chosen symmetry from a given group has the string as its unique fixed point. We show that for any fix-retractable symmetry group, a group admitting a computable section that selects an isolating symmetry for every string, the symmetry prior is a universal lower semi-computable semi-measure. In this case, the Geometric Coding Theorem holds. We also develop a Galois connection between subgroups of G and subsets of binary strings, characterizing closed points and maximal closed subgroups, and explore the join-semilattice of dense subgroups. Our results unify algorithmic information theory with group theory and provide a framework for studying symmetry-induced complexity measures. This paper is the first in a series on Computational Algorithmic Statistics (CAS).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在对称群（symmetry groups）的设定中建立了经典编码定理的直接类比。定义二进制字符串的对称先验（symmetry prior）为随机选择的对称性使该字符串成为其唯一不动点的概率，并证明对于固定可收缩对称群（fix-retractable symmetry group），该先验是一个通用下半可计算半测度（universal lower semi-computable semi-measure），从而使得几何编码定理（Geometric Coding Theorem）成立。此外，还发展了子群与二进制字符串子集之间的伽罗瓦连接（Galois connection），刻画了闭点和最大闭子群，并探索了稠密子群的并半格。本文是计算算法统计（Computational Algorithmic Statistics, CAS）系列的第一篇。
Motivation: 该工作旨在将经典编码定理推广到对称群的场景，从而建立算法信息论（algorithmic information theory）与群论（group theory）之间的直接联系，为研究对称性诱导的复杂度度量提供形式化框架。
Method: 考虑二进制字符串集合上的可计算双射（称为对称性），定义对称先验为从给定群中随机选取的对称性以该字符串为唯一不动点的概率。通过引入固定可收缩对称群（即存在可计算截面为每个字符串选取一个隔离对称性的群），证明对称先验满足通用下半可计算半测度的性质，并在此条件下证明几何编码定理。此外，利用伽罗瓦连接分析子群与字符串子集之间的结构关系。
Result: 摘要宣称：对于任何固定可收缩对称群，对称先验是通用下半可计算半测度，从而几何编码定理成立。同时给出了子群与字符串子集之间的伽罗瓦连接，并刻画了闭点和最大闭子群。
Conclusion: 该成果将算法信息论与群论统一，提供了一个研究对称性诱导复杂度度量的框架。本文是系列工作的首篇，后续将在此基础上进一步展开计算算法统计的研究。

papers.title: EgoProceVQA: A Novel Egocentric Procedural Understanding Task with Self-Skill-Exploration Agent
papers.abstract_en: Most daily activities are inherently procedural. However, existing evaluations for egocentric video understanding seldom address procedural understanding and largely overlook complex key-step-level reasoning under the widely used video question answering (VQA) paradigm for MLLMs. Such capabilities are crucial for building procedural AI assistants deployable on wearable devices. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Egocentric Procedural Understanding VQA task (EgoProceVQA), which systematically evaluates egocentric procedural reasoning abilities of current MLLMs and agents through six types of key-step-centric questions. Furthermore, we develop EgoProceGen, a data generation platform that efficiently constructs QA data tailored to different question types. Based on this platform, we build a benchmark with 3,600 questions, four common procedural scenarios, and 31 everyday procedural tasks. Evaluations on EgoProceVQA show that existing MLLMs and agents still have substantial room for improvement in procedural understanding. Therefore, we further propose EgoProceAgent, a self-skill-exploration agentic framework. We design a generic tool library for procedural understanding and a standardized sub-skill library shared across tools and models, enabling self-exploration without ground-truth supervision. By exploring how to compose and select sub-skills, the agent discovers effective skill strategies for diverse problems, and attains state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on multiple tasks. Together, our benchmark, generation platform, and agentic framework establish a unified foundation for EgoProceVQA. Project page: https://z1oong.github.io/EgoProceVQA/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EgoProceVQA任务，系统评估多模态大模型（MLLM）和智能体在第一人称视频中的程序性理解能力，包含六类关键步骤问题。作者构建EgoProceGen数据平台并生成3600个问题的基准，覆盖四个常见场景。进一步提出EgoProceAgent自技能探索框架，通过通用工具库和标准化子技能库实现无真值监督的自我探索，在开源模型中达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有第一人称视频理解缺乏程序性任务评估，尤其是关键步骤级推理，限制了可穿戴设备上的AI助手构建。
Method: 提出EgoProceGen数据生成平台和EgoProceAgent自技能探索框架，包含通用工具库和标准化子技能库，通过组合和选择子技能发现有效策略。
Result: 现有MLLM在程序性理解上仍有较大提升空间；EgoProceAgent在多个任务上达到开源模型最佳性能。
Conclusion: 该工作为第一人称程序性理解提供了统一的基准、生成平台和智能体框架。

papers.title: Mono-Z Dark Matter Search with Neural Spline Flows Using CMS Run 2015D Open Data
papers.abstract_en: We report a search for dark matter (DM) produced in association with a leptonically decaying \(Z\) boson at \(\sqrt{s}=13\) TeV using CMS Run 2015D open data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of \(2.32\,\mathrm{fb}^{-1}\) together with simplified-model Monte Carlo simulation. Events are selected in the mono-\(Z\rightarrow\ell^+\ell^-\) final state in both the \(μμ\) and \(ee\) channels. Forty kinematic observables are extracted from MINIAOD and MINIAODSIM, cleaned with physics-motivated selections, and reduced to a 37-dimensional feature vector. Five Neural Spline Flows are trained independently to model Standard Model background and mediator-specific DM signal densities. The per-event test statistic is constructed from the log-likelihood ratio between the signal and background density estimates, providing sensitivity across the full kinematic phase space without requiring a hard upper \(\mathrm{MET}\) threshold. A simultaneous profile-likelihood fit combining the two channels yields observed (expected) 95\% confidence level upper limits on the signal-strength parameter of \(μ<0.0177\) (\(0.0018\)) for the scalar mediator, \(μ<0.0362\) (\(0.0039\)) for the vector mediator, and \(μ<0.0498\) (\(0.0069\)) for the axial-vector mediator. The observed limits are weaker than expected because of a residual high-\(\mathrm{MET}\) background-modeling discrepancy rather than evidence for a DM signal. To our knowledge, this is the first application of Neural Spline Flow likelihood-ratio scoring to a mono-\(Z\) dark matter search using CMS Run 2015D open data simultaneously in the \(μμ\) and \(ee\) channels.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用CMS Run 2015D开放数据（积分亮度2.32 fb^{-1}），在√s=13 TeV下搜索与轻子衰变Z玻色子成对产生的暗物质。选用mono-Z→ℓ⁺ℓ⁻末态（μμ和ee通道），提取40个运动学观测量并降维至37维特征向量。训练五个神经样条流（Neural Spline Flows）分别建模标准模型背景和三种介质（标量、矢量、轴矢量）的暗物质信号密度，基于对数似然比构造逐事件检验统计量，无需硬性MET上限阈值。联合μμ和ee通道的轮廓似然拟合给出95%置信水平信号强度参数上限：标量介质μ<0.0177（预期0.0018），矢量介质μ<0.0362（预期0.0039），轴矢量介质μ<0.0498（预期0.0069）。观测上限弱于预期，归因于高MET区域的背景建模差异，而非暗物质信号证据。据我们所知，这是首次将神经样条流似然比评分同时应用于μμ和ee通道的mono-Z暗物质搜索。
Motivation: 暗物质的存在是粒子物理和宇宙学的重要未解问题，mono-Z通道为低能标暗物质产生提供了互补搜索途径。现有搜索通常依赖硬MET截断，可能损失低MET区域的灵敏度。
Method: 使用五个神经样条流神经网络分别对标准模型背景及标量、矢量、轴矢量介质信号进行密度估计；通过信号与背景密度估计的对数似然比构造逐事件检验统计量，覆盖全运动学相空间。然后对μμ和ee通道进行联合轮廓似然拟合，获得信号强度参数的上限。
Result: 在95%置信水平下，观测（预期）信号强度参数上限：标量介质μ<0.0177（0.0018），矢量介质μ<0.0362（0.0039），轴矢量介质μ<0.0498（0.0069）。观测上限弱于预期，源于高MET区域背景建模差异，未见暗物质信号证据。
Conclusion: 首次证明神经样条流似然比评分可有效应用于mono-Z暗物质搜索，且同时处理μμ和ee通道。该方法无需硬MET阈值，提升了相空间灵敏度。但背景建模不足导致观测上限偏弱，亟待改进。

papers.title: Kaleido: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Video Diffusion Transformers by Exploiting Latent Space Correlations
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality video but introduce extremely high compute cost due to the long diffusion timesteps and self attention computation. As diffusion timesteps are reduced, the computation cost of self attention becomes the dominant bottleneck. Existing acceleration approaches largely inherit sparse attention techniques from large language models, which fail to consider the unique spatiotemporal correlation of video data. This paper presents Kaleido, an algorithm hardware codesign that accelerates all operations in vDiTs by exploiting channel-wise spatiotemporal correlations in latent space. Based on this insight, we propose a lightweight channelwise reuse algorithm that skips redundant computations by reusing partial results while preserving higher generative quality than prior methods (>17 dB). To efficiently support this algorithm, we design a systolic array like accelerator with reconfigurable processing elements and a lightweight data dispatcher to mitigate irregular sparsity and data access patterns introduced by our reuse algorithm. Evaluations across three mainstream vDiT models show that Kaleido achieves up to 5.9x speedup and 16.0x energy savings over state of the art accelerators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kaleido，一种算法-硬件协同设计方案，通过利用视频扩散Transformer（vDiT）潜空间中的通道级时空相关性来加速计算。该方法设计了轻量级通道重用算法，跳过冗余计算，并配合可重构处理单元和轻量级数据调度器的类脉动阵列加速器。在三种主流vDiT模型上，Kaleido实现了最高5.9倍加速和16.0倍能效提升，生成质量优于先前方法（>17 dB）。
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer因长扩散步数和自注意力计算导致计算成本极高，现有加速方法继承自大语言模型的稀疏注意力技术，未考虑视频数据的独特时空相关性。
Method: 提出轻量级通道重用算法，通过重用部分结果跳过冗余计算；设计类脉动阵列加速器，包含可重构处理单元和轻量级数据调度器，以应对重用算法带来的不规则稀疏性和数据访问模式。
Result: 在三种主流vDiT模型上，Kaleido比现有最优加速器实现最高5.9倍速度提升和16.0倍能效节省，同时生成质量比先前方法高17 dB以上。
Conclusion: Kaleido通过算法-硬件协同设计有效加速vDiT所有操作，证明了潜空间通道级时空相关性在加速视频扩散模型中的价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MxGPS: Multiplex Graph Transformers for a Power Grid Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Single-task fine-tuning of graph neural networks (GNNs) for power grid problems exhibits a systematic failure mode: models that achieve the lowest in-distribution error degrade the most under topology shift. We term this topology overfitting: the tendency of task-specific gradient signals to encode relational structure particular to the training topologies rather than the underlying physics, causing models to fail on unseen grids despite strong in-distribution performance. To expose and address this failure mode, we introduce MxGPS (Multiplex GPS), a multiplex graph transformer that runs K task-specialised GPS branches over a shared node encoder, jointly trained on Static State Estimation (SSE) and AC Power Flow (PF) via a self-supervised pre-training and multi-task fine-tuning protocol, with a cross-branch attention module evaluated in ablation. The joint SSE+PF objective forces the shared encoder to simultaneously satisfy complementary gradient signals, preventing it from overfitting to topology-specific relational structure. Under a 3-fold sliding-window cross-validation spanning four unseen topologies (14-, 24-, 162-, and 300-bus), MxGPS attains 0% boundary violation rate (BVR) on all four zero-shot Power Flow topologies. Critically, models with substantially lower in-distribution PF error degrade by 190% to 1400% under topology shift, whereas MxGPS degrades by only 39%, an inversion that directly implicates topology overfitting as the failure mechanism rather than insufficient model capacity. With only 1.6M parameters (12x fewer than the GridFM reference baseline), MxGPS demonstrates that multi-task joint training is a principled and parameter-efficient mechanism for topology-agnostic generalisation in power grid foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MxGPS，一种多路图变换器 (multiplex graph transformer)，用于电力网格基础模型。摘要发现单任务微调图神经网络在拓扑偏移下性能急剧下降，称为拓扑过拟合 (topology overfitting)。MxGPS 通过共享节点编码器上运行 K 个任务专用的 GPS 分支，联合训练静态状态估计 (SSE) 和潮流 (PF) 任务，在零样本下对四种未见拓扑实现了 0% 边界违例率 (BVR)，且仅用 1.6M 参数。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络在电力网格问题上单任务微调时会过拟合训练拓扑，导致拓扑偏移下性能严重退化，这一系统性失败模式（拓扑过拟合）尚未被充分暴露和解决。
Method: 提出 MxGPS 架构，包含一个共享节点编码器和 K 个任务特化的 GPS 分支，通过自监督预训练和多任务微调协议联合优化 SSE 和 PF 目标，并引入跨分支注意力模块（消融实验中评估）。
Result: 在 14、24、162、300 总线四种未见拓扑的零样本潮流任务上，MxGPS 达到 0% 边界违例率 (BVR)。相比单任务模型在拓扑偏移下性能下降 190%–1400%，MxGPS 仅下降 39%，且参数量仅为 GridFM 基线的 1/12（1.6M）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多任务联合训练是一种原则性的、参数高效的机制，能够实现拓扑无关的泛化，为电力网格基础模型提供了新思路。

papers.title: Algebraic Representability as the Limiting Regime of Grokking: An Exactly Solvable Model with Holomorphic Activations
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks trained on modular arithmetic exhibit grokking, a delayed transition from memorisation to generalisation known to depend on model capacity: too little and the network memorises slowly or not at all, too much and it generalises almost immediately. What happens at the extreme of this spectrum, when the architecture's expressible function class collapses to a finite-dimensional algebraic variety? We study two-layer networks with a holomorphic monomial activation sigma(z)=z^k, trained on modular tasks encoded via roots of unity. Here the network output, regardless of hidden width, is confined to a (k+1)-dimensional subspace of characters of (Z_p)^2, an O(k/p^2) slice of the full function space. We give a complete algebraic characterisation of this subspace: a task is representable if and only if its discrete Fourier support lies on the diagonal u+v = k (mod p), which for linear-phase targets reduces to the arithmetic criterion m+n=k. This is not merely a constraint on eventual generalisation but on memorisation itself: because the outputs are algebraically confined, a non-representable target cannot be fit even on the training set, and we prove a positive lower bound on the training loss, independent of width. Across 585 runs the algebraic prediction matches the observed outcome with 99.8% accuracy, with no memorisation regime and no grokking; outcomes split cleanly into instant success and outright failure. This binary behaviour is the limiting case of the capacity-grokking relationship: when the expressible class shrinks to a fixed algebraic object, the question of when a network will grok dissolves into whether it can represent the target at all. A bottleneck ablation connects this extreme to standard networks, tracing a continuous path from representational failure, through memorisation without generalisation, to grokking with a shrinking gap as capacity grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了两层神经网络在全纯单项激活函数下训练模算术任务时的代数可表示性，揭示了当模型能力坍缩到有限维代数簇时的极端行为：任务要么立即成功，要么完全失败，不存在记忆化或grokking阶段。该行为是grokking与模型容量关系的极限情况。
Motivation: 神经网络在模算术任务上表现出grokking现象，即从记忆化到泛化的延迟转变，且该现象依赖于模型容量。本文旨在探索模型容量极端情况（可表达函数类坍缩为有限维代数簇）下的行为，以理解grokking的本质。
Method: 研究两层网络，激活函数为全纯单项式 sigma(z)=z^k，模任务通过单位根编码。网络输出被限制在 (k+1) 维子空间中，该子空间由 (Z_p)^2 的特征函数构成。给出了该子空间的完整代数刻画，并训练了585次实验进行验证。
Result: 任务可表示当且仅当其离散傅里叶支持位于对角线 u+v = k (mod p) 上，对于线性相位目标简化为算术准则 m+n=k。不可表示的目标即使在训练集上也无法拟合，训练损失有正下界，与宽度无关。585次实验中，代数预测与观察结果匹配准确率99.8%，无记忆化或grokking，结果分为即时成功或完全失败。
Conclusion: 网络输出的代数约束导致极端二元行为：当可表达类坍缩为固定代数对象时，grokking问题简化为目标是否可表示。通过瓶颈消融实验，从表示失败经无泛化的记忆化到grokking（随容量增加差距缩小）存在连续路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anatomically Faithful but Temporally Blind: Auditing Attribution for Left-Ventricular Ejection-Fraction Estimation from Echocardiography
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objective: Deep video models estimate left-ventricular ejection fraction (EF) from echocardiography with near-expert accuracy, and post-hoc attribution (Chefer relevance for transformers, Grad-CAM for CNNs) is increasingly used to certify that models "look at the right place." Yet whether these explanations are faithful both spatially and temporally is unaudited. Because EF is defined by the end-systolic (ES) and end-diastolic (ED) frames, a faithful explanation must localize the left ventricle (space) and the decisive frames (time). Methods: We fine-tune two distinct EF regressors on EchoNet-Dynamic -- a self-supervised VideoMAE transformer and a Kinetics-pretrained R(2+1)D CNN -- and audit each with architecture-matched attribution along three axes: intersection-over-relevance (IoR) against LV masks, deletion AUC, and a temporal localization index on ES/ED frames, each relative to chance with per-case 95% CIs over 50 studies. A tubelet-occlusion probe separates attribution failure from model behavior. Results: Both models are anatomically faithful -- IoR 2.91x (VideoMAE) and 1.98x (R(2+1)D) above chance -- yet temporally blind: temporal localization is indistinguishable from chance (0.97--1.00) and no better than random attribution. Occlusion shows the models do not preferentially rely on ES/ED (0.90x chance), so temporal blindness reflects model behavior, not an attribution artifact. Conclusions: Spatial faithfulness does not imply temporal faithfulness. Attribution can certify anatomical grounding while masking that a model ignores the clinically decisive frames -- a caution for XAI-based validation of video diagnostic models and a call for temporally-aware training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计深度视频模型在超声心动图中估计左心室射血分数（EF）时的归因解释，发现模型在空间上忠实（关注左心室），但在时间上盲目（不关注收缩末期和舒张末期关键帧），说明空间忠实性不代表时间忠实性。
Motivation: 现有归因解释用于验证模型‘看对地方’，但仅关注空间，未审计时间维度；EF由关键帧定义，模型是否关注关键帧未经验证。
Method: 微调两个视频模型（VideoMAE和R(2+1)D）在EchoNet-Dynamic上，用架构匹配的归因方法（Chefer相关性和Grad-CAM）从三个轴审计：与左心室掩膜的IoR、删除AUC、ES/ED帧的时间定位指数，并设置tubelet遮挡探针。
Result: 两个模型在空间上忠实（IoR 2.91x和1.98x高于随机），但时间定位与随机无差异（0.97-1.00）；遮挡实验表明模型并不优先依赖ES/ED帧（0.90x随机）。
Conclusion: 空间忠实性不保证时间忠实性；归因可以证明模型关注解剖结构，但可能掩盖其忽略临床关键帧的问题；呼吁时间感知的训练和评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Implementations of Quantum and Classical Topology-Aligned Architectures for Molecular Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: For low-data and resource-constrained regimes typical of quantum chemistry, parameter-efficient learning is a key objective. Here, we propose a topology-aligned inductive bias in which the model architecture mirrors the molecular bond graph: atoms map to a fixed register of computational units, and bonds determine which pairs interact through shared learnable parameters. This principle is instantiated in two architectures: a variational quantum circuit (Iso-QGNN), and a parameter-matched classical message-passing model (Iso-CGNN). The models are benchmarked on HOMO-LUMO and dipole moment binary classification tasks over the QM9 benchmark. With 64 trainable parameters, the implementations achieve test AUCs of approximately 0.88 (quantum) and 0.91 (classical) on the gap task, and close to 0.78 (both) on the dipole task. The models reach 90% of asymptotic performance within about 250 training molecules and gradient norms remain stable throughout training. These results indicate that the topology-aligned inductive bias is the active ingredient driving parameter efficiency at QM9 scale, with implications for matched-baseline benchmarking in quantum machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑对齐归纳偏置，使模型架构镜像分子键图：原子映射到计算单元，共享参数决定相互作用。在变分量子电路（Iso-QGNN）和经典消息传递（Iso-CGNN）中实例化，用于QM9数据集上的HOMO-LUMO和偶极矩二元分类。仅用64个可训练参数，量子模型在带隙任务上达到约0.88 AUC，经典模型约0.91 AUC，偶极任务两者接近0.78 AUC，且约250个分子即可达到90%渐近性能。
Motivation: 在量子化学的低数据、资源受限场景中，参数高效学习是关键目标，现有模型通常需要大量参数。
Method: 提出拓扑对齐归纳偏置，架构直接镜像分子键图：原子映射为固定计算单元，化学键决定共享可训练参数的成对交互。具体实例化为两个参数配对的架构：变分量子电路（Iso-QGNN）和经典消息传递模型（Iso-CGNN）。
Result: 在QM9基准上，HOMO-LUMO带隙分类任务中，64个可训练参数下量子模型AUC约0.88，经典模型约0.91；偶极矩分类任务两者均接近0.78。模型在约250个训练样本后达到90%渐近性能，梯度范数在整个训练中保持稳定。
Conclusion: 结果表明拓扑对齐归纳偏置是QM9规模下参数效率的主动成分，对量子机器学习中的匹配基线基准测试具有启示意义。

papers.title: Constraint-Driven Model Optimization: An Industry Framework for Selecting Compression and Acceleration Techniques in Modern Machine Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: The rapid deployment of machine learning systems across cloud, edge, and enterprise environments has brought model optimization to the forefront of systems-engineering. Despite a rich literature spanning quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), and inference-time optimization, practitioners are often left navigating these techniques through heuristics rather than principled methodology. We argue that optimization should be formulated as a constraint-driven, multi-objective engineering decision and introduce a unified framework that characterizes any production deployment along five interacting constraint dimensions: data availability, latency budget, memory budget, accuracy tolerance, and retraining budget. Building on this taxonomy, we synthesize empirical gains reported across the research literature and map them to operational constraints rather than algorithmic categories. To ensure practical relevance, we selected these techniques by reviewing recent literature for methods that report measurable improvements against critical deployment bottlenecks. We propose a prescriptive decision framework and provide optimization pipelines for four representative industrial scenarios to illustrate it in practice. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides one of the first structured attempts to formalize model optimization as a constraint-aware, multi-objective engineering process, synthesizing quantitative evidence from the research literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个约束驱动的模型优化框架，将机器学习模型部署中的优化问题形式化为多目标工程决策。该框架通过五个约束维度（数据可用性、延迟预算、内存预算、精度容差和重训练预算）来表征生产部署，并基于文献实证将优化技术映射到这些操作约束上。文章还提供了四个代表性工业场景的优化流水线作为实践示例。
Motivation: 当前机器学习模型优化技术（量化、剪枝、知识蒸馏等）丰富，但实践者往往依赖启发式方法而非原则性方法论，缺乏统一的约束感知决策框架。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，定义五个交互约束维度（数据可用性、延迟预算、内存预算、精度容差、重训练预算），并基于文献综述将经验性改进映射到这些约束上，形成推荐决策。
Result: 文章未报告具体实验结果，而是基于文献数据综合提出推荐；框架通过四个工业场景案例展示实用性。
Conclusion: 该工作首次尝试将模型优化形式化为约束感知的多目标工程过程，为实践者提供了结构化决策指南。
Relevance: 0
