summary_sections.result: 文章未报告具体实验结果，而是基于文献数据综合提出推荐；框架通过四个工业场景案例展示实用性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作首次尝试将模型优化形式化为约束感知的多目标工程过程，为实践者提供了结构化决策指南。

papers.title: DAGR: State-Conditioned Goal Representations via Difference-Aware Goal Cross-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning hinges on how the goal is encoded. Contrastive, metric, temporal-distance, and information-theoretic encoders differ in objective. They still share one trait. None of them sees the current state. Such a state-independent embedding cannot mark which part of the goal still needs action. The policy must then recover that cue by inverting both encoders. We propose DAGR. It refines the static embedding of any late-fusion encoder into a state-conditioned one through multi-scale gated cross-attention. A near-identity gated residual preserves the base representation. Difference-aware Goal Cross-Attention then biases the attention scores using a per-token state-goal discrepancy map. On OGBench, DAGR improves navigation. Our ablations trace the gain to the gated residual, not to the difference bias that names the method. On manipulation and puzzle tasks it matches or falls below the base. DAGR is a structured refinement, not a universal improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAGR 提出通过多尺度门控交叉注意力将任何晚期融合编码器的静态目标嵌入转化为状态条件嵌入，利用差异感知目标交叉注意力基于逐令牌状态-目标差异图偏置注意力分数。在 OGBench 上改进导航性能，消融实验表明增益来自门控残差而非差异偏置，在操作和拼图任务上持平或低于基线。
Motivation: 现有目标条件强化学习中的目标编码器（对比、度量、时间距离、信息论）都不考虑当前状态，导致策略需要从状态无关嵌入中反向推断哪些目标部分仍需行动，增加了学习难度。
Method: 提出 DAGR，通过多尺度门控交叉注意力将任意晚期融合编码器的静态嵌入细化为状态条件嵌入；使用近恒等门控残差保留基础表示，并通过差异感知目标交叉注意力基于逐令牌状态-目标差异图偏置注意力分数。
Result: 在 OGBench 的导航任务上改进性能；消融实验表明增益来自门控残差而非差异偏置；在操作和拼图任务上表现持平或低于基线。
Conclusion: DAGR 是一种结构性细化方法，并非通用改进；其有效性取决于任务类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cluster with Auctions for Vector Search
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale approximate nearest neighbor search commonly relies on partitions for indexing: database vectors are partitioned into clusters, and for each query a probing function selects the clusters to be scanned. The query probing function and the database partition are rarely treated as separate entities: most techniques assign queries with the same assignment function as the database vectors, which is suboptimal especially when database and query distributions differ. This paper introduces CwA (Cluster with Auctions), which addresses this limitation by jointly learning a balanced database partition and a neural probing function. CwA optimizes search performance directly for the query distribution. It minimizes its objective by alternating two steps: (i) gradient descent on the neural network of the probing function, and (ii) a large-scale combinatorial optimization of the cluster assignment for the database vectors. We solve the latter with a parallelizable auction algorithm that balances the partition by design. To further scale CwA, we extend the method to a Cartesian product of clusters that increases the partition's granularity. When database and query distributions differ, CwA achieves up to 4.7$\times$ throughput over the state-of-the-art at equal recall. In the in-distribution (ID) setting, even a simple linear probing function trained with CwA outperforms competing deep neural methods.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CwA（Cluster with Auctions），一种针对大规模近似最近邻搜索的索引方法。CwA联合学习平衡的数据库向量分区和神经网络探针函数，通过交替执行梯度下降和可并行化的拍卖算法优化聚类分配。该方法可扩展到笛卡尔积形式的聚类，提高分区粒度。实验表明，在查询与数据库分布不同时，CwA在同等召回率下可达到最高4.7倍的吞吐量提升；在分布一致的情况下，简单的线性探针也能胜过深度神经网络方法。
Motivation: 现有近似最近邻搜索方法通常使用相同的分配函数处理查询和数据库向量，忽略了二者分布可能不同的问题，导致性能次优。
Method: CwA通过两步交替优化： (i) 对探针函数的神经网络进行梯度下降； (ii) 使用可并行化的拍卖算法对数据库向量进行大规模组合优化，实现平衡的聚类分配。此外，通过笛卡尔积扩展聚类粒度以进一步提升可扩展性。
Result: 在分布偏移设置下，同等召回率时吞吐量最高提升4.7倍；在分布一致设置下，即使线性探针也优于深度方法。
Conclusion: CwA通过联合学习分区和探针函数，有效解决了分布偏移场景下的向量搜索效率问题，且可扩展至大规模。

papers.title: Towards quantum machine learning for assessing the resilience of post-quantum cryptography
papers.abstract_en: The potential capabilities of quantum computers motivated the development of cryptographic protocols suitable for securing communication against adversaries with access to large fault-tolerant quantum computers. However, even though current quantum computers are limited in terms of size and precision, they can still be useful for finding loopholes and weaknesses in the post-quantum cryptographic protocols. In this work, we present an attempt to utilize the capabilities of Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGANs), one of the promising architectures used in quantum machine learning, for this purpose. We describe an example application of QGAN architecture for the purpose of loading the probability distribution of the hash-based digital signatures into the memory of a quantum computer. Our results confirm that near-term hybrid quantum-classical methods possess capabilities required for this purpose. The presented approach can be used as a first step in the workflow, enabling the utilization of quantum computing for attacking post-quantum cryptographic primitives.

papers.title: How Agents Ask for Permission: User Permissions for AI Agents, from Interfaces to Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents gain prevalance, users are increasingly exposed to the risks such systems entail. Prompt injection attacks, as well as hallucination, can cause agents to leak private information to third parties. As autonomous systems, agents also present the more active danger of performing sensitive tasks, such as bank transactions, without the user's intent or authorization. Recognizing this challenge, the agentic security community has developed numerous proposals for secure agentic systems. Much of this work has focused on product-level approaches, where agentic system developers determine and apply the same security policies and permissions to all users. Yet different users have different needs and preferences, necessitating support for user-level permissions policies in agentic AI systems. To understand how user-level permissions are handled in AI agent systems, we survey 21 proposals for agent permissions systems. From this review, we construct a taxonomy of how different systems specify user-level permissions policies, both at the user interface and internally; derive internal policies from user input; and enforce those policies at run-time. We then analyze five prominent commercial agents and compare their permissions handling to agentic permissions systems in the literature. We identify several high-level themes across the literature and commerical agents, as well as multiple gaps where future work is needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI代理系统中的用户级权限问题，调研了21个代理权限系统提案，构建了关于用户级权限策略如何指定、从用户输入推导以及运行时执行的分类体系，并分析了五个商业代理系统与文献中的权限处理对比，识别出需要进一步工作的空白。
Motivation: AI代理面临提示注入、幻觉导致隐私泄露以及执行未经授权的敏感任务（如银行交易）等风险，现有的产品级安全策略无法满足不同用户的个性化需求，因此需要研究用户级权限策略的支持。
Method: 通过调研21个代理权限系统提案，构建分类体系，包括用户界面和内部策略指定、从用户输入推导内部策略、以及运行时执行策略；并对比五个商业代理系统。
Result: 识别出文献和商业代理中的多个高层主题以及需要未来工作的空白。
Conclusion: 强调用户级权限策略在AI代理系统中的重要性，并指出了现有工作的不足。

papers.title: CAVA: Canonical Action Verification and Attestation for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems increasingly act through heterogeneous runtimes: local coding hooks, SDK tools, browser automation, managed-agent traces, API gateways, and workflow engines. A single operational act such as publishing code, changing identity state, moving money, or exporting data may therefore be represented by many incompatible runtime records. This makes a basic governance question difficult to answer: what action was actually approved, what evidence binds the approval to execution, and can an independent verifier reproduce the same action identity later? This paper presents Canonical Action Verification and Attestation (CAVA), a runtime-semantics layer for converting heterogeneous agent activity into canonical runtime action objects. CAVA is positioned below Proof-Carrying Agent Actions (PCAA): PCAA defines the deployer-owned route-review-prove governance process, while CAVA defines the stable action object that process governs. The paper formalizes canonical action identity, semantic pattern detection, approval binding, receipt integrity, runtime-portable projection, and optional attestation substrates. We study a reference implementation through a 96-seed, 384-variant benchmark covering semantic equivalence, semantic separation, wrapper bypass, false-positive control, approval binding, receipt reproducibility, attestation tamper detection, runtime portability, semantic pattern detection, policy degradation, and Azure deployment drills. The contribution is a systems formulation of action-level canonicalization and policy-addressable semantic patterns as a necessary substrate for deployer-side AI governance.
papers.comment: 35 pages. Working paper on canonical action verification, runtime governance, semantic pattern detection, and approval-bound action receipts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出规范动作验证与证明（CAVA），一个运行时语义层，用于将异构代理活动转化为规范运行时动作对象，支持运行时治理和独立验证。CAVA位于证明携带代理动作（PCAA）之下，定义了稳定的动作对象。通过96种子、384变体的基准测试验证了语义等价、语义分离、包装绕过、批准绑定、收据完整性、运行时可移植性等多个方面。
Motivation: 代理AI系统通过异构运行时执行动作，导致同一操作有多种不兼容的记录，使得治理问题难以回答：什么动作被批准、证据如何绑定批准与执行、独立验证者如何复现动作身份。
Method: 提出CAVA层，将异构代理活动转换为规范运行时动作对象，形式化规范动作身份、语义模式检测、批准绑定、收据完整性、运行时可移植投影和可选证明基底。
Result: 通过96种子、384变体的基准测试，验证了语义等价、语义分离、包装绕过、假阳性控制、批准绑定、收据可重现性、证明篡改检测、运行时可移植性、语义模式检测、策略退化以及Azure部署演练。
Conclusion: CAVA作为动作级规范化和策略可寻址语义模式的系统化公式，是部署方AI治理的必要基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Groc-PO: Grounded Context Preference Optimization for Truthful Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they still suffer from untruthfulness issues, such as visual hallucinations, content fabrication, and unfaithful reasoning, which substantially undermine their faithfulness and practical utility. Alignment methods based on human preference, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), have been widely adopted to address these issues. However, multimodal reasoning errors often propagate across stages, and final-answer errors can often be traced to mistakes in early grounding stages, yet standard DPO typically applies preference optimization at the final-answer level. This credit-assignment challenge means that supervision for early grounding stages is indirect rather than stage-specific, making it difficult to suppress error propagation arising from grounding drift and context inconsistency. To address this, we propose Grounded Context Preference Optimization (Groc-PO), a grounded preference optimization framework for MLLMs. We further construct the Grounded Context Preference Dataset (GCPD), organizing multi-stage preference samples around three stages of Object Grounding, Contextual Grounding, and Grounded Reasoning, to capture the formation, integration, and utilization of grounded context. By introducing more explicit preference supervision over multiple grounded stages, Groc-PO strengthens context-dependent reasoning and mitigates cross-stage error propagation. Extensive experiments show that, compared with standard DPO and other strong baselines, Groc-PO achieves improved performance in hallucination mitigation, faithful reasoning, and overall reliability, supporting the value of more explicit grounded supervision for trustworthy multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 的幻觉和虚假推理问题，提出了一种基于阶段级偏好优化的新方法。通过构建多阶段偏好数据集 (GCPD) 并在对象接地、上下文接地和接地推理三个环节施加显式监督，该方法抑制了跨阶段错误传播，提升了模型的事实性和可靠性。实验表明，相比于标准 DPO 等方法，Groc-PO 在减少幻觉和增强推理忠实度上取得了优势。
Motivation: 现有 MLLMs 存在视觉幻觉、内容编造和不忠实推理等问题，而基于最终答案级别的 DPO 优化无法有效惩罚早期接地阶段的错误，导致错误级联传播。
Method: 提出 Grounded Context Preference Optimization (Groc-PO) 框架，并构建 GCPD 数据集，包含物体接地、上下文接地和接地推理三个阶段的偏好样本，从而在多个阶段引入显式偏好监督。
Result: 在幻觉缓解、忠实推理和整体可靠性评估上，Groc-PO 超越标准 DPO 及其他强基线。
Conclusion: 更显式的多阶段接地监督对实现可信赖的多模态推理具有重要价值。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 的幻觉和虚假推理问题，提出了一种基于阶段级偏好优化的新方法。通过构建多阶段偏好数据集 (GCPD) 并在对象接地、上下文接地和接地推理三个环节施加显式监督，该方法抑制了跨阶段错误传播，提升了模型的事实性和可靠性。实验表明，相比于标准 DPO 等方法，Groc-PO 在减少幻觉和增强推理忠实度上取得了优势。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 MLLMs 存在视觉幻觉、内容编造和不忠实推理等问题，而基于最终答案级别的 DPO 优化无法有效惩罚早期接地阶段的错误，导致错误级联传播。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Grounded Context Preference Optimization (Groc-PO) 框架，并构建 GCPD 数据集，包含物体接地、上下文接地和接地推理三个阶段的偏好样本，从而在多个阶段引入显式偏好监督。
summary_sections.result: 在幻觉缓解、忠实推理和整体可靠性评估上，Groc-PO 超越标准 DPO 及其他强基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 更显式的多阶段接地监督对实现可信赖的多模态推理具有重要价值。

papers.title: AgentCompass: A Unified Evaluation Infrastructure for Agent Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, the need for unified evaluation infrastructure becomes critical. However, current evaluation pipelines remain highly fragmented and tightly coupled, hindering reproducibility and causing redundant engineering. To address this, we introduce AgentCompass, an open-source, lightweight, and extensible infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents. AgentCompass organizes the evaluation process around three independent components, namely Benchmark, Harness, and Environment, thereby enabling flexible configurations without requiring the reimplementation of complex execution logic. Furthermore, it features a fault-tolerant asynchronous runtime and comprehensive trajectory analysis tools to transparently diagnose nuanced failure modes like reward-hacking. Natively supporting over 20 benchmarks across five capability dimensions, AgentCompass provides the community with a scalable and reproducible infrastructure for advancing agent research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对当前LLM代理评估管线的碎片化与紧耦合问题，AgentCompass提出一个开源、轻量、可扩展的评估基础设施。它将评估流程解耦为Benchmark、Harness和Environment三个独立组件，支持灵活配置而无须重实现复杂执行逻辑，并内置容错异步运行时和全面轨迹分析工具，可透明诊断奖励黑客等细微失败模式。
Motivation: 现有评估管线高度碎片化且紧耦合，阻碍可重复性并造成冗余工程，亟需统一的评估基础设施。
Method: 围绕Benchmark、Harness、Environment三个独立组件组织评估过程，通过解耦实现灵活配置；采用容错异步运行时支持并行执行；提供轨迹分析工具用于诊断失败模式。
Result: 原生支持20多个基准测试，涵盖五个能力维度，为社区提供可扩展且可重复的评估基础设施。
Conclusion: AgentCompass旨在通过解耦设计和工具支持，提升LLM代理评估的可重复性与工程效率。

papers.title: Conditional Invertible Neural Networks for Data-Driven UAV Control: A 2-D Proof of Concept
papers.abstract_en: We investigate conditional invertible neural networks (cINNs) as probabilistic inverse-dynamics models for multirotor control. For a planar X8 coaxial multicopter, we learn $p(u \mid s_t, c_t)$ from an incremental nonlinear dynamic inversion (INDI) teacher using rational-quadratic spline coupling and invertible linear mixing. Open-loop reproduction reaches $R^2 = 0.944$, mean CRPS 0.0915, and log-probability-error correlation $ρ= -0.60$. Over 15 closed-loop scenarios, position RMSE matches INDI (9.7 vs. 9.5 m), with 47 percent tracking acceptably; failures separate into attitude divergence under aggressive steps and phase lag under high-frequency references, isolating command bandwidth and data coverage as dominant failure mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究条件可逆神经网络（cINN）作为多旋翼控制的概率逆动力学模型。在平面X8共轴多旋翼上，使用有理二次样条耦合和可逆线性混合从INDI教师学习p(u|s_t,c_t)。开环复现R^2=0.944，CRPS=0.0915，闭环位置RMSE与INDI相当（9.7 vs 9.5 m），但47%轨迹跟踪可接受，失败归因于姿态发散和相位滞后。
Motivation: 需要为无人机控制提供概率逆动力学模型，以处理不确定性和多模态分布。
Method: 使用条件可逆神经网络（cINN），包含有理二次样条耦合层和可逆线性混合层，从INDI教师策略学习条件分布p(u|s_t,c_t)。
Result: 开环复现R^2=0.944，平均CRPS=0.0915，对数概率误差相关ρ=-0.60；15个闭环场景中位置RMSE为9.7 m（INDI为9.5 m），47%轨迹跟踪可接受，失败表现为姿态发散和相位滞后。
Conclusion: cINN可有效学习概率逆动力学模型，但在激进步骤和高频参考下失败，主要受限于命令带宽和数据覆盖。

papers.title: Towards a Modular Bin-picking Framework for Handling Object Pose Uncertainties
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, there has been growing interest in robust robotic systems for precise bin-picking applications. To achieve reliable performance, such systems must address errors arising from both the object pose estimation and the grasping process. Although various approaches have been proposed, they typically target specific challenges and do not offer general solutions. In this paper, we present a modular framework that jointly handles both error types. The framework incorporates object pose distribution estimation to account for pose uncertainty, which frequently arises in situations with ambiguous observations where a single correct pose cannot be determined. To further reduce uncertainty, we introduce a second-viewpoint module that computes complementary pose distributions, which are subsequently fused. This fusion decreases overall uncertainty and improves system efficiency. Additionally, two independent modules are included to compensate for grasping errors. The modular design allows the components to be combined for optimal performance or used individually, depending on the physical setup. The proposed method is evaluated in a real-world setup with three different objects, with no errors, and all modules are shown to improve efficiency. These results suggest that incorporating pose distributions with grasping pose errors is a promising direction for developing more flexible and reliable robotic production systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that jointly addresses both grasping and object pose uncertainties using interchangeable modules. We believe there is ample opportunity to integrate additional modules, resulting in improved performance and flexibility. The current framework is limited to pose uncertainties in SO(2), but it could be extended to SE(3), enabling additional modules to improve the system.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, keywords: bin picking; object manipulation; grasping strategies; object pose distribution estimation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化框架，用于处理物体姿态估计和抓取过程中的不确定性，通过姿态分布估计和第二视角融合来减少不确定性，并包含抓取误差补偿模块。在真实场景中三个物体上评估，零错误，所有模块提升效率。但仅处理SO(2)中的姿态不确定性。
Motivation: 现有方法通常针对特定挑战，缺乏通用解决方案，需要同时处理物体姿态估计误差和抓取误差。
Method: 提出模块化框架，包括物体姿态分布估计模块（处理观测模糊时的姿态不确定性）、第二视角模块（计算互补姿态分布并融合）、两个独立的抓取误差补偿模块。
Result: 在真实场景中三个不同物体上评估，无错误，所有模块均提升效率。
Conclusion: 框架限于SO(2)中的姿态不确定性，可扩展至SE(3)；集成更多模块有望提升性能和灵活性。

papers.title: Social Simulations: from Agent-Based Modeling to Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: This book chapter covers the evolution of social simulation from classical agent-based models, in which agents interact according to explicitly defined behavioral rules, to AI-enhanced simulations based on Large Language Models and, ultimately, Social Digital Twins: high-fidelity, data-driven representations of real-world socio-technical systems. Along this trajectory, we discuss the main methodological foundations, applications, advantages, and limitations of each paradigm, highlighting the progressive shift from abstract models designed to investigate general social mechanisms toward increasingly realistic computational representations of specific social systems.
papers.comment: Entry for Encyclopedia of Social Network Analysis and Mining
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该章节回顾了社会模拟从经典基于主体的模型（agent-based models）到基于大语言模型的AI增强模拟，再到社会数字孪生（Social Digital Twins）的演进，讨论了每种范式的方法论基础、应用、优势与局限，并突出了从抽象模型向高保真、数据驱动的真实社会系统表示的趋势。
Motivation: 社会模拟领域需要系统梳理从经典ABM到AI驱动模型再到数字孪生的演变路径，以理解不同范式的适用范围和局限性。
Method: 采用综述视角，按时间顺序分析三种范式：经典ABM（显式行为规则）、大语言模型增强的模拟、以及社会数字孪生（高保真数据驱动表示），并对比其方法论和应用。
Result: 论文描述了每种范式的核心特点、典型应用场景及其优势与不足，强调了向更高真实性和数据耦合方向发展的趋势。
Conclusion: 社会模拟正从抽象理论模型转向具体的、数据驱动的数字孪生，但各范式各有适用场景，需根据研究目标选择合适的方法。

papers.title: Barnamala: Parameter-Efficient Handwritten Devanagari Recognition at Benchmark Saturation
papers.abstract_en: We built a compact convolutional network (1.11 M parameters) for 46-class DHCD Devanagari recognition and reached 99.73%, the highest reported at 15.6x smaller than prior state-of-the-art. We have effectively reached the saturation point: every model tested, large teacher ensembles included, hits the same 11-error intrinsic floor. No configuration achieves a statistically clear win under exact McNemar tests with Wilson confidence intervals. Even without knowledge distillation, our student matches the nearest large-model baseline (17.32 M parameters; McNemar $p = 0.345$). Outside of DHCD, zero-shot on CMATERdb digits gives 76.6% and fine-tuning reaches 97.8%; corruption robustness is also far better than large baselines (mean corruption accuracy 75.7% vs. 38.7%). All artifacts are at https://github.com/Ampixa/barnamala.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and artifacts available at https://github.com/Ampixa/barnamala
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个紧凑的卷积网络（1.11M参数），用于46类天城文手写体识别（DHCD数据集），达到了99.73%的准确率，为目前最高，且参数数量比之前最优模型小15.6倍。实验表明，所有模型（包括大型教师集成）均触及相同的11错误固有下限，在精确McNemar检验和Wilson置信区间下，没有配置能获得统计显著性优势。即使没有知识蒸馏，学生模型也以p=0.345的水平匹配了17.32M参数的大模型基线。在CMATERdb数字集上零样本准确率为76.6%，微调后达到97.8%；对污染的鲁棒性也远优于大基线（平均污染准确率75.7% vs 38.7%）。
Motivation: 手写天城文识别任务已接近饱和，现有方法追求更大模型但收益递减，本文试图在极小参数规模下达到甚至超越大模型的性能，并探究数据集的内在误差下限。
Method: 设计了一个仅1.11M参数的紧凑卷积网络，通过一系列实验（包括大型教师集成、知识蒸馏消融）来验证模型在DHCD数据集上的性能，并使用精确McNemar检验和Wilson置信区间进行统计比较。
Result: 在DHCD上达到99.73%准确率，为当前最高；所有模型均受限于11个错误的固有下限；学生模型在统计上与大模型基线无显著差异（p=0.345）；零样本迁移至CMATERdb数字集为76.6%，微调后97.8%；污染鲁棒性平均75.7% vs 大基线38.7%。
Conclusion: 手写天城文识别在DHCD上已饱和，紧凑模型可达到与大模型同等的性能，且具备更好的泛化性和鲁棒性。代码和模型已公开。

papers.title: Microstructure-Conditioned Surrogate Models for Graded Multiscale Optimization of Mycelium Composites
papers.abstract_en: Emerging sustainable materials increasingly rely on engineered hierarchy and microstructure to achieve control of their properties and mechanical behavior. Optimizing these materials with controllable microstructures requires efficient multiscale simulations. Data-driven surrogate models for the microscale can accelerate multiscale simulations, but require large amounts of data even for a fixed microstructure. When a range of microstructures is considered, as is the case in multiscale optimization, even more data is needed to train a surrogate. To overcome this challenge, we condition a hybrid physics-data surrogate on microstructural variables using a hypernetwork. This approach enables accurate predictions of multiscale mechanical behavior for a mycelium-woodchip composite material, even when trained on small datasets. The conditioned surrogate makes multiscale simulations of functionally graded structures tractable, and we validate it against a full FE^2 simulation. We optimize a graded multiscale disk, and reduce the peak stress by 42% compared to one with a random microstructure. Then, we go one step further, conditioning the network directly on manufacturing variables that can have a complex influence on the microstructure. This is a practical route to engineer the microscale for desired macroscale behavior. This contribution highlights the benefits of microarchitectured structures and demonstrates how conditioned surrogate models enable their multiscale optimization, which will accelerate the development and design of future sustainable materials and structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对真菌-木屑复合材料的多尺度优化问题，提出一种基于超网络（hypernetwork）的条件混合物理-数据代理模型。该模型通过将微观结构变量作为条件输入，在仅使用小数据集的情况下准确预测多尺度力学行为，并实现了对功能梯度结构的可处理多尺度仿真。实验验证了模型对标全FE^2仿真的准确性，并通过对梯度多尺度圆盘的优化将峰值应力降低42%。进一步，将网络直接条件于制造变量，为通过微观结构工程实现宏观性能控制提供了实用途径。
Motivation: 数据驱动的微观结构代理模型通常需要大量数据，且当需要考虑多种微观结构（如多尺度优化中的情况）时数据需求更大，而传统方法难以应对。
Method: 利用超网络将混合物理-数据代理模型条件化于微观结构变量，使得模型能够在数据量有限的情况下学习微观结构参数与宏观力学行为之间的映射，并支持对制造变量的直接条件化。

papers.title: Optimal and Efficient Contextual Combinatorial Semi-bandits with General Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study the contextual combinatorial semi-bandit (CCSB) problem with general reward function approximation. At each round, the learner observes a context, selects a combinatorial action consisting of a subset of basic arms, and receives the reward of each selected arm; the goal is to maximize the cumulative reward over time. We propose SquareCB.Comb, a computationally efficient algorithm that, at each round, solves a convex optimization problem to sample a combinatorial action that balances exploration and exploitation. SquareCB.Comb scales to large arm sets and imposes no structural assumptions on the action set beyond a cardinality bound of $m$ on each combinatorial action. We prove that SquareCB.Comb achieves a minimax optimal regret bound of $O(\sqrt{m A T \log |\mathcal{F}|})$, where $A$ is the number of arms, $m$ is the maximum number of arms in a combinatorial action, $T$ is the time horizon, and $\mathcal{F}$ is the reward function class. In the realizable setting, this bound matches the state-of-the-art regret guarantees achieved by policy search-based algorithms in the more restricted slate recommendation settings, while simultaneously generalizing to arbitrary combinatorial action structures and general reward function approximation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文组合半老虎机（CCSB）问题，提出一种计算高效的算法 SquareCB.Comb，通过每轮求解凸优化问题来平衡探索与利用，无需对动作集结构做假设。理论上证明了在可实现假设下达到极小化最优遗憾界 O(√(m A T log |F|))，其中 m 是组合动作中的臂数上限，A 是臂总数，T 是时间范围，F 是奖励函数类。该结果匹配了基于策略搜索的算法在更受限的推荐设置中的最优保证，同时推广到任意组合动作结构和通用奖励函数逼近。
Motivation: 现有的上下文组合半老虎机算法要么计算成本高，要么对动作集结构有强假设（如推荐中的 slate 结构），缺乏一个既高效又适用于一般组合动作集的通用方法。
Method: 提出 SquareCB.Comb 算法，每轮通过求解一个凸优化问题来采样组合动作，该问题基于乐观奖励估计和探索正则化，无需枚举所有可能动作，从而扩展到大臂集。
Result: 证明了 SquareCB.Comb 在可实现奖励函数假设下达到 O(√(m A T log |F|)) 的遗憾界，与基于策略搜索的最优算法在 slate 推荐设置中的界匹配，且适用性更广。
Conclusion: 该工作为上下文组合半老虎机问题提供了一个计算高效且理论最优的通用算法，填补了高效性与一般性之间的空白。

papers.title: DNA: Dual-stage Native Attribution for Generated Image Source Tracing
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of image generation has produced numerous within-family variants, making source-model attribution of suspect images increasingly important for digital forensics. Existing proactive methods rely on watermark embedding or model modification, which may degrade visual quality and limit deployment flexibility. Passive methods often rely on large-scale supervised training or a single reconstruction signal, limiting their ability to handle unknown sources and distinguish highly similar within-family variants. We observe that attribution signals in latent generative models are naturally stratified across architectural levels: VAE-level cues reflect family-shared information, whereas backbone-level cues capture variant-specific behaviors. Motivated by this insight, we propose Dual-stage Native Attribution (DNA), a coarse-to-fine framework that follows this hierarchy without additional neural-network training. The coarse-grained stage uses Autoencoder Double-Reconstruction (AEDR) for efficient open-set family-level screening. The fine-grained stage performs closed-set model-level attribution with Native Prediction Consistency (NPC), which compares native prediction errors of within-family variants across multiple noise levels under semantic conditioning and attributes the source via normalized calibrated scores. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct DNA-30K, a benchmark for within-family variant attribution under open-set family-level evaluation. It comprises 30,000 images generated by 24 candidate models across six families spanning both denoising diffusion and flow matching, plus non-candidate generated and natural images as unknown sources. Experiments show that DNA achieves 89.11% end-to-end attribution accuracy on a task where random guessing accuracy is below 1% and outperforms the strongest baseline by 33.81% even when AEDR is used as the coarse-grained stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双阶段原生溯源（DNA）框架，用于生成图像源模型的归属，无需额外神经网络训练。粗粒度阶段使用自动编码器双重重建（AEDR）进行开放集家族级筛选，细粒度阶段使用原生预测一致性（NPC）进行封闭集模型级归属。构建了DNA-30K基准，包含24个候选模型、6个家族（覆盖去噪扩散和流匹配），共30000张图像。实验显示端到端归属准确率达到89.11%，远超随机猜测（<1%），并超过最强基线33.81%。
Motivation: 现有生成图像溯源方法（主动/被动）存在局限性：主动方法依赖水印或模型修改，影响视觉质量和部署灵活性；被动方法依赖大规模监督训练或单一重建信号，难以处理未知来源和区分高度相似的家族内变体。
Method: 提出双阶段原生溯源（DNA）框架，遵循潜在生成模型中自然分层结构：粗粒度阶段使用自动编码器双重重建（AEDR）进行开放集家族级筛选，无需训练；细粒度阶段使用原生预测一致性（NPC），比较多个噪声水平下家族内变体的原生预测误差，通过归一化校准分数归属源模型。
Result: 在包含24个候选模型、6个家族（覆盖去噪扩散和流匹配）的DNA-30K基准上，DNA端到端归属准确率89.11%（随机猜测<1%），即使使用AEDR作为粗粒度阶段，也超过最强基线33.81%。
Conclusion: 通过利用生成模型中固有层级信号，DNA实现了无需训练的粗到细溯源，在开放集家族筛选和封闭集模型归属上均取得显著优势。

papers.title: Calibrated Closed-Form Uncertainty for Radiative Gaussian Splatting in Sparse-View CT
papers.abstract_en: Radiative Gaussian splatting has made sparse-view CT reconstruction fast, but existing methods output point estimates with no notion of where the reconstruction can be trusted. We exploit a property of transmissive X-ray imaging that RGB splatting cannot claim -- projection and voxelization are strictly linear in the per-Gaussian densities -- to equip radiative Gaussians with a variational density posterior whose predictive variance propagates in closed form, exactly, in a single forward pass, in both volume space ($σ^2(x)=\sum_i g_i(x)^2 s_i^2$) and projection space ($\mathrm{Var}[I_p]=\sum_i w_{i,p}^2 s_i^2$). We present the first systematic calibration study for Gaussian-splatting CT (Spearman / AUSE / ECE with temperature scaling), showing that the resulting per-voxel uncertainty ranks true reconstruction error on 14 of 15 scenes of the official benchmark across three view budgets -- 9 of 15 additionally meeting our magnitude-calibration target after a single temperature -- while the perturbation-ensemble heuristic of concurrent work, transplanted to voxel space under the same protocol on our development scenes, does not (rank correlation as low as $-0.08$). We then dissect why uncalibrated acquisition scores can nevertheless select acceptable views, identifying three regimes -- flat (isotropic, balanced), pathological (degenerate coverage), and anisotropic -- and showing, in controlled single-scene testbeds, that principled uncertainty earns a measurable premium only in the last, motivating a coverage-gated, maturity-scheduled acquisition policy; the same calibrated posterior further points toward a dose-adaptive stopping rule, whose experimental validation we leave to future work.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Equal contribution: Chulin Zhao and Yiran Xu.(Co-first authors) Corresponding author: Yiran Xu (2617300@dundee.ac.uk)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏视图CT重建中辐射高斯溅射（radiative Gaussian splatting）缺乏不确定性估计的问题，利用X射线投影与体素化的线性特性，推导出变分密度后验的封闭形式预测方差，在体素空间和投影空间均能精确传播。在官方基准的15个场景中，该方法在14个场景上实现了每体素不确定性对重建误差的正确排序，其中9个场景经过单次温度缩放后达到幅度校准目标；而并行的扰动集成启发式方法在校准上表现不佳（秩相关低至-0.08）。
Motivation: 现有辐射高斯溅射方法只能输出点估计，无法指示重建的可靠性，缺乏不确定性量化。
Method: 利用透射X射线成像的线性特性（投影和体素化在每高斯密度上严格线性），为辐射高斯配备变分密度后验，推导出预测方差的封闭形式精确表达式：体素空间σ²(x)=∑g_i(x)² s_i²，投影空间Var[I_p]=∑w_{i,p}² s_i²。
Result: 在官方基准的15个场景中，14个场景的每体素不确定性正确排序了真实重建误差，9个场景经单次温度缩放后达到幅度校准目标；而扰动集成启发式方法在校准上失败，秩相关低至-0.08。
Conclusion: 原理性不确定性在校准后仅在各项异性覆盖场景下具有可衡量的优势，由此提出覆盖门控、成熟度调度的采集策略；校准的后验还可用于剂量自适应停止规则，但实验验证留待未来工作。

papers.title: Towards Spatial Supersensing in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Humans can efficiently parse continuous sensory streams, from hours to years, scaffolding an internal world model that grounds spatial reasoning and prediction. To mimic this capacity, spatial supersensing challenges multimodal models to move beyond linguistic understanding toward true world modeling. However, their benchmark relies on synthetic long videos, formed by concatenating random short clips, and is mostly limited to household scenes, leaving real-world continuity and diversity underexplored. To address the gap, we introduce $\textbf{VSI-Super-Wild}$, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating spatial supersensing over long temporal horizons in diverse in-the-wild scenes. Notably, inspired by cognitive studies on how humans structure experience, we systematically probe the full triad of world state: the agent (observer), objects (scene items), and the environment (places and global layout). In total, VSI-Super-Wild contains $\textbf{6,980}$ human-verified question-answer pairs derived from $\textbf{442}$ real-world videos spanning 8 scene categories, including long-form recordings exceeding 4 hours. Results on VSI-Super-Wild expose a fundamental disconnect: despite advances in static image understanding, models consistently fail at tasks that require coherent world-state tracking over time. We characterize how performance degrades with world-state complexity and temporal horizon, and diagnose four failure modes: spatial collapse, semantic shortcuts, insufficient update, and instance confusion. This taxonomy reveals that models lack mechanisms to bind objects, agents, and environments into a unified spatial world model, a fundamental gap that defines the path forward for spatial supersensing.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://vsi-super-wild.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍VSI-Super-Wild基准，用于评测多模态模型在长时间真实世界视频中的空间超感知能力。基准包含6980个问答对，来自442个真实视频，覆盖8种场景。实验发现模型在随时间跟踪世界状态的任务上持续失败，并诊断出四种失效模式，表明模型缺乏将对象、代理和环境绑定为统一空间世界模型的机制。
Motivation: 现有空间超感知基准依赖合成长视频且局限于家庭场景，无法反映真实世界的连续性和多样性，限制了该领域的发展。
Method: 受认知科学启发，系统性地探查世界状态三元组（代理、对象、环境），构建包含长期真实视频的基准VSI-Super-Wild。
Result: 实验揭示模型在静态图像理解上有进步，但在需要随时间一致跟踪世界状态的任务上持续失败，性能随世界状态复杂度和时间跨度增加而下降。
Conclusion: 模型缺乏将对象、代理和环境绑定为统一空间世界模型的机制，这是空间超感知未来需要解决的根本差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Bots Join the Team: Bot Adoption and the Institutional Fabric of Open-Source Software Projects
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are joining human teams, raising a basic question: when an automated agent becomes a regular participant, does group organization strengthen or weaken? We study this question in open-source software, where bots open pull requests, review code, and merge changes alongside people, leaving a public record of every interaction. Treating bots as participants rather than tools, we examine 2,991 GitHub projects for two years before and after each adopted its first bot. We measure three capabilities that institutional theory links to durable coordination - repeated engagement, social memory, and role differentiation - and two outcomes: conflict cascades and output distinctiveness. Bot adoption is followed by more repeated collaboration, greater recognition of specific bots in discussion, fewer conflict cascades, and more distinctive outputs. These changes cluster around adoption rather than accumulating gradually. Because we lack an untreated comparison group, we interpret the results as precisely timed associations, not causal effects. Two patterns are difficult for alternative explanations to account for: capabilities predict outcomes according to their function - coordination versus differentiation - rather than whether humans or bots provide them, and human-side capabilities account for the bot-conflict association but not the bot-distinctiveness association. The findings are consistent with a specific interpretation: predictable, rule-based agents can become part of a community's social infrastructure. The bot is the occasion; social organization is the mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开源软件项目中引入机器人作为常规参与者对团队组织的影响。通过分析2,991个GitHub项目在首次采用机器人前后两年的数据，发现机器人采用后重复协作增多、机器人在讨论中被更明确地识别、冲突级联减少、输出更独特。这些变化集中在采用时刻，而非逐渐积累。由于缺乏未采用机器人的对照组，结果解释为精确时序关联，而非因果效应。
Motivation: AI代理加入人类团队引发基本问题：自动化代理成为常规参与者时，群体组织是增强还是削弱？现有研究多将机器人视为工具，本文将其视为参与者，探讨其对团队组织的影响。
Method: 收集2,991个GitHub项目，每个项目首次采用机器人前后两年的交互数据。测量制度理论中与持久协调相关的三种能力（重复参与、社会记忆、角色分化）和两种结果（冲突级联、输出独特性）。
Result: 机器人采用后，重复协作增加，机器人被更明确地提及，冲突级联减少，输出更独特。能力与结果之间的关联取决于功能（协调 vs 分化）而非提供者（人类 vs 机器人）。人类侧能力解释了机器人与冲突的关联，但未解释机器人与独特性的关联。
Conclusion: 可预测、基于规则的代理可以成为社区社会基础设施的一部分。机器人是契机，社会机制是运作机制。结果需谨慎解释为非因果关联。

papers.title: WAVE-Stereo: Warp-Aligned Volume Encoding for Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: Existing iterative stereo matching methods primarily adopt two types of correspondence representation: explicit matching search via correlation volumes and local residual refinement via warped features, yet the two remain separately modeled. We propose WAVE-Stereo, built on a core insight: correlation volumes and feature warping provide complementary matching cues. \textbf{GeoWarp Correspondence Encoder (GWCE)} encodes matching search, residual alignment, and disparity prior in parallel at the ConvGRU input. To mitigate matching degradation in textureless regions, we propose \textbf{Periodic Global Context Propagation (PGCP)}, which propagates global spatial information in a periodic manner. On five real-world benchmarks -- Middlebury, ETH3D, KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, and Booster -- WAVE-Stereo achieves competitive zero-shot generalization accuracy without any external foundation model prior, achieving 3.18\% D1-all on KITTI 2015, 4.42\% Bad-2.0 on Booster, and 66ms real-time inference, striking a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yamanoko-do/WAVE-Stereo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAVE-Stereo 提出一种基于扭曲对齐体素编码的立体匹配方法，通过 GeoWarp 对应编码器同时编码匹配搜索、残差对齐和视差先验，并利用周期性全局上下文传播缓解纹理缺失区域的匹配退化。在 Middlebury、ETH3D、KITTI 2012/2015 和 Booster 五个真实世界基准上，方法实现了有竞争力的零样本泛化精度（KITTI 2015 D1-all 3.18%，Booster Bad-2.0 4.42%）和 66ms 实时推理，在准确性与效率间取得良好平衡。
Motivation: 现有迭代立体匹配方法将相关体素和特征扭曲分别建模，未能充分利用两者互补的匹配线索。
Method: 提出 WAVE-Stereo，核心包括：1) GeoWarp 对应编码器，在 ConvGRU 输入并行编码匹配搜索、残差对齐和视差先验；2) 周期性全局上下文传播，以周期性方式传播全局空间信息以处理无纹理区域。
Result: 在五个基准上达到：KITTI 2015 D1-all 3.18%，KITTI 2012 2.98%，ETH3D 0.22%，Middlebury 2.39%，Booster Bad-2.0 4.42%，推理时间 66ms，无需外部基础模型。
Conclusion: 方法无需外部基础模型即可实现高精度零样本泛化，并保持实时推理速度，适合实际应用。

papers.title: Learning Speaker Identity Beyond Language and Modality Constraints: Insights from the POLY-SIM 2026 Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal speaker identification systems typically assume the availability of complete and homogeneous audio-visual modalities during both training and testing, and assume each speaker only speaks a single language. However, in real-world applications, such assumptions often do not hold. Visual or audio information may be missing due to occlusions, camera or microphone failures, or privacy constraints. Multilingual speakers introduce additional complexity due to linguistic variability across languages. These situations constitute substantial challenges for the robustness and generalization capabilities of multimodal speaker identification systems. Aim of the POLY-SIM 2026 challenge is to address these aspects of speaker identification and to provide a standardized setup for the comparison of the proposed solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了POLY-SIM 2026挑战赛，旨在解决多模态说话人识别中音频-视觉模态缺失和多语言说话人带来的鲁棒性问题，并提供了标准化评估框架。
Motivation: 现有多模态说话人识别系统通常假设训练和测试时音频-视觉模态完整且同质，且每个说话人只说一种语言，但实际应用中常出现模态缺失（如遮挡、设备故障）和多语言说话人的情况，严重影响系统鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Method: POLY-SIM 2026挑战赛提供了一个标准化设置，用于评估和比较不同解决方案在处理模态缺失和多语言说话人场景下的性能。
Result: 挑战赛旨在通过统一基准推动该领域研究，具体结果未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 该挑战赛强调了多模态说话人识别实际部署中模态缺失和多语言问题的必要性，并为未来研究提供了比较平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fine-grained CLIP fine-tuning with self-annotated region alignment
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has been shown to have limitations in its fine-grained dense feature representation, due to its pre-training focusing on matching the whole image to a text description. Considering the large data and computational burden in pre-training a vision-language model from scratch, a series of works aim to enhance the fine-grained ability of CLIP through a fine-tuning scheme. However, existing works suffer from a variety of limitations: additional region annotations are usually required, which limits the semantic diversity due to the predefined categories and leads to a large effort to process the training data; and they usually sacrifice CLIP's original ability for global visual representation. To bypass these limitations, we propose SFF-CLIP (Self-annotated Fine-grained Fine-tuning for CLIP), which only uses image-text pairs as input to boost the fine-grained representation ability in the CLIP fine-tuning, while maintaining the global visual-semantic consistency. Concretely, a run-time region-phrase alignment scheme is designed, which obtains concept phrases from the input sentence, and aligns them with corresponding extracted region-based features using text-specific heat maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFF-CLIP leads to significant performance improvements on fine-grained dense feature representation, as well as maintaining the performance of the original CLIP on image-level tasks. Code will be released later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SFF-CLIP（Self-annotated Fine-grained Fine-tuning for CLIP），一种仅使用图像-文本对进行 CLIP 微调的方法，通过运行时区域-短语对齐（region-phrase alignment）来提升细粒度密集特征表示能力，同时保持全局视觉-语义一致性。实验表明该方法在细粒度任务上性能显著提升，且不损害图像级任务性能。
Motivation: 现有 CLIP 微调方法通常需要额外的区域标注，导致语义多样性受限且数据预处理工作量大，同时往往牺牲原始 CLIP 的全局表示能力。本文旨在避免这些限制。
Method: 提出运行时区域-短语对齐方案：从输入句子中提取概念短语，利用文本特定热图（text-specific heat maps）将短语与对应的区域特征对齐，仅使用图像-文本对进行微调。
Result: 在细粒度密集特征表示任务上取得显著性能提升，同时保持原始 CLIP 在图像级任务上的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需额外区域标注，仅需图像-文本对即可提升 CLIP 的细粒度能力，并保持全局一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Hyperspherical Geometry of CLIP Latent Space: A Semantic Mixture Model
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) representations form a semantic embedding space governed by cosine similarity, reflecting an intrinsic hyperspherical geometry. However, existing probabilistic interpretations typically rely on Gaussian assumptions, which fail to capture this directional and multimodal structure. We propose a principled density model for the CLIP latent space based on Mixtures of von Mises-Fisher (MovMF) distributions defined on the unit hypersphere. Using the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, we efficiently learn a probabilistic model in which each mixture component corresponds to a coherent semantic concept. This formulation yields a closed-form likelihood naturally aligned with hyperspherical geometry, enabling accurate and interpretable density estimation. Empirically, our model significantly improves long-tailed and out-of-distribution detection and provides a natural semantic decomposition, representing each embedding as a sparse probabilistic combination of interpretable concepts. These results suggest that CLIP latent space is more faithfully characterized as a hyperspherical semantic mixture rather than an isotropic Gaussian, establishing a simple and geometrically consistent probabilistic framework for modeling and understanding multimodal representations. Project page is available at https://xiaoyuzhizi.github.io/movmf-clip/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对CLIP潜在空间的几何结构进行研究，指出其本质是超球面几何，并提出基于von Mises-Fisher混合分布（MovMF）的概率密度模型。利用EM算法学习该模型，每个混合分量对应一个语义概念，实现与超球面几何一致的封闭形式似然。实验表明该方法在长尾检测和分布外检测上显著提升，并能将嵌入表示为可解释语义概念的稀疏概率组合。
Motivation: 现有CLIP潜在空间的概率解释多基于高斯假设，无法捕捉其方向性和多模态结构，缺乏与超球面几何一致的密度模型。
Method: 提出基于von Mises-Fisher混合分布（MovMF）的概率模型，通过EM算法在单位超球面上学习，每个分量对应一个语义概念，得到封闭形式的似然函数。
Result: 该方法在长尾检测和分布外检测任务上取得显著改进，并提供自然的语义分解，将嵌入表示为稀疏可解释的概念组合。
Conclusion: CLIP潜在空间更适合建模为超球面语义混合模型而非各向同性高斯，该框架简单且几何一致，适用于理解多模态表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FreeLit: Paired-Free Indoor Relighting via Physics-Guided Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Image-based indoor scene relighting remains challenging due to the complex interplay between cluttered geometry and local illumination, requiring precise modeling of light position, color, and intensity. Existing data-driven methods implicitly learn this relationship via paired multi-illumination datasets. Nevertheless, this data is costly and fails to scale, which is essential for accurate light-source-level control. Conversely, inverse-rendering methods reduce the data dependency by incorporating physical priors; however, they lack the robustness of intrinsic estimation in challenging conditions. In this paper, we present FreeLit, a paired-free framework for controllable indoor relighting that explicitly manipulates light-source location, color, and intensity. Instead of relying on paired supervision, we construct a physics-guided illumination prior from intrinsic scene properties, generating a structured lightmap along with a pseudo-relit image to guide diffusion-based synthesis. To address instability in intrinsic estimation, especially in low-light scenes, we introduce a relighting-guided intrinsic stabilization strategy that enforces illumination-invariant reflectance through structure-aware distillation and consistency constraints. Furthermore, we propose controllability-oriented evaluation metrics to quantify alignment with user-specified illumination color and intensity. Experimental results demonstrate that FreeLit achieves stable, physically consistent, and controllable relighting, with improved robustness in low-light indoor scenes, without requiring paired supervision.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia (ACM MM) 2026. This is the accepted manuscript prior to publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FreeLit，一个无需配对数据的可控室内重光照框架，通过物理引导的扩散模型显式操作光源位置、颜色和强度。该方法利用内在场景属性构建光照先验，生成结构化光图和伪重光照图像以指导扩散合成，并引入重光照引导的内在稳定策略解决低光照场景下的估计不稳定问题。实验表明，FreeLit在无需配对监督的情况下实现了稳定、物理一致且可控的重光照，在低光照室内场景中具有更好的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于配对数据的方法成本高昂且难以扩展，而基于逆渲染的方法在挑战性条件下缺乏内在估计的鲁棒性，因此需要一种无需配对监督、能精确控制光源属性的室内重光照方法。
Method: 构建物理引导的光照先验，从内在场景属性生成结构化光图和伪重光照图像，引导扩散模型合成；提出重光照引导的内在稳定策略，通过结构感知蒸馏和一致性约束强制光照不变的反射率。
Result: 实验证明FreeLit在无配对监督下实现稳定、物理一致的可控重光照，在低光照室内场景中鲁棒性更优。
Conclusion: FreeLit提供了一种无需配对数据的可控室内重光照方案，通过物理先验和稳定性策略克服了现有方法的局限，但摘要未提及在极端复杂场景或室外场景的泛化能力。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于配对数据的方法成本高昂且难以扩展，而基于逆渲染的方法在挑战性条件下缺乏内在估计的鲁棒性，因此需要一种无需配对监督、能精确控制光源属性的室内重光照方法。
summary_sections.method: 构建物理引导的光照先验，从内在场景属性生成结构化光图和伪重光照图像，引导扩散模型合成；提出重光照引导的内在稳定策略，通过结构感知蒸馏和一致性约束强制光照不变的反射率。
summary_sections.result: 实验证明FreeLit在无配对监督下实现稳定、物理一致的可控重光照，在低光照室内场景中鲁棒性更优。
summary_sections.conclusion: FreeLit提供了一种无需配对数据的可控室内重光照方案，通过物理先验和稳定性策略克服了现有方法的局限，但摘要未提及在极端复杂场景或室外场景的泛化能力。

papers.title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) seeks to make Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies more transparent and interpretable, a key requirement in safety-critical and human-centric scenarios. However, it is mostly based on user studies, thus targeting the needs of a specific audience and lacking shared evaluation metrics. On the other hand, logic-based approaches within eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) provide compact, human-readable abstractions of decision-making. However, the systematic quantification of the explainability degree of logical representations remains an open problem. This work aims to advance the state of the art in XRL by introducing objective and planning-oriented metrics for policy explainability in RL settings. At the same time, it contributes to the field of logic for XAI by providing a principled way to quantify the explainability of logical rules, moving beyond common-sense assessments and simple propositional fragments. We employ Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) to extract symbolic representations of RL policies and define a novel set of explainability metrics, including activation rate, feature coverage, syntactic distance and semantic distance. These metrics quantify alignment between symbolic rules and agent behavior, the role of features in decision-making, and the evolution of policies during training and across agents in single and multi-agent RL. Experiments across different RL domains show that the proposed metrics highlight action-specific learning dynamics beyond global return, provide fine-grained insights into domain features beyond classical approaches for global feature importance estimation, and uncover coordination, specialization, and adaptation patterns in MARL. Moreover, they provide crucial insights for the transfer and generalization of action-specific policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）从强化学习（RL）策略中提取符号表示，并定义了一套可解释性度量（激活率、特征覆盖、语法距离、语义距离），量化逻辑规则的可解释性。实验表明这些度量能够揭示动作特定的学习动态、特征重要性以及多智能体系统中的协作与适应模式。
Motivation: 现有可解释强化学习（XRL）多基于用户研究，缺乏共享评估指标；而逻辑方法虽提供可读抽象，但缺乏对可解释程度的系统量化。
Method: 采用ILP从RL策略中学习符号规则，并提出四个可解释性度量：激活率（规则触发频率）、特征覆盖（特征参与决策的比例）、语法距离（规则结构差异）、语义距离（规则行为差异）。
Result: 在多种RL领域实验中，度量能揭示全局回报之外的细粒度动作学习动态，提供超越传统特征重要性估计的洞察，并发现多智能体系统中的协调、特化和适应模式。
Conclusion: 本文为XRL提供了客观的、面向规划的可解释性度量，并为逻辑XAI领域提供了量化规则可解释性的原则性方法，同时有助于动作特定策略的迁移与泛化。

papers.title: T3HG-Editor: Text-driven 3D Human Garment Editing with Body Priors Embedded in SMPL-X
papers.abstract_en: While 3D Gaussian Editing (3DGE) has seen substantial progress, text-driven 3D human garment editing remains largely underexplored. Existing 3DGE works typically follow a paradigm that applies 2D editing techniques to multi-view rendered images and updates 3D Gaussians based on the modified images. Extending such methods to 3D human garment editing suffers from low-fidelity outcomes, caused by introduced distortions and garment inconsistencies. A promising breakthrough opportunity arises from the SMPL eXpressive (SMPL-X) model that embodies rich prior information for virtual humans. Motivated by this insight, we propose a text-driven 3D human garment editor termed T3HG-Editor, which delivers high-fidelity and garment consistent results by leveraging geometry and joint priors embedded in SMPL-X. Specifically, T3HG-Editor contains three stages, namely obtainment of editable Gaussians, garment consistent editing, and Gaussian updating with overflow pruning. The obtainment of editable Gaussians begins with seeding Gaussians along SMPL-X normals to generate sufficient near surface Gaussians, followed by a 2D mask constraint that precisely localizes the target Gaussians to be edited. The garment consistent editing aggregates tokens corresponding to the same SMPL-X vertex across multiple views and propagates them to their original views, enforcing garment consistency without requiring additional training. Gaussian updating with overflow pruning employs a Signed Distance Function (SDF) defined on SMPL-X to construct a human distance field, which is then integrated with a 2D semantic mask to prune overflowing Gaussians, thus preventing contamination of non-target regions. Experiments on multiple subjects and diverse garment types demonstrate that T3HG-Editor outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both editing quality and garment consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出T3HG-Editor，一种基于文本驱动的3D人体服装编辑方法。利用SMPL-X模型中的几何和关节先验，通过三个阶段实现高保真和服装一致性的编辑：可编辑高斯获取、服装一致性编辑、带溢出修剪的高斯更新。实验表明在编辑质量和服装一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯编辑方法扩展到人体服装编辑时存在失真和服装不一致问题，而SMPL-X模型蕴含丰富的人体先验信息，为解决此问题提供了机会。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：1) 沿SMPL-X法线播种高斯并利用2D掩码约束定位可编辑高斯；2) 跨视图聚合对应同一SMPL-X顶点的token并传播回原始视图，实现服装一致性无需额外训练；3) 利用SMPL-X定义的有符号距离函数构建人体距离场，结合2D语义掩码修剪溢出高斯，防止污染非目标区域。
Result: 在多个对象和多种服装类型上的实验表明，T3HG-Editor在编辑质量和服装一致性上优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用SMPL-X的几何和关节先验可以有效提高文本驱动的3D人体服装编辑的保真度和一致性。

papers.title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world deployment of embodied agents requires active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation. However, existing frameworks often rely on privileged simulator states or assume complete instructions, bypassing realistic deployment challenges. To bridge this gap, we present REAL, an agentic framework for open-world mobile manipulation. REAL establishes sim-to-real-consistent environment APIs without oracle perception and integrates a simulated user to enable human-in-the-loop interaction. Within this environment, we design diverse task compositions to drive data collection, supervised fine-tuning, and online reinforcement learning, systematically optimizing agent performance. To comprehensively evaluate this approach, we introduce REAL-Bench, a benchmark spanning 241 tasks across active exploration, visual distraction, articulated manipulation, and interactive disambiguation. Experimental results demonstrate that our trained agent outperforms leading commercial closed-source VLMs on interactive tasks with a 56.9% success rate. Further empirical analysis reveals that our hierarchical training pipeline successfully aligns the model's tool-use capabilities while maintaining robust open-vocabulary reasoning under extended exploration horizons. Finally, we deploy and evaluate our framework on a physical dual-arm mobile robot, where it achieves a 78.3% end-to-end success rate over 60 real-world episodes. These physical trials demonstrate robust zero-shot transferability to unseen household scenarios, validating that our sim-to-real-consistent design successfully bridges the reality gap for long-horizon mobile manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 57 pages. Code available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REAL框架，用于开放世界移动操作中的主动探索、视觉定位和交互式意图消歧。框架建立模拟到真实一致的环境API，集成模拟用户进行人机交互，并设计多样化任务组合以驱动数据收集、监督微调和在线强化学习。实验表明，训练后的代理在交互任务上以56.9%的成功率超越领先的商业闭源VLM，并在真实双手机器人上达到78.3%的端到端成功率，展现出稳健的零样本迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有操作框架常依赖特权仿真状态或假设完整指令，忽视了真实部署中主动探索和交互式消歧的挑战。本文旨在弥合这一差距。
Method: 提出REAL agentic框架，包含模拟到真实一致的API（无先验感知）、模拟用户交互模块，以及由多样化任务组合驱动的数据收集、监督微调和在线强化学习流水线。
Result: 在REAL-Bench（241个任务）上，代理在交互任务中以56.9%成功率领先商业闭源VLM；在真实双手机器人上完成60次试验，端到端成功率为78.3%，展示了零样本迁移到未见家庭场景的能力。
Conclusion: 本文验证了sim-to-real-consistent设计能有效弥合长程移动操作中的现实差距，使代理在真实世界中具备稳健的零样本泛化能力。

papers.title: Maximally Robust Satisficing Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many design tasks can be cast as black-box function optimization, enabling use of Bayesian optimization to find an ideal design with minimal number of trials. However, often we do not actually need the optimum but instead a sufficiently good solution is enough, for instance a material that is durable enough for its intended use. In most cases there are multiple satisfactory solutions, forming a superlevel set of the function, raising a key question of which one to prefer. We answer this by explaining why robustness to input perturbations that may occur when the solution is deployed is a good criterion and by introduce a Bayesian optimization method that efficiently finds satisficing solutions that are robust to maximally large perturbations. In contrast to previous works, we assume the inputs can be accurately controlled during optimization, but will be perturbed after the deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种最大化鲁棒满意贝叶斯优化方法，针对设计任务中只需找到足够好（而非最优）解的场景，强调解对部署后输入扰动的鲁棒性。该方法在优化阶段精确控制输入，但考虑部署后的扰动，高效寻找能容忍最大扰动的满意解。
Motivation: 许多设计任务中，最优解非必需，只需满意解，且解需要抵抗部署后可能出现的输入扰动。现有方法未同时考虑优化时的精确控制与部署后的扰动鲁棒性。
Method: 引入一种贝叶斯优化方法，以最大化满意解的鲁棒性为目标，假设优化时输入可精确控制，但部署后输入会受扰动。通过构造鲁棒性指标引导搜索过程。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法能高效找到对最大扰动鲁棒的满意解。
Conclusion: 该方法为需要鲁棒满意解的设计任务（如材料筛选）提供了新视角，区别于传统贝叶斯优化追求全局最优。

papers.title: From Surface Forecasting to Observability Forecasting: A Latent World Model for Cloud-Aware EO Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: The bottleneck of Earth Observation processing chains is not the arrival of new imagery but whether the surface is actually visible when the image arrives. We study this as an observability forecasting problem on EarthNet2021. Given recent multispectral imagery and exogenous weather drivers, the goal is to predict whether the next acquisition will be usable and, if not, when a usable view is likely to return. To do this, we adapt LeWorldModel, a joint-embedding predictive architecture world model, to cloud-aware Earth Observation sequences. The final pipeline converts raw minicubes into episodic HDF5 sequences with five image channels (blue, green, red, near-infrared, cloud mask) and eight meteorological and calendar covariates. The resulting model has 18.0M trainable parameters and is trained from scratch on 23,904 training episodes. The trained leWorldModel is evaluated under a locked protocol: linear probes are fit on train only, calibration choices are set on an internal validation split, and the fitted heads are then frozen for valsplit, IID, OOD, and extreme evaluation. On the full frozen-bundle observability benchmark, LeWorldModel consistently outperforms persistence. For next-step usability, balanced accuracy ranges from 0.769 to 0.887, compared with 0.493 to 0.556 for persistence. For exact first-usable-horizon prediction, accuracy ranges from 0.602 to 0.806, compared with 0.120 to 0.369 for persistence. Against a frozen LightGBM baseline fit on the same training windows, LeWorldModel is better on continuous clear/cloud regression and on exact recovery timing on valsplit, IID, and extreme, while LightGBM is stronger on the simpler binary any-usable-within-six task and is more robust on OOD. In separate sampled diagnostic analyses, LeWM also produces strong ranking-based anomaly signals under synthetic temporal inconsistencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将地球观测中的云遮挡问题建模为可观测性预测任务，基于LeWorldModel联合嵌入预测架构，利用多光谱影像和气象协变量预测下一景图像是否可用以及何时恢复可用。在EarthNet2021上，模型在下一时刻可用性预测的平衡准确率0.769-0.887，首次可用时隙预测准确率0.602-0.806，显著优于持久性基线。
Motivation: 地球观测处理链的瓶颈不是新图像到达，而是表面在图像到达时是否实际可见。现有方法缺乏对未来可观测性的预测能力，导致数据利用率低。
Method: 将原始minicubes转化为包含5个图像通道（蓝、绿、红、近红外、云掩膜）和8个气象与日历协变量的HDF5序列；采用LeWorldModel联合嵌入预测架构，模型参数量18.0M，在23,904个训练episode上从头训练。评估时使用冻结锁协议：线性探针仅在训练集上拟合，内部验证集设定校准参数，验证/OOD/极端场景下冻结探头。
Result: 在完整冻结可观测性基准上，LeWorldModel一致优于持久性基线：下一时刻可用性平衡准确率0.769-0.887（持久性0.493-0.556），首次可用时隙预测准确率0.602-0.806（持久性0.120-0.369）。与LightGBM相比，在连续晴空/云回归和精确恢复时间上更优，但LightGBM在简单六步内可用性二分类任务上更强且对OOD更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 通过潜在世界模型进行云感知可观测性预测是可行的，能显著提升预报准确性，但简单任务上仍是集成树方法的补充。

summary_sections.motivation: 地球观测处理链的瓶颈不是新图像到达，而是表面在图像到达时是否实际可见。现有方法缺乏对未来可观测性的预测能力，导致数据利用率低。
summary_sections.method: 将原始minicubes转化为包含5个图像通道（蓝、绿、红、近红外、云掩膜）和8个气象与日历协变量的HDF5序列；采用LeWorldModel联合嵌入预测架构，模型参数量18.0M，在23,904个训练episode上从头训练。评估时使用冻结锁协议：线性探针仅在训练集上拟合，内部验证集设定校准参数，验证/OOD/极端场景下冻结探头。
summary_sections.result: 在完整冻结可观测性基准上，LeWorldModel一致优于持久性基线：下一时刻可用性平衡准确率0.769-0.887（持久性0.493-0.556），首次可用时隙预测准确率0.602-0.806（持久性0.120-0.369）。与LightGBM相比，在连续晴空/云回归和精确恢复时间上更优，但LightGBM在简单六步内可用性二分类任务上更强且对OOD更鲁棒。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过潜在世界模型进行云感知可观测性预测是可行的，能显著提升预报准确性，但简单任务上仍是集成树方法的补充。

papers.title: Beyond Color Geometry: Evaluating Human-Like Color Representations in Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Do vision models see colors the way humans do? Existing evaluations of color representations usually compare them with geometric spaces such as CIELAB or with discrete color labels. These references capture perceptual distance or category membership, but not the graded way in which people organize colors. We evaluate color grounding against a fuzzy perceptual model with 86 graded categories fitted to human survey data. The framework can be applied to any image encoder and measures three complementary properties: category boundaries, category compactness, and graded alignment beyond what color geometry alone can explain. Across eleven Vision Transformer encoders, the category-level results are broadly similar, whereas graded alignment differs substantially. Masked Autoencoders achieve the strongest beyond-geometry alignment, with confidence intervals that do not overlap those of the other encoders. A layer-wise analysis further shows that masked reconstruction preserves this structure toward the output. On natural images, MAE represents surface color globally, while language-supervised models encode color more strongly in relation to the foreground object. These results show that human-like color grounding has several distinct aspects that should not be reduced to a single score.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables submitted to 2026 Joint 14th International Conference on Soft Computing and Intelligent Systems and 27th International Symposium on Advanced Intelligent Systems (SCIS&ISIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模糊感知模型的颜色表示评估框架，用于衡量视觉模型在颜色组织上与人类感知的相似程度。框架评估类别边界、类别紧凑性和渐变对齐三个互补属性，并在11个Vision Transformer编码器上进行实验。结果表明，掩码自编码器（MAE）在渐变对齐上显著优于其他编码器，且层分析显示其结构保持较好；语言监督模型则在前景对象上更强调颜色信息。
Motivation: 现有颜色表示评估通常与几何空间（如CIELAB）或离散标签比较，但无法捕捉人类组织颜色的渐变方式。
Method: 提出基于模糊感知模型的评估框架，包含86个渐变类别拟合自人类调查数据，用于衡量任何图像编码器的类别边界、紧凑性和渐变对齐。
Result: 在11个Vision Transformer编码器上，MAE在渐变对齐上达到最强性能，置信区间不重叠；层分析显示MAE向输出层保持结构；自然图像中MAE全局表示表面颜色，语言监督模型更关注前景对象颜色。
Conclusion: 人类般的颜色表示包含多个不同方面，不应简化为单一分数；框架揭示了不同模型在颜色处理上的差异。

papers.title: Human4K: A Large-Scale 4K Multi-View Mocap Dataset for Whole-Body 3D Human Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D human reconstruction have improved overall performance, yet current models still fail in the most challenging real-world scenarios. They often produce unstable geometry, inaccurate limb articulation and unreliable predictions under depth ambiguity or self-occlusion. A key reason is that existing datasets still lack the combination of high-resolution images, high-precision annotations and diverse whole-body motions required to support robust reconstruction. To address this gap, we present Human4K, a large-scale 4K multi-view whole-body human reconstruction dataset with mocap-accurate SMPL-X annotations. Human4K contains over six million 4K images captured by an eight-view high-resolution camera system synchronized with a professional Vicon motion capture setup, covering 11 subjects performing complex, highly articulated and strongly self-occluded full-body motions. All sequences are processed by a Motion-Retargeting and Refinement Module (MRRM) to ensure precise alignment for the full body and extremities. Experimental results show that training with Human4K consistently improves whole-body reconstruction on standard benchmarks, with particularly large gains for hands, feet and depth-ambiguous limb configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Human4K，一个大规模4K多视图全身人体重建数据集，包含超过600万张4K图像，由八视图高分辨率相机系统和Vicon运动捕捉系统同步采集，覆盖11个受试者的复杂全身运动，并通过运动重定向与细化模块（MRRM）实现精确对齐。实验表明，在该数据集上训练可以提升全身重建基准的性能，尤其是手、脚和深度模糊的肢体配置。
Motivation: 现有3D人体重建数据集缺乏高分辨率图像、高精度标注和多样的全身运动组合，导致模型在深度模糊或自遮挡等困难场景下产生不稳定的几何和姿态预测。为了填补这一空白，作者构建了Human4K。
Method: 作者使用八视图4K相机系统和Vicon运动捕捉设备同步采集数据，并设计了运动重定向与细化模块（MRRM）以确保全身和肢端精确对齐。
Result: 在Human4K上训练后，模型在全身重建标准基准上表现一致提升，尤其在手、脚和深度模糊的肢体配置上有显著改进。
Conclusion: Human4K数据集通过提供高分辨率、高精度和多样运动的全面数据，有助于推动全身3D人体重建在困难场景下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Consensus as Privileged Context for Label-Free Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Sampling multiple solutions and returning the majority answer is among the most reliable ways to improve the reasoning accuracy of large language models without labels, and a growing family of methods converts this consensus signal into training supervision. However, existing approaches use consensus only in restricted forms: as a filter that selects solutions for fine-tuning, as a preference between answers, or as a scalar reward for reinforcement learning, discarding most of the information that the agreeing solutions contain. We present CANON (Consensus-ANchored self-distillatiON), a label-free training method that turns consensus into dense, token-level supervision. For each unlabeled prompt, CANON samples multiple solutions, extracts the majority answer, and conditions a frozen snapshot of the model on a solution that reaches it; this consensus-anchored teacher then supervises the model on its own rollouts at every token. Experiments on mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that CANON improves pass@1 by up to 12 points, outperforming label-free reinforcement learning by 6 points at a seventh of its compute and approaching a teacher conditioned on gold solutions; trained on pooled unlabeled data, it transfers to held-out benchmarks, matching training methods that use gold labels. Analysis suggests that the improvements are not pure distribution sharpening: after training, the model solves problems it previously never solved in 32 attempts, and its majority vote itself becomes more accurate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CANON是一种无标签自蒸馏方法，通过采样多个解决方案并提取多数答案，将共识转化为密集的token级监督，用于训练大型语言模型。在数学和科学推理基准上，pass@1提升最多12点，优于无标签强化学习且计算成本更低。
Motivation: 现有方法使用共识时仅作为过滤、偏好或标量奖励，丢弃了达成一致答案的多个解决方案中的丰富信息。
Method: 对每个未标记提示采样多个解决方案，提取多数答案，然后让冻结的模型快照以生成该多数答案的解决方案为条件，产生密集的token级监督来训练模型自身。
Result: 在数学和科学推理基准上，CANON将pass@1提升最多12点，比无标签强化学习高6点且计算量仅为后者的七分之一；在未标记数据池上训练后，能迁移到留出基准，性能接近使用真实标签的教师方法。
Conclusion: 改进不仅是分布锐化：训练后模型能解决之前32次尝试从未解决的问题，且多数投票本身更准确。

papers.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions. We build a data engine that combines filtered real-document annotations with synthetic pages whose rendered images and Markdown targets are derived from the same HTML source. The training recipe includes supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning on a 4B branch with a multi-component reward design, on-policy distillation into the 0.8B model, and model fusion. On OmniDocBench v1.6, OvisOCR2 achieves a state-of-the-art overall score of 96.58, placing an end-to-end model at the top of this leaderboard previously dominated by pipeline methods and highlighting the potential of end-to-end document parsing. On PureDocBench, OvisOCR2 also achieves the highest Avg3 score of 75.06. Beyond these two public benchmarks, we evaluate OvisOCR2 on an in-house benchmark designed to cover a broader set of long-tail and challenging scenarios. OvisOCR2 obtains the best overall performance among the compared methods, providing further evidence of its generalization and robustness. OvisOCR2 is available at https://huggingface.co/ATH-MaaS/OvisOCR2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OvisOCR2是一个0.8B参数的小型文档解析模型，能够将文档页面图像端到端地转换为自然阅读顺序的Markdown表示，涵盖文本、公式、表格和视觉区域。通过数据引擎结合真实注释与合成页面，并采用监督微调、强化学习（4B分支）和知识蒸馏等训练策略，在OmniDocBench v1.6上达到96.58的SOTA分数，在PureDocBench上达到75.06的Avg3分数，超越了许多流水线方法。
Motivation: 现有文档解析方法多依赖流水线，端到端模型在基准上落后，而OvisOCR2旨在证明小参数端到端模型也能取得领先性能。
Method: 构建过滤真实文档注释与合成HTML生成页面的数据引擎；训练包括监督微调、基于多组件奖励的4B分支强化学习、0.8B模型上的策略蒸馏以及模型融合。
Result: OmniDocBench v1.6整体得分96.58（最高），PureDocBench Avg3得分75.06；在内部长尾困难场景基准上也取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: OvisOCR2表明参数仅0.8B的端到端模型在文档解析任务上可超越传统流水线方法，具有良好泛化和鲁棒性。

papers.title: How the Hessian-Spectrum of Neural Networks Depends on Data
papers.abstract_en: The Hessian matrix is an important quantity of interest when it comes to studying the loss landscape and optimization dynamics in deep learning, as well as designing measures of generalization, second-order learning algorithms, etc. Prior works have focused on empirical results or pursued a theoretical treatment under overly simplified settings. In this work, we derive the eigenvalues of the Hessian of linear networks with arbitrary widths and depths, and datasets with an arbitrary number of samples, features, and labels. Importantly, for classification tasks with MSE loss, we identify that the sharpness of the solution is directly related to the maximum proportion of samples belonging to any class. We empirically validate our predictions and systematically analyze the effects of shedding the impractical assumptions one at a time, as well as incorporating nonlinearities. We observe that our predictions are considerably robust in most cases, allowing us to extend our conclusions to more practical learning setups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了任意宽度和深度的线性网络以及任意样本数、特征数和标签数的数据集上的Hessian矩阵特征值。对于使用MSE损失的分类任务，发现解的锐度与样本中最大类别的比例直接相关。实验验证了理论预测，并系统分析了逐步放宽不切实际假设及引入非线性的影响。
Motivation: Hessian矩阵在研究损失景观、优化动力学和泛化度量中很重要，但先前工作多为经验结果或在过于简化的设定下进行理论分析。
Method: 从线性网络出发，推导出任意宽度、深度和数据规模下Hessian特征值的解析形式；针对MSE损失的分类任务，将锐度与类别比例关联；通过实验逐步放宽假设并引入非线性以检验鲁棒性。
Result: 理论推导表明，线性网络Hessian的锐度由训练集中最大类别的样本比例决定；实验验证该预测在多数情况下稳健，可推广至更实际的设置。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解神经网络Hessian谱与数据分布的关系提供了理论基础，并在简化假设下得出有洞察力的结论，但非线性网络下的完全理论仍有待探索。

papers.title: From Language to Navigation Goals: A Vision-Language Approach for Semantic Navigation of Mobile Robots Using RGB-D Perception
papers.abstract_en: Natural language interaction provides an intuitive way for non-expert users to communicate with robotic platforms. However, transforming user requests into executable navigation actions remains a challenging task, requiring the integration of language understanding, environment perception, and autonomous navigation. This work presents a language-driven navigation framework that enables mobile robots to interpret user requests in natural language to move the robot to a destination and autonomously navigate towards it. The framework is composed of modular ROS 2 components that cooperate to transform natural language instructions into navigation actions. Given a natural language request referring to a target in the environment (e.g., "go to the mail box"), the system identifies the referenced object, estimates its position using RGB-D data, and generates a navigation goal, which is then executed through the ROS 2 Nav2 navigation stack. The ROS 2-based implementation facilitates portability across different robotic platforms, requiring only the configuration of the corresponding topics and services. The system is evaluated in both simulation and real-world scenarios using a TurtleBot3 Waffle and a Unitree Go2 robot with a RealSense camera. Experimental results show that the framework successfully interprets both direct commands and contextual requests, generates meaningful natural-language feedback, and navigates towards the desired target. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining semantic perception and autonomous navigation to provide an intuitive human-robot interaction paradigm. Code will be released as open source upon acceptance.

Method: 框架由模块化ROS 2组件组成，包括自然语言指令解析、基于RGB-D的目标检测与定位、导航目标生成，并通过Nav2执行导航。

Conclusion: 证明了结合语义感知和自主导航实现直观人机交互范式的可行性。代码将在论文被接收后开源。

papers.title: UESF-Bench: Benchmarking and Probing for Unified Embodied Seeking and Following
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided human following is an important capability for embodied agents, but existing benchmarks typically assume that the target person is visible at the start of an episode. This setting simplifies the problem and overlooks a more realistic requirement: an agent often needs to first find a language-described target and then persistently follow that target in a dynamic environment. While recent work has started to study human search, existing settings are typically evaluated in task-specific scenarios and often rely on stronger prior knowledge of the environment. Moreover, they usually treat searching and following as separate tasks and still lack a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce the Unified Embodied Seeking and Following Benchmark (UESF-Bench), a large-scale and diverse benchmark for embodied human seeking and following. The benchmark requires agents to handle semantic-guided exploration, reliable behavior switching and recovery, and delayed identity grounding. To this end, we propose SeekFollow-VLA, a vision-language-action framework with a task-driven routing mechanism for latent phase inference and transition modeling between seeking and following. Experimental results show that SeekFollow-VLA achieves clear improvements over both single-head and dual-head baselines across single-person and multi-person environments, establishing a baseline for unified embodied seek-and-follow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UESF-Bench，一个大规模多样化的具身人类寻找与跟随基准，要求智能体处理语义引导探索、可靠行为切换与恢复，以及延迟身份确认。作者提出SeekFollow-VLA，一个视觉-语言-动作框架，带有任务驱动的路由机制用于潜阶段推理和寻找与跟随之间的转换建模。实验结果表明SeekFollow-VLA在单人和多人环境中均优于单头和双头基线。
Motivation: 现有语言引导的人类跟随基准通常假设目标人物在开始时可见，忽略了更现实的需求：智能体需要先找到语言描述的目标，然后在动态环境中持续跟随。此外，搜索和跟随常被当作分离任务，缺乏统一的基准进行系统评估。
Method: 提出UESF-Bench统一基准，并设计SeekFollow-VLA框架，包含视觉-语言-动作模型和任务驱动路由机制，用于推断潜在阶段和建模寻找与跟随之间的转换。
Result: SeekFollow-VLA在单人和多人环境中均优于单头和双头基线，建立了统一具身寻找-跟随的基线。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了统一具身寻找和跟随评估的空白，为后续研究提供基准。

papers.title: STOCKTAKE: Measuring the Gap Between Perception and Action in LLM Agents with a Fair Oracle
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly evaluated on multi-week decision tasks in which the state that drives cost is never directly observed. On such tasks the final cost cannot say why an agent failed: it may have misread the world, or read it correctly and still failed to act (the knowing-doing gap). Existing evaluations cannot separate these two failures; their reference policies either read privileged information the agent never sees, or are missing altogether. We introduce STOCKTAKE, a 26-week supply-chain replenishment benchmark built as a factored partially observable Markov decision process with six hidden factor processes, designed so that a fair reference policy is computable: an exact Bayes filter per factor drives a rollout policy on the identical observation stream the agent receives. Scoring each run between a symptom-blind base-stock floor (0) and this oracle (1) yields a skill score, and grading each week's written rationale yields a stated-belief detection lag and a knowing-doing rate, so state estimation and control are measured separately. On fifty seeds with curated stress profiles, Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Grok 4.5 detect 84-88% of hidden failures, typically within a week of onset, yet span skill scores from 0.62 to -0.23: two of the four end below the symptom-blind floor while naming factors slightly faster than the two that beat it. The failure has two faces. Where stress persists, 34-43% of correctly diagnosed stress weeks still end in stockout for every model, a rate that partly reflects the severity of the weeks models notice. That rate also runs opposite to skill: the two models under the floor stock out least on diagnosed weeks, so under-response is only one face of the gap, and their traces point to the other, responses whose cost exceeds what they protect. STOCKTAKE measures both directions of that failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STOCKTAKE基准，用于衡量LLM agent在部分可观测的供应链补货决策任务中的感知-行动差距。通过一个公平的参考策略计算技能分数，并分别测量状态估计和实际控制能力。实验发现，模型能检测大部分隐藏故障，但技能分数差异大，且诊断正确后仍频繁缺货。
Motivation: 现有评估无法区分agent失败的原因（是感知错误还是知道却未行动），需要一种方法分别测量状态估计和控制能力。
Method: 构建26周的供应链补货任务，作为分解的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，其中存在六个隐藏因子过程。计算一个公平参考策略（每个因子的精确贝叶斯滤波器驱动滚动策略），用其与症状盲点基准之间的技能分数来评分，并通过每周书面理由评估信念检测滞后和知道-行动率。
Result: 在50个种子上，Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V4-Pro和Grok 4.5检测到84-88%的隐藏故障，技能分数范围从0.62到-0.23，其中两个模型低于症状盲点基准。在持续压力下，正确诊断的压力周仍发生34-43%的缺货，且该率与技能分数成反比。
Conclusion: 失败的缺口有两个方面：一是对诊断出的压力周反应不足，二是反应成本超过其保护的价值。STOCKTAKE能够同时测量这两个方向的失败。

papers.title: FastCentNN: Accelerating Centroid Neural Network with Entropy Proxy
papers.abstract_en: Centroid neural network (CentNN) is an unsupervised competitive learning algorithm in which centroid splitting is triggered only after strict local stabilization, often leading to prolonged low-movement training phases before model expansion. This report proposes FastCentNN, an accelerated variant that addresses this inefficiency by introducing an early splitting strategy based on the total centroid movement per epoch, which serves as a training entropy proxy. As a result, FastCentNN reduces unnecessary reassignment epochs while preserving the original winner-loser learning dynamics. FastCentNN supports both absolute and stage-relative movement thresholds, allowing the splitting criterion to remain either fixed or adaptive throughout training. Experiments on some benchmark datasets show that FastCentNN consistently achieves clustering quality comparable to CentNN while reducing runtime by up to 16% on synthetic 2D datasets and about 5% on high-dimensional datasets. FastCentNN therefore provides a practical and efficient drop-in replacement for CentNN, retaining its online adaptive learning behavior while offering a simple and interpretable speed-stability trade-off through configurable splitting thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FastCentNN，通过基于每轮质心总移动量的早期分裂策略加速质心神经网络（CentNN），减少不必要的重新分配轮次。实验表明，在保持聚类质量的同时，运行时间在合成2D数据集上最多减少16%，高维数据集上约减少5%。
Motivation: CentNN在质心分裂前需要严格局部稳定，导致训练阶段长时间低更新，效率低下。
Method: 提出基于每轮质心总移动量作为训练熵代理的早期分裂策略，支持绝对和阶段相对移动阈值，使分裂标准固定或自适应。
Result: 聚类质量与CentNN相当，合成2D数据集运行时间减少16%，高维数据集减少5%。
Conclusion: 提供一种简单、可解释的速度-稳定性权衡的替代方案，保留在线自适应学习行为。

papers.title: The SIGReg Objective as Variational Free Energy: A Theoretical Active-Inference Account of JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are the dominant design for latent world models, yet they are usually justified by empirical performance rather than a normative principle. We show that the choice of anti-collapse regulariser determines whether a JEPA's training objective, a prediction loss plus a weighted embedding regulariser, is a valid Active Inference (AIF) variational free energy. We organise four non-contrastive regularisers (VICReg, LogDet, PairDist, and SIGReg) into an entropy-estimator hierarchy indexed by a prior-miscalibration gap, and show that the gap's sign, whether the estimator bounds the latent entropy from above or below, decides whether the AIF surprise bound survives: VICReg and LogDet are unsafe upper bounds, PairDist a safe lower bound, and SIGReg eliminates the gap. We then prove a correspondence theorem: under the standard constant-noise encoder model and successful SIGReg enforcement (isotropic-Gaussian embeddings), the gap vanishes, the objective becomes an exact information bottleneck, the surprise bound is preserved, and the latent goal cost becomes an exact proxy for AIF pragmatic value, whereas VICReg leaves an irreducible second-order anisotropy term. We extend the correspondence to multi-step expected free energy, ensemble epistemic value, and a learned-policy regime, and we identify the one AIF term no current JEPA world model computes: the state-epistemic value, a future-state coverage signal. The predictions differ in kind, not degree, and are stated here as theoretical consequences left for empirical test in separate work; full proofs are in Appendix A, and the algebraic core of every result is machine-verified in Lean 4 (Appendix D).
papers.comment: Theoretical paper; empirical validation of the stated predictions is left to separate work. 28 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度证明，联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)的训练目标在特定条件下等价于主动推理(AIF)的变分自由能。通过将四种非对比正则化器组织成熵估计器层次，并分析先验校准间隙，作者证明SIGReg正则化器能消除该间隙，使目标成为精确的信息瓶颈，而VICReg等则保留不可约项。论文还扩展到多步期望自由能、集成认知价值和学习策略，并指出当前JEPA世界模型缺少状态认知价值项。所有结果均附有机器验证的证明。
Motivation: JEPA虽然广泛用于潜在世界模型，但其训练目标通常基于经验表现而非规范原理。本文旨在从主动推理的变分自由能角度为JEPA提供理论依据。
Method: 本文通过理论分析，将四种非对比正则化器（VICReg, LogDet, PairDist, SIGReg）按先验校准间隙组织成熵估计器层次，并证明SIGReg消除间隙，使JEPA目标成为精确信息瓶颈。建立对应定理，扩展到多步期望自由能等。
Result: 摘要声称SIGReg正则化下的JEPA目标变成精确信息瓶颈，保留surprise界，潜在目标成本成为主动推理实用价值的精确代理；而VICReg留下不可约的二阶各向异性项。还识别出当前JEPA缺失的状态认知价值项。
Conclusion: 本文的理论预测性质不同而非程度差异，需要后续实证检验。所有证明均在附录中给出，并使用Lean 4进行了机器验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gauge-Invariant, Parameter-Insensitive Regularization for Potential Recovery from Flow on Directed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Recovering a latent potential from observed flow on a directed graph (a discrete Poisson problem with Dirichlet boundaries) is ill-posed, and the standard fix backfires: ridge regularization shrinks toward a gauge-meaningless origin, collapsing and reversing the recovered ordering ($+0.81\to-0.42$ rank correlation against a planted ground truth). The gauge-invariant graph Dirichlet energy removes the hazard and delivers parameter-insensitivity: the estimate is stable across four orders of magnitude in $λ$, whereas ridge inverts the ordering for every $λ>0$. We prove the reduced solve is SPD and preserves dynamic range exactly where ridge collapses it, and localize absorbing boundaries from flow alone via a Poisson residual. The $H^1$ seminorm is classical; what is new is the gauge diagnosis, the parameter-insensitivity it buys, and an ablation showing the result is robust to the extraction method. On three public clickstream corpora the gauge-invariant estimate retains $28$--$41\%$ of the interior dynamic range while ridge collapses to as little as $0.2\%$. The same gauge invariance carries into graph neural networks -- neutralizing the constant mode per layer prevents the oversmoothing that collapses a deep directed GCN -- linking this classical inverse problem to a central question in graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有向图上从观测流恢复隐势（离散泊松问题）的不适定性，指出岭回归会因规范变换导致排序反转，提出规范不变量图Dirichlet能量正则化方法。该方法对正则化参数λ在四个数量级内稳定，而岭回归在任何λ>0时都会反转排序。实验表明规范不变估计保留28-41%的内部动态范围，而岭回归仅保留0.2%。该规范不变性可推广到图神经网络，每层中和常数模式可防止深层有向GCN的过平滑。
Motivation: 从有向图上的观测流恢复隐势（离散泊松问题）是不适定的，标准岭回归正则化会因规范变换（gauge transformation）使恢复排序反转，需要一种不受规范变换影响的稳定正则化方法。
Method: 提出规范不变量图Dirichlet能量（gauge-invariant graph Dirichlet energy）作为正则化项，代替岭回归；通过求解规范不变的SPD系统恢复势，并利用泊松残差从流中定位吸收边界。
Result: 规范不变正则化对λ在四个数量级内保持参数不敏感且排序稳定；在三个公开点击流数据集上保留28-41%的内部动态范围，岭回归仅保留0.2%。
Conclusion: 规范诊断揭示了岭回归的失效机制，规范不变量正则化提供了参数不敏感性和动态范围保持；该规范不变性可推广至GNN，通过每层中和常数模式防止过平滑。
