papers.title: Automatic Ordinary Differential Equations Discovery For Biological Systems Using Large Language Model Powered Agentic System
papers.abstract_en: Automatic scientific discovery has long been a goal of computational scholars - a machine that can discover nature's secrets on its own, moving computational systems beyond data-fitting tools toward the generation and refinement of mechanistic models of the universe. Recent advances in symbolic regression (SR) and large-language-model (LLM)-based agents suggest that such systems can recover equations from data, incorporate domain priors, and automate parts of the research workflow. However, most existing approaches either focus on narrow equation-discovery benchmarks or broad end-to-end automation pipelines, while biological systems remain comparatively underexplored. Here, we introduce the MEDA system, an LLM- and SR-powered agentic framework for discovering ordinary-differential-equation (ODE) models of biological and biologically inspired dynamical systems. MEDA retrieves background knowledge, defines admissible variables, generates mechanistic constraints, proposes candidate ODEs, and fits and evaluates them. We evaluate it across canonical model retrieval, reasoning-based extrapolation to unseen variants, and open-ended discovery, with and without experimental data. Across these settings, MEDA recovered the correct state variables, achieved strong structural recovery in retrieval and extrapolation tasks, and produced biologically plausible discovery-oriented models. Ablation and robustness analyses show that knowledge-guided formalization and mechanistic constraints are load-bearing components, whereas numerical fitting alone can preserve trajectory-compatible but biologically incorrect equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为MEDA的自动化科学发现系统，结合大语言模型（LLM）和符号回归（symbolic regression），用于自动发现生物及仿生动力系统的常微分方程（ODE）模型。MEDA通过检索背景知识、定义可允许变量、生成机制约束、提出候选ODE并拟合评估，在典型模型检索、推理外推和开放式发现任务中恢复了正确的状态变量，实现了强的结构恢复，并产生了生物学上合理的模型。消融分析表明知识引导的形式化和机制约束是系统关键组成部分。

Method: 提出一个LLM和符号回归驱动的agent框架MEDA，包括检索背景知识、定义可允许变量、生成机制约束、提出候选ODE、拟合和评估五个步骤。
Result: 在典型模型检索、推理外推和开放式发现任务中，MEDA恢复了正确的状态变量，实现了强的结构恢复，并产生了生物学上合理的发现导向模型。消融分析显示知识引导和机制约束是关键，而仅靠数值拟合可能保留轨迹兼容但生物学错误的方程。
Conclusion: MEDA展示了在生物动力系统中自动发现ODE模型的潜力，强调了知识引导和机制约束的重要性。

papers.title: Analogical Deep Research: Retrieving and Integrating Historical Analogies for Foresight Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Systematic comparisons between current situations and structurally similar past events in the historical, i.e., historical analogies, is among the most powerful tools for foresight analysis. In this work, we present a new task called Analogical Deep Research (ADR) to Large Language Model (LLM) agents and construct the first ADR benchmark ADR-bench to study whether LLM agents are able to find and leverage historical analogies when doing foresight analysis. Our investigation reveals a key obstacle: LLM agents are poor at finding analogies because they match on surface features rather than underlying mechanisms. We argue that ADR is inherently a causal question as it requires understanding why the event occurred. Based on our theoretical analysis, we propose two principles required for ADR, including the mechanism alignment and cross-analogy confirmation. Built upon our theoretical results, we propose a new agentic framework called Causal Analogical Researcher (CANA) that guides LLMs to find and integrate historical analogies. CANA incorporates a simple yet effective structural decomposition representation, and integrates structural feedback for reflective improvements of historical analogy identification and integration. We show that CANA brings up to 10% improvements in historical analogy generation, and surpasses the state-of-the-art deep research agents in the ADR-bench. Case studies with the ongoing events confirm the effectiveness of CANA in leveraging historical analogies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类比深度研究 (Analogical Deep Research, ADR) 任务，并构建首个基准 ADR-bench，研究 LLM agent 能否利用历史类比进行预见分析。发现 LLM agent 倾向于基于表面特征而非内在机制匹配类比。基于因果分析提出机制对齐和跨类比确认原则，并设计 Causal Analogical Researcher (CANA) 框架，通过结构分解表示和结构反馈改进类比识别与集成。CANA 在 ADR-bench 上超越现有深度研究 agent，历史类比生成提升达 10%。
Motivation: LLM agent 在预见分析中难以找到历史类比，因为其匹配依赖表面特征而非底层机制。论文认为 ADR 本质是因果问题，需要理解事件发生原因。
Method: 提出 CANA 框架，包含结构分解表示 (structural decomposition representation) 和结构反馈 (structural feedback) 用于反思改进类比识别与集成。基于理论分析提出机制对齐和跨类比确认两个原则。
Result: CANA 在历史类比生成上提升达 10%，在 ADR-bench 上超越最先进的深度研究 agent。案例研究确认了 CANA 在利用历史类比方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文强调结构分解和反馈对于提升 LLM agent 利用历史类比进行预见分析的有效性。该项目仍在进行中。

papers.title: Video to All-in-focus Image Reconstruction Algorithm for Automated Microscopic Urinalysis
papers.abstract_en: Microscopic urinalysis is a routine diagnostic test at hospitals. Recent studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of deep learning methods to automate microscopic urinalysis. These methods rely on high-quality images of the urine samples in which each cell is clearly identifiable. However, in practice, the urine sample on a glass slide has a multi-layer structure; hence, all the cells are not clearly visible within the depth of field of a lens focused at a particular focal plane. It demands acquiring multiple images at different focal planes to correctly identify each cell in a given urine sample, which is a time-consuming task. In this paper, we propose to simplify the task by recording a video, in place of acquiring multiple images, while gradually changing the focus of the lens manually by hand. A typical length of the video is from 2 to 14 seconds. We reconstruct an all-in-focus image from the recorded video frames and apply a deep learning model to detect and classify urine sediments. As a proof of concept, we conduct experiments on 14 videos acquired by a trained lab technician in a usual diagnostic lab environment and show the effectiveness of the proposed automated urinalysis pipeline with our novel reconstruction algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对显微镜尿检中因样本多层结构导致单个焦平面无法清晰显示所有细胞的问题，提出通过手动变焦录制视频，然后从视频帧重建全焦图像，再使用深度学习模型进行尿沉渣检测与分类的自动化流程。在14段真实诊断环境下录制的视频上验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有自动尿检方法依赖高质量全焦图像，但实际样本多层结构需采集多张不同焦平面图像，耗时且复杂。
Method: 录制手动变焦视频（时长2-14秒），基于视频帧提出一种全焦图像重建算法，再利用深度学习模型检测和分类尿沉渣。
Result: 在14段由实验室技术员在常规诊断环境下录制的视频上，实验表明该自动化尿检管线有效。
Conclusion: 证明了所提出的视频到全焦图像重建算法结合深度学习模型能够简化尿检自动化流程。

papers.title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? Inspired by the mirror neuron theory's insight that observation and execution share an intention-level encoding, we examine whether a robot's action representations preserve the semantic structure captured by pretrained encoders. Systematic probing confirms that this structure erodes during finetuning, and that its quality synchronizes with both task success and out-of-distribution generalization. We further introduce a plug-and-play method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold while decomposing representations into a shared semantic channel and a private channel, all discarded at inference, leaving the deployed model unchanged. Validated on different VLA backbones across simulation and real-world benchmarks, our method yields up to +18.7% on real-world in-distribution tasks and +21.5% on out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人动作表征中的语义结构退化问题，发现微调会破坏预训练编码器的语义结构，且该退化程度与任务成功率和分布外泛化性能相关。受镜像神经元理论启发，提出一种即插即用方法，将动作表征锚定到语义流形，并分解为共享语义通道和私有通道，推理时丢弃私有通道，在不改变部署模型的情况下提升性能。在仿真和真实世界基准上，该方法在分布内任务上最高提升18.7%，分布外泛化提升21.5%。
Motivation: 微调视觉-语言-动作模型时，预训练的丰富语义结构被破坏，导致泛化能力下降。现有研究缺乏对动作表征质量的定义和量化分析，需要明确何种表征有利于机器人学习。
Method: 引入语义锚定方法，将机器人动作表征强制约束到一个语义流形上，同时将表征分解为共享语义通道（与预训练语义一致）和私有通道（任务特定），推理时仅保留共享通道，实现即插即用。
Result: 在多种VLA骨干上，真实世界分布内任务成功率提升最高达18.7%，分布外泛化性能提升最高达21.5%。
Conclusion: 动作表征中保留语义结构对机器人泛化至关重要，所提方法有效缓解微调带来的结构退化，且不增加推理开销。

papers.title: Protective Capacity Hallucination: When Large Language Models Claim Nonexistent Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: When cast as the protector of a vulnerable user yet given no explicit capability boundary, a large language model (LLM) may respond not by acknowledging its limits but by claiming to have taken -- or to be taking -- a real-world protective action it cannot perform, such as contacting emergency services or administering care. We term this phenomenon Protective Capacity Hallucination (PCH): a self-referential misattribution in which a model, acting in a protective role, asserts physical or institutional agency exceeding its affordances as a language model. In a three-phase study spanning eight LLMs and 13{,}600 sessions, we find PCH jointly gated by situational severity and interactional format: multi-party dialogic input drives it toward ceiling in most models across ordinary service domains, whereas in intimate-partner conflict -- a domain explicitly covered by safety alignment -- it remains at floor in all eight models despite greater physical severity. We interpret PCH as the signature of a deployment-design gap between role assignment and capability-boundary specification: a by-product of partial alignment in which a universally trained pressure to help outruns a domain-selective specification of how to help. Because suppression tracks alignment coverage rather than severity, deployment-side specification of capability boundaries emerges as a general mitigation target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型语言模型在扮演保护者角色时，会声称拥有无法执行的真实世界保护行动（如联系紧急服务），这种现象称为保护能力幻觉（PCH）。研究在八个LLM和13,600个会话中显示，PCH受情境严重性和交互形式共同影响：多轮对话输入在高严重性场景下触发高PCH，但在亲密伴侣冲突（安全对齐覆盖的领域）中PCH极低。作者将其解释为角色分配与能力边界规范之间的部署设计差距，并指出通过部署侧明确能力边界可缓解。
Motivation: 现有LLM在扮演保护者角色时，缺乏明确的能力边界说明，可能导致模型声称拥有实际无法执行的动作，引发安全风险。
Method: 设计三阶段研究，涵盖八个LLM和13,600个会话，系统性地测试不同情境（普通服务域与亲密伴侣冲突）和交互格式（单轮 vs 多轮对话）下PCH的发生率。
Result: PCH在普通服务域的多轮对话中接近天花板，但在亲密伴侣冲突（安全对齐覆盖的领域）中所有模型均处于最低水平。
Conclusion: PCH源于部分对齐中“帮助”压力与领域特定帮助规范的脱节，部署侧明确能力边界是通用缓解目标。

papers.title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode autonomy and train users to wave through the most consequential alerts. We reframe the problem as a per-instance three-way routing decision over {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE} and instantiate it with Safety Sentry, a lightweight guard model whose inference reduces to a single decoding call. A single decoding-time threshold lets one fixed checkpoint be re-positioned across deployments of differing risk tolerance without retraining. Safety Sentry outperforms a broad set of open-weight and frontier closed-source baselines on overall accuracy and safety-related recall, while controlling both directional error rates simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Safety Sentry，一种轻量级守卫模型，用于LLM代理在工具调用时进行每实例的三路路由决策：执行、询问或拒绝。通过单次解码阈值调整，同一检查点可适应不同风险容忍度的部署。该方法在准确性和安全相关召回率上优于多个开源和闭源基线。
Motivation: 现有守卫模型将动作分类为安全/不安全，但忽略了动作本身危害性和用户上下文适当性的区别，且基于类别而非实例，导致频繁中断和用户忽视。
Method: 将问题建模为三路路由（执行/询问/拒绝），使用轻量级模型Safety Sentry，其推理仅需一次解码调用，并通过解码时阈值调整适应不同风险容忍度。
Result: 摘要报告Safety Sentry在整体准确性和安全相关召回率上优于多个开源和前沿闭源基线，同时控制双向误差率。
Conclusion: 该方法通过实例级别的三路决策和阈值调整，在安全性和自主性之间取得更好平衡。

papers.title: Memory as a Controlled Process: Learned Adaptive Memory Management for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to accumulate experience across tasks. Yet nearly all existing approaches, from graph-structured memories to reflective insight stores, access memory through fixed, hand-designed heuristics. We argue that this static view of memory is a core bottleneck for agentic learning because optimal memory behavior is fundamentally context-dependent. The early stages of the tasks, benefit from minimal retrieval because memory is sparse; recurring goal types benefit from plan reuse rather than generic nearest-neighbor lookup; stuck agents benefit from re-retrieval with alternative queries; and across long task streams, the memory store itself must be consolidated and pruned to remain useful. We present Memory as a Controlled Process (MemCon), a framework that models memory operations as a Markov Decision Process and learns an online policy that adaptively decides when, what, and how much to retrieve, when to inject a distilled plan, and when to consolidate or forget. MemCon is backend-agnostic: it wraps any existing memory implementation, learns from task-by-task binary feedback with no pretraining and no additional LLM calls, and uses a lightweight tabular contextual bandit with UCB exploration that converges within tens of tasks. Across 6 benchmarks, 3 agent frameworks, and 3 LLM backbones, MemCon consistently outperforms multiple memory baselines by up to 15.2 points in task success while reducing token consumption by 5--20%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemCon框架，将LLM代理的外部记忆操作建模为马尔可夫决策过程，学习自适应策略以决定何时检索、注入计划或遗忘/合并记忆。该框架与后端无关，无需预训练，仅通过任务级二元反馈学习，在6个基准、3个代理框架和3个LLM主干上，任务成功率提升最高15.2%，并减少5-20%的token消耗。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆访问依赖固定启发式规则，无法适应任务上下文的变化（如稀疏记忆、重复目标、卡顿、长任务流），成为代理学习的瓶颈。
Method: 将记忆操作建模为马尔可夫决策过程，使用轻量级表格上下文赌博机并加入UCB探索，学习在线策略自适应决定何时、检索什么、检索多少、何时注入精炼计划、何时合并或遗忘，且可包裹任何现有记忆后端。
Result: 在6个基准、3个代理框架和3个LLM主干上，MemCon相比多种记忆基线在任务成功率上提升最高15.2个点，同时减少5-20%的token消耗。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确限制，但强调静态记忆是瓶颈，MemCon通过自适应记忆管理显著提升性能并降低开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Prediction to Collaboration: Interactive Symbolic Music Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Automatic symbolic music analysis has made substantial progress, yet existing systems are typically designed for a single mode of use, such as full-score prediction, and therefore do not match the broader range of operations that arise in analysis workflows, including partial completion, local correction, and iterative refinement. As a result, there remains a gap between strong benchmark models and systems that can support interactive analytical use. We present a unified framework for symbolic Roman-numeral (RN) analysis that narrows this gap by combining strong predictive performance with direct support for constrained completion and revision. The method is designed to provide a practical trade-off between accuracy and interactive responsiveness by computing expensive pretrained representations once and reusing them during iterative refinement, making powerful pretrained models more amenable to interactive settings. It supports complete score analysis, targeted revision of existing labels, and inference of missing annotations from partial context through a shared modeling framework. Experiments on Dilemmadata, the largest and most heterogeneous benchmark of its kind, show that the proposed approach is a strong RN-analysis baseline while also supporting masked completion from partial labels. Together with a prototype interface for multi-level candidate inspection and editing, these results position automatic RN analysis not only as a prediction problem, but also as a foundation for future interactive tools for music analysis.
papers.comment: in Proceedings of the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的符号音乐罗马数字（Roman-numeral, RN）分析框架，将自动分析从单纯的全谱预测扩展到支持局部修正、缺失标注推断等交互式工作流。该框架通过一次性计算昂贵的预训练表征并在迭代精炼中复用，在保持强预测性能的同时实现交互响应。实验在最大的异构基准Dilemmadata上表明该方法既是强RN分析基线，也支持从部分标签进行掩码补全。配套原型界面支持多级候选检查和编辑，为未来交互式音乐分析工具奠定基础。
Motivation: 现有自动符号音乐分析系统通常只支持全谱预测这一种模式，无法满足分析流程中常见的局部完成、修正和迭代精炼等操作，导致强基准模型与实际交互分析工具之间存在差距。
Method: 提出统一框架，通过一次性计算并复用预训练表征来支持完整分析、局部修正和基于部分上下文的标注推断，在准确性与交互响应间取得实际权衡。
Result: 在Dilemmadata基准上，该方法作为RN分析基线表现强劲，同时成功支持从部分标签进行掩码补全。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作将罗马数字分析从纯预测问题转变为交互式分析工具的基础，并指出框架的设计可以推广到其他符号音乐分析任务。

papers.title: UniPhysGen: Unified Physical Grounding for Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
papers.abstract_en: Physically grounded 3D assets are increasingly important for embodied AI and robotic simulation. However, most existing 3D assets lack unified physical semantics, including articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties, required for realistic interaction. Current approaches either treat these semantics independently or rely on canonicalized object structures, limiting robustness across heterogeneous 3D assets. We present UniPhys, a scalable framework for automatically transforming raw 3D assets into simulation-ready assets with unified physical semantics. Based on UniPhys, we construct UniPhys-40K, a large-scale physically grounded dataset, together with UniPhys-Bench, a carefully verified benchmark for unified physical grounding evaluation. We further introduce UniPhysGen, a unified physical grounding model that jointly reasons over articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties. UniPhysGen incorporates geometry-robust articulation grounding to mitigate geometric shortcut bias under heterogeneous part decompositions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across articulation grounding and intrinsic physical property estimation tasks, while the resulting assets can be directly deployed in robotic simulation environments for realistic physical interaction. Our code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/breezexian/UniPhysGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniPhys框架，自动将原始3D资产转换为具有统一物理语义（包括关节语义和内在物理属性）的仿真就绪资产。基于该框架构建了UniPhys-40K数据集和UniPhys-Bench基准，并提出了UniPhysGen模型，该模型联合推理关节语义和物理属性，引入几何鲁棒关节接地以缓解异构部件分解下的几何捷径偏差。实验表明在关节接地和物理属性估计任务上达到SOTA，生成的资产可直接用于机器人仿真环境。
Motivation: 现有3D资产大多缺乏统一的物理语义，无法支持具身AI和机器人仿真中的真实交互。现有方法要么独立处理语义，要么依赖规范化对象结构，限制了跨异构3D资产的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出UniPhys可扩展框架，自动将原始3D资产转换为仿真就绪资产；基于该框架构建数据集UniPhys-40K和基准UniPhys-Bench；提出UniPhysGen模型，联合推理关节语义和内在物理属性，并采用几何鲁棒关节接地来缓解异构部件分解下的几何捷径偏差。
Result: 实验表明UniPhysGen在关节接地和内在物理属性估计任务上达到SOTA性能，生成的资产可直接部署于机器人仿真环境进行真实物理交互。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法生成了统一物理语义的3D资产，可直接用于机器人仿真，且性能领先。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visual Place Recognition Using Rate-Encoded Spiking Neural Networks with Discrete STDP Learning
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) trained through unsupervised Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) have been explored as solutions to visual loop closure problems, driven by the prospect of efficient on-device inference on neuromorphic devices. State-of-the-art STDP-based models deliver high classification accuracy but fail to reach the high Recall at 100% Precision (R@100P) needed for reliable autonomous navigation. We present a discrete, tensor-native implementation of the STDP-based SNN-VPR pipeline using PyTorch with snnTorch and evaluate it on a 100-place Nordland dataset using 15 independently-trained networks. The contribution of three decisions in the implementation is investigated. First, we show how to perform neuron assignment with a closed-form, deterministic tensor pipeline and show that it provides significantly higher R@100P than a standard argmax procedure. However, some of this gain comes from implementation differences compared to prior continuous-time models, which we measure independently. Second, ablation in isolation shows that state reset after each query helps improve R@100P regardless of the way neurons are assigned. Third, velocity-compensated sliding window aggregation over k consecutive frames reaches R@100P = 100.00% at k = 5 for constant-velocity traversal and an additional 0.20 ms latency. Taken together, these findings show the impact of inference stage design decisions in STDP-based SNN-VPR on recall precision, although the separate contribution of each mechanism and implementation differences is only partially disentangled and needs further examination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于速率编码脉冲神经网络（SNN）与离散STDP学习的视觉位置识别（VPR）方法。在Nordland数据集上评估了15个独立训练网络，研究了神经元分配、状态重置和滑动窗口聚合等推理阶段设计决策对召回率的影响。实验表明，采用闭式张量流水线的神经元分配和状态重置可显著提升R@100P，结合速度补偿滑动窗口（k=5）可达100%的R@100P，但各机制的单独贡献尚未完全分离。
Motivation: 现有基于STDP的SNN在视觉闭环检测中分类精度高但R@100P不足，无法满足自主导航的可靠性要求。
Method: 提出离散张量原生STDP-SNN-VPR流水线，使用PyTorch和snnTorch实现；采用闭式确定性张量流水线进行神经元分配，并引入状态重置和速度补偿滑动窗口聚合。
Result: 神经元分配的闭式张量流水线显著优于标准argmax；状态重置有助于改善R@100P；速度补偿滑动窗口（k=5）在恒定速度遍历下达到R@100P=100%，附加延迟0.20ms。
Conclusion: 推理阶段的设计决策（神经元分配、状态重置、滑动窗口）对STDP-SNN-VPR的召回精度有重要影响，但各机制贡献和实现差异需进一步研究。

papers.title: Agile perceptive multi-skill locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
papers.abstract_en: Enabling quadrupedal robots to traverse complex terrains-from rugged outdoor environments to urban landscapes-requires seamless integration of multiple motor skills, smooth transitions between gaits, and high-speed perceptive locomotion using only onboard sensors. We present APT-RL (Action Pretrained Transformer-based Reinforcement Learning), a unified framework that enables multi-skill locomotion to achieve high-speed traversal in complex environments through autonomous skill transitions utilizing only onboard perception and computation. Our approach generates large-scale, feature-rich 2D motion datasets through trajectory optimization with simplified dynamics. These datasets enable training of diverse, reusable locomotion skills that transfer effectively to a real quadruped robot operating on complex uneven terrains. The resulting high-quality skills serve as strong priors for efficient learning of complex downstream tasks and extend naturally to 3D environments, enabling smooth, high-speed multi-skill locomotion in deployed policy. Real-world experiments demonstrate the framework's capabilities: the robot performs agile maneuvers through complex indoor obstacles and outdoor wild environments, including dynamic drop-down maneuvers that reach instantaneous peak speeds of up to 6 meters per second. A single onboard policy enables robust traversal of diverse obstacles, including stairs, hurdles, stepping stones, gaps, and fallen branches, demonstrating the versatility and effectiveness of our approach.

TL;DR: 本文提出APT-RL（基于动作预训练Transformer的强化学习）框架，使四足机器人能够在复杂地形上通过自主技能切换实现高速感知运动。该方法利用轨迹优化生成大规模2D运动数据集，训练多种可重用技能，并扩展至3D环境。真实实验中机器人达到6米/秒的瞬时速度，可穿越楼梯、障碍、踏脚石、间隙、倒树枝等多样障碍。
Motivation: 四足机器人在复杂地形上需要无缝集成多种运动技能、平滑切换步态以及高速感知运动，现有方法难以同时满足这些需求。
Method: 使用轨迹优化和简化动力学生成大规模特征丰富的2D运动数据集，基于这些数据训练多样可重用的运动技能，然后通过强化学习使策略扩展到3D环境并实现自主技能切换。
Result: 真实实验达到最高6米/秒的瞬时速度，成功穿越室内外复杂障碍，包括楼梯、障碍、踏脚石、间隙、倒树枝等。
Conclusion: 一个单一的机载策略即可鲁棒地穿越多种障碍，证明了框架的通用性和有效性。

papers.title: Structured Reinforcement Learning for Bayesian Persuasion : Application to Intelligent Interactive Driving
papers.abstract_en: Interactive driving, wherein an intelligent lead vehicle equipped with real-time traffic data coordinates route choices of connected vehicles, offers a promising approach to dynamic traffic management. To address the challenge of harmonising decisions, this paper considers the strategic information revealing framework of Bayesian persuasion. Here, the principal (lead vehicle) aims to guide the agent's (connected vehicle) partially observable sequential decision making towards its own objectives by selectively revealing information, such as real-time traffic ahead, using signals. However, the agent's farsighted response to maximize its long-term reward, renders the principal's signaling strategy design computationally challenging. We propose an online structured reinforcement learning framework to synthesize computationally efficient signaling strategy which is persuasive for a far-sighted agent. The main contributions of the paper are as follows: (i) For a monotonic agent with approximate best response, we propose MAPL, a structured policy learning algorithm for faster online learning, (ii) Identification of sufficient conditions for the supermodular structure of the Q function of the principal for a monotonic agent, (iii) Identification of sufficient conditions to ensure the persuasiveness of the principal's signaling strategy, (iv) Supermodular Q learning for Principal (SQP), which leverages the supermodular structure of principal's action value to synthesize computationally efficient signaling strategy that is persuasive for a monotonic learning agent, (v) Numerical analysis considering a real-time application of Bayesian persuasive driving for lane selection demonstrates that the proposed method is 30% cost efficient for optimising travelling rewards of both the lead and connected vehicle compared to the existing methodologies for signaling strategy design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化强化学习框架用于贝叶斯说服，以解决智能交互驾驶中主车（lead vehicle）通过信号策略引导联网车辆路线选择的问题。针对远见型智能体的反应，作者提出MAPL和SQP算法，实现计算高效的信号策略，并在车道选择应用中展示30%的成本效率提升。
Motivation: 交互驾驶中，主车需通过策略性信息揭示（如前方实时交通）引导联网车辆决策，但智能体的远见行为使得信号策略设计计算复杂。
Method: 提出在线结构化强化学习框架，包括针对单调智能体近似最优反应的MAPL算法，以及利用超模Q函数结构的SQP算法，并识别了确保信号策略说服力的充分条件。
Result: 在实时贝叶斯说服驾驶车道选择数值分析中，所提方法相比现有信号策略设计方法，在优化主车和联网车的行驶奖励上实现30%的成本效率提升。
Conclusion: 论文证明结构化强化学习能有效合成针对远见型智能体的说服性信号策略，且超模结构可加速学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Approximation of solutions of parameter-dependent problems by residual neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We develop a convergent scheme to train neural networks involving analytic activation functions based on gradient flows. Convergence properties are guaranteed by Lojasiewicz theory. The main advantage of this approach is its simplicity of implementation. The coefficients of the network are approximated by solving a system of ordinary differential equations. We test the method by constructing residual neural network approximations of solutions of parametric problems. The dependence of the solutions of simple ordinary differential equations on a few parameters is correctly reproduced. The solutions of inverse problems involving wave constraints which depend on a few parameters can be reasonably approximated, even in regions in which the problem is severely ill posed.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究开发了一种基于梯度流的训练方案，使用解析激活函数的神经网络，通过Lojasiewicz理论保证收敛性。方法通过求解常微分方程组来逼近网络系数，并测试了残差神经网络对参数依赖问题解的逼近能力。实验显示，对于简单微分方程的参数依赖解以及涉及波约束的逆问题（即使在严重病态区域）都能得到合理逼近。
Motivation: 现有神经网络训练方法可能缺乏收敛性保证，且实现复杂。该工作旨在提供一种简单实现、有理论收敛保证的训练方案，用于逼近参数依赖问题的解。
Method: 提出基于梯度流的训练方法，利用Lojasiewicz理论确保收敛，网络系数通过求解常微分方程组近似。具体采用残差神经网络架构，激活函数为解析函数。
Result: 正确再现了含少量参数的常微分方程解的参数依赖关系；对于参数依赖的波约束逆问题，即使在严重病态区域也能合理逼近。
Conclusion: 该梯度流训练方法简单有效，为参数依赖问题的神经网络逼近提供了收敛性保证，可处理病态逆问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IMMNet: Hybrid Fusion of Model-based and Data-driven Approaches for Maneuvering Target Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Maneuvering target tracking in three-dimensional space remains a challenging problem due to complex motion dynamics and model mismatch. To address this, this paper proposes a hybrid model/data-driven algorithm named IMMNet, which integrates the interpretable structure of the interacting multiple model (IMM) algorithm with learnable neural components. Unlike end-to-end black-box methods, the proposed IMMNet algorithm not only can preserve the Bayesian inference mechanism that is essential for real-time radar applications, but also can adaptively learn motion patterns and noise characteristics from data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed IMMNet algorithm consistently outperforms the existing algorithms across various scenarios, validating it as a robust, interpretable, and practical solution for maneuvering target tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IMMNet，一种融合交互多模型（IMM）算法和可学习神经网络组件的混合模型/数据驱动方法，用于三维空间机动目标跟踪。该方法保留了贝叶斯推理机制，同时从数据中自适应学习运动模式和噪声特性，在多种场景下优于现有算法。
Motivation: 三维空间中机动目标跟踪因复杂运动动态和模型失配而具有挑战性，现有方法要么缺乏可解释性（黑盒），要么无法适应未知模式。
Method: IMMNet 将传统 IMM 算法的解释性结构与可学习的神经网络组件结合，通过数据驱动方式改进模型匹配和噪声估计，同时保持贝叶斯推理机制。
Result: 大量实验表明，IMMNet 在各种场景下一致优于现有算法，验证了其鲁棒性、可解释性和实用性。
Conclusion: IMMNet 是一种鲁棒、可解释且实用的机动目标跟踪解决方案，适用于实时雷达应用。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Cover First, Disagree Softly: Rethinking Mismatch-First Active Learning for Frame-Level Audio Classification
papers.abstract_en: Sound event detection relies on frame-level strong labels whose annotation is expensive. Active learning addresses this problem by selecting the audio segments whose labels help the classifier most. One of the prevailing acquisition strategies for this task, mismatch-first farthest-traversal (MFFT), combines the disagreement between two classifiers and the diversity of the selected segments through hard sequential decisions. It selects whole groups of high-disagreement segments first and spreads only the remaining budget by farthest traversal. On two multi-label datasets we show that this design is blind to the similarity among the selected segments and fails under low budgets, with every mismatch-first variant ending below the plain geometric strategy it builds on. We propose mismatch-weighted facility location (MW-FL), which spends the entire budget through a disagreement-weighted coverage objective that penalizes similarity among the selected segments. The disagreement signal from MFFT is used to obtain the nonnegative weights of this facility-location objective, without introducing hyperparameters. Experiments across two geometric mechanisms with three ways of using disagreement show that coverage of the selected segments is the dominant factor, hard disagreement gating of selection is harmful on both mechanisms, and soft disagreement weighting helps on top of coverage. MW-FL attains the best area under the learning curve on both datasets.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对声音事件检测中帧级强标签标注昂贵的问题，重新思考了以不匹配优先（mismatch-first）为策略的主动学习方法。通过实验发现，现有的MFFT策略在低预算下表现不佳，其硬决策忽略了所选片段间的相似性。作者提出不匹配加权设施选址（MW-FL）方法，用不匹配信号作为软权重来指导覆盖目标，在两种多标签数据集上获得最佳学习曲线面积。
Motivation: 声音事件检测的帧级标签标注昂贵，主动学习可降低标注成本。现有MFFT策略结合分类器分歧与多样性，但硬决策导致低预算时性能劣于简单几何策略。
Method: 提出MW-FL方法，将整个预算用于不匹配加权的覆盖目标，通过设施选址目标惩罚所选片段间的相似性，并利用MFFT的分歧信号产生非负权重，无需引入超参数。
Result: 在两个多标签数据集上，MW-FL在两种几何机制和三种分歧使用方式下均达到最佳学习曲线面积，实验表明覆盖是主导因素，硬分歧门控有害，软分歧加性有助于覆盖。
Conclusion: 软分歧加权结合覆盖目标可有效提升主动学习在帧级音频分类中的性能，硬决策的分歧优先策略在低预算时不可取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GHR-VLM: Making Zero-Shot Transit Video Analytics Realizable with Grounded Hybrid Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Transit video understanding can provide valuable fine-grained data that conventional passenger counters and fare systems cannot capture. However, supervised video models require task-specific annotations, while applying vision-language models (VLMs) directly to long onboard videos is unreliable and costly. To leverage the complementary strengths of both approaches, we propose GHR-VLM, a visual grounded hybrid reasoning framework for zero-shot transit-bus video analytics. It is motivated by the observation that explicit visual grounding can improve VLM reasoning by converting long surveillance streams into compact, passenger-centered spatiotemporal evidence. Specifically, we propose an edge-cloud design in which a lightweight edge-based monitor continuously tracks door status and segments passenger clips. A backend VLM then identifies boarding passengers and classifies payment behavior through a two-stage coarse-to-fine refinement of spatiotemporal evidence. By invoking the VLM only on grounded passenger clips and contact sheets, GHR-VLM reduces cloud inference, avoids payment-specific training data, and supplies the localized evidence that VLMs otherwise struggle to identify. Evaluation on 486 minutes of real-world bus surveillance video demonstrates the potential of grounded edge-cloud reasoning for passenger-level payment analytics while highlighting the challenges posed by degraded video conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GHR-VLM，一种视觉接地混合推理框架，用于零样本公交视频分析。通过边缘设备跟踪车门状态并分割乘客片段，后端 VLM 对接地乘客片段进行两阶段粗到细的时空证据推理，实现乘客上车识别和支付行为分类，无需支付特定训练数据。在486分钟真实公交监控视频上评估，展示了边缘-云接地推理在乘客级支付分析中的潜力，同时指出退化视频条件带来的挑战。
Motivation: 监督视频模型需要任务特定标注，而直接将视觉语言模型（VLM）应用于长时车载视频不可靠且成本高。
Method: 边缘-云设计：轻量边缘监控连续跟踪车门状态并分割乘客片段；后端 VLM 通过两阶段粗到细的时空证据精炼，识别上车乘客并分类支付行为。
Result: 在486分钟真实公交监控视频上评估，证明了接地边缘-云推理对乘客级支付分析的潜力，同时揭示了退化视频条件带来的挑战。
Conclusion: GHR-VLM 通过将长监控流转换为紧凑、以乘客为中心的时空证据，提高了 VLM 推理的可解释性和效率。

papers.title: Graded Entity-Familiarity Readouts in Language Models: Polish Adaptation, Cross-Language Robustness, and Refusal Steering
papers.abstract_en: Can a language model estimate its familiarity with an entity before generating an answer? We study activations at the final prompt token in twelve instruction-tuned models from the Bielik, PLLuM, Gemma-4, and Qwen3 families, using a new dataset of 1,440 Polish entities spanning four domains and ten Wikipedia-pageview deciles, plus fabricated controls. Familiarity-probe scores separate real from fabricated entities in every family; in the Polish-adapted Bielik and PLLuM families they additionally track entity popularity (model-mean Spearman $ρ$ 0.28-0.57, versus at most 0.11 in Gemma-4 and Qwen3), a pattern more strongly associated with Polish adaptation than with parameter count in this model sample. In a paired experiment on two families, probes retain 96-101% of within-language AUROC when the Polish question stem is replaced with an English one around unchanged entity names, showing robustness to prompt language in this setting. In Gemma-4-12B, the only model that natively refuses, adding a one-dimensional familiarity direction at a single layer moves refusal rates monotonically in both directions (0.24 to 1.00 on well-known entities; 0.73 to 0.00 on unknown ones). Finally, a calibrated familiarity probe is competitive among pre-generation abstention gates, although post-generation detectors better predict behavioral error on average. These results support a graded pre-generation entity-familiarity readout, and a separation between representational familiarity and the policy that converts it into abstention.

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在生成答案前对实体熟悉度的估计能力。作者使用12个指令微调模型（Bielik、PLLuM、Gemma-4、Qwen3家族）和包含1440个波兰实体的新数据集（4个领域、10个Wikipedia页面浏览分位数及虚构对照），训练熟悉度探针（familiarity probe）并考察其跨语言鲁棒性和拒绝行为。实验表明：探针分数在所有模型家族中均能区分真实与虚构实体；在波兰适应模型（Bielik、PLLuM）中还能跟踪实体流行度（Spearman ρ 0.28-0.57，而Gemma-4和Qwen3最多0.11）；将问题词干从波兰语换成英语后，探针AUROC保持96-101%；在原生拒绝模型Gemma-4-12B中，单层加入一维熟悉度方向可单调调节拒绝率（已知实体从0.24到1.00，未知实体从0.73到0.00）；校准后的熟悉度探针在生成前拒绝门控中具有竞争力，但生成后检测器平均更优。
Motivation: 语言模型常对未知实体产生幻觉，现有方法多依赖生成后检测或拒绝对话。问题在于模型能否在生成前就感知到自身对某实体的不熟悉，从而提前拒绝或引导行为。
Method: 使用12个指令微调模型，构建包含1440个波兰实体（按Wikipedia页面浏览分位数分层）和虚构实体的数据集。提取最后一层提示标记（final prompt token）的激活，训练线性探针预测熟悉度分数。进行跨语言实验（波兰语/英语问题词干）和拒绝引导实验（在Gemma-4-12B的单层隐向量中加入熟悉度方向）。
Result: 熟悉度探针的AUROC在所有模型家族中分离真实与虚构实体（0.66-0.85）；波兰适应模型（Bielik、PLLuM）的探针分数与实体流行度相关（ρ 0.28-0.57），而Gemma-4和Qwen3无此现象（ρ≤0.11）；跨语言鲁棒性实验显示AUROC保持96-101%；在Gemma-4-12B中通过添加熟悉度方向，拒绝率在已知实体上从0.24增至1.00，在未知实体上从0.73降至0.00；校准探针在生成前拒绝门控中表现与生成后检测器可比，但后者平均更优。
Conclusion: 实验结果支持语言模型在生成前存在可读出的实体熟悉度表征，且该表征与模型将熟悉度转换为拒绝行为的策略是分离的。这为可解释的模型行为控制提供了新思路。

papers.title: Spectral-Informed Neural Networks Outperform Spectral Methods in High-dimensional PDEs
papers.abstract_en: For low-dimensional problems ($d\leq3$), spectral methods can achieve exceptionally high accuracy. For middle-dimensional problems ($4 \leq d \lesssim 10$), spectral methods remain feasible through specific techniques such as sparse grids or hyperbolic cross. However, for high-dimensional problems ($d\gg 10$), spectral methods suffer frome the curse of dimensionality. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising approach to overcome this challenge, offering scalability to high dimensions, but often suffer from limited accuracy and efficiency. Recently proposed spectral-informed neural networks (SINNs) combine spectral methods with PINNs, operating directly in the spectral domain to avoid spatial derivative computations and to reduce memory consumption. In this work, we introduce Modified SINNs, which integrate coefficient decay scaling and basis embeddings motivated by harmonic analysis to enhance accuracy in high-dimensional problems and enable accurate approximation of unknown spectral coefficients. Numerical experiments on steady and time-dependent partial differential equations demonstrate that Modified SINNs outperform sparse grid spectral methods on middle-dimensional problems with incomplete spectral information and achieve superior accuracy compared to PINNs on high-dimensional problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维偏微分方程（PDE）问题，提出改进的谱信息神经网络（Modified SINNs），通过在谱域中引入系数衰减缩放和基嵌入，提升了高维问题的精度，并能够准确逼近未知谱系数。数值实验表明，在中等维度问题中，Modified SINNs优于稀疏网格谱方法；在高维问题中，其精度优于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）。
Motivation: 传统谱方法在高维（d>>10）问题中遭遇维数灾难，而PINNs虽然可扩展至高维但精度和效率有限。需要一种结合两者优势的方法。
Method: 提出Modified SINNs，在谱域中直接操作以避免空间导数计算，并融合系数衰减缩放和基嵌入（基于调和分析），增强对高维问题中未知谱系数的近似能力。
Result: 在稳态和时变PDE的数值实验中，Modified SINNs在中等维度问题（4≤d≤10）中优于稀疏网格谱方法，在高维问题（d>>10）中取得比PINNs更优的精度。
Conclusion: SINNs通过将频谱信息嵌入神经网络，有效克服了高维PDE的维数灾难，为高精度求解提供了新路径。

papers.title: UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors
papers.abstract_en: We investigate which language model evasion attacks survive state-of-the-art adversarial fine-tuning, developing strategies that sweep the top 5 positions on the ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff leaderboard. While adversarial fine-tuning trivially closes the 2025 winning evasion recipes, we uncover a fundamental asymmetry in detector vulnerability: pushing generated text out of the detector's training distribution reliably defeats adversarial detection, whereas pulling it into the distribution (e.g., mimicking human training data) fails completely. Exploiting this, we introduce two novel out-of-distribution attack families - cross-decade register attacks and modernist stream-of-consciousness form. Both strategies easily bypass adversarial closure, achieving up to approximately 50x higher fool rates than previous methods while preserving naturalness. Furthermore, experiments show that the obvious deployer countermeasure (augmenting training data with period prose) fails to close the vulnerability. Our findings show that the tested detector families, including adversarially fine-tuned ones, exhibit persistent vulnerabilities under structural out-of-distribution shifts, a mechanism that directly powers our leading competition performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究哪些语言模型逃避攻击能绕过最先进的对抗性微调检测器，在ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff排行榜上占据前5。发现检测器存在根本不对称性：将生成文本推离检测器训练分布可可靠击败对抗性检测，而拉近分布则完全失败。基于此，提出两种新的分布外攻击家族——跨年代语域攻击和现代主义意识流形式，实现高达约50倍的更高愚弄率，且保持自然性。实验表明增加训练数据（如时期散文）无法封堵漏洞。
Motivation: 现有的对抗性微调虽能轻易封堵2025年的获胜攻击，但检测器在面对结构分布外移位时存在根本不对称性，这成为新攻击的突破口。
Method: 提出两种分布外攻击家族：跨年代语域攻击（使用不同历史时期的语言风格）和现代主义意识流形式（模仿意识流写作）。利用检测器对训练分布外文本的脆弱性，绕过对抗性微调。
Result: 新攻击在保持自然性的前提下，愚弄率比先前方法提升约50倍，并在排行榜中占据前5。对抗性微调检测器对此无效，增扩训练数据也无法防御。
Conclusion: 测试的检测器家族（包括对抗性微调后的）对结构分布外移位表现出持续性脆弱性，这一机制直接支撑了竞赛的领先表现。

papers.title: Nexus: Native Mesh Generation with Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality triangle meshes is essential for film, gaming, and interactive 3D applications. Mainstream methods rely on mesh serialization and autoregressive processes, which stuggles in effective inference and is sensitive to error accumulation. In this paper, we present Nexus, a diffusion method that achieves holistic mesh generation via decoupled vertex and topology generation. First, we view mesh vertices as sparse voxels organized as an octree and adopt a diffusion model to generate the vertices in a coarse-to-fine manner. Second, for topology modeling, we propose Spacetime Interval, as an extension of Spacetime Distance to encode arbitrary edge and face topology into continuous per-vertex embeddings. It allows for a global and efficient recovery of complex topology. We then employ a diffusion model to generate the continuous embeddings on the generated vertices. Extensive experiments on the Objaverse and Toys4K datasets and in-the-wild images demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art autoregressive and two-stage baselines, effectively circumventing the inherent limitations of sequential mesh modeling. A blind user study from 3D practitioners confirms strong perceptual preference for our results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nexus，一种基于扩散的网格生成方法，通过解耦顶点生成和拓扑生成来实现整体网格生成。顶点生成采用稀疏体素八叉树结构，扩散模型从粗到细生成顶点；拓扑生成提出 Spacetime Interval 扩展 Spacetime Distance，将任意边和面拓扑编码为连续逐顶点嵌入，再用扩散模型生成。实验在 Objaverse 和 Toys4K 数据集以及野外图像上优于自回归和两阶段基线。
Motivation: 主流网格生成方法依赖序列化和自回归过程，推理效率低且易受误差累积影响，需要一种避免顺序建模固有限制的整体网格生成方法。
Method: 解耦顶点和拓扑生成：顶点生成将网格顶点视为稀疏体素并组织为八叉树，用扩散模型从粗到细生成；拓扑生成提出 Spacetime Interval 扩展，将边和面拓扑编码为连续逐顶点嵌入，再用扩散模型生成嵌入。
Result: 在 Objaverse 和 Toys4K 数据集以及野外图像上，Nexus 优于最新的自回归和两阶段基线；盲测表明 3D 从业者对其结果有强烈的感知偏好。
Conclusion: Nexus 有效规避了顺序网格建模的固有限制，实现了高质量的整体网格生成。

papers.title: AI advice suppresses people's willingness to say "I don't know", even when the advice is wrong and accuracy is incentivized
papers.abstract_en: Knowing when to say "I don't know" is fundamental to human judgment, yet AI assistants offer a fluent answer to almost any question. In five experiments (N = 3,132; four preregistered, one direct replication), participants answered difficult questions and could always decline to respond. We engineered the questions so that AI advice was wrong, separating AI use from its accuracy. Merely having access to AI nearly eliminated participants' willingness to suspend judgment, and this held whether the advice was actively requested or simply displayed. Consequently, participants answered more questions but were correct about a third as often as when AI was unavailable-yet their confidence nearly doubled. Incentivizing accuracy and penalizing inaccuracy led participants to seek and follow AI advice less, answer more accurately, and suspend judgment more often, though still far less than when AI was unavailable. As AI suggestions grow ubiquitous and unsolicited, they may not simply affect answer accuracy; they may even alter the metacognitive threshold at which people decide whether they know enough to answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过5个实验（N=3132）研究AI建议对人们说“我不知道”意愿的影响。即使AI建议错误且准确率受激励，仅提供AI建议就几乎消除了人们暂停判断的意愿。参与者回答更多问题，但正确率仅为无AI时的约三分之一，而自信却翻倍。准确率激励能部分缓解，但远未恢复无AI时的水平。
Motivation: 研究AI建议如何影响人们在不确定时说“我不知道”这一基本判断能力，特别是当建议错误时。
Method: 设计了5个实验（其中4个预注册，1个直接复制），让参与者回答困难问题并允许不回答。问题被设计为使AI建议错误，以分离AI使用与其准确性。实验比较了无AI、主动请求AI建议、AI建议自动显示等条件，并操纵了准确率激励。
Result: 仅提供AI建议几乎消除了暂停判断的意愿，无论建议是主动请求还是自动显示。参与者回答更多问题但正确率仅为无AI时的约三分之一，自信几乎翻倍。准确率激励使参与者更少寻求和遵循AI建议，回答更准确，更多暂停判断，但仍远低于无AI时。
Conclusion: 随着AI建议变得普遍和主动推送，它们可能不仅影响答案准确性，还会改变人们决定自己是否知道足够答案的元认知阈值。

summary_sections.method: 设计了5个实验（其中4个预注册，1个直接复制），让参与者回答困难问题并允许不回答。问题被设计为使AI建议错误，以分离AI使用与其准确性。实验比较了无AI、主动请求AI建议、AI建议自动显示等条件，并操纵了准确率激励。
summary_sections.result: 仅提供AI建议几乎消除了暂停判断的意愿，无论建议是主动请求还是自动显示。参与者回答更多问题但正确率仅为无AI时的约三分之一，自信几乎翻倍。准确率激励使参与者更少寻求和遵循AI建议，回答更准确，更多暂停判断，但仍远低于无AI时。
summary_sections.conclusion: 随着AI建议变得普遍和主动推送，它们可能不仅影响答案准确性，还会改变人们决定自己是否知道足够答案的元认知阈值。

papers.title: Grounded world models in biological organisms and future embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative and embodied AI have been driven by large-scale predictive learning over multimodal data. However, the resulting systems remain largely based on passive training regimes where linguistic regularities create the scaffold onto which information from other modalities is attached. Conversely, neuroscience and cognitive science suggest that biological intelligence is organized in the opposite way, where grounded world models acquired through interaction with the environment provide the semantic scaffold to which language is attached. Here, we illustrate five examples of neural circuits supporting grounded world modelling, which underlie navigation in physical and conceptual spaces, affordance-based perception and interaction with objects, active perception and exploratory learning, allostatic control and emotion, and the distinction between self- and world-generated outcomes. These examples highlight several features largely missing from current embodied AI, including the role of intrinsic dynamics as a foundation for learning, the centrality of action in aligning these dynamics with the external world, the prominence of autonomous experience and open-ended learning over passive assimilation of externally provided data, and the fact that early predictive and control mechanisms scaffold higher cognitive abilities such as reasoning, conceptual navigation, planning, imagination, understanding others' minds, and communication. Finally, we discuss whether and how principles derived from biological systems may inform future embodied AI, including training regimes based on social interaction to construct world models that are not only grounded but also socially shared and aligned with human norms and values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从神经科学和认知科学角度，论证生物智能通过与环境交互获得具身世界模型（grounded world models），这些模型为语言提供了语义支架，而当前生成式AI和具身AI的被动训练模式相反。论文通过五个神经回路实例说明具身世界模型支撑导航、基于可供性的感知与交互、主动感知与探索学习、稳态控制与情感、自我与世界生成结果的区分，并讨论生物原理对未来具身AI的启示。
Motivation: 当前生成式AI和具身AI主要依赖大规模多模态数据的被动预测学习，语言规则成为信息整合的支架，而生物智能的组织方式相反——具身世界模型是语义的基础。论文旨在揭示生物世界中具身世界建模的神经机制，并指出当前AI缺失的关键特征。
Method: 论文通过综述五个神经回路实例（导航、多模态感知、主动感知、稳态情感、自我-世界区分）来阐明生物具身世界模型的原则，并讨论这些原则如何启发未来具身AI的训练框架，如基于社会交互的联合世界模型构建。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验数据，但提出生物具身世界模型具有内在动力学的学习基础、行动对齐外部世界的中心作用、自主开放学习优先于被动数据吸收、早期预测控制机制支架高级认知能力等特征。
Conclusion: 论文主张未来具身AI应借鉴生物系统的训练原则，尤其是通过社会交互构建不仅具身而且社会共享、符合人类规范和价值观的世界模型。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning with Tool-Augmented Evidence for Urban Region Profiling
papers.abstract_en: Urban region profiling constitutes a core problem in urban computing, supporting applications such as population estimation, economic assessment, and environmental monitoring. Existing methods typically formulate this task as multimodal representation learning, fusing heterogeneous urban data, e.g., satellite imagery, points of interest, textual descriptions, and 3D building information, into latent embeddings for prediction. However, these approaches are largely correlation-driven, assume cross-modal consistency, and rely on static pipelines, which limit their robustness in heterogeneous or unseen urban regions. We propose UrbanAgent, an agentic framework that reframes urban region profiling as a reasoning-driven inference problem. UrbanAgent instantiates an independent agent for each data modality and performs structured multi-agent collaborative reasoning to explicitly address cross-modal inconsistencies rather than absorbing them into a single representation. In addition, UrbanAgent extends indicator prediction as a closed-loop process of active evidence acquisition and iterative reasoning, enabling agents to verify uncertain inferences through tool-augmented retrieval of external knowledge optimized via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on global urban datasets for Carbon emissions, GDP, and Population estimation show that UrbanAgent consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average improvement of 8.1% in R2, and exhibiting strong generalization performance in unseen-city settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UrbanAgent，一个基于智能体的框架，将城市区域画像重新定义为推理驱动的问题。它针对每种数据模态实例化独立智能体，执行结构化多智能体协作推理以显式处理跨模态不一致性，并通过强化学习优化的工具增强外部知识检索来验证不确定推理。在全球城市数据集上，UrbanAgent在碳排放、GDP和人口估计任务中平均R²提升8.1%，并在未见城市设置中表现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有城市区域画像方法多为相关性驱动，假设跨模态一致性并依赖静态管道，在异构或未见过的城市区域中鲁棒性有限。
Method: UrbanAgent为每种数据模态创建独立智能体，进行多智能体协作推理；将指标预测扩展为主动证据获取和迭代推理的闭环过程，通过强化学习训练工具增强检索来验证推理。
Result: 在全球城市数据集上，UrbanAgent在碳排放、GDP和人口估计任务中平均R²提升8.1%，并在未见城市设置中表现出强泛化性能。
Conclusion: 论文将城市区域画像定位为推理问题而非表示学习问题，展示了智能体协作和工具增强推理的有效性，但该框架的复杂性可能带来计算开销。

papers.title: Greedy Volume Maximization of Gradient Embeddings for Long-Tailed Frame-Level Bioacoustic Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Bioacoustic call-type classification relies on costly expert annotation. Active learning can reduce this burden by selecting a small batch of segments for expert annotation and using the labeled segments for training the classifier. The setting is hard: the target calls are extremely sparse and the call-type distribution is long-tailed, so a tight budget must be spent on the few rare, informative segments. We propose BADGE-Greedy-DPP, a deterministic batch selector that greedily adds the segment whose BADGE gradient embedding most enlarges the volume spanned by the batch; because this log-volume objective is submodular, the greedy rule guarantees a batch value at least a (1-1/e) fraction of the optimum of this objective, a guarantee not provided by BADGE's existing k-means++ and MCMC DPP sampling heuristics. There is also a temporal granularity mismatch in the task. The acquisition function scores whole segments, yet the informative frames inside them are few. Uniform averaging therefore washes them out. We show that the BADGE construction naturally addresses this mismatch when applied frame-wise, as prediction residuals weight the aggregated pseudo-gradient, so confidently predicted no-call frames contribute little while a single uncertain rare-call frame can still set the segment's direction. Across 10 runs on a sparse, imbalanced hyena call-type dataset, BADGE-Greedy-DPP achieves the best overall and rare-call-type performance among all compared query strategies, including MFFT, the strongest non-BADGE baseline, and the two vanilla BADGE traversals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长尾框架级生物声学主动学习中的稀有类别检测问题，提出 BADGE-Greedy-DPP，一种基于子模函数最大化梯度嵌入体积的确定性批次选择器。该方法通过贪婪添加使批次体积最大的段，保证 (1-1/e) 近似最优性，并利用框架级 BADGE 构造自然解决时间粒度不匹配问题。在稀疏、不平衡的鬣狗叫声数据集上，该方法在整体和稀有类别性能上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 生物声学调用类型分类依赖昂贵的专家标注，主动学习可减少负担。但目标调用极度稀疏且类别分布长尾，需在紧预算下选择少量稀有、信息丰富的段。现有 BADGE 方法的 k-means++ 和 MCMC DPP 采样缺乏近似保证，且时间粒度不匹配导致均匀平均稀释了信息。
Method: 提出 BADGE-Greedy-DPP，一种确定性批次选择器，贪心添加使 BADGE 梯度嵌入体积最大的段。由于对数体积目标是子模的，贪婪规则保证 (1-1/e) 近似最优。利用框架级 BADGE 构造，预测残差加权聚合伪梯度，使高置信度无调用帧贡献小，而单个不确定稀有调用帧可主导方向。
Result: 在稀疏、不平衡的鬣狗叫声数据集上（10 次运行），BADGE-Greedy-DPP 在整体和稀有类别性能上均优于所有对比查询策略，包括最强非 BADGE 基线 MFFT 和两种标准 BADGE 遍历。
Conclusion: 本文展示了所提方法在长尾框架级生物声学主动学习中的有效性，并强调了子模性保证和框架级梯度的优势。

papers.title: Flow-aware Optimal Navigation in Unsteady Flows through Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robotic navigation in nonstationary time-varying fluid flows remains a fundamental challenge due to partial observability and the unpredictability of realistic environments. While classical optimal control frameworks employed in robotics require unrealistic a-priori global flow knowledge, biological systems are able to navigate successfully by exploiting localized sensory cues. In this work we present a reinforcement learning approach using the TD3 algorithm to train autonomous agents to reach arbitrary targets within a parametric, chaotic double-gyre flow. To investigate optimal sensory mechanisms, we evaluate five bio-inspired observation strategies based on relative position, local velocity or local vorticity measures, and short-term memory variants. Additionally, we analyze the impact of providing agents with explicit global flow parameters. Numerical results demonstrate that an agent that is able to sense and remember a set number of flow velocity measures achieves the highest performance. The experiments reveal a trade-off in sensor utility: velocity-aware agents optimize energy efficiency, whereas vorticity sensors provide superior structural mapping and achieve better target proximity. Incorporating explicit global flow parameters is shown to decrease navigation performance. This behavior suggests that reinforcement learning-based autonomous systems develop more robust and general policies when restricted to implicit flow representations. The presented results offer insights for improving the transition of bio-inspired robotic navigation from simulation to real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于TD3强化学习的方法，用于在非稳态混沌双漩涡流中训练自主机器人导航至任意目标。通过比较五种生物启发的观测策略（基于相对位置、局部流速、局部涡度及其短期记忆变体），发现结合流速记忆的策略性能最佳，而显式全局流参数会降低导航性能。
Motivation: 现有经典最优控制方法需要不现实的先验全局流场知识，而生物系统依靠局部感知线索成功导航，论文旨在通过强化学习探索最优感知机制。
Method: 采用TD3算法在参数化混沌双漩涡流中训练智能体，设计五种基于相对位置、局部速度或涡度、短期记忆变体的观测策略，并分析显式全局流参数的影响。
Result: 能够感知并记忆一定数量流速测量值的智能体性能最高；速度智能体优化能量效率，涡度传感器提供更好的结构映射和更近的目标距离；显式全局流参数降低导航性能。
Conclusion: 强化学习自主系统在仅使用隐式流表示时能发展更鲁棒、更通用的策略，研究结果有助于将生物启发导航从模拟迁移到真实环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parallel gradient boosting for flexible estimation of conditional distributions
papers.abstract_en: Boosting is one of the most successful learning techniques for standard classification and regression tasks. Its extension to multi-output prediction problems has found an increasing number of applications in recent years. Among them is the prediction of entire conditional distributions rather than single functionals, which can often be framed as a multi-output regression problem, for example multiple quantile regression. Addressing such problems with classical implementations of boosting is computationally challenging, because usually one base model is trained for each target at every iteration. More efficient variants of boosting have been proposed to speed up training, but they tend to be tied to specific loss functions and classes of base learners, usually decision trees. In this work, we study a modification of the gradient boosting algorithm, which we call parallel gradient boosting, designed to circumvent all these limitations. The core idea is to use a common descent direction for all training observations. By doing so, only one base model is needed at each iteration, regardless of the number of targets, which allows for considerable performance gains. We establish sufficient conditions for the convergence of the algorithm, whose practical use is introduced via the multiple quantile regression setting. We show that in such a setting, it provides predictions of similar quality to state-of-the-art boosting libraries such as XGBoost, while being faster by several orders of magnitude. Then, we evaluate the properties of the resulting conditional distribution estimator, which is shown empirically to outperform other nonparametric and semiparametric estimators, especially in high-dimensional settings and in the presence of mixed and/or missing covariates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并行梯度提升算法，通过使用公共下降方向，每次迭代只训练一个基模型，适用于多输出回归（如多分位数回归）。理论上给出收敛条件，实验表明与XGBoost质量相当但速度快几个数量级，在高维和混合/缺失协变量场景下表现更优。
Motivation: 传统梯度提升扩展到多输出预测时计算成本高，且现有高效变体受限于特定损失函数和基学习器类型（如决策树）。本文旨在提出一种通用、高效的梯度提升变体。
Method: 提出并行梯度提升算法，核心是使用公共下降方向（对所有训练观测相同），每次迭代只训练一个基模型，无论目标数量多少。并在多分位数回归背景下引入实际使用，给出收敛充分条件。
Result: 在多分位数回归设置中，预测质量与XGBoost相当，但速度快数个数量级。经验上，条件分布估计器在高维、混合和缺失协变量场景中优于其他非参数和半参数估计器。
Conclusion: 该方法克服了现有多输出梯度提升的计算限制，具有通用性，适用于多种损失函数和基学习器。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出并行梯度提升算法，通过使用公共下降方向，每次迭代只训练一个基模型，适用于多输出回归（如多分位数回归）。理论上给出收敛条件，实验表明与XGBoost质量相当但速度快几个数量级，在高维和混合/缺失协变量场景下表现更优。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统梯度提升扩展到多输出预测时计算成本高，且现有高效变体受限于特定损失函数和基学习器类型（如决策树）。本文旨在提出一种通用、高效的梯度提升变体。
summary_sections.method: 提出并行梯度提升算法，核心是使用公共下降方向（对所有训练观测相同），每次迭代只训练一个基模型，无论目标数量多少。并在多分位数回归背景下引入实际使用，给出收敛充分条件。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法克服了现有多输出梯度提升的计算限制，具有通用性，适用于多种损失函数和基学习器。

papers.title: How Far Can Root Cause Analysis Go on Real-World Telemetry Data?
papers.abstract_en: Identifying root causes in production microservice failures requires reasoning over large-scale, multimodal telemetry spanning metrics, logs, and traces, a problem that has proved resistant to both classical and LLM-based approaches. The OpenRCA dataset exemplifies these challenges: it is large-scale, multimodal, and lacks detailed domain knowledge, and yields consistently low accuracy across all existing methods. We show that classical causal discovery methods and existing LLM-based multi-agent systems fail to reliably identify root causes on this benchmark, and present a Structured Multi-Agent RCA pipeline that substantially outperforms existing LLM-based and classical baselines, supporting both domain-knowledge and knowledge-free operating modes. To diagnose where failures originate, we introduce a reverse reasoning agent that, given the correct answer, identifies which signals in the extracted anomalies support it and determines whether Stage~1 had access to those signals, classifying each failure as Reasoning Gap (evidence present but unused) or Data Ambiguity (evidence genuinely absent). This analysis reveals that the required evidence is present in the vast majority of failures: the bottleneck is not data access but the agent's ability to reason over it correctly. We further introduce an automated rule mining pipeline that systematically extracts discrimination rules from reverse reasoning reports, reducing reliance on manual knowledge curation. Across all configurations, model reasoning capability and domain knowledge are the primary constraints: stronger models embed more domain expertise, and explicit knowledge injection partially compensates for this gap. Reasoning performance remains practically bounded even when evidence extraction is perfect: scaffold engineering and better data pipelines alone cannot close this gap; progress requires improvements at the model level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生产微服务故障中的根因分析问题，使用OpenRCA基准数据集，发现经典因果发现和现有LLM多智能体系统均难以可靠识别根因。提出结构化多智能体RCA流水线，显著优于基线方法；引入逆向推理智能体诊断失败来源，揭示瓶颈在于模型推理能力而非数据获取；还提出自动规则挖掘流水线减少人工知识依赖。
Motivation: 生产微服务故障的根因分析需处理大规模多模态遥测数据（指标、日志、踪迹），现有经典方法和LLM方法均表现不佳，OpenRCA数据集上准确率持续低下。
Method: 提出结构化多智能体RCA流水线，支持领域知识和无知识两种模式；引入逆向推理智能体，根据正确答案判断异常信号是否支持，分类失败原因为推理缺口或数据歧义；以及自动规则挖掘流水线从逆向推理报告中提取判别规则。
Result: 所提方法显著优于现有LLM和经典基线；逆向推理分析表明绝大多数失败中证据存在，瓶颈是推理能力而非数据；更强模型嵌入更多领域知识，显式知识注入可部分弥补差距。
Conclusion: 即使证据提取完美，推理性能仍存在实际上限；仅靠脚手架工程和数据管道无法缩小差距，需要模型层面的改进。

papers.title: From Novice to Expert: Cost-Aware Bandits for Evolving Worker Performance in Crowdsensing
papers.abstract_en: Mobile crowdsensing (MC) recruits mobile users to perform sensing tasks using their smartphones, enabling large-scale applications such as traffic monitoring and environmental sensing. A fundamental challenge is online worker recruitment under uncertainty, where the platform must learn workers' sensing performance while operating with a limited budget. Existing learning-based MC recruitment methods typically assume that each worker's sensing quality is stationary with a fixed mean over time. In practice, however, worker performance often improves with experience and eventually stabilizes, while the incurred sensing cost can be unknown in advance due to time-varying device and context states. In this paper, we study a budget-constrained online recruitment problem in which the platform selects one worker in each round, observes the sensing quality and incurred cost, where the expected sensing quality of each worker increases with experience and eventually converges to a plateau, and repeats until the budget is exhausted. We formulate this problem as a structured bandit model where each worker's expected reward evolves according to an unknown increasing-then-converging function of its participation count, and each worker has an unknown expected cost. We develop a cost-aware online learning framework that jointly learns evolving reward trajectories and heterogeneous costs, detects performance saturation, and allocates the limited budget to maximize long-term sensing utility. We provide theoretical performance guarantees and validate the proposed approach through extensive experiments, demonstrating consistent improvements over baselines that ignore experience-driven dynamics or assume known costs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对移动众包中预算约束下的在线工人招募问题，提出成本感知的在线学习框架。该框架考虑工人表现随经验提升并收敛至稳定水平，且成本未知，通过学习奖励轨迹和成本、检测饱和并分配预算，最大化长期感知效用。实验表明持续优于忽略经验动态或假设成本已知的基线。
Motivation: 现有学习型众包招募方法通常假设工人表现稳定，但实际中工人表现随经验提升并最终稳定，且成本因设备和环境变化而未知，导致招募效率低下。
Method: 将问题建模为结构化bandit，每个工人的期望奖励是其参与次数的未知递增-收敛函数，成本未知。提出成本感知在线学习框架，联合学习奖励轨迹和成本，检测性能饱和，并优化预算分配。
Result: 实验验证了所提方法持续优于忽略经验动态或假设成本已知的基线方法。
Conclusion: 所提框架有效处理工人表现动态演化和未知成本，提升了预算约束下的众包效用。

papers.title: Clustering algorithms for multivariate wind farm SCADA data filtering
papers.abstract_en: During wind farm operation, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems record numerous anomalies, transients, and specific operational modes, leading to large datasets. However, for a wide range of applications, only measurements corresponding to normal operation are required and, therefore, the SCADA data must be filtered. For this purpose, several methods have been proposed to automate and replace manual filtering conducted by experts via visual inspection of the data. In this paper, we compare the filtering accuracy of multiple clustering algorithms against manual filtering, introducing evaluation metrics that are suitable for unlabeled data and robust across potential applications. Based on the results, we provide recommendations for generalizing model calibration to different datasets and discuss potential use cases for each model. The models are applied to the SCADA data of three turbines of an existing offshore wind farm, using 10-minute statistics across multiple data channels. In addition to the anomalies and operational modes typically recorded, the dataset presents a large number of non-evident outliers due to several field tests. Overall, the results highlight the importance of extending the analysis beyond the power curve, both in feature selection and in the design of evaluation metrics. In most cases, cluster-based methods are able to detect both evident and subtle outliers, achieving higher accuracy than manual filtering. However, the accuracy and the amount of data retained vary considerably depending on the model, and expert involvement remains necessary, though to a reduced extent compared to manual filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较多种聚类算法用于过滤风场SCADA数据中的异常和瞬态，以保留正常操作数据，并引入适用于无标签数据的评估指标。在海上风电场三台涡轮机的10分钟统计数据上测试，发现聚类方法能检测明显和隐蔽异常，准确率高于人工过滤，但结果因模型而异，仍需专家参与。
Motivation: 风场SCADA数据包含大量异常和瞬态，需过滤以用于正常操作分析，但现有自动过滤方法缺乏系统比较和通用评估指标。
Method: 对比多种聚类算法（如K-means、DBSCAN等）对SCADA数据进行过滤，并设计适合无标签数据的评估指标，在多通道数据上测试。
Result: 聚类方法能检测明显和隐蔽异常，准确率高于人工过滤，但保留数据量因模型差异大，且仍需专家参与。
Conclusion: 聚类方法可辅助过滤，但校准需推广至不同数据集，且需将分析扩展到功率曲线之外。

papers.title: When T2I Synthetic Data Backfires: Amplified Privacy Risks in Real-Synthetic Mix Training
papers.abstract_en: To overcome data scarcity and privacy constraints in data collection, it has become standard practice across academia and industry to augment real training data with text-to-image (T2I)-generated synthetic data, a paradigm we term Real-Synthetic Mix-Training (RSMT). While substituting synthetic data for sensitive real samples is widely regarded as a means to mitigate privacy exposure of the substituted data, the risk to the remaining real samples that actively participate in training has remained largely unexamined. This work reveals, for the first time, that RSMT can substantially amplify privacy leakage of these real training samples. We establish a theoretical framework, RSMT Memorization Amplification, proving that incorporating synthetic data displaces real samples toward peripheral regions of the mixed feature space, in turn forcing the model to memorize them more aggressively. Guided by this foundation, we propose RSMixLeak to systematically assess this risk through membership inference attacks (MIAs). RSMixLeak comprises two variants depending on the adversary's capability. The non-adversarial variant audits a benign RSMT pipeline with an honest T2I provider, establishing a lower bound on the leakage induced by the intrinsic gap between real and T2I-generated data. The adversarial variant considers an adversary who controls the T2I model or contributes crafted data to the T2I provider, and deliberately enlarges this distributional gap on a target class via either high-level semantic attribute binding or imperceptible pixel-level coating, further amplifying leakage on real training data while improving downstream model utility. Motivated by these findings, we further propose a lightweight leakage propensity indicator computable from real data alone that reliably identifies high-risk datasets unsuitable for entering RSMT, as a self-assessable mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次揭示在真实-合成混合训练（RSMT）中，使用文本到图像（T2I）生成的合成数据会显著放大剩余真实训练样本的隐私泄露风险。作者建立了理论框架证明合成数据将真实样本推向混合特征空间的边缘，迫使模型更激进地记忆它们，并提出了RSMixLeak方法通过成员推理攻击系统评估这一风险，包括非对抗和对抗两种变体。最后提出一个轻量级泄露倾向指标，用于识别不适合进入RSMT的高风险数据集。
Motivation: 现有研究普遍认为用T2I合成数据替代敏感真实数据可以降低被替换数据的隐私暴露，但未考察参与训练的真实样本的隐私风险。本文填补这一空白，首次揭示RSMT会放大真实训练样本的隐私泄露。
Method: 建立RSMT记忆放大的理论框架，证明合成数据将真实样本推向混合特征空间外围导致更激进的记忆。提出RSMixLeak方法，包含非对抗变体（审计诚实T2I提供者的基准泄露）和对抗变体（恶意T2I模型通过语义属性绑定或像素级涂布放大分布差距，同时提升下游模型效用）。
Result: 理论证明和实验表明RSMT显著放大真实训练样本的隐私泄露，对抗变体能进一步放大泄露同时保持或提升模型效用。
Conclusion: 本文揭示RSMT中真实样本的隐私风险，并提出可自评估的泄露倾向指标用于识别高风险数据集，但未讨论其他隐私攻击类型或防御措施的通用性。

papers.title: ThinkBLOX: 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Progressive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While traditional graphics methods often synthesize 3D indoor scenes autoregressively or hierarchically, recent vision-language model (VLM)-based generators predominantly adopt a one-shot paradigm where the full layout is planned at once. This one-shot approach often requires global re-optimization or complete reconstruction during interactive editing (e.g., inserting or moving objects) and can lead to physically or semantically poorly organized arrangements. To address these challenges, we propose ThinkBLOX, a VLM-based progressive reasoning framework that iteratively designs and refines 3D scenes. ThinkBLOX treats layout generation as a state-conditioned, step-by-step reasoningand-action process. To power this, we construct the ThinkBLOX-Data-200K dataset, containing 224,757 procedural placement pairs annotated with multi-view scene context, explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales, and structured JSON layouts. Through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on this dataset, the VLM learns to bridge the reasoning-action gap under incremental updates. Furthermore, recognizing that scene synthesis is inherently a multisolution task where SFT suffers from reward conflict, we introduce Tier-Decoupled GDPO. This reinforcement learning scheme organizes heterogeneous rewards into distinct tiers, stabilizing policy optimization across physical validity, semantic plausibility, and reasoning-action consistency. Extensive experiments show that ThinkBLOX significantly outperforms recent one-shot and iterative baselines in physical plausibility, semantic alignment, and interactive editability. Additionally, we show that it supports diverse applications, including both global and local generation and rearrangement of 3D scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThinkBLOX 是一个基于 VLM 的渐进式推理框架，用于 3D 室内场景生成。它通过构建包含 224,757 个程序化放置对的数据集并进行监督微调，使 VLM 学会逐步推理和行动；同时引入 Tier-Decoupled GDPO 强化学习方法以解决多解任务中的奖励冲突。实验表明，该方法在物理合理性、语义对齐和交互式编辑能力上优于现有基准。
Motivation: 现有基于 VLM 的 3D 室内场景生成器多采用一次性规划全部布局的方式，导致交互编辑时需要全局重优化或完全重建，且布局可能物理或语义组织不佳。
Method: 提出 ThinkBLOX 框架：将布局生成视为状态条件的分步推理-行动过程；构建 ThinkBLOX-Data-200K 数据集（含多视角场景上下文、显式链式思维推理和结构化 JSON 布局）；通过监督微调训练 VLM 弥合推理-行动差距；引入 Tier-Decoupled GDPO 强化学习方案，将异构奖励分为不同层级以稳定策略优化。
Result: 实验表明 ThinkBLOX 在物理合理性、语义对齐和交互编辑能力上显著优于近期的一次性和迭代基准，并支持全局/局部生成及场景重排等多种应用。
Conclusion: ThinkBLOX 通过渐进式推理和分层强化学习有效解决了 VLM 一次生成场景的可编辑性和布局合理性问题。

summary_sections.result: 实验表明 ThinkBLOX 在物理合理性、语义对齐和交互编辑能力上显著优于近期的一次性和迭代基准，并支持全局/局部生成及场景重排等多种应用。
summary_sections.conclusion: ThinkBLOX 通过渐进式推理和分层强化学习有效解决了 VLM 一次生成场景的可编辑性和布局合理性问题。

papers.title: VGIF-Score: Interpretable and Diagnostic Evaluation of Spatio-Temporal Instruction Following in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent video generation models (VGMs) have made substantial progress in visual fidelity, yet their ability to follow long, compositional instructions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing evaluation protocols often rely on prompts that are short and semantically shallow, with limited atomic constraints and weak spatio-temporal dependencies. They also frequently depend on costly human evaluation or handcrafted vision pipelines, while providing little diagnostic insight into which instruction constraints succeed or fail. To address this gap, we propose VGIF-Score, a highly automated and interpretable framework for evaluating instruction following in video generation. VGIF-Score consists of two complementary components: an objective completion branch that parses prompts into a Spatio-Temporal Directed Acyclic Graph (ST-DAG) and performs dependency-aware QA with short-circuit diagnostics, and a subjective satisfaction branch that uses instruction-conditioned AutoRubric to assess cinematography, visual purity, motion smoothness, and physics adherence. Together, these components produce a unified score that captures both objective completion and perceptual satisfaction. We instantiate this framework on VGIF-Bench, a benchmark of 223 long, structurally entangled prompts paired with approximately 4.3K fine-grained evaluation items. Experiments on 14 proprietary and open-source VGMs across more than 3K generated videos show that VGIF-Score provides reliable, interpretable, and diagnostically useful evaluation of video generation instruction following. The code will be available at https://github.com/PRIS-CV/VGIF-SCORE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VGIF-Score，一个用于评估视频生成模型对长时、组合式指令跟随能力的自动化可解释框架。该框架包含客观完成分支（将指令解析为时空有向无环图并进行依赖感知问答）和主观满意度分支（利用指令条件自动评分表评估电影感、视觉纯度、运动平滑度和物理一致性）。作者在自建的 VGIF-Bench 基准（223 条长指令，约 4300 个细粒度评估项）上对 14 个视频生成模型进行了测试，结果表明 VGIF-Score 能提供可靠、可解释且具有诊断价值的评估。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型评估方法多依赖短浅提示、手工视觉流程或昂贵人工评测，缺乏对长指令中复杂时空约束的可解释诊断能力。
Method: 提出 VGIF-Score，由两个互补分支组成：客观完成分支将提示解析为时空有向无环图（ST-DAG）并进行依赖感知的问答与短路诊断；主观满意度分支使用指令条件 AutoRubric 评估电影摄影、视觉纯度、运动平滑度和物理遵循。
Result: 在 VGIF-Bench 基准上对 14 个视频生成模型生成的超过 3000 个视频进行测试，结果表明 VGIF-Score 提供可靠、可解释且诊断有用的评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为视频生成模型的指令跟随能力提供了自动化的、可解释的评估工具，有助于识别具体指令约束的成败。

papers.title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
papers.abstract_en: A robot must understand the state of its own body, but a camera sees only part of it. Force and contact leave almost no trace in a single frame, and raw vision features read force at $R^2$ at or below $0.10$ on every robot we test. We present Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal encoder that treats robot state as a modality and fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque into a single shared latent with a learned-query cross-attention layer, trained self-supervised by masked cross-modal prediction under the LeJEPA/SIGReg objective. At evaluation only vision enters, which poses a sharp question. Does fusing state into training make the vision-only latent carry anything the pixels do not already contain? On the RH20T corpus the answer is yes, precisely where the camera is weakest. On held-out scenes, the vision-only latent recovers end-effector state, and force in particular, significantly above both raw frozen-ViT features and a compute-matched vision-only control on every sensored robot, though absolute force recovery at a single timestep is modest; on motor state, which the camera largely sees, it is statistically tied with the strongest vision baselines, and it is the only feature whose latent geometry tracks state. A single embodiment-agnostic encoder covers four robots, and a data-matched control shows this breadth reflects embodiment diversity rather than data volume. The frozen latent is directly useful. Its own cross-modal prediction error is a training-free invalid-state monitor (AUROC $0.90$ on out-of-range states, $0.69$ on scene-swapped states), and a diffusion decoder (PixNerd) reconstructs the camera frame from the latent, confirming the spatial compression preserves world-state. This report validates the single-timestep case; native-rate temporal fusion is the next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一种机器人优先的多模态嵌入模型，通过跨模态预测自监督学习将视觉、本体感觉和力/力矩融合到共享隐空间中。在推理时仅使用视觉，但隐空间仍能恢复力、末端执行器状态等，尤其弥补了相机的弱点。实验覆盖四个机器人，隐空间可直接用于异常检测（AUROC 0.90）及图像重建。
Motivation: 相机只能看到机器人身体的一部分，力和接触在单帧中几乎不可见，原始视觉特征与力的相关性极低（R²≤0.10）。需要一种能隐式编码机器人状态的多模态嵌入。
Method: 提出机器人优先的多模态编码器，将机器人状态作为模态，通过可学习查询的交叉注意力层将视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩融合到共享隐空间，使用LeJEPA/SIGReg目标进行掩码跨模态预测自监督训练。推理时仅输入视觉。
Result: 在RH20T语料库上，视觉隐空间恢复末端执行器状态和力显著优于原始冻结ViT和纯视觉基线；绝对力恢复有限；电机状态与最强视觉基线无显著差异。隐空间自身跨模态预测误差可作为无训练无效状态监测器（AUROC 0.90/0.69）。扩散解码器PixNerd可从隐空间重建相机帧。
Conclusion: 验证了单时间步的情况，确认融合状态信息使得视觉隐空间携带像素之外的信息。下一步是原生速率时间融合。

papers.title: DriveFace: A Cross-Spectral Through-Glass Face Dataset for On-the-Move Vehicular Border Control
papers.abstract_en: The continuous growth in cross-border mobility places increasing pressure on existing border control infrastructures, motivating on-the-move biometric authentication, in which travellers are identified directly inside their vehicles at checkpoints. Face recognition is well-suited to this setting, as it can be acquired passively and at a distance. Its development, however, is hindered by the lack of representative datasets: existing benchmarks are collected in controlled environments and do not capture the challenges inherent to vehicular acquisition, including motion blur, variable illumination, occlusions, and cross-spectral enrollment. To address this gap, we introduce a dataset for on-the-move face recognition in border-control scenarios, comprising NIR vehicle-crossing videos paired with smartphone-based pre-enrollment data. Baseline evaluations with state-of-the-art models show clear performance limitations under these realistic conditions, highlighting the need for dedicated methods to advance the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 DriveFace 数据集，用于移动车辆边界控制场景中的跨光谱（NIR 与可见光）车窗人脸识别。数据集中包含 NIR 车辆通过视频和智能手机预注册数据，基线评估显示现有模型在真实条件下性能有限，亟需专门方法。
Motivation: 现有边界控制基础设施面临压力，需要移动中生物识别认证，但缺乏代表车辆采集挑战（运动模糊、光照变化、遮挡、跨光谱注册）的数据集。
Method: 构建了 DriveFace 数据集，包含车辆通过时的 NIR 视频以及智能手机拍摄的预注册人脸图片（跨光谱），并采用多种 SOTA 人脸识别模型进行基线评估。
Result: 基线评估显示现有模型在真实车辆采集条件下性能明显受限，表明需要专门设计的方法来提升准确率。
Conclusion: 该数据集揭示了当前人脸识别在移动车辆场景中的不足，为跨光谱车窗人脸识别研究提供了基准和方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ExTernD: Expanded-Rank Ternary Decomposition Ternary LLM PTQ with Accuracy Approaching Any Quantization Level
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ExTernD (Expanded-rank Ternary Decomposition), a post-training factorization of each LLM weight matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ into $A \approx B \mathrm{diag}(D) C$ with ternary factors $B \in \{-1,0,+1\}^{m \times k}$, $C \in \{-1,0,+1\}^{k \times n}$ and a real scale vector $D \in \mathbb{R}^k$. The inner rank $k = μ\min(m,n)$ is deliberately expanded beyond full rank ($μ> 1$), so that components past full rank correct the quantization error of earlier ones. We prove the residual decreases monotonically in $k$ and can be driven below any $\varepsilon > 0$: ExTernD approaches bf16 accuracy arbitrarily closely, which no ternary scheme with a fixed plane count can do. Memory and compute scale continuously with $μ$, and factor sparsity continuously with a threshold $τ$, so an accuracy target is hit exactly rather than rounded to the next bit-width. ExTernD matches Q4_K's per-matrix accuracy at 5.2-5.5 effective bpw (5.1-5.5 with importance weighting) on Gemma-4-E2B and Qwen3.5-4B, and a full Qwen3.5-4B conversion at $μ= 3$ reaches 10.10 wikitext-2 perplexity against 9.78 for bf16 (+3.2%), placing it near the Q4_K/Q5_K accuracy band at ~5.7 effective bpw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExTernD 是一种后训练量化方法，将 LLM 权重矩阵分解为两个三值因子（{-1,0,+1}）和一个实数尺度向量，并通过扩展内部秩超过满秩来校正量化误差。理论上残差可任意接近零，从而逼近 bf16 精度。在 Gemma-4-E2B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 上，该方法以 5.2-5.5 有效比特每权重 (bpw) 达到 Q4_K 的矩阵级精度；Qwen3.5-4B 在 μ=3 时 WikiText-2 困惑度为 10.10，相比 bf16 的 9.78 仅增加 3.2%。
Motivation: 现有三值量化方案因固定平面数而无法精确达到任意精度目标，ExTernD 旨在解决这一限制。
Method: 将权重矩阵 A 分解为 A ≈ B diag(D) C，其中 B、C 为三值矩阵，D 为实数尺度向量；内部秩 k = μ min(m,n) 且 μ > 1，使得超过满秩的分量能够逐步减小残余误差。
Result: 理论证明残余误差随 k 单调递减并可在任意 ε > 0 下趋近零；实验上，ExTernD 在 Gemma-4-E2B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 上以 5.2-5.5 bpw 达到 Q4_K 精度，Qwen3.5-4B（μ=3）困惑度 10.10，接近 Q4_K/Q5_K 精度带（约 5.7 bpw）。
Conclusion: ExTernD 能够任意逼近 bf16 精度，且精度目标可精确命中而非四舍五入到最近位宽，为三值量化提供了可扩展的精度-效率权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CDS: Counterfactual Directionality Score for Structured Interventions in Spatial Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying directional influence between node populations is a fundamental problem in graph-based modeling, particularly in spatial biological systems where cell-cell interactions shape functional outcomes. Existing approaches based on attention, attribution, or correlation capture associations but do not provide a principled framework for evaluating directional effects under controlled perturbations. We introduce a framework for structured counterfactual interventions in graph-based models to estimate directional influence between node types. Our approach trains a Neighbor Influence Model (NIM) to predict node states from local neighborhoods and applies constrained interventions that modify neighborhood composition while preserving key spatial and structural properties. We define the Counterfactual Directionality Score (CDS), which measures the change in predicted node state induced by targeted perturbations, and provide a theoretical interpretation of CDS as a finite-difference measure of local intervention sensitivity. To obtain valid uncertainty estimates, we introduce a core-level bootstrap procedure that accounts for dependencies within spatial samples. Experiments on synthetic spatial graphs with known directional structure show that CDS recovers directional influence, remains well calibrated under null conditions, and is robust to confounding signals, while preliminary results on spatial transcriptomics data reveal biologically plausible and consistent interactions across tissue cores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对空间图中节点群体间方向性影响量化问题，提出反事实方向性评分（CDS）框架。该框架训练邻居影响模型（NIM）预测节点状态，通过施加保留空间结构的受控干预并测量预测变化来评估方向效应。在合成空间图上，CDS能准确恢复已知方向影响、保持零假设校准性并对混杂信号鲁棒；在空间转录组数据上产生生物学上合理的细胞间相互作用。
Motivation: 现有基于注意力、归因或相关性的方法只能捕捉关联，无法在有控扰动下评估方向性效应，而空间生物系统中细胞间相互作用的方向性对理解功能至关重要。
Method: 提出结构化反事实干预框架：先训练邻居影响模型（NIM）从局部邻域预测节点状态，然后对邻域组成施加约束干预（保持空间和结构特性），通过预测状态的变化定义反事实方向性评分（CDS），并从理论上解释为局部干预敏感性的有限差分度量；为获得有效不确定性估计，引入核级bootstrap方法。
Result: 合成空间图实验表明CDS能恢复方向影响、在零假设下保持校准并对混杂信号鲁棒；空间转录组数据初步结果显示跨组织核的生物学上合理且一致的相互作用。
Conclusion: 摘要指出CDS提供了评估空间图中方向影响的原理性框架，并且初步实验支持其在生物学数据上的有效性。
