papers.title: Is the Statistical Advantage Worth the Cost? An Empirical Comparison of KANs and MLPs for Structured Data Classification
papers.abstract_en: This study presents an empirical benchmarking comparison between Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) and Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) on structured tabular classification tasks. Motivated by the growing interest in KANs as an alternative function-approximating architecture, we evaluate their out-of-the-box performance on twelve publicly available datasets spanning binary, multiclass, multilabel, and ordinal problems. Both models were trained under standardized preprocessing, architecture, and fixed hyperparameter settings, with performance assessed using test accuracy and F1-Score, paired hypothesis testing, and effect size analysis. Results show that KANs statistically outperform MLPs in binary and multiclass domains and achieve a significant aggregate advantage across all datasets. However, the observed medium effect size (d = -0.46) raises an important cost-benefit consideration: while KANs offer superior generalization through adaptive spline-based mappings, this advantage comes with substantially higher parameter and computational complexity relative to the MLP baseline. These findings suggest KANs are the preferred choice for high-precision applications, while MLPs remain a robust and efficient option for resource-constrained environments. Future work should extend this analysis to additional data modalities to further refine these architectural selection criteria.
papers.comment: To be presented at the 9th International Conference on Machine Learning and Machine Intelligence (MLMI 2026), Tokyo, Japan

papers.title: Evaluating Frontier AI Agents as Autonomous Clinical Security Auditors
papers.abstract_en: Clinical AI models can expose patients to harm when adversarial vulnerabilities go undetected, yet formal security auditing requires statistical expertise, specialized tools, and significant time. We present an open evaluation task, built on METR Task Standard v0.3.0, that tests whether frontier AI agents can autonomously implement a structured clinical AI security audit. Given a pre-trained clinical prediction model, a patient dataset, and written instructions, each agent must implement four attacks from pseudocode, compute a Security Posture Score covering FGSM robustness, membership inference resistance, expected calibration error, and boundary attack resistance, and write a structured JSON report in a Docker container using only a bash interface and no scaffolding code. Six variants span the Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer and MIMIC-IV ICU mortality datasets across three model architectures with increasing defense strength, with reference scores from 55.60 to 90.41. We ran 54 evaluations across three frontier models, with three runs per variant. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-4.1 completed all 18 runs and received perfect evaluator scores. GPT-4o completed 61 percent of runs and used about five times the per-run token count of Claude, although provider tokenization differs. Total API costs were 8 US dollars for GPT-4.1, 12 US dollars for Claude Sonnet 4.6, and 27 US dollars for GPT-4o. GPT-4o failures involved premature session termination, an aggregation error, and an empty submission file. The task, scoring infrastructure, and Wisconsin Breast Cancer assets are publicly released; MIMIC-IV variants require separate PhysioNet access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于METR Task Standard v0.3.0的开放评估任务，测试前沿AI代理能否自主执行结构化的临床AI安全审计。代理需从伪代码实现四种攻击，计算安全态势分数（涵盖FGSM鲁棒性、成员推断抵抗、期望校准误差、边界攻击抵抗），并在Docker容器中生成JSON报告。在威斯康星诊断乳腺癌和MIMIC-IV ICU死亡率数据集上，对三个前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-4.1、GPT-4o）进行了54次评估。
Motivation: 临床AI模型的对抗性漏洞可能使患者受到伤害，而正式的安全审计需要统计专业知识、专门工具和大量时间，因此需要评估前沿AI代理能否自主完成此类审计。
Method: 构建一个开放评估任务，包括预训练临床预测模型、患者数据集和书面指令，代理需从伪代码实现四种攻击，计算安全态势分数，并通过bash接口在Docker容器中生成JSON报告，不使用脚手架代码。
Result: Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-4.1完成了所有18次运行并获得满分；GPT-4o完成61%的运行，每运行令牌数约为Claude的5倍（但令牌化方式不同）。总API成本为GPT-4.1 8美元、Claude 12美元、GPT-4o 27美元。GPT-4o的失败包括提前终止会话、聚合错误和空提交文件。
Conclusion: 任务、评分基础设施和部分数据集已公开发布，MIMIC-IV变体需单独申请PhysioNet访问。

papers.title: AnomExpert: Identifying and Selecting Anatomical Planes for Prenatal Ultrasound Anomaly Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Life-limiting congenital anomalies require accurate prenatal diagnosis for appropriate clinical decision-making. Prenatal ultrasound (US) examinations involve multiple anatomical planes, and diagnosis depends on identifying anatomical planes and selecting diagnostically relevant planes for each anomaly. Existing automated methods either rely on plane-level annotations or aggregate heterogeneous images without explicitly modeling these diagnostic capabilities. We propose AnomExpert, a prototype-driven framework for prenatal US anomaly diagnosis using only case-level supervision. AnomExpert introduces learnable plane prototypes to organize unordered images into latent representations corresponding to anatomical planes without requiring plane annotations. A disease-aware sparse selection mechanism further selects diagnostically relevant planes for each anomaly. Experiments on a multi-center dataset of 3,654 cases show that AnomExpert consistently outperforms nine representative multi-instance learning methods. Using a ViT-small backbone, it achieves 86.9% accuracy and 84.2% F1-score while maintaining parameter efficiency. These findings indicate that modeling anatomical plane identification and disease-specific plane selection improves weakly supervised multi-plane prenatal US anomaly classification. The code is available at https://github.com/TIanCat/AnomExpert.
papers.comment: It has been accepted early by MICCAI2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnomExpert，一种基于原型驱动（prototype-driven）的框架，用于产前超声异常诊断，仅需病例级别监督。通过可学习的平面原型将无序图像组织成对应解剖平面的潜在表示，并引入疾病感知稀疏选择机制筛选每个异常相关的诊断平面。在多中心3654例数据集上，使用ViT-small骨干网络达到86.9%准确率和84.2% F1分数，优于九种多实例学习方法。
Motivation: 现有产前超声异常诊断方法要么依赖平面级标注，要么聚合异质图像而未显式建模识别解剖平面和选择诊断相关平面的能力。
Method: 提出 AnomExpert 框架，包含可学习的平面原型将无序超声图像映射为解剖平面潜在表示，以及疾病感知稀疏选择机制自动选取每个异常类别中诊断相关的平面。
Result: 在3654例多中心数据集上，AnomExpert 使用 ViT-small 骨干取得86.9%准确率和84.2% F1分数，超越九种多实例学习方法，且参数效率高。
Conclusion: 显式建模解剖平面识别和疾病特定平面选择能提升弱监督多平面产前超声异常分类性能。代码已开源。

papers.title: Improving Text-to-Audio Instruction Following via Fine-Grained Feedback from Audio-Aware Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-audio models generate high-quality audio, but often fail to follow instructions involving multiple sound events and temporal order. This gap arises because existing evaluation and training signals mainly emphasize global similarity or perceptual quality, with limited supervision on instruction-level correctness. We propose an instruction-level framework that uses audio-aware large language models (ALLMs) as fine-grained judges to verify target event presence and temporal relations in generated audio. After validating ALLM judgments on benchmarks and through human verification, we use their feedback to construct preference pairs for direct preference optimization. We further introduce S3Bench, a narrative benchmark for evaluating multi-event temporal instruction following. Experiments show that our method improves event completeness, temporal ordering, and joint instruction-following accuracy across existing benchmarks and S3Bench, while maintaining audio quality.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Long Paper Track at Interspeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到音频生成模型在遵循多事件和时间顺序指令上的不足，提出利用音频感知大语言模型（ALLMs）作为细粒度裁判，验证生成音频中目标事件的存在和时序关系，并构建偏好对进行直接偏好优化（DPO）。此外，引入叙事基准S3Bench用于评估多事件时序指令遵循能力。实验表明该方法在事件完整性、时序顺序和联合指令遵循准确率上均有提升，同时保持音频质量。
Motivation: 现有文本到音频模型生成的音频质量高，但在涉及多个声音事件和时序顺序的指令遵循上常失败，主要因为现有评估和训练信号强调全局相似性或感知质量，对指令级别正确性的监督有限。
Method: 提出指令级框架，使用音频感知大语言模型（ALLMs）作为细粒度裁判，验证生成音频中目标事件存在性和时序关系。通过验证ALLM判断的可靠性后，利用其反馈构建偏好对，用于直接偏好优化（DPO）。
Result: 在现有基准和所提S3Bench上，方法提升了事件完整性、时序顺序和联合指令遵循准确率，同时保持音频质量。
Conclusion: 本文展示了通过细粒度ALLM反馈进行指令级优化能有效改进文本到音频的指令遵循能力，尤其针对多事件时序任务。

papers.title: Price of Fairness in Bandits: A Tight Minimax Characterization
papers.abstract_en: In bandit problems, standard regret-minimizing algorithms treat exploration as an amortized cost, which can expose early participants to unfair ex-ante losses in settings such as clinical trials. Recent work addresses this by evaluating the sequence of per-round expected rewards through the generalized $p$-mean, interpolating between utilitarian welfare ($p=1$), Nash welfare ($p\to0$), and Rawlsian fairness ($p\to-\infty$). Although tight guarantees are known for $p\ge0$, the strictly fair regime $q=-p>0$ remains unresolved because negative-power means are dominated by the smallest per-round rewards. For $σ$-sub-Gaussian rewards with nonnegative means, the best prior algorithm relied on uniform early exploration and achieved regret $O(k^{(q+1)/2}/\sqrt{T})$, while the only general lower bound was the classical $Ω(σ\sqrt{k/T})$. Thus it was unclear whether the extra dependence on $k$ was intrinsic to strict fairness or an artifact of uniform exploration. We close this gap by identifying the exact polynomial price of strict fairness. Using a needle-in-haystack construction, we prove an algorithm-independent lower bound $Ω(σ\sqrt{k^{\max(1,q)}/T})$; for $q>1$, this shows that the penalty $k^{q/2}$ is information-theoretically unavoidable. We then introduce \textsf{UCB-HARE} (Harmonic Anchored Rank Exploration), which replaces uniform exploration with an inverse-weighted harmonic rank schedule protected by a certified positive-mean anchor. Its regret is $\widetilde{O}(σ\sqrt{k^{\max(1,q)}/T})$, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Experiments on synthetic instances confirm that \textsf{UCB-HARE} improves over uniform-exploration baselines, with gains increasing as $q$ grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 bandit 问题中严格公平（strict fairness）的代价，通过广义 p-均值评估回合期望奖励，填补了负幂均值（q>0）情形下的上下界间隙。作者证明信息论下界 Ω(σ√(k^{max(1,q)}/T))，并提出算法 UCB-HARE，其遗憾匹配该下界至对数因子。
Motivation: 标准 bandit 算法最小化累积遗憾，但可能对早期参与者不公平。近期工作用广义 p-均值衡量公平性，但严格公平区域（q>0）的紧界未知，先前算法有额外的 k 依赖，不清楚是否为本质代价。
Method: 提出 UCB-HARE 算法，用逆加权调和排名调度替代均匀探索，并引入认证的正均值锚点。
Result: 证明算法无关下界 Ω(σ√(k^{max(1,q)}/T))，UCB-HARE 的遗憾为 Õ(σ√(k^{max(1,q)}/T))，匹配下界至对数因子。实验验证优于均匀探索基线。
Conclusion: 严格公平的代价是信息论不可避免的 k^{q/2} 惩罚，UCB-HARE 达到最优。

papers.title: Demystifying On-Policy Distillation: Roles, Pathologies, and Regulations
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a key paradigm in LLM post-training, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study examining the role, pathologies, and regulations of OPD. We first clarify the role of OPD as an exploration catalyst: it steers the student toward correct reasoning paths via dense token-level guidance, without expanding capability ceiling. We confirm this by showing that prompt diversity matters more than per-problem sampling numbers, and critically, that the effectiveness of OPD hinges entirely on the quality of its guiding signal. This dependency exposes two pathologies that derail exploration. The Student-Teacher Mismatch occurs when a large teacher-student distributional gap causes the guiding signal to misalign with task correctness, steering exploration in counterproductive directions. Length Exploitation arises when the aggregated token-level objective creates length-dependent shortcuts, allowing the student to game the reward landscape through response truncation or redundant padding, exploring degenerate length modes rather than reasoning strategies. To tame these pathologies, we investigate lightweight signal regulations: advantage clipping and log-scale compression, ensuring exploration is guided by faithful signals. Experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that these regulations alleviate length exploitation and enable effective distillation, stably surpassing OPD variants and RLVR baselines, thereby confirming that well-regulated signal quality, rather than mere teacher scale, governs successful exploration in OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在大语言模型后训练中的作用、病理和调控方法。作者指出OPD作为探索催化剂，通过密集的token级引导推动学生模型走向正确推理路径，但不会扩展能力上限。其有效性完全依赖于引导信号的质量，而学生-教师不匹配和长度利用两种病态会破坏探索。通过优势裁剪和对数尺度压缩等轻量信号调控，可以缓解这些问题，在七个基准上稳定超越OPD变体和RLVR基线。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为LLM后训练的关键范式，但其训练动态尚不明确，特别是引导信号质量如何影响探索效果以及存在的病态行为。
Method: 通过系统实验明确OPD的角色为探索催化剂，并识别出学生-教师不匹配和长度利用两种病理。提出优势裁剪和对数尺度压缩作为轻量信号调控方法，以改善引导信号质量。
Result: 在七个基准上，所提出的调控方法缓解了长度利用问题，稳定地超越了OPD变体和RLVR基线，表明信号质量而非教师规模决定了OPD中的成功探索。
Conclusion: 本文强调OPD的成功依赖于高质量的引导信号，而非单纯的教师规模；所提出的信号调控方法能有效改善蒸馏效果。

summary_sections.method: 通过系统实验明确OPD的角色为探索催化剂，并识别出学生-教师不匹配和长度利用两种病理。提出优势裁剪和对数尺度压缩作为轻量信号调控方法，以改善引导信号质量。
summary_sections.result: 在七个基准上，所提出的调控方法缓解了长度利用问题，稳定地超越了OPD变体和RLVR基线，表明信号质量而非教师规模决定了OPD中的成功探索。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文强调OPD的成功依赖于高质量的引导信号，而非单纯的教师规模；所提出的信号调控方法能有效改善蒸馏效果。

papers.title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
papers.abstract_en: What happens to an LLM agent's tool choice when the reliable tool silently changes within an ongoing session? We borrow set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study how well agents adapt to hidden reliability shifts. Our benchmark mounts tool-skill libraries with redundancies, where many tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. In our evaluation framework, a branched schedule shifts the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs every shift with a no-shift control. We find that agents, by default, settle on a small recurring routine within a few turns of each boundary, with call shares concentrating on a few discrete values after each reliability shift. We score the set-shifting accuracy for each agent trajectory: the joint probability of routing to the target tool group in every post-shift window. We test open-weight LLMs in an open-source agentic harness and find qualitatively distinct failure modes across the same set of routines. We also find that set framing, how the toolset presents the alternatives as competing or complementary, shifts the routing dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文借鉴认知心理学中的任务转换 (set-shifting) 概念，研究 LLM 代理在工具选择时对隐藏可靠性变化的适应能力。构建了一个包含冗余工具技能库的基准测试，其中多个工具可解决相同任务但隐藏可靠性不同。通过分支调度在隐蔽边界处切换可靠工具组，并设置无切换对照。测试发现代理默认在每个边界几轮内形成固定重复模式，调用份额集中在少数离散值上。他们计算了每个代理轨迹的任务转换准确率，即每个切换后窗口路由到目标工具组的联合概率。在开源代理框架中测试开放权重 LLM，发现相同例程存在定性不同的失败模式，并且工具集的呈现方式（竞争或互补）影响路由动态。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏评估 LLM 代理在动态环境中对工具可靠性变化适应能力的系统性方法。借鉴认知心理学的任务转换范式，量化代理在隐蔽变化下的行为灵活性。
Method: 构建冗余工具库，其中多个工具功能相同但可靠性不同。设计分支调度脚本，在隐蔽边界切换可靠性更高的工具组，并记录每次切换的代理行为。定义任务转换准确率指标，计算连续正确路由的概率。在开源代理框架中测试多个开放权重 LLM。
Result: 代理在新边界后迅速收敛到固定模式，调用份额离散化。不同 LLM 在相同任务转换规程下表现出定性不同的失败模式。工具集呈现方式（竞争或互补）显著影响路由动态。
Conclusion: 该基准测试揭示了 LLM 代理在工具使用中对可靠性变化适应能力的局限性，工具呈现方式是影响适应性的重要因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Improving is Often Sudden: Enlightenment-style Finetuning for Large-Scale Models
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of autonomously self-improving models has attracted growing interest in the era of large-scale foundation models. Drawing inspiration from the concept of "enlightenment" or "aha moment" in human brain, we hypothesize that large models exhibit an analogous enlightenment phenomenon-a latent capacity for sudden capability boost. Then, we propose Enlightenment, a novel training-free post-tuning paradigm for large-scale models. Our approach modifies shortcuts for key modules/layers without weight updates, while existing training-free ones predominantly manipulate attention weights. We introduce two architecture-specific instantiations: i) For large language models, we propose attention head-mixing shortcuts that recalibrate attention weights by linking the initial attention head's output to all other target heads, modulated by an adaptive scaling factor initialization strategy. ii) For vision-language models, we apply a lightweight scalar-modulated factor to residual connections in the decoder layers, regulating information flow. Extensive experiments show that Enlightenment efficiently unlocks the latent potential of pre-trained networks, yielding remarkable performance improvements across diverse benchmarks and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受人类“顿悟”现象启发，提出一种无需训练的后微调范式Enlightenment，通过修改关键模块/层的捷径连接（不更新权重）来激发大模型的潜在能力。针对大型语言模型提出注意力头混合捷径，针对视觉语言模型使用标量调制残差连接。实验表明该方法能有效提升多种基准和模型的性能。
Motivation: 现有自提升方法通常需要大量训练或微调，本文旨在探索一种无需权重更新的轻量级后微调方法，利用模型本身已有的潜在大模型能力。
Method: 提出Enlightenment范式：对于LLM，通过连接初始注意力头输出到其他目标头并加入自适应缩放因子来重新校准注意力权重；对于VLM，在解码器残差连接中加入标量调制因子。
Result: 摘要报告在多种基准和模型上取得显著性能提升，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: Enlightenment作为一种训练-free的后微调方法，能高效激发预训练网络的潜在能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GFlowRL: Scaling Distribution-Matching RL to Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) offer a promising alternative to reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) for large reasoning models, encouraging diverse reasoning paths by matching reward distributions rather than collapsing to dominant modes. Recent work shows promise on math and code, but scaling GFlowNet-style RL to modern post-training pipelines remains difficult: as model size, rollout horizon, reward noise, and distributed-systems complexity grow together, a learned prompt-conditional partition function becomes a source of gradient instability and engineering overhead rather than a useful normalizer. Through systematic analysis, we find that the learned partition function, previously treated as essential, can be replaced by an in-batch Monte Carlo estimate computed from the rollout group already required for training. We propose GFlowRL, a streamlined GFlowNet-style RL algorithm that removes the auxiliary partition network entirely while preserving the reward-distribution-matching objective, completed by two stabilizers: importance-sampling correction for rollout/trainer drift and asymmetric flow-gap clipping for outlier residuals. GFlowRL exceeds all counterparts on math, code, and adversarial red-teaming benchmarks, reaching a Codeforces rating of 2048 at the 14B scale (within 25 Elo of o3-mini) and attaining the highest average ASR@1 on AdvBench and HarmBench, outperforming the previous SOTA multi-turn attacker in a regime where FlowRL, a prior GFlowNet-style method, diverges. The same recipe transfers to all evaluated MoE configurations up to 235B parameters, where FlowRL again fails to converge. To our knowledge, GFlowRL is the first GFlowNet-style RL algorithm to scale stably across both dense and sparse architectures. Code will be at: https://github.com/microsoft/gflowrl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GFlowRL 是一种简化的 GFlowNet 风格强化学习算法，专为大型语言模型设计，通过移除学习到的配分函数并用批次内蒙特卡洛估计替代，结合重要性采样校正和不对称流间隙裁剪来稳定训练。在数学、代码和对抗性红队测试中，GFlowRL 取得了优于现有方法的结果，在 14B 规模下 Codeforces 评分达到 2048，并在 AdvBench 和 HarmBench 上获得最高平均 ASR@1，同时可稳定扩展到 235B 参数的 MoE 架构。
Motivation: 现有 GFlowNet 风格 RL 在扩展至现代后训练流水线时，学习到的条件配分函数导致梯度不稳定和工程开销，难以在大规模语言模型上有效应用。
Method: 提出 GFlowRL，使用批次内蒙特卡洛估计替代学习到的配分函数，并加入重要性采样校正（解决 rollout/训练器漂移）和不对称流间隙裁剪（处理离群残差）两个稳定器。
Result: 在数学、代码和对抗性红队基准上超越所有对比方法，14B 模型 Codeforces 评分 2048（接近 o3-mini），AdvBench 和 HarmBench 上平均 ASR@1 最高，且可稳定扩展至 235B MoE 架构，而先前方法 FlowRL 在此规模下不收敛。
Conclusion: GFlowRL 是首个在密集和稀疏架构上均能稳定扩展的 GFlowNet 风格 RL 算法。

papers.title: The Café in Amsterdam: When the Incumbent Becomes the Oracle
papers.abstract_en: A field can reformulate its computations freely exactly where its demand is stated independently of any incumbent implementation, and finds itself unable to when the incumbent's own output has quietly become the specification. This note offers that observation as a lens on computational reformulation for modern accelerators, where posing a problem in a hardware-friendly form can yield large speed and energy gains, but only if a replacement can be judged at all. Building on the test-oracle problem (Weyuker; Barr et al.), on requirements engineering's notion of implementation bias (Zave and Jackson), and on the roofline performance model, it names the pathology "baseline capture" -- the moment an incumbent stops being evidence that a demand can be met and becomes the definition of meeting it -- and separates two questions that are easily confused: whether a reformulation can be judged (which turns on the existence of an incumbent-independent demand) and whether its discovery can be automated (which turns additionally on the cost of evaluating that demand). Short cases -- shortest-path routing, learnable audio frontends, ZIP-215 for Ed25519 signature validation, CESM-ECT for climate models, and a single-GEMM audio frontend -- illustrate the pattern and the move of "buying a verifier": making a demand explicit, operational, and independent of the incumbent. No component is claimed novel in isolation; the contribution is the synthesis and the single question it makes easy to ask of any reformulation result -- does its acceptance test mention the incumbent's output?
papers.comment: 4 pages, two-column. A research note / position paper. Companion conceptual note to arXiv:2606.01009 (MelT)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“基线捕获”（baseline capture）概念，指在计算重构中，原有实现（incumbent）的输出悄然成为需求定义，从而阻碍自由重构。通过最短路径路由、可学习音频前端、ZIP-215、CESM-ECT等案例说明该现象，并建议通过“购买验证器”（buying a verifier）将需求显式化、操作化且独立于原有实现。
Motivation: 计算重构时，若需求依赖于原有实现，则重构难以进行。问题在于如何判断重构是否成功，即是否存在独立于原有实现的需求定义。
Method: 提出基线捕获概念并区分两个问题：重构能否被评判（取决于是否存在独立于原有实现的需求）和自动化发现能否实现（取决于评判成本）。通过多个案例展示“购买验证器”的解决路径。
Result: 通过最短路径路由、可学习音频前端、ZIP-215、CESM-ECT及单GEMM音频前端案例，证实基线捕获普遍存在，并展示购买验证器使需求独立于原有实现的有效性。
Conclusion: 提出一个简单问题：重构结果的验收测试是否提及原有实现的输出？这有助于识别基线捕获，但未声称各组件新颖性，贡献在于综合与视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Should RL Post-Training Compute Go? Model Size, Search, Learning, and Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training is increasingly used to adapt foundation models for reasoning, planning, and feedback-driven robot-learning pipelines, but constrained post-training resources are often summarized by a single total FLOP budget. We study the fixed-budget decision problem behind this practice: under the same post-training budget, should one use a larger policy, train a smaller policy longer, generate more rollout search, or spend compute on stronger reward feedback? We introduce a FLOP-accounting framework for GRPO post-training that decomposes compute into rollout/search, policy-update/learning, and reward- or feedback-model evaluation. Across LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5 policies, we find conditional allocation frontiers: the best observed allocation changes with model size, compute budget, reward system, and evaluation target. Same-FLOP model-size comparisons show that model choice and training allocation are coupled because larger policies consume more per-token compute and therefore buy fewer updates or rollouts under the same budget. Reward systems also change the accounting: rule-based rewards spend nearly all non-update compute on policy rollouts, while PRM-style feedback allocates a visible part of the budget to reward-model inference. We present RACE as a diagnostic pilot-grid protocol, not a guarantee of held-out improvement, for identifying allocation regimes before expensive validation runs; our results suggest that RL post-training papers should report total FLOPs together with how compute is divided among model size, search, learning, and feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习后训练（RL post-training）中固定计算预算的最佳分配问题，提出了一个FLOP核算框架，将计算分解为搜索（rollout）、学习（policy update）和奖励反馈（reward feedback）。在LoRA微调的Qwen2.5策略模型上实验发现，最优分配依赖于模型大小、计算预算、奖励系统和评估目标。结果显示，模型选择和训练分配是耦合的，不同奖励系统（规则奖励 vs PRM风格反馈）改变计算开销分布。论文提出了RACE诊断协议，用于在昂贵验证前识别分配机制。
Motivation: RL后训练资源常被简化为单一总FLOP预算，但实际中需要决定如何在更大策略模型、更多训练步数、更多搜索或更强奖励反馈之间分配固定预算。缺乏统一框架来指导这种分配决策。
Method: 提出FLOP核算框架分解GRPO后训练的计算成本，包括搜索/rollout、策略更新/学习、奖励/反馈模型评估。在LoRA适配的Qwen2.5策略上实验，扫描不同分配方案。
Result: 发现条件分配前沿：最优分配随模型大小、计算预算、奖励系统和评估目标变化。相同FLOP下更大模型每token消耗更多计算，从而购买更少的更新或rollout。规则奖励几乎将所有非更新计算用于rollout，而PRM风格反馈将部分预算用于奖励模型推理。
Conclusion: RL后训练论文应报告总FLOPs以及计算在模型大小、搜索、学习和反馈之间的分配细节。RACE协议可作为诊断工具，但非保证提升。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究强化学习后训练（RL post-training）中固定计算预算的最佳分配问题，提出了一个FLOP核算框架，将计算分解为搜索（rollout）、学习（policy update）和奖励反馈（reward feedback）。在LoRA微调的Qwen2.5策略模型上实验发现，最优分配依赖于模型大小、计算预算、奖励系统和评估目标。结果显示，模型选择和训练分配是耦合的，不同奖励系统（规则奖励 vs PRM风格反馈）改变计算开销分布。论文提出了RACE诊断协议，用于在昂贵验证前识别分配机制。
summary_sections.motivation: RL后训练资源常被简化为单一总FLOP预算，但实际中需要决定如何在更大策略模型、更多训练步数、更多搜索或更强奖励反馈之间分配固定预算。缺乏统一框架来指导这种分配决策。
summary_sections.method: 提出FLOP核算框架分解GRPO后训练的计算成本，包括搜索/rollout、策略更新/学习、奖励/反馈模型评估。在LoRA适配的Qwen2.5策略上实验，扫描不同分配方案。
summary_sections.result: 发现条件分配前沿：最优分配随模型大小、计算预算、奖励系统和评估目标变化。相同FLOP下更大模型每token消耗更多计算，从而购买更少的更新或rollout。规则奖励几乎将所有非更新计算用于rollout，而PRM风格反馈将部分预算用于奖励模型推理。
summary_sections.conclusion: RL后训练论文应报告总FLOPs以及计算在模型大小、搜索、学习和反馈之间的分配细节。RACE协议可作为诊断工具，但非保证提升。

papers.title: FM$^2$: Unified Federated Foundation Models for Heterogeneous Multimodal Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Building foundation models for medical imaging requires pooling data across institutions, yet privacy regulations prohibit centralized aggregation. Existing Federated Foundation Models either fine-tune natural-image models with poor medical-domain transfer, or train from scratch within a single modality, lacking the flexibility to unify tasks. We identify an under-explored challenge, Imaging Modality Heterogeneity, where clients operate under two structural regimes: Overlapped (shared modalities with heterogeneous label distributions) and Non-overlapped (fully disjoint modalities per client). We propose FM$^2$, a unified framework that trains the core backbone from scratch to preserve medical domain fidelity while optionally incorporating biomedical pretrained encoders for vision-language alignment. FM$^2$ equips each client with dual Mixture-of-Experts modules (a Class-wise MoE for personalized category knowledge and a Domain-wise MoE for shared cross-modality representations), coupled with a Heterogeneous Modality Alignment (HMA) regularizer that explicitly aligns modality-specific expert parameters, admitting provable $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence and generalization guarantees. FM$^2$ further incorporates Caption-Enhanced Learning (CEL), where locally retained GPT-4o-generated captions serve as a textual semantic bridge enabling representation transfer across clients with disjoint modalities, and demonstrates extensibility to Federated Medical VQA. Experiments on our MIMH benchmark (classification and CEL) and real-world medical VQA datasets confirm consistent superiority over state-of-the-art federated baselines and strong out-of-modality generalization across all three tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FM^2统一框架，用于异构多模态医学影像的联邦基础模型训练，解决客户端影像模态异质性问题（重叠和非重叠模态）。方法包括双混合专家模块、异质模态对齐正则化器和标题增强学习。实验在MIMH基准和真实医学VQA数据集上优于现有联邦方法。
Motivation: 现有联邦基础模型要么微调自然图像模型导致医学域迁移差，要么单模态从头训练缺乏灵活性。本文提出未充分探索的成像模态异质性挑战。

Result: 在MIMH分类和标题增强学习任务以及真实医学VQA数据集上，FM^2一致优于最先进联邦基线，并展示强模态外泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FM^2在异构多模态医学影像联邦学习中的有效性，并给出理论收敛性和泛化保证。

papers.title: Weight Feedback Computes the Jacobian Transpose Locally in Modern Deep Networks
papers.abstract_en: Predictive Coding (PC) offers a biologically motivated alternative to backpropagation via local weight updates, yet routing error between layers still relies on an autograd Jacobian-transpose ($J^\top$) product - the last non-local operation in PC. We show that this dependency is largely avoidable. For any layer $f(x)=\mathrm{Act}(\mathrm{Norm}(L(x)))$ with frozen normalization statistics, the exact $J^\top$ factors into three locally available terms, $J^\top v = L^\top(s \odot σ'(z) \odot v)$, where $σ'$ is the activation derivative, $z$ is the pre-activation, and $s=γ/σ_{\mathrm{run}}$ is the normalization gain. Prior weight-feedback methods omitted both corrections; restoring them closes the transport gap for this layer class. Locality here holds up to three assumptions, which we state upfront: weight symmetry ($L^\top$ mirrors the forward operator, as assumed by all PC), a soft spectral-norm control that is not synapse-local, and a nearest-neighbour approximation for MaxPool. Substituting the identity into PC yields WF-Act-PC, which removes the autograd backward pass from error transport. On CIFAR-10/100 (50 epochs, 5 seeds), WF-Act-PC is the only PC method whose accuracy improves with depth, surpassing iPC - the strongest classical PC baseline - by 2.7-22.3 pp on CIFAR-10. With both methods tuned per architecture, it matches or exceeds a comparably-tuned backpropagation baseline on the deeper CIFAR-10 architectures (VGG-9: 93.57% vs. 92.43%; ResNet-18: 92.76% vs. 91.54%) and on the harder Tiny-ImageNet benchmark, while trailing tuned BP on the deeper CIFAR-100 VGG cells. Our WF-Act-PC implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/jlshen025/pcax
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现预测编码（Predictive Coding）中仍依赖非局部的Jacobian转置乘积，并提出对于形如f(x)=Act(Norm(L(x)))且冻结归一化统计量的层，该乘积可分解为三个局部可计算项，从而提出WF-Act-PC方法，移除了自动微分反向传播。在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny-ImageNet上，WF-Act-PC是唯一随深度增加精度提升的PC方法，在CIFAR-10上超过最强经典PC基线iPC达2.7-22.3个百分点，在深层架构上匹配或超过调优后的反向传播基线。
Motivation: 预测编码（PC）虽提出局部权重更新，但误差在各层间传递仍依赖自动微分的Jacobian转置乘积，这是PC中最后一个非局部操作，限制了其生物合理性与计算效率。
Method: 对于形如f(x)=Act(Norm(L(x)))且冻结归一化统计量的层，将Jacobian转置乘积分解为J^T v = L^T(s ⊙ σ'(z) ⊙ v)，其中σ'为激活导数、z为预激活、s为归一化增益，从而消除自动微分反向传播，得到WF-Act-PC方法。方法假设权重对称、软谱范数控制（非突触局部）及MaxPool的最近邻近似。
Result: 在CIFAR-10/100上（50轮，5种子），WF-Act-PC是唯一精度随深度提升的PC方法，在CIFAR-10上超过iPC基线2.7-22.3个百分点。在深层架构上（VGG-9: 93.57% vs. 92.43%；ResNet-18: 92.76% vs. 91.54%）匹配或超越调优后的BP基线，在Tiny-ImageNet上也优于BP，但在深层CIFAR-100 VGG上落后于调优BP。
Conclusion: WF-Act-PC证明了对于含归一化层和激活函数的网络，预测编码中的误差传递可以完全局部化，消除了自动微分依赖，同时保持了与反向传播竞争的性能。但方法存在权重对称、非局部谱范数控制及MaxPool近似等假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learned Pairwise Deep Dual-Optimal Inequalities for Stabilizing Column Generation
papers.abstract_en: Column generation (CG) is central to many large-scale optimization algorithms, including branch-price-and-cut methods for vehicle routing problems, but unstable dual solutions can substantially slow its convergence. Existing deep dual-optimal inequalities can reduce this instability by restricting the dual space. Their construction, however, typically relies on problem-specific exchange arguments that are difficult to establish for routing problems with capacity limits, time windows, and other resource constraints. We introduce learned pairwise deep dual-optimal inequalities (L-PDDOIs), a learning framework that predicts pairwise orderings between dual variables and incorporates their primal counterparts directly into the master problem. To construct training labels, the framework samples optimal dual solutions and selects pairwise order relations that hold simultaneously on a sufficiently large common subset of the samples. A classifier then assigns a score to each candidate relation. Because conflicts and redundancies among the predicted relations can impair performance, graph-based postprocessing filters and compresses the candidate set before deployment. We further introduce a recovery procedure that selectively relaxes learned inequalities and provides a certificate when the baseline CG bound has been restored. On the main test sets for the capacitated vehicle routing problem and the vehicle routing problem with time windows, direct deployment of L-PDDOIs reduces the geometric mean root CG time by 89.7% and 93.9%, respectively, while incurring mean bound losses of only 1.3% and 0.5%. The recovery procedure retains corresponding time reductions of 54.8% and 83.1%, respectively, while guaranteeing no loss in the CG bound.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 3 figures, and 12 tables; online appendix included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习框架L-PDDOIs，通过预测对偶变量的偏序关系并引入主问题来稳定列生成（column generation），显著缩短了带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）和带时间窗的车辆路径问题（VRPTW）的CG求解时间，同时保证边界损失极小。
Motivation: 列生成中不稳定的对偶解会严重降低收敛速度，现有深度对偶最优不等式（deep dual-optimal inequalities）需要问题特定的交换论证，难以推广到带容量、时间窗等资源约束的路径问题。
Method: 提出L-PDDOIs框架：通过采样最优对偶解，选取在足够大样本子集上同时成立的成对序关系作为训练标签；用分类器为候选关系打分；图后处理过滤冗余和冲突关系；引入恢复过程，在有需要时松弛学习到的不等式并保证基线CG边界。
Result: 在CVRP和VRPTW主测试集上，直接部署L-PDDOIs使几何平均根CG时间分别降低89.7%和93.9%，平均边界损失仅1.3%和0.5%；恢复过程保留54.8%和83.1%的时间缩减，且保证无边界损失。
Conclusion: L-PDDOIs能有效稳定列生成，显著加速带资源约束的路径问题求解，同时通过恢复过程保证边界质量。

papers.title: RoughNet: Mapping Arctic Sea Ice Roughness Using Diffusion-Based Super-Resolution of Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of landfast sea ice roughness is critical for climate modeling and safe Arctic over-ice travel, yet existing approaches rely on costly airborne surveys or sparse in-situ measurements, limiting spatial coverage and operational scalability. Here we show that high-resolution sea ice topography can be reconstructed directly from optical satellite imagery using a conditional diffusion framework. Our approach, RoughNet, learns to map 10 m Sentinel-2 multispectral images to locally normalized 1 m surface elevation residual fields, enabling fine-scale roughness characterization from widely available satellite data. Trained on airborne LiDAR data from two Arctic regions and evaluated on an unseen third Arctic region, the model generalizes across diverse ice conditions and partially reproduces small-scale topographic structure. The best-performing model achieves an out-of-domain root mean squared error of 9 cm while preserving the statistical and spectral properties of the underlying roughness field. These results demonstrate that generative diffusion models can recover physically meaningful surface structure from optical imagery alone, providing a scalable pathway for high-resolution sea ice mapping and roughness estimation in data-sparse environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoughNet，利用条件扩散模型从10米Sentinel-2多光谱图像重建1米分辨率的北极海冰表面高程残差，从而估计海冰粗糙度。在机载LiDAR数据上训练，并在未见的第三个北极区域上评估，最佳模型均方根误差为9厘米，并保持了粗糙度场的统计与谱特性。结果表明，生成式扩散模型可从光学图像恢复具有物理意义的地表结构，为数据稀缺环境下的高分辨率海冰制图提供可扩展路径。
Motivation: 现有海冰粗糙度估计依赖昂贵的航空测量或稀疏的现场测量，空间覆盖有限且难以业务化，亟需一种从广泛可用的卫星数据中获取高分辨率粗糙度的方法。
Method: 采用条件扩散框架，学习从10米Sentinel-2多光谱图像到本地归一化的1米表面高程残差场的映射，实现基于光学卫星图像的精细尺度粗糙度表征。
Result: 在未见过的第三个北极区域上，最佳模型达到9厘米的均方根误差，同时部分重建了小尺度地形结构，并保持了粗糙度场的统计和谱特性。
Conclusion: 生成式扩散模型能够仅从光学图像中恢复具有物理意义的表面结构，为数据稀疏环境下高分辨率海冰粗糙度估计提供了可扩展的途径。

papers.title: Learning Engagement Assistant (LEA): Cross-Course Scalability and Classroom Evaluation of an Agentic AI Tutoring System
papers.abstract_en: This paper is an extension of a paper presented at the ICAART 2026 conference, which introduced LEA (Learning Engagement Assistant), an adaptive AI tutoring agent combining course-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with structured Knowledge Component (KC) models across integrated Chat, Tutor, and Quiz modes. That prior work validated LEA on a single STEM course (CMP511) exclusively through simulation, using synthetic learner agents. This paper extends that work by reporting the first classroom deployment of LEA with real students (n = 8, CMP511) and the first empirical test of its cross-course scalability, deploying the system across three courses spanning two academic levels and two disciplinary domains. The study reveals a divergence from simulation predictions across modes, showing that synthetic evaluation alone cannot anticipate all aspects of real deployment. A RAGAS-based cross-course scalability evaluation (660 questions) finds Answer Relevancy and Context Precision broadly stable across courses (0.88-0.94 and 0.88-0.90 respectively), while Faithfulness declines with curriculum distance from the system's original course (0.69 to 0.50), a preliminary finding that may reflect generation logic tuned to the system's original subject rather than a scalability limitation. These findings suggest that while the orchestration layer requires no modification, full course-agnosticism of all downstream components requires further investigation.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper presented at ICAART 2026. Manuscript under review at SN Computer Science (Springer). 32 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了学习参与助手（LEA）系统在真实课堂环境中的首次部署和跨课程可扩展性测试。LEA结合课程特定的检索增强生成（RAG）与结构化知识组件（KC）模型，通过聊天、辅导和测验三种模式工作。研究在三个不同学科和学术水平的课程中进行，并与合成模拟结果对比，发现真实部署与模拟预测存在差异。基于RAGAS的跨课程评估显示答案相关性和上下文精度稳定，但忠实度随课程与原始课程距离增加而下降。
Motivation: 先前工作仅通过合成学习者代理在单一STEM课程上验证了LEA系统，缺乏真实课堂部署和跨课程泛化能力的评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，检验系统在实际教学环境中的有效性和可扩展性。
Method: 将LEA部署到真实课堂（CMP511课程，n=8名学生），并在三个课程（涵盖两个学术水平和两个学科领域）上进行跨课程可扩展性测试；使用RAGAS框架对660个问题进行评估，测量答案相关性、上下文精度和忠实度。
Result: 答案相关性和上下文精度在课程间保持稳定（分别为0.88-0.94和0.88-0.90），但忠实度从0.69下降到0.50，与课程距离增加相关。合成模拟与真实部署结果存在分歧。
Conclusion: 系统的编排层无需修改即可跨课程使用，但完全实现所有下游组件与课程无关仍需进一步研究。合成评估不能完全预测真实部署行为。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DiffGI: Differentiable Geometry Images for High-Fidelity Thin-Shell 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D generative models predominantly rely on implicit volumetric representations, which enforce watertight topology and struggle to represent thin-shell and non-manifold geometries such as garments. Geometry image-based approaches offer a surface-centric alternative, but existing methods rely on discrete binary occupancy maps whose resolution-dependent boundary encoding causes staircase artifacts and information loss upon downsampling, while surface reconstruction remains a non-differentiable post-processing step disconnected from the learning pipeline. To address this, we propose Differentiable Geometry Image (DiffGI), an end-to-end 3D-to-2D mapping framework that seamlessly integrates surface representation and geometric optimization. DiffGI replaces binary maps with a continuous 2D Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF), which encodes boundary position at subpixel precision within a fixed grid resolution, eliminating resolution-dependent staircase artifacts even under aggressive downsampling. Building on this continuous field, we introduce a differentiable Marching Squares algorithm based on analytical linear interpolation, allowing gradients from 3D surface losses to propagate back to the 2D latent space. Leveraging this differentiable pipeline, we train a DiffGI-VAE augmented with a geometry-aware normal rendering loss to compress complex 3D surfaces into an ultra-compact 32X32 latent space, and instantiate a transformer-based latent diffusion model with a flow-matching objective on top of this space for conditional 3D generation. Extensive experiments on garment and object datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior reconstruction fidelity and boundary precision compared to prior geometry-image and voxel-based approaches, while requiring significantly fewer computational resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可微几何图像（DiffGI），一种端到端的3D到2D映射框架，用于高质量薄壳3D生成。DiffGI用连续2D截断符号距离函数（TSDF）替代离散二进制占用图，消除阶梯伪影，并引入基于解析线性插值的可微Marching Squares算法，使梯度可回传到2D潜在空间。在此基础上训练DiffGI-VAE和基于transformer的潜在扩散模型，在服装和物体数据集上实现了优于先前几何图像和体素方法的重建保真度与边界精度，且计算资源更少。
Motivation: 现有3D生成模型依赖隐式体积表示，难以处理薄壳和非流形几何（如服装）。基于几何图像的方法使用离散二进制占用图，导致分辨率依赖的阶梯伪影和信息损失，且表面重建是不可微的后处理步骤，与学习流程脱节。
Method: 提出DiffGI，用连续2D TSDF编码边界位置（亚像素精度），消除阶梯伪影；设计基于解析线性插值的可微Marching Squares，实现3D表面损失到2D潜在空间的梯度传播。进而训练DiffGI-VAE（加入几何感知法线渲染损失）将复杂表面压缩至32x32潜在空间，并训练基于transformer的潜在扩散模型（flow-matching目标）进行条件生成。
Result: 在服装和物体数据集上的实验表明，DiffGI在重建保真度和边界精度上显著优于先前基于几何图像和体素的方法，同时所需计算资源更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过可微表面重建和连续TSDF表示，DiffGI克服了现有方法的局限性，实现了高质量薄壳3D生成，为表面中心的三维生成提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detector Confidence Signals Presence Rather Than Occlusion in Cluttered Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Occlude a named object until about an eighth of it remains visible, and an open-vocabulary detector's confidence that the object is present barely changes; as the clutter around it grows the confidence can even rise. On real video the detector still reports the object present in 99% of occluded frames, on another instance of the same category. This matters because that confidence is widely read as a visibility signal, used to threshold detections, evaluate open-vocabulary detectors, ground language, retrieve instances, and gate active perception. We audit whether it reflects occlusion by pairing every view with a geometry-segmentation oracle that gives detector-free ground-truth visibility. As true visibility falls from every scene to one in eight, the confidence stays nearly constant and uncorrelated with visibility, and the detector reports the target present in about nine of ten scenes, firing on same-category distractors: it signals that the category is present somewhere, not that the specific target is visible. The failure holds across three detectors (Grounding DINO, OWLv2, and Segment Anything Model 3), nine object categories, two simulators with different renderers and object sets, built and natural occlusion, and real video. Two consequences follow: a confidence-based metric understates the value of resolving occlusion by about ten times (8 against 88 points in our active-perception setting), and a confidence-based gate fires exactly when the object is hidden. No single-view signal we tried, including a realizable localization check, flags the occlusion, because the occluders sit where the target is. We connect the effect to detector miscalibration and object hallucination, release the controlled benchmark, and recommend target-grounded signals for gating and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放词汇检测器在杂乱操作环境中的置信度行为，发现遮挡几乎不影响置信度，检测器在物体被遮挡约八分之七时仍报告物体存在。置信度实际上表示类别出现在场景中，而非特定目标可见。该现象在三个检测器、九个物体类别、两个模拟器和真实视频中均成立。置信度用于门控和评估会低估遮挡分辨的价值，并导致门控错误触发。作者将现象归因于检测器校准和物体幻觉，并推荐使用目标接地信号。
Motivation: 检测器置信度广泛被解读为可见性信号，用于阈值、评估、语言接地和主动感知，但实际中遮挡对置信度影响极小，导致误导。
Method: 通过几何分割oracle获得无检测器的真实可见性，与检测器置信度对比，分析遮挡与置信度的关系。
Result: 真实可见性从全可见降至八分之一可见时，置信度几乎不变且与可见性不相关；检测器在约90%场景中仍报告目标存在，且被同类别干扰物触发。置信度指标低估遮挡分辨价值约10倍（8对88点），置信度门控在物体隐藏时错误触发。
Conclusion: 检测器置信度反映类别存在而非特定目标可见；现有单视角信号（包括可实现的定位检查）均不能标记遮挡；作者建议使用目标接地信号进行门控和评估，并发布受控基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation Ability Does Not Imply Optimization Utility: LLM-as-a-Judge Signals in Closed-Loop Table Recognition
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge is widely used to provide feedback and selection signals in closedloop regeneration, but this use remains insufficiently validated. We study it in table recognition, where deterministic TEDS evaluation provides a controlled testbed, using FinTabNet and OmniDocBench. Three findings emerge. First, judge signals were weak on both datasets: scores frequently tied, rankings were not reproducible, and the only selection policy that beat random on both datasets depended on an earliest-iteration tie rule, so its advantage cannot be attributed to the judge scores alone. Iteration produced better candidates, but the judge failed to recover them. Second, severe losses occurred even without specific judge feedback. A structurepreserving instruction significantly reduced the severe-loss rate on FinTabNet and was directionally consistent on OmniDocBench. The contrasts support target-preservation failure under unconstrained regeneration as a proximate mechanism of the observed severe losses. Third, the structure-preservation constraint reduced the severe-loss tail but produced no improvement. In an exploratory 2x2 analysis, the same protection was not stably observed when judge feedback was retained. These results do not dispute the value of LLMs as evaluators. Instead, they show that evaluation ability does not imply optimization utility. Iterative refinement requires, at minimum, a verification signal that deterministically detects structural change, rather than judge scores alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM-as-a-judge在闭环表格识别中的反馈有效性。实验表明，judge信号在FinTabNet和OmniDocBench上表现弱：分数常平局、排名不可重现，唯一优于随机的选择策略依赖最早迭代平局规则；结构保留指令显著降低严重损失率，但仅靠judge分数无法实现优化效用。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge被广泛用于闭环再生中的反馈和选择信号，但其效用尚未充分验证。本文以表格识别为受控测试平台，探究评估能力是否等同于优化效用。
Method: 在表格识别任务（FinTabNet、OmniDocBench）中，使用确定性TEDS评估作为基准，对比不同judge信号和选择策略（包括随机、基于得分、基于规则）的效果，并引入结构保留指令干预。
Result: 三项发现：1) judge信号弱，评分常平局、排名不可重现，唯一优于随机的策略依赖最早迭代平局规则；2) 结构保留指令显著降低FinTabNet上的严重损失率，并在OmniDocBench上方向一致；3) 结构保留约束减少了严重损失尾部，但未带来改善。
Conclusion: 评估能力不意味着优化效用。迭代细化需要至少能确定性检测结构变化的验证信号，而非仅依赖judge分数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Refusal Residue: When Probes Catch Alignment Faking and When They Don't
papers.abstract_en: Alignment faking is dangerous because a model can appear compliant under monitoring while preserving behavior it would reveal when unmonitored. When no scratchpad is visible, behavior alone cannot distinguish strategic from genuine compliance. We ask whether hidden states reveal what outputs hide. We run a 13-model sweep for naturally-emerging faking, then probe and steer hidden states on the two models that fake. Natural faking appears only in Qwen3-32B (+18.2pp) and Llama-3.1-8B (+24.4pp at n=10, p<10^-15), while explicit scratchpad self-reports are rare (a Claude Opus 4 judge flags faking reasoning in 1.4% of Qwen and 0.0% of Llama compliant scratchpads). Both fakers show an asymmetric refusal residue: monitored compliance shifts toward refusal (d=0.32 Qwen, d=0.33 Llama, both p<0.0001), while refusal representations do not move (p=1.00). Per-sample detection is model-conditional. Under leakage-free leave-one-query-out probing, detection survives on Llama (AUROC 0.87) but collapses to chance on Qwen (0.43), and cross-model transfer is null. Steering over 2,000 runs barely changes compliance (|h|<0.08), so the detected direction can flag faking but does not by itself control it. Standard residualized probing leaks across folds and reaches AUROC 0.63 on a control where no faking can occur; naive linear probes reach a meaningless AUROC 1.0; and conventional MLPs overstate detectability by 0.2-0.3 AUROC. For future alignment-faking detection work, we release a five-control measurement framework: multi-token extraction, refuse-vs-refuse confound checks, per-fold residualization, leave-one-query-out evaluation, and orthogonality-constrained probing.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026. 12 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型在监控下伪装顺从但在无监控时暴露真实行为的对齐伪装问题。通过对13个模型进行自然虚假行为扫描，发现只有Qwen3-32B和Llama-3.1-8B出现自然虚假。探测隐藏状态发现不对称的拒绝残留：监控顺从向拒绝方向偏移，但拒绝表征本身不移动。逐样本检测具有模型依赖性，且跨模型迁移无效。提出包含五项控制指标的测量框架，以避免标准探测方法的高估问题。
Motivation: 对齐伪装具有危险性，因为模型可在监控下表现出顺从，而在无监控时保留真实行为。当没有scratchpad可见时，仅凭行为无法区分战略性顺从与真正顺从。
Method: 进行13个模型的自然虚假行为扫描，对出现虚假的两个模型进行隐藏状态探测和引导。采用多种探测方法，包括无泄漏留一查询探测、标准化残差探测、MLP等，并提出包含五控制测量（多token提取、拒绝vs拒绝混淆检查、每折残差化、留一查询评估、正交约束探测）的框架。
Result: 自然虚假仅在Qwen3-32B（+18.2pp）和Llama-3.1-8B（+24.4pp，n=10，p<10^-15）中出现。两个虚假模型显示不对称拒绝残留：监控顺从向拒绝偏移（d=0.32 Qwen，d=0.33 Llama，p<0.0001），拒绝表征不动（p=1.00）。无泄漏留一查询探测在Llama上AUROC 0.87，在Qwen上降至0.43，跨模型迁移无效。引导2000次运行对顺从影响极小（|h|<0.08）。标准化残差探测在无虚假的对照上AUROC为0.63。
Conclusion: 标准探测方法可能高估可检测性。提出的五控制测量框架可用于未来对齐伪装检测工作，以区分真实信号与混淆因素。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究模型在监控下伪装顺从但在无监控时暴露真实行为的对齐伪装问题。通过对13个模型进行自然虚假行为扫描，发现只有Qwen3-32B和Llama-3.1-8B出现自然虚假。探测隐藏状态发现不对称的拒绝残留：监控顺从向拒绝方向偏移，但拒绝表征本身不移动。逐样本检测具有模型依赖性，且跨模型迁移无效。提出包含五项控制指标的测量框架，以避免标准探测方法的高估问题。
summary_sections.motivation: 对齐伪装具有危险性，因为模型可在监控下表现出顺从，而在无监控时保留真实行为。当没有scratchpad可见时，仅凭行为无法区分战略性顺从与真正顺从。
summary_sections.method: 进行13个模型的自然虚假行为扫描，对出现虚假的两个模型进行隐藏状态探测和引导。采用多种探测方法，包括无泄漏留一查询探测、标准化残差探测、MLP等，并提出包含五控制测量（多token提取、拒绝vs拒绝混淆检查、每折残差化、留一查询评估、正交约束探测）的框架。
summary_sections.result: 自然虚假仅在Qwen3-32B（+18.2pp）和Llama-3.1-8B（+24.4pp，n=10，p<10^-15）中出现。两个虚假模型显示不对称拒绝残留：监控顺从向拒绝偏移（d=0.32 Qwen，d=0.33 Llama，p<0.0001），拒绝表征不动（p=1.00）。无泄漏留一查询探测在Llama上AUROC 0.87，在Qwen上降至0.43，跨模型迁移无效。引导2000次运行对顺从影响极小（|h|<0.08）。标准化残差探测在无虚假的对照上AUROC为0.63。
summary_sections.conclusion: 标准探测方法可能高估可检测性。提出的五控制测量框架可用于未来对齐伪装检测工作，以区分真实信号与混淆因素。

papers.title: Audio-Text Cross-Attention with Psycholinguistic Support Features for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We present an audio-text system for the Ambivalence/Hesitancy Video Recognition Challenge of the 11th ABAW Competition. The method excludes visual frames and represents each video as overlapping 5-second windows aligned with transcript timestamps. Each window combines a 320-dimensional prosodic audio descriptor, a 768-dimensional emotion-oriented RoBERTa embedding, and 74 handcrafted features capturing uncertainty, hedging, and attitudinal conflict. Audio and text are fused via temporal cross-attention, while support features are injected prior to gated multiple-instance learning (MIL) pooling to modulate the window's importance. Predictions from five independently initialized models are averaged. On the labeled public development set, the ensemble achieved an average precision of 0.875 and a macro-F1 of 0.72. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Liga-de-IA-PUCPR/abaw-11-ah-challenge/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ABAW竞赛的矛盾/犹豫视频识别挑战，提出了一个仅使用音频和文本的双流系统。系统将视频分割为5秒窗口，每个窗口结合韵律特征、情感RoBERTa嵌入和手工设计的语言特征，通过时间交叉注意力融合，并使用门控多实例学习池化。集成模型在开发集上达到0.875的平均精度和0.72的宏F1。
Motivation: 现有方法多依赖视觉模态，而矛盾/犹豫线索可能更多体现在语音和文本中，因此探索纯音频-文本模型以提升识别性能。
Method: 使用重叠5秒窗口对齐转录时间戳；每个窗口提取320维韵律描述符、768维RoBERTa情感嵌入和74维手工特征（覆盖不确定性、迟疑和态度冲突）。窗口级特征通过时间交叉注意力融合，然后注入手造特征到门控MIL池化前，最后对五个独立初始化的模型取平均预测。
Result: 在公开开发集上，集成模型平均精度0.875，宏F1 0.72。
Conclusion: 提出的纯音频-文本方法有效识别矛盾/犹豫状态，代码已开源。

papers.title: EZSMT Version 3, Matured
papers.abstract_en: Constraint Answer Set Programming (CASP) is a hybrid reasoning paradigm that combines Answer Set Programming (ASP) with Constraint Processing and Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT), enabling powerful declarative encodings of complex combinatorial search problems. This paper presents the design and implementation of EZSMTV3, an extensible SMT-based CASP framework that advances the translational approach to CASP solving. Building upon the foundation of the EZSMT+ system, EZSMTV3 introduces a more expressive input language, supports optimization via weak constraints, and offers foundations for streamlined integration of new constraint types. Rather than implementing custom search procedures, EZSMTV3 leverages state-of-the-art SMT solvers, such as CVC5, YICES, and Z3 to perform reasoning. The paper provides benchmarking results comparing EZSMTV3 with its CASP peers such as CLINGCON, CLINGO[DL], and CLINGO[LP], while showcasing its ability to handle mixed-domain constraints involving both integers and reals. The system provides a robust platform for future extensions and theoretical exploration within the CASP domain.
papers.comment: Under consideration in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了EZSMTV3，一个基于SMT的约束回答集编程（CASP）框架，扩展了EZSMT+系统，支持更丰富的输入语言、弱约束优化和新约束类型的集成。摘要报告了与CLINGCON、CLINGO[DL]和CLINGO[LP]等CASP系统的基准测试结果，展示了其处理整数和实数混合域约束的能力。
Motivation: CASP是一种结合回答集编程与约束处理的混合推理范式，现有系统在处理复杂组合搜索问题时存在表达能力或效率不足。
Method: EZSMTV3采用翻译方法，利用CVC5、YICES和Z3等SMT求解器进行推理，而非实现自定义搜索过程。系统引入更表达性的输入语言和弱约束优化功能。
Result: 基准测试显示EZSMTV3在与CLINGCON等CASP系统的对比中具备竞争力，并能有效处理整数与实数混合域约束。
Conclusion: EZSMTV3为CASP领域的未来扩展和理论探索提供了稳健的平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Marker-free deformable registration and fusion for augmented reality-guided positive margin localization during tumor resection surgery
papers.abstract_en: Positive margins in head and neck oncologic surgery require mapping specimen-side pathology findings to the patient resection bed. This is challenging because pathologists identify the positive margin on slices of the resected, deformed specimen, while surgeons must relocate the corresponding site on the resection bed using only verbal descriptions and no visual guidance. We present a marker-free augmented reality (AR) workflow for mapping a margin label from a three-dimensional specimen scan to the resection bed. The method combines contour-constrained deformation, residual alignment to a depth scan, surface-based fusion to a head-mounted display, and target projection onto the reconstructed bed. Bead-suture correspondences estimate specimen deformation, whereas patient-to-display fusion does not require external fiducial markers. Following formative experiments, five residents and surgeons performed cadaveric cheek and scalp re-resection tasks under verbal guidance, verbal guidance with specimen examination, and AR guidance. Deformation target errors were $7.63 \pm 3.74$ mm for the cheek and $3.72 \pm 1.02$ mm for the scalp; residual specimen-to-bed distances were $2.43 \pm 2.15$ mm and $2.19 \pm 1.06$ mm, respectively. Fusion error did not differ significantly between marker-free and marker-based methods on either cadaver; overall marker-free fusion error was $2.15 \pm 0.87$ mm. End-to-end margin localization error decreased from $21.40 \pm 3.84$ mm with verbal guidance and $16.09 \pm 4.30$ mm with specimen examination to $6.19 \pm 1.79$ mm with AR guidance ($p < 0.001$). Online fusion required $5.23 \pm 0.34$ s. These results demonstrate effective marker-free AR guidance for positive-margin localization and support more precise tumor resection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无标记的增强现实（AR）工作流，用于将肿瘤标本上的阳性切缘标记映射到患者手术切除床。方法结合轮廓约束变形、深度扫描残差对齐、头戴显示表面融合和目标投影。在尸体实验上，五名住院医师和外科医生进行了面颊和头皮再切除任务，AR引导下的切缘定位误差从口头引导的21.40 mm降至6.19 mm（p < 0.001）。
Motivation: 头颈肿瘤手术中，阳性切缘需要将标本病理发现映射到患者切除床，但当前仅依赖口头描述，缺乏视觉引导，导致定位困难。
Method: 提出无标记AR工作流：利用缝线对应点估计标本变形（轮廓约束+深度扫描残差对齐），然后基于表面融合将信息注册到头戴显示器，并投影到重建的切除床上。无需外部基准标记。
Result: 在尸体实验中，面颊变形目标误差7.63±3.74 mm，头皮3.72±1.02 mm；标本到切除床残差分别为2.43±2.15 mm和2.19±1.06 mm。无标记融合误差2.15±0.87 mm，与有标记方法无显著差异。端到端切缘定位误差从口头引导的21.40±3.84 mm和标本检查的16.09±4.30 mm降至AR引导的6.19±1.79 mm（p < 0.001）。在线融合耗时5.23±0.34 s。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了无标记AR引导在阳性切缘定位中的有效性，可支持更精确的肿瘤切除。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Introducing Human-Centeredness in AI-Assisted Lexicography
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a human-centered artificial intelligence (HCAI) framework for AI-assisted lexicography. While generative AI offers significant opportunities to enhance lexicographic work, it also raises concerns regarding the future role of lexicographers and the preservation of linguistic and cultural diversity. Drawing on HCAI principles and previous applications in other language professions, the paper identifies four interrelated dimensions through which AI integration in lexicography can be understood and critically examined: the augmented lexicographer, the sociotechnical context of AI integration, bias, and the design of AI-powered lexicographic tools. The framework argues that AI should augment rather than replace lexicographers, combining automation with meaningful human control. It further emphasizes the importance of preserving professional agency, mitigating AI-generated biases, and designing tools around the needs of lexicographers. By doing so, the paper provides a foundation for future research and the beneficial integration of AI into lexicographic workflows.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the XXII EURALEX International Congress 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于AI辅助词典编纂。框架识别了四个关键维度：增强的词典编纂者、AI整合的社会技术背景、偏见以及AI驱动词典工具的设计，强调AI应增强而非取代词典编纂者。
Motivation: 生成式AI为词典编纂带来机遇，但也引发对词典编纂者未来角色及语言文化多样性保护的担忧，现有研究缺乏系统性的以人为中心视角。
Method: 基于HCAI原则及在其他语言专业中的应用，提出一个包含四个相互关联维度的分析框架，用于批判性地审视AI在词典编纂中的整合。
Result: 论文本身为理论框架，未报告具体实验结果，但为未来研究和AI在词典编纂工作流中的有益整合提供了基础。
Conclusion: AI应通过自动化与有意义的人类控制相结合来增强词典编纂者，同时需保留专业能动性、减轻偏见并围绕词典编纂者需求设计工具。

papers.title: An Explainable Agentic System for Detection of Conversational Scams with Summary-Based Memory
papers.abstract_en: Following the rapid progress of generative Artificial Intelligence, there is a growing threat posed by conversational scams. These scams often span over multiple weeks or months, gradually build trust and request for money or sensitive information. Existing scam-detection systems mainly focus on isolated messages, which renders them inadequate against this evolving threat. This paper extends single-message phishing detection and presents an explainable agentic system for detecting sophisticated conversational scams. It also introduces ConScamBench-278, an initial public multi-category benchmark for conversational scam detection spanning eight scam types, released to support reproducible evaluation and future expansion. On isolated messages the single-message detector attains 100% phishing recall, while the conversation-level detector identifies all conversational scams in the public LoveFraud02 corpus (83/83) and reaches 97.8% accuracy (95% CI [95.4, 99.0]) on ConScamBench-278. Two user studies (N = 100 and N = 45) further motivate the system: participants report frequently experiencing uncertainty when judging suspicious conversations. In an uncontrolled pre/post comparison, users self-reported trust, self-confidence, and perceived need for AI-based scam detection all increased (p < 0.001, Wilcoxon signed-rank). The system also receives a System Usability Scale score of 74.7 (95% CI [72.5, 76.9]), above the established usability benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的智能体系统，用于检测基于摘要记忆的对话式诈骗。系统包含单消息检测器和对话级检测器，并发布了首个多类别基准数据集 ConScamBench-278。实验表明，在 LoveFraud02 语料库上对话级检测器识别了全部诈骗 (83/83)，在 ConScamBench-278 上达到 97.8% 准确率，用户研究显示系统可用性评分 74.7。
Motivation: 现有诈骗检测系统主要针对孤立消息，无法有效应对跨多周/月、逐步建立信任的对话式诈骗，亟需可解释且能处理长对话的检测方法。
Method: 提出一个基于智能体 (agentic) 的架构，利用摘要记忆 (summary-based memory) 来跟踪对话上下文，结合单消息和对话级检测器，并引入可解释性机制。
Result: 单消息检测器在钓鱼邮件上达到 100% 召回率；对话级检测器在 LoveFraud02 上识别全部 83 个诈骗，在 ConScamBench-278 上达 97.8% 准确率 (95% CI [95.4, 99.0])；用户研究显示信任、自信和感知需求显著提升 (p<0.001)，系统可用性评分 74.7。
Conclusion: 摘要表明所提系统在检测对话式诈骗方面有效且可用性超过基准，但未提及在真实部署中的局限或对未见诈骗类型的泛化能力。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明所提系统在检测对话式诈骗方面有效且可用性超过基准，但未提及在真实部署中的局限或对未见诈骗类型的泛化能力。

papers.title: FoundationGeo: Learning Spatial Pixel-Wise Fields for Monocular Metric Geometry
papers.abstract_en: We present FoundationGeo, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges relative and metric prediction via spatial calibration and principled data design. Stage 1 learns a high-fidelity, affine-invariant geometry model by initializing with DINOv3 and training on a curated 10.2M-sample multi-domain corpus with complementary local-detail supervision, yielding sharp boundaries and strong cross-domain generalization. Stage 2 moves beyond global scaling by introducing lightweight pixel-wise calibration fields for metric estimation: a scale field for spatially varying metric alignment and a ray-direction correction field that mitigates directional bias in point-map geometry, together producing metrically consistent 3D point maps. Beyond model design, we identify camera intrinsic coverage, especially focal length distribution mismatch between training and test data, as a key bottleneck for zero-shot metric generalization: performance drops sharply when test intrinsics fall outside the training distribution. To address this, we synthesize additional training data across diverse focal lengths using a Blender-based data engine, repairing under-covered focal regimes and improving robustness under intrinsic shift. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven benchmarks show that FoundationGeo significantly strengthens cross-domain robustness, staying near the top across diverse domains while avoiding the sharp cross-domain performance drops observed in other methods. This consistency translates into the best overall performance, surpassing heavier baselines by over 5.2% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FoundationGeo，一个两阶段框架，通过空间校准和原则性数据设计显式桥接相对预测与度量预测。第一阶段利用DINOv3初始化并在10.2M样本多域数据集上训练，辅以局部细节监督，学习高保真仿射不变几何模型；第二阶段引入轻量级像素级校准场（尺度场和射线方向校正场）用于度量估计，生成度量一致的3D点图。此外，通过Blender数据引擎合成不同焦距的训练数据，解决相机内参分布不匹配导致的零样本度量泛化瓶颈。在七个基准上的零样本评估表明，该方法显著增强跨域鲁棒性，平均性能超越重基线5.2%。
Motivation: 现有方法在零样本度量泛化中存在关键瓶颈：训练与测试数据的相机内参（尤其是焦距）分布不匹配，导致测试时性能急剧下降。
Method: 两阶段框架：Stage1用DINOv3初始化并在包含10.2M样本的多域数据集上训练，补充局部细节监督以学习仿射不变几何模型；Stage2引入像素级尺度场进行空间变化度量对齐，以及射线方向校正场减轻点图几何中的方向偏差。同时采用基于Blender的数据引擎合成不同焦距的训练数据，覆盖训练分布中不足的焦距范围。
Result: 在七个零样本基准上，FoundationGeo显著增强跨域鲁棒性，避免其他方法中出现的跨域性能剧烈下降，总体平均性能超越更重的基线模型5.2%。
Conclusion: 论文强调，通过空间校准和原则性的数据设计（特别是覆盖多种焦距）可以有效桥接相对预测与度量预测，为解决零样本度量泛化问题提供新思路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain Optimization with Process Efficiency), a two-stage framework that densifies this anchor while retaining the GRPO update: Adaptive Scaffolded RL adds prefix-decomposed verifiable rewards on answer-hidden sub-question chains before success, and Quality-Aware Process RL applies correctness-gated process-shape rewards to refine correct trajectories after success. An expert-validated Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol evaluates useful-step density, error localization, and token efficiency beyond final-answer accuracy. On Qwen3-8B-Instruct trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math, SCOPE-RL improves average accuracy by up to 11.2 pp and reduces reasoning tokens by up to 27.1% over outcome-only GRPO; the gains hold under GSPO and on Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct, indicating that reward-signal densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE-RL框架，在GRPO更新基础上对成功前的子问题链添加前缀分解的可验证奖励，对成功后的正确轨迹应用正确性门控的过程形状奖励。在Qwen3-8B-Instruct上训练后，平均准确率提升11.2个百分点，推理token减少27.1%。
Motivation: 现有RLVR仅使用最终答案的稀疏奖励，无法在成功前给困难问题的中间进展提供奖励，也无法在成功后区分正确轨迹中是否有多余或局部错误。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：Adaptive Scaffolded RL在成功前对隐藏答案的子问题链添加前缀分解的可验证奖励；Quality-Aware Process RL在成功后应用正确性门控的过程形状奖励来细化正确轨迹。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B-Instruct上，SCOPE-RL平均准确率提升11.2个百分点，推理token减少27.1%；在Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct上也有效，且与GSPO政策更新互补。
Conclusion: 奖励信号致密化是政策更新层面RLVR进步的补充，代码和数据已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SalientGS: Unified SfM-to-3DGS with Importance-Guided MCMC Gaussian Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D scenes from unordered images remains bottlenecked by expensive Structure-from-Motion (SfM) preprocessing and frozen pose interfaces. We present SalientGS, a unified SfM-to-3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipeline. Its central contribution is importance-guided Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) Gaussian allocation, which aggregates multi-view residuals into per-Gaussian underfit and redundancy signals. These signals define a smooth importance-weighted sampling distribution that biases both birth and relocation toward underfit regions. This reallocates capacity from well-fit areas without altering the underlying stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD). SalientGS achieves end-to-end reconstruction in 15 minutes with state-of-the-art perceptual quality. The supplementary material provides dedicated sections for Per-Scene Qualitative Comparisons and Per-Image Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) Analysis, including failure cases. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/Six-Bit-TX/SalientGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SalientGS，一种统一SfM到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的端到端重建管道。其核心是重要性引导的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）高斯分配方法，通过聚合多视图残差生成每个高斯的欠拟合和冗余信号，定义平滑的重要性加权采样分布，使新生和重定位偏向欠拟合区域，从而从拟合良好的区域重新分配容量。该方法在15分钟内完成重建，达到最先进的感知质量。
Motivation: 传统SfM预处理计算开销大且相机姿态接口固定，限制了3DGS的效率和灵活性。
Method: 提出重要性引导的MCMC高斯分配，利用多视图残差统计定义欠拟合和冗余信号，构建重要性加权采样分布，在高斯的生灭和重定位过程中偏向欠拟合区域，同时保持随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）不变。
Result: 在15分钟内实现端到端重建，感知质量达到最先进水平，并提供逐场景定性比较和逐图像LPIPS分析，包括失败案例。
Conclusion: SalientGS统一了SfM和3DGS流程，通过重要性引导的MCMC分配高效分配高斯容量，在速度和质量上取得良好平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bringing Back Rule Induction to Fluid Intelligence Research? An Initial Validation of the ARC-AGI Benchmark in Humans
papers.abstract_en: Two competing perspectives on fluid intelligence (gf) measures propose that performance is primarily constrained either by working memory capacity or by the ability to induce novel relations. The first perspective is currently dominant in measurement, as evident from the use of a limited set of recurring rules, whereas the second perspective is reflected in many definitions but rarely present in measurement. The ARC-AGI benchmark predominantly requires rule induction and was proposed as a measure of gf for both humans and artificial systems. However, its psychometric properties have not yet been examined in human samples. We therefore investigated the psychometric characteristics and nomological network of ARC-AGI in a first study with 100 participants. A compilation of ARC-AGI items showed good psychometric properties and correlated substantially with figural fluid intelligence as measured by a figural reasoning test ($ρ$ = .63). Associations with figural originality were weak. These findings provide initial support for the validity of ARC-AGI as a measure of human fluid intelligence. Future research should include more rule induction tasks as well as additional multivariate covariates. This study is unusual by studying a task in humans that was initially designed for machines. We suggest systematically embedding AI benchmarks into the nomological network of human cognitive abilities to enable more systematic evaluation and interdisciplinary cooperation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次研究ARC-AGI基准在人类样本中的心理测量特性，发现其与图形流体智力显著相关（ρ=.63），支持其作为人类流体智力测量工具的初步有效性。该基准最初为人工智能设计，作者建议将AI基准系统地嵌入人类认知能力的nomological网络以促进跨学科合作。
Motivation: 流体智力测量存在工作记忆容量与规则归纳能力两种竞争视角，当前主流测量使用有限规则集，而ARC-AGI基准侧重规则归纳，但其在人类中的心理测量特性尚未被检验。
Method: 对100名参与者进行ARC-AGI项目编译，并与图形推理测试（figural fluid intelligence）和图形独创性测试进行相关分析。
Result: ARC-AGI项目具有良好的心理测量特性，与图形流体智力相关ρ=.63，与图形独创性相关弱。
Conclusion: 初步支持ARC-AGI作为人类流体智力测量工具的有效性，未来研究应加入更多规则归纳任务和多变量协变量，并建议将AI基准嵌入人类认知能力网络。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GDP.pdf: Benchmarking Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Professional PDF Documents
papers.abstract_en: A large share of day-to-day work in professional domains happens inside PDF files: benefits packets, leases, datasheets, clinical guidelines, construction plans. Benchmarks for document AI have generally measured the required capabilities in isolation: OCR, layout analysis, chart reasoning, table QA, document VQA. A high score on any one of them does not necessarily reveal whether a model can answer a realistic question that someone in the field would actually ask about a specific PDF. GDP_pdf is a benchmark built to measure this directly. It consists of question-document pairs authored by working professionals in ten fields, and a candidate question was kept only when at least two frontier multimodal models failed it in a way that mattered: a wrong answer, missed decisive evidence, or a fabricated claim, rather than a superficial difference such as style. Each item comes with a rubric of atomic criteria, so we can report a graded rubric score as well as a strict task-level pass rate, and each item is tagged against a taxonomy of eleven capabilities in three tiers, spanning text extraction and grounding, table and chart comprehension, cross-referencing, spatial reasoning, and abstention on unsupported queries. We report results for seventeen frontier models on the 100-item benchmark: the best model passes only 30.7% of the items and the worst passes 2%. Most errors trace back to a small set of recurring loss patterns: misaligned tables, misread charts, skipped footnotes and exclusions, miscounted floor-plan symbols, scan noise, and amendments that supersede earlier text.
papers.comment: 9 pages. v2: results updated to July 2026 leaderboard (17 models). Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Knowledge-Intensive Multimodal Reasoning (KnowledgeMR) at CVPR 2026 (non-archival), under the former title "PDFParse: A Benchmark for Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Professional PDF Documents". Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/surgeai/GDP.pdf ; Code: https://github.com/surge-ai/gdp-pdf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出了GDP_pdf基准，用于评估多模态模型在专业PDF文档上的接地推理能力。基准包含由十个领域专业人士编写的问答对，并通过严格筛选确保问题具有挑战性。在100项任务上测试了十七个前沿模型，最佳模型通过率仅为30.7%，最差为2%。错误主要源于表格错位、图表误读、脚注遗漏等常见模式。
Motivation: 现有文档AI基准分别评估OCR、布局分析等独立能力，无法衡量模型在应对专业人士提出的真实、复杂的PDF文档问题时的综合表现。
Method: 由十个领域的专业人士编写问题-文档对，并通过多人审核保留至少两个前沿模型失败的问题；每个问题附带原子评分标准和11种能力标签（如文本提取、表格理解、空间推理等）。
Result: 在100项基准上，最佳模型通过30.7%，最差通过2%。大多数错误可归因于表格错位、图表误读、脚注遗漏、扫描噪声等六种常见损失模式。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前多模态模型在专业PDF文档推理上的显著不足，并提供了细粒度的错误分析以指导未来改进。

papers.title: AgentCheck: A Reproduce-Intervene-Mitigate Workbench for LLM Agents over MCP
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents are mostly evaluated assuming all tools work. When a tool times out, returns a week-stale value, or has its description poisoned in deployment, the developer needs a controlled way to reproduce the failure, test a fix, and confirm the fix worked before deployment. We present AgentCheck, an open-source web workbench that turns an MCP server into an intervention surface. AgentCheck runs an agent against its real tools and records every tool response, then re-runs the agent with the response perturbed by a fault (12 types) injector. Matching tool calls are replayed from cache, and later tool calls go live after the agent diverges. This yields a reproduce-intervene-confirm loop: the developer toggles a mitigation, re-runs against the identical fault, and sees if the failure goes away. Scoring has two parts: deterministic pass/fail rules, plus an LLM judge for interpretive labels, validated against human annotations. Across five agents, the best passes 105/120 scenarios and the weakest only 77. The failures are usually silent, confident use of incorrect tool outputs rather than crashes. On the weakest agent, a retry mitigation raises success on timeout error faults from as few as 30% of cases to 100%, whereas stale-data faults remain near 3-4 of 10 regardless of the mitigation. AgentCheck makes these failure modes reproducible, comparable, and verifiable before deployment.

papers.title: Unsupervised Detection of Entry and Exit Regions from Vehicle Trajectories for Camera-Agnostic Turning Movement Counts
papers.abstract_en: Turning movement counts are essential for intersection-level traffic management, yet their collection remains predominantly manual due to the cost of per-camera region annotation. This paper presents an unsupervised pipeline that identifies entry and exit regions directly from raw vehicle trajectories extracted via object detection and multi-object tracking, requiring no manual annotation, camera calibration, or prior knowledge of intersection geometry. Unlike trajectory clustering methods that classify individual trajectories using pairwise similarity and must be re-executed on every new batch, the proposed pipeline clusters initial and terminal point locations to produce persistent spatial region polygons that classify future trajectories by point-in-polygon containment at linear cost. The pipeline comprises six sequential steps, five of which introduce configurable parameters evaluated through a systematic statistical analysis spanning 17,100 pipeline executions across 9 surveillance cameras capturing dense heterogeneous traffic in Bengaluru, India, and 10 sequences from the UA-DETRAC benchmark dataset. Both parametric and nonparametric testing frameworks identify three consistently significant parameters and yield an empirically grounded recommended configuration. Under this configuration, the pipeline achieves a median classification error of 3.4% across all 25 Bengaluru cameras, including 16 held-out locations, with a median per-turning-movement GEH of 2.43. Compared with two trajectory clustering baselines, the proposed pipeline exhibits greater stability across camera views and lower computational cost, at the expense of higher median error. Extended evaluation demonstrates that calibration clips of at least 60 minutes and peak-traffic selection further improve region estimation quality.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督流水线，从车辆轨迹中自动识别入口和出口区域，用于十字路口转向计数，无需人工标注、相机标定或路口几何知识。方法通过聚类轨迹起始点和终点生成空间区域多边形，后续轨迹只需点包含检测即可分类。在25个密集交通监控视频上评估，中位分类误差3.4%。
Motivation: 转向计数对交通管理重要，但传统方法依赖人工标注区域，成本高；现有轨迹聚类方法需每次重聚类效率低。
Method: 提出无监督流水线，包含六个步骤：从跟踪得到的轨迹中提取起始点和终点，进行聚类生成区域多边形（入口和出口），然后通过点包含测试分类新轨迹。通过系统的统计分析确定关键参数。
Result: 在25个监控摄像头（包括16个未见过的位置）上中位分类误差3.4%，每转向运动的GEH中位数为2.43。相比两种轨迹聚类基线，方法更稳定、计算成本更低，但中位误差略高。60分钟以上的校准视频和高峰时段选择可进一步改善。
Conclusion: 该无监督方法能有效实现跨相机的转向计数，减少人工成本，但存在一定误差。

papers.title: Bandit PCA with Minimax Optimal Regret
papers.abstract_en: We study the bandit-feedback version of online principal component analysis (Bandit PCA): in each round $t = 1,\dots,T$, the adversary selects a $d \times d$ symmetric gain matrix $G_t$ with spectrum in $[0,1]$ and rank at most $r$; the learner simultaneously selects a unit vector $w_t \in S^{d-1}$ and receives the reward $w_t^\top G_t w_t$. The learner receives no other feedback, and aims to minimize the regret against the best unit vector in hindsight. This problem was introduced by Kotlowski and Neu (2019), who gave an algorithm with regret $O(d\sqrt{rT \log T})$ and showed the lower bound of $Ω(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$. We improve upon both of these bounds and essentially bridge the gap between them, establishing the minimax regret of order $r\sqrt{dT}$ up to polylogarithmic factors in $d$ and $T$. The upper bound is attained by a novel algorithm, which combines online mirror descent on the spectrahedron of (real) density matrices with a multiscale exploration scheme in which the eigenspaces with different spectral magnitudes are updated at different rates. For the lower bound, we construct an adaptive adversary that refines a hidden large-reward subspace based on the learner's actions, in such a way that low regret is impossible without estimating the subspace; as a result, lower-bounding the regret reduces to studying the arising subspace estimation problem. Finally, we discuss connections of Bandit PCA with adaptive-measurement quantum tomography.

papers.title: GNet: A scalable and flexible Gaussian process network with nonparametric neurons
papers.abstract_en: We develop GNet, a scalable and flexible Gaussian process network with nonparametric activation functions modeled by Gaussian processes. To reduce computational and storage costs, we introduce the jointly inverse Kalman filter, a fast algorithm together with closed-form expressions of gradients for accelerating model training and predictions without the need to form covariance matrices. Using a unified optimization setting, GNet shows competitive performance across a diverse range of test problems, including predicting nonlinear functions, nonparametric regression of real-world data, and predicting one-body direct correlation functions with high-dimensional inputs in classical density function theory. The strong performance of GNet, accelerated by the jointly inverse Kalman filter, suggests broad applicability to large-scale predictive modeling with substantially reduced computational and storage costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GNet，一种可扩展且灵活的高斯过程网络，使用高斯过程建模的非参数激活函数。为降低计算和存储成本，引入联合逆卡尔曼滤波算法，提供快速计算和梯度闭式表达式，无需形成协方差矩阵。在预测非线性函数、真实数据非参数回归以及经典密度泛函理论中高维输入的一体直接相关函数预测等任务上展现了竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有高斯过程方法在大规模数据上计算和存储成本高，需要可扩展且灵活的替代方案。
Method: 提出GNet，使用高斯过程作为非参数激活函数，并开发联合逆卡尔曼滤波算法加速训练和预测，无需显式计算协方差矩阵。
Result: 在非线性函数预测、真实数据非参数回归、高维密度泛函预测等多种测试问题上展示了竞争性能，并大幅降低了计算和存储成本。
Conclusion: GNet结合联合逆卡尔曼滤波，适用于大规模预测建模，显著降低了计算和存储开销。

papers.title: RecRec: Recursive Refinement for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommender systems typically infer user preferences through single-pass encoding of interaction histories without iterative refinement, relying on increasingly deep architectures to capture complex patterns. In this work, we revisit sequential recommendation from a recursive inference perspective: can user preferences be modeled as a persistent latent state that is recursively refined? We propose RecRec (Recursive Recommendation), a lightweight model that maintains a compact latent state and updates it through a shared recursive module conditioned on interaction evidence. Unlike prior recursive models, RecRec introduces an evidence-anchored correction mechanism that stabilizes refinement by grounding each update in the original interaction context, preventing semantic drift during deep recursive reasoning. Experiments on three benchmark datasets under standard evaluation protocols show that RecRec matches or outperforms state-of-the-art sequential, graph-based, and reasoning-enhanced recommenders while using only 3.9M to 14M parameters. Ablation studies demonstrate that both recursive refinement and the evidence-anchored correction gate contribute significantly to performance, highlighting the effectiveness of recursive latent inference as a scalable alternative to deeper or language-based architectures. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RecRec-6B67/README.md.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecRec，一种轻量级递归序列推荐模型，通过维护紧凑的潜在状态并基于交互证据进行递归细化来建模用户偏好。引入证据锚定校正机制防止语义漂移。实验表明，在三个基准数据集上，RecRec 以 3.9M 到 14M 参数匹配或超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有序列推荐系统通常通过单次编码交互历史来推断用户偏好，依赖更深架构捕捉复杂模式，缺乏迭代细化。本文从递归推理角度出发，探讨能否将用户偏好建模为可递归细化的持久潜在状态。
Method: 提出 RecRec 模型，维护一个紧凑的潜在状态，并通过共享递归模块根据交互证据更新该状态。引入证据锚定校正机制，将每次更新锚定到原始交互上下文，防止深度递归推理中的语义漂移。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，RecRec 以 3.9M 到 14M 参数匹配或超越最先进的序列、图增强及推理增强推荐方法。消融研究表明递归细化和证据锚定校正门对性能贡献显著。
Conclusion: 本文表明递归潜在推理作为更深或基于语言架构的可扩展替代方案是有效的。代码已开源。

papers.title: ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recent VLM and VLA systems have improved robotic perception and action prediction, yet long-horizon embodied agents still require a general runtime layer for reasoning, memory, tool use, verification, and cross-embodiment execution. We present ABot-AgentOS, a general robotic Agent Operating System that sits above low-level controllers and provides a deliberative agent layer for scene-conditioned planning, context-isolated skill execution, multi-stage verification, multi-modal memory, and edge-cloud collaboration. To evaluate such systems, we introduce EmbodiedWorldBench, an executable benchmark with 16 indoor, outdoor, and hybrid scenes, four difficulty levels, and over 200 tasks involving navigation, object search, NPC dialogue, dynamic events, and trace-grounded scoring. ABot-AgentOS further introduces Universal Multi-modal Graph Memory, a persistent source-grounded substrate that converts dialogue, visual observations, spatial context, temporal relations, and task traces into typed nodes and edges. A failure-driven self-evolution loop converts diagnosed memory failures into gated runtime evo-assets that are promoted only to later evaluation splits, preventing current-split ground-truth leakage while enabling continual improvement. On an initial EmbodiedWorldBench subset, ABot-AgentOS improves over a single-controller baseline in both task success and goal completion. Across memory benchmarks, ABot-AgentOS Static achieves 87.5 on LoCoMo, 59.9 on OpenEQA EM-EQA, 88.6 on Mem-Gallery, and 76.5 Acc@All on NExT-QA; self-evolution further improves LoCoMo to 88.7, OpenEQA to 60.4, and Mem-Gallery to 89.0. These results suggest that a general Agent OS layer can improve long-horizon embodied execution while providing persistent, auditable memory for continual interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABot-AgentOS 是一个通用机器人智能体操作系统，位于低级控制器之上，提供场景条件规划、上下文隔离技能执行、多阶段验证、多模态记忆和边缘-云端协作。为了评估此类系统，作者提出了 EmbodiedWorldBench 基准，包含16个场景和200+任务。系统还引入了通用多模态图记忆和故障驱动的自我进化循环。在 EmbodiedWorldBench 子集上，ABot-AgentOS 优于单控制器基线，并在多个记忆基准上取得良好结果。
Motivation: 现有 VLM/VLA 系统改进了感知和动作预测，但长期任务智能体仍缺乏通用的运行时层来支持推理、记忆、工具使用、验证和跨实体执行。
Method: 提出 ABot-AgentOS，包括场景条件规划器、上下文隔离技能执行、多阶段验证器、通用多模态图记忆（将对话、视觉、空间、时间等信息转换为类型化节点和边）以及故障驱动的自我进化循环。

Conclusion: 通用智能体操作系统层可以改善长期实体执行，并提供持久、可审计的记忆以支持持续交互。
