papers.title: AvAtar: Learning to Align via Active Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Alignment plays a fundamental role in many machine learning problems, such as multi-network analysis, multimodal learning, and point cloud registration. Recent works increasingly leverage optimal transport (OT) for distributional alignment, whose effectiveness largely depends on sparse supervision that is hard or costly to obtain in practice. Existing works, however, largely overlook how to actively acquire high-quality supervision to improve their alignment performance under OT frameworks. In this paper, we propose a principled active alignment framework for optimal transport alignment called AvAtar. We quantify the informativeness of a candidate by measuring its gradient-based impact on the global alignment result, computed as the gradient propagation from the global alignment result to all possible supervisions of the candidate through the entropy-regularized OT formulation. While differentiating through OT is challenging given its constrained nature, we leverage the adjoint-state method to reformulate the computation to a linear system solvable by the conjugate gradient method with linear complexity and guaranteed convergence. By encoding the global alignment result via effective utility functions, AvAtar is applicable to general alignment problems under the OT framework. Extensive experiments on three representative alignment tasks demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and generalizability of the proposed AvAtar.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AvAtar，一种基于主动最优传输的对齐框架，通过测量候选样本的梯度影响（从全局对齐结果传播到熵正则化OT中的监督）来量化信息性，并利用伴随状态法和共轭梯度法高效求解。在三个代表性对齐任务上验证了有效性、可扩展性和泛化性。

Result: 在多网络分析、多模态学习和点云配准三个任务上验证了方法有效性，表明其可扩展性和泛化性。

papers.title: Vision Transformers and Convolutional Neural Networks for Land Use Scene Classification
papers.abstract_en: Land Use Scene Classification (LUSC) from remote sensing imagery plays a critical role in environmental monitoring, urban planning, and sustainable resource management. In recent years, deep learning methods have significantly advanced the state of the art, with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) dominating the field because of their strong ability to capture local spatial features. However, the emergence of Vision Transformers (ViTs) has introduced a new paradigm that models long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms, potentially enabling improved global context understanding. This paper presents a comparative assessment of Vision Transformers and CNN-based architecture for remote sensing land use scene classification. Representative CNN models, such as AlexNet, is evaluated alongside the Vision Transformer (ViT) using benchmark remote sensing datasets, including the UC Merced Land Use and EuroSAT Land Use datasets. The study examines classification accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and computational complexity to provide a comprehensive performance comparison. Experimental results demonstrate that CNNs perform robustly on datasets with limited training samples and strong local texture characteristics, whereas Vision Transformers exhibit superior performance in capturing global spatial relationships in complex scenes when sufficient training data are available. However, ViTs typically require greater computational resources and larger training datasets to achieve optimal performance. The findings of this study provide insights into the strengths and limitations of both architectures and offer guidance for selecting appropriate models for remote sensing land use scene classification applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了 Vision Transformer (ViT) 与 CNN（如 AlexNet）在遥感土地利用场景分类中的性能，使用 UC Merced 和 EuroSAT 数据集评估准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数和计算复杂度。结果表明，CNN 在样本少、局部纹理强的数据集上表现稳健，而 ViT 在有足够训练数据时能更好地捕捉全局空间关系，但需要更多计算资源。
Motivation: 现有土地利用场景分类主要依赖 CNN，但 ViT 通过自注意力机制能建模长距离依赖，可能提升全局上下文理解，需要系统比较两种架构在该任务上的优劣。
Method: 选取代表性 CNN（AlexNet）与 Vision Transformer (ViT) 在 UC Merced Land Use 和 EuroSAT Land Use 基准数据集上进行分类精度、召回率、F1 分数及计算复杂度的综合比较。
Result: 实验表明，CNN 在训练样本有限、局部纹理特征突出的数据集上表现稳健；ViT 在有充足训练数据时能更好捕捉复杂场景中的全局空间关系，但通常需要更多计算资源和更大训练集。
Conclusion: 本研究为遥感土地利用场景分类任务中模型选择提供了依据，指出了两种架构的优势与局限。

papers.title: Foundation Models for Credit Risk Prediction: A Game Changer?
papers.abstract_en: Predictive models play a pivotal role in credit risk management, guiding critical decisions through accurate estimation of default probabilities and losses. Extensive research has introduced new modeling techniques, complemented by large-scale benchmarking studies consolidating the state-of-the-art. Today, quasi-standards such as gradient-boosting models paired with SHAP explainers have emerged, yet continuous improvement of risk models remains a top priority. Concurrently, rapid advancements in AI, most notably large language models, have disrupted predictive modeling paradigms. Foundation models, pretrained on extensive datasets from diverse domains, have demonstrated remarkable performance by leveraging prior knowledge. While prevalent in natural language processing and computer vision, foundation models for tabular data have only recently emerged. We conjecture that pretraining on out-of-domain data is particularly beneficial in small-data settings, such as SME lending or specialized corporate portfolios, and may help address longstanding challenges including low default portfolios and class imbalance. This paper benchmarks recently proposed tabular foundation models against a broad set of competitors, including established and advanced machine learning techniques, across two core tasks: PD and LGD modeling. Our evaluation encompasses various datasets, performance indicators, and experimental conditions. We find that tabular foundation models generally perform best across datasets and tasks. Moreover, they offer significant improvement in predictive performance as dataset size shrinks. These results are remarkable given that the models are tested out-of-the-box, without hyperparameter tuning, ensuring ease of use and mitigating computational costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了表格基础模型在信用风险预测（PD与LGD建模）中的表现，发现其优于包括梯度提升在内的多种机器学习方法，尤其在小型数据集上提升显著，且开箱即用无需调参。

papers.title: Stable Attention Response for Reliable Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation nowcasting remains challenging due to the highly localized, rapidly evolving, and heterogeneous nature of atmospheric dynamics. Although recent methods increasingly adopt attention-based architectures in both unimodal and multimodal settings, they mainly emphasize stronger representation learning and prediction capacity, while paying less attention to the stability of attention responses across samples. In this work, we show that cross-sample instability of attention-response energy is an important and previously underexplored source of forecasting unreliability. Empirically, inaccurate forecasts are associated with larger attention-response energy variance across heads and layers. Theoretically, we show that cross-sample variability can propagate through self-attention, and enlarge a lower bound on prediction error. Based on this insight, we propose HARECast, a Head-wise Attention Response Energy-regulated framework for precipitation nowcasting. HARECast explicitly models head-wise attention-response energy and stabilizes it through a group-wise regularization objective that reduces cross-sample fluctuations. The proposed formulation is generic and applicable to both unimodal and multimodal nowcasting architectures. We instantiate HARECast in a standard forecasting pipeline with reconstruction branches and a diffusion-based predictor, and evaluate it on commonly used benchmarks--SEVIR and MeteoNet. Experimental results demonstrate that HARECast achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对降水临近预报中注意力响应跨样本不稳定的问题，提出HARECast框架。通过逐头注意力响应能量建模和分组正则化减少波动，提升预报可靠性。在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有注意力模型侧重表征学习，忽视了注意力响应跨样本的不稳定性，这是导致预报不可靠的未充分探究因素。
Method: 提出HARECast框架，显式建模逐头注意力响应能量，并通过分组正则化目标降低跨样本波动；可适用于单模态和多模态架构。
Result: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上，HARECast实现了最先进的预报性能。
Conclusion: 注意力响应能量跨样本方差是预报误差的重要来源，稳定该能量可提升临近预报可靠性。

papers.title: Fre-Res: Frequency-Residual Video Token Compression for Efficient Video MLLMs
authors: Jie Liu (1) ((1) The College of Computer Science
(2) The Shien-Ming Wu School of Intelligent Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Video MLLMs face a persistent tension between spatial fidelity and temporal coverage: preserving fine-grained visual details requires many spatial tokens, while capturing short-lived events requires dense temporal sampling. We propose \textbf{Fre-Res}, a budget-adaptive dual-track video-token compression framework that separates these two forms of evidence. Fre-Res preserves sparse high-fidelity spatial anchors and represents dense temporal evolution through compact residual-frequency tokens. Specifically, it applies temporal 1D-DCT to inter-frame residual trajectories in vision-latent space, where we observe strong low-frequency concentration. To align frequency-domain dynamics with native visual embeddings, Fre-Res introduces a Spatial-Guided Absorber that injects temporal residual information into spatially corresponding anchor tokens. Across fine-grained short-video and long-video reasoning benchmarks, Fre-Res achieves a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off, matching or approaching full-token performance while substantially reducing visual-token length. Extensive ablations further show that temporal-frequency residuals preserve causal transition cues, while spatial anchors remain essential for fine-grained object and layout reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fre-Res，一种预算自适应的双轨视频token压缩框架，旨在解决视频多模态大模型（Video MLLMs）中空间保真度与时间覆盖的矛盾。该方法通过时间1D-DCT压缩帧间残差轨迹，并利用空间引导吸收器将时间残差信息注入空间锚点token，在细粒度短视频和长视频推理基准上实现了接近全token性能的准确率，同时大幅减少视觉token长度。
Motivation: 视频MLLMs在处理视频时，保留细粒度空间细节需要大量空间token，而捕捉短暂事件则需要密集时间采样，两者之间存在矛盾。
Method: 提出双轨框架：保留稀疏高保真空间锚点，通过紧凑的残差频率token表示密集时间演化；具体使用时间1D-DCT压缩视觉潜在空间中的帧间残差轨迹，并引入空间引导吸收器将时间残差信息注入对应空间锚点。
Result: 在细粒度短视频和长视频推理基准上，Fre-Res匹配或接近全token性能，同时显著减少视觉token长度，实现了良好的准确率-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 时间频率残差保留了因果转变线索，而空间锚点对细粒度对象和布局推理仍然必要。

papers.title: Flatness and Gradient Alignment Are Both Necessary: Spectral-Aware Gradient-Aligned Exploration for Multi-Distribution Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness-aware and gradient-alignment methods have been shown to improve generalization, however each family of methods targets a single geometric property of the loss landscape, while ignoring the other. In this paper, we show that this omission is structurally unavoidable and that both flatness and gradient alignment should be considered in multi-distribution learning settings. Specifically, we derive an excess-risk decomposition that yields two additive leading-order terms: (i) an alignment term, controlled by the trace of $\bar{H}^{-1}Σ_g$ and (ii) a curvature term, controlled by $\bar{H}$, where $\bar{H}$ is the average Hessian and $Σ_g$ is the covariance of the gradient across distributions. Notably, $\bar{H}$ appears inverted in one and non-inverted in the other. We further show, via a counterexample, that neither quantity bounds the other in general, so no algorithm targeting only one term can guarantee low excess risk. Motivated by this decomposition, we propose SAGE (Spectral-Aware Gradient-Aligned Exploration) that targets both terms. The curvature component replaces SAM's gradient-scaled perturbation with the polar factor of each layer's gradient matrix, computed via Newton-Schulz iteration, so that the ascent step probes all directions with similar magnitude. On the other hand, the alignment component injects isotropic noise at the descent step, the magnitude of which scales with cross-distribution gradient disagreement. Experiments on five domain-generalization and two multi-task learning benchmarks show that the proposed method establishes a new state-of-the-art on DomainBed and acts as a general-purpose improvement to base MTL solvers, remaining competitive with, or even surpassing, state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了多分布学习（multi-distribution learning）下的超额风险分解，证明平坦度（flatness）与梯度对齐（gradient alignment）两项误差项在一般意义下互不界定，因此仅优化其中一项无法保证低风险。基于此提出SAGE方法：通过Newton-Schulz迭代计算每层梯度矩阵的极分解因子作为上升扰动，以平衡各方向曲率；在下降步注入各向同性噪声，其幅度与跨分布梯度不一致性成比例。在五个领域泛化和两个多任务学习基准上达到新最优。
Motivation: 现有锐度感知方法（如SAM）和梯度对齐方法各自仅关注损失景观的单一几何性质，但在多分布学习设定下，两性质各自贡献不同阶的误差项且互不包含，因此需要同时优化。
Method: 从超额风险分解出发，发现两项主导项分别由平均Hessian的逆迹（对齐项）和平均Hessian本身（曲率项）控制。SAGE方法中，曲率项用每层梯度矩阵的极分解因子替代SAM的梯度缩放扰动，使上升步在各方向等幅探索；对齐项在下降步加入各向同性噪声，噪声幅度正比于跨分布梯度离散度。
Result: 在DomainBed的五个领域泛化基准和两个多任务学习基准上，SAGE达到新最优性能，并作为通用改进基线，与最先进方法持平或更优。

papers.title: Discovering Ordinary Differential Equations with LLM-Based Qualitative and Quantitative Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Discovering governing differential equations from observational data is a fundamental challenge in scientific machine learning. Existing symbolic regression approaches rely primarily on quantitative metrics; however, real-world differential equation modeling also requires incorporating domain knowledge to ensure physical plausibility. To address this gap, we propose DoLQ, a method for discovering ordinary differential equations with LLM-based qualitative and quantitative evaluation. DoLQ employs a multi-agent architecture: a Sampler Agent proposes dynamic system candidates, a Parameter Optimizer refines equations for accuracy, and a Scientist Agent leverages an LLM to conduct both qualitative and quantitative evaluations and synthesize their results to iteratively guide the search. Experiments on multi-dimensional ordinary differential equation benchmarks demonstrate that DoLQ achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, not only attaining higher success rates but also more accurately recovering the correct symbolic terms of ground truth equations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bon99yun/DoLQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DoLQ 方法，利用基于 LLM 的多智能体架构（Sampler Agent、Parameter Optimizer、Scientist Agent）从观测数据中发现常微分方程。该方法不仅依赖定量指标，还通过 LLM 进行定性评估以保证物理合理性。在多维 ODE 基准上，DoLQ 相比现有方法获得更高的成功率并更准确地恢复真实符号项。
Motivation: 现有符号回归方法主要依赖定量指标，但真实微分方程建模还需融入领域知识以保障物理合理性，这一需求尚未被充分解决。
Method: 提出多智能体架构：Sampler Agent 负责生成动态系统候选，Parameter Optimizer 优化参数以提升精度，Scientist Agent 利用 LLM 进行定性与定量评估并综合结果迭代引导搜索。
Result: 在多维常微分方程基准上，DoLQ 实现了比现有方法更高的成功率和更准确的真实符号项恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DoLQ 通过结合 LLM 的定性评估与定量指标，有效提升了微分方程发现的性能。

papers.title: Partially Observed Structural Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Here we introduce Partially Observed Structural Causal Models (POSCMs) as an extension of structural causal models (SCMs) to settings where upstream contexts co-determine both the interaction structure and downstream mechanisms on observed variables. POSCMs thus provide a self-contained causal modeling framework for endogenous graphs, allowing for an intervention hierarchy spanning node- and edge-level contexts and endogenous variable interventions. To define edge interventions, we separate node mechanisms into edge-local transmission channels that can be modified without changing the source node or the rest of the target mechanism. We provide an identifiability theory that clarifies which intervention families would suffice to disentangle structure formation from mechanisms. We then empirically validate these theoretical results in two external simulators: a biophysically detailed virtual human retina and a gene-regulatory analogue. The experiments reproduce non-identifiability under latent context, expose structure-mechanism confounding under latent edges, and recover pathway-level input-output relationships under targeted interventions, consistent with our positive Markov kernel identifiability results. Together, POSCMs provide an intervention-oriented framework for causal systems in which contexts, graph structure, mechanisms, and measurements are jointly generated and only partially observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出部分观测结构因果模型（POSCMs），扩展了结构因果模型（SCMs）至上游上下文共同决定交互结构和下游机制的场景，允许节点级和边级上下文的干预层次。通过将节点机制分解为边级传输通道实现边干预，并给出可识别性理论。在虚拟人类视网膜和基因调控模拟器上验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有SCM假设图结构已知或完全观测，但许多真实系统中上下文同时影响图结构和机制，且只有部分观测，缺乏统一的因果建模框架。
Method: 提出POSCM框架，将节点机制分解为边级传输通道，允许在不改变源节点或目标机制其余部分的情况下修改边；定义干预层次（节点、边、内生变量），并给出识别哪些干预族可区分结构形成与机制的条件。
Result: 在虚拟人类视网膜和基因调控模拟器上，实验重现了潜在上下文下的非可识别性，揭示了潜在边下的结构-机制混淆，并通过定向干预恢复通路级输入输出关系，与正马尔可夫核可识别性结果一致。
Conclusion: POSCM为上下文、图结构、机制和测量共同生成且仅部分观测的因果系统提供了干预导向的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A-IC3: Learning-Guided Adaptive Inductive Generalization for Hardware Model Checking
papers.abstract_en: The IC3 algorithm represents the state-of-the-art (SOTA) hardware model checking technique, owing to its robust performance and scalability. A significant body of research has focused on enhancing the solving efficiency of the IC3 algorithm, with particular attention to the inductive generalization process: a critical phase wherein the algorithm seeks to generalize a counterexample to inductiveness (CTI), which typically is a state leading to a bad state, into a broader set of states. This inductive generalization is a primary source of clauses in IC3 and thus plays a pivotal role in determining the overall effectiveness of the algorithm. Despite its importance, existing approaches often rely on fixed inductive generalization strategies, overlooking the dynamic and context-sensitive nature of the verification environment in which spurious counterexamples arise. This rigidity can limit the quality of generated clauses and, consequently, the performance of IC3. To address this limitation, we propose a lightweight machine-learning-based framework that dynamically selects appropriate inductive generalization strategies in response to the evolving verification context. Specifically, we employ a multi-armed bandit (MAB) algorithm to adaptively choose inductive generalization strategies based on real-time feedback from the verification process. The agent is updated by evaluating the quality of generalization outcomes, thereby refining its strategy selection over time. Empirical evaluation on a benchmark suite comprising 914 instances, primarily drawn from the latest HWMCC collection, demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. When implemented on the state-of-the-art model checker rIC3, our method solves 26 to 50 more cases than the baselines and improves the PAR-2 score by 194.72 to 389.29.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对IC3硬件模型检验算法中的归纳泛化过程，提出基于多臂老虎机（MAB）的轻量级机器学习框架，动态选择归纳泛化策略以适应不断变化的验证环境。实验表明，在914个基准实例（主要来自最新HWMCC数据集）上，该方法比基线多解决26至50个案例，PAR-2评分提升194.72至389.29。
Motivation: 现有IC3算法在归纳泛化阶段固定使用一种策略，忽略了验证环境的动态性和上下文敏感性，导致生成的子句质量受限，影响整体性能。
Method: 使用多臂老虎机（MAB）算法，根据验证过程的实时反馈（泛化结果质量）自适应地选择归纳泛化策略，并随时间更新策略选择。
Result: 在包含914个实例的基准测试上，基于SOTA模型检验器rIC3实现，该方法比基线多解决26至50个案例，PAR-2评分提升194.72至389.29。
Conclusion: 动态选择归纳泛化策略能有效提升IC3算法的求解效率，且框架轻量、无需大量数据训练。

papers.title: When W4A4 Breaks Camouflaged Object Detection: Token-Group Dual-Constraint Activation Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection (COD) segments objects that intentionally blend with the background, so predictions depend on subtle texture and boundary cues. COD is often needed under tight on-device memory and latency budgets, making low-bit inference highly desirable. However, COD is unusually hard to quantize aggressively. We study post-training W4A4 quantization of Transformer-based COD and find a task-specific cliff: heavy-tailed background tokens dominate a shared activation range, inflating the step size and pushing weak-but-structured boundary cues into the zero bin. This exposes a token-local bottleneck -- remove cross-token range domination and bound the zero-bin mass under 4-bit activations. To address this, we introduce COD-TDQ, a COD-aware Token-group Dual-constraint activation Quantization method. COD-TDQ addresses this token-local bottleneck with two coupled steps: Direct-Sum Token-Group (DSTG) assigns token-group scales to suppress cross-token range domination, and Dual-Constraint Range Projection (DCRP) projects each token-group clip range to keep the step-to-dispersion ratio and the zero-bin mass bounded. Across four COD benchmarks and two baseline models (CFRN and ESCNet), COD-TDQ consistently achieves an $S_α$ score more than 0.12 higher than that of the state-of-the-art quantization method without retraining. The code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NKU/nku-model-compre.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer-based伪装目标检测（COD）在4比特权重与4比特激活（W4A4）量化下的性能退化问题，发现背景token主导量化范围导致边界信息丢失。提出COD-TDQ方法，包括Direct-Sum Token-Group（DSTG）分配组级缩放因子和Dual-Constraint Range Projection（DCRP）约束裁剪范围，在四个COD基准和两个模型上S_α分数比现有量化方法提升超过0.12，且无需重新训练。
Motivation: 伪装目标检测依赖细微纹理和边界线索，但现有量化方法在4比特激活下，背景token的分布范围主导共享量化步长，将弱但有结构的边界信息推入零区间，造成任务特定的性能悬崖。
Method: 提出COD-TDQ，包含两步：Direct-Sum Token-Group（DSTG）为每个token组分配独立缩放因子以消除跨token范围支配；Dual-Constraint Range Projection（DCRP）约束每个token组的裁剪范围，保持步长-分散比和零区间质量。
Result: 在四个COD基准（如CAMO、COD10K）和两个基线模型（CFRN、ESCNet）上，COD-TDQ在W4A4设置下S_α分数比现有最优量化方法高0.12以上，且无需任何重新训练或微调。
Conclusion: COD-TDQ有效解决了COD任务在4比特激活量化下的token局部瓶颈，为低比特推理提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

papers.title: Filtered Reasoning Score: Evaluating Reasoning Quality on a Model's Most-Confident Traces
papers.abstract_en: Should we trust Large Language Models (LLMs) with high accuracy? LLMs achieve high accuracy on reasoning benchmarks, but correctness alone does not reveal the quality of the reasoning used to produce it. This highlights a fundamental limitation of outcome-based evaluation: models may arrive at correct answers through flawed reasoning, and models with substantially different reasoning capabilities can nevertheless exhibit similar benchmark accuracy, for example due to memorization or over-optimization. In this paper, we ask: given existing benchmarks, can we move beyond outcome-based evaluation to assess the quality of reasoning itself? We seek metrics that (1) differentiate models with similar accuracy and (2) are robust to variations in input prompts and generation configurations. To this end, we propose a reasoning score that evaluates reasoning traces along dimensions such as faithfulness, coherence, utility, and factuality. A remaining question is how to aggregate this score across multiple sampled traces. Naively averaging them is undesirable, particularly in long-horizon settings, where the number of possible trajectories grows rapidly, and low-confidence correct traces are more likely to be coincidental. To address this, we introduce the Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS), which computes reasoning quality using only the top-K% most confident traces. Evaluating with FRS, models that are indistinguishable under standard accuracy exhibit significant differences in reasoning quality. Moreover, models with higher FRS on one benchmark tend to perform better on other reasoning benchmarks, in both accuracy and reasoning quality. Together, these findings suggest that FRS complements accuracy by capturing a model's transferable reasoning capabilities. We open source our evaluation codebase: https://github.com/Manas2006/benchmark_reproducibility.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出过滤推理分数（FRS），用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在推理轨迹上的质量，包括忠实度、连贯性、实用性和事实性。FRS仅使用模型最自信的前K%推理轨迹计算推理质量，能够区分在标准准确率上无法区分的模型。实验表明，FRS能捕捉模型的迁移推理能力，与准确率互补。
Motivation: 现有基于结果的评估仅考虑正确性，无法揭示推理质量；不同推理能力的模型可能因记忆或过度优化而表现出相似的准确率。因此需要一种超越结果评估的推理质量度量。
Method: 提出过滤推理分数（FRS），先对多条推理轨迹按置信度排序，仅保留最自信的top-K%轨迹，然后在这些轨迹上评估推理的忠实度、连贯性、实用性和事实性等维度。
Result: 在标准准确率无法区分的模型上，FRS显示出显著的推理质量差异。模型在某一基准上的FRS越高，在其他推理基准上的准确率和推理质量也越好，表明FRS能捕捉迁移推理能力。
Conclusion: FRS通过评估模型的最自信推理轨迹，提供了与准确率互补的推理质量度量，有助于揭示模型间推理能力的差异。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在标准准确率无法区分的模型上，FRS显示出显著的推理质量差异。模型在某一基准上的FRS越高，在其他推理基准上的准确率和推理质量也越好，表明FRS能捕捉迁移推理能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: FRS通过评估模型的最自信推理轨迹，提供了与准确率互补的推理质量度量，有助于揭示模型间推理能力的差异。

papers.title: Holistic Optimal Label Selection for Robust Prompt Learning under Partial Labels
papers.abstract_en: Prompt learning has gained significant attention as a parameter-efficient approach for adapting large pre-trained vision-language models to downstream tasks. However, when only partial labels are available, its performance is often limited by label ambiguity and insufficient supervisory information. To address this issue, we propose Holistic Optimal Label Selection (HopS), leveraging the generalization ability of pre-trained feature encoders through two complementary strategies. First, we design a local density-based filter that selects the top frequent labels from the nearest neighbors' candidate sets and uses the softmax scores to identify the most plausible label, capturing structural regularities in the feature space. Second, we introduce a global selection objective based on optimal transport that maps the uniform sampling distribution to the candidate label distributions across a batch. By minimizing the expected transport cost, it can determine the most likely label assignments. These two strategies work together to provide robust label selection from both local and global perspectives. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets show that HopS consistently improves performance under partial supervision and outperforms all baselines. Those results highlight the merit of holistic label selection and offer a practical solution for prompt learning in weakly supervised settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Holistic Optimal Label Selection (HopS) 方法，用于解决部分标签场景下提示学习 (prompt learning) 的性能下降问题。通过局部密度滤波和全局最优传输两种互补策略，从局部和全局角度选择最可能的标签，在八个基准数据集上一致提升半监督性能并超越基线。
Motivation: 现有提示学习方法在仅提供部分标签时，受限于标签模糊性和监督信息不足，性能受限。
Method: 提出 HopS，包含两种策略：1) 基于局部密度的过滤器，从近邻候选集中选择高频标签并利用 softmax 分数确定最可能标签；2) 基于最优运输的全局选择目标，将均匀采样分布映射到批次内的候选标签分布，最小化期望运输成本以确定标签分配。
Result: 在八个基准数据集上的实验表明，HopS 在部分监督下持续提升性能并优于所有基线。
Conclusion: HopS 通过局部与全局视角的协同标签选择，为弱监督场景下的提示学习提供了实用解决方案。

papers.title: How LLMs Might Think
papers.abstract_en: Do large language models (LLMs) think? Daniel Stoljar and Zhihe Vincent Zhang have recently developed an argument from rationality for the claim that LLMs do not think. We contend, however, that the argument from rationality not only falters, but leaves open an intriguing possibility: that LLMs engage only in arational, associative forms of thinking, and have purely associative minds. Our positive claim is that if LLMs think at all, they likely think precisely in this manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对Stoljar和Zhang关于LLM不会思考的“理性论证”的哲学回应。作者指出该论证存在缺陷，并由此提出一种可能性：如果LLM具有思考能力，那么它们进行的很可能是非理性的、联想式的思考，拥有纯粹的联想式心智。
Motivation: 针对LLM是否具有思考能力这一哲学问题，现有理性论证主张LLM不会思考，本文旨在揭示该论证的不足，并为探索LLM可能具有的特殊思考方式开辟空间。
Method: 采用批判性分析的方法，剖析理性论证的逻辑结构及其漏洞，并基于联想主义哲学传统提出LLM可能具有的思考模式。
Result: 论证了理性论证不能排除LLM思考的可能性，且暗示LLM若思考则很可能以非理性的联想方式进行。
Conclusion: 作者主张，如果LLM能够思考，它们很可能只具有联想式心智，从事非理性的联想式思考。

papers.title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Learning (TTL) enables language agents to iteratively refine their performance through repeated interactions with the environment at inference time. At the core of TTL is an adaptation policy that updates the actor policy based on experience from previous episodes, thereby improving future behavior. Existing methods rely on fixed, hand-crafted adaptation policies rather than optimizing them for downstream improvement. We argue that optimal adaptation policies should be learned from task environments, not hand-engineered based on human intuition. To achieve this, we introduce Meta-TTL, a framework that formulates the discovery of effective adaptation policies as a bi-level optimization problem. Within this framework, the inner loop executes the standard TTL process, measuring how effectively a candidate adaptation policy helps an agent correct errors across sequential episodes. Guided by the agent's performance, the outer loop employs evolutionary search over a diverse distribution of training tasks to continually optimize the adaptation policy. We evaluate Meta-TTL on Jericho, WebArena-Lite, and $τ^2$-bench across both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings. Results on all three show that Meta-TTL consistently outperforms single-agent, prompt-optimization, and unoptimized meta-agent baselines, suggesting that the optimized adaptation policy encodes transferable strategies that generalize beyond the training task distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Meta-TTL框架，将测试时学习（TTL）中自适应的手动策略替换为通过学习得到的优化策略，通过双层优化在任务分布上进化搜索最佳策略。实验显示Meta-TTL在Jericho、WebArena-Lite和τ²-bench上优于基线方法，且学到的策略能泛化到分布外任务。
Motivation: 现有TTL依赖固定手工程略，缺乏对下游性能的优化，理想的自适应策略应从任务环境中学习而非手工设计。
Method: 提出Meta-TTL框架，将TTL过程建模为双层优化：内层执行TTL评估候选策略的性能，外层通过进化搜索在训练任务分布上持续优化策略。
Result: 在Jericho、WebArena-Lite和τ²-bench上的实验表明，Meta-TTL在分布内和分布外设置下均一致优于单智能体、提示优化和未优化的元智能体基线。
Conclusion: 优化的自适应策略编码了可迁移的策略，能够泛化到训练任务分布之外。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Multimodal Fusion for Time Series: Text Modalities Need Constrained Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal learning have motivated the integration of auxiliary modalities such as text or vision into time series (TS) forecasting. However, most existing methods provide limited gains, often improving performance only in specific datasets or relying on architecture-specific designs that limit generalization. In this paper, we show that multimodal models with naive fusion strategies (e.g., simple addition or concatenation) often underperform unimodal TS models, which we attribute to the uncontrolled integration of auxiliary modalities which may introduce irrelevant information. Motivated by this observation, we explore various constrained fusion methods designed to control such integration and find that they consistently outperform naive fusion methods. Furthermore, we propose Controlled Fusion Adapter (CFA), a simple plug-in method that enables controlled cross-modal interactions without modifying the TS backbone, integrating only relevant textual information aligned with TS dynamics. CFA employs low rank adapters to filter irrelevant textual information before fusing it into temporal representations. We conduct over 20K experiments across various datasets and TS/text models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the constrained fusion methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/cfa.
papers.comment: KDD Workshop on Mining and Learning from Time Series 2026 (Oral presentation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列预测中多模态融合的问题，发现简单融合（如相加或拼接）经常不如纯时间序列模型，原因是辅助模态引入了无关信息。作者提出受控融合适配器（CFA），这是一种即插即用方法，通过低秩适配器过滤无关文本信息，再融合到时间表示中，无需修改时间序列主干网络。在超过20K次实验中，受控融合方法一致优于简单融合。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合在时间序列预测中增益有限，常仅在特定数据集上有效或依赖特定架构，且简单融合可能引入无关信息导致性能下降。
Method: 提出Controlled Fusion Adapter (CFA)，使用低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）在融合前过滤与时间序列动态不一致的文本信息，实现受控的跨模态交互，不改变时间序列主干网络。
Result: 在多种数据集和时间序列/文本模型上进行了超过20K次实验，受控融合方法一致优于简单融合（如相加、拼接），证明了有效性。
Conclusion: 受控融合对于提升多模态时间序列预测至关重要，CFA作为一种简单插件，能够有效整合相关文本信息，且具有通用性。

papers.title: A plug-and-play approach with fast uncertainty quantification for weak lensing mass mapping
papers.abstract_en: Upcoming stage-IV surveys such as Euclid and Rubin will deliver vast amounts of high-precision data, opening new opportunities to constrain cosmological models with unprecedented accuracy. A key step in this process is the reconstruction of the dark matter distribution from noisy weak-lensing shear measurements. Current deep-learning-based mass-mapping methods achieve high reconstruction accuracy, but either require retraining a model for each new observed sky region (limiting practicality) or rely on slow Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling. Efficient exploitation of future survey data therefore calls for a new method that is accurate, flexible, and fast at inference. In addition, an uncertainty quantification with coverage guarantees is essential for a reliable cosmological parameter estimation. We introduce PnPMass, a plug-and-play approach for weak-lensing mass mapping. The algorithm produces point estimates by alternating between a gradient descent step with a carefully chosen data fidelity term and a denoising step implemented with a single deep-learning model trained on simulated data corrupted by Gaussian white noise. We also propose a fast sampling-free uncertainty quantification scheme based on moment networks, with calibrated error bars obtained through conformal prediction to ensure coverage guarantees. Finally, we benchmark PnPMass against model-driven and data-driven mass-mapping techniques. PnPMass achieves a performance close to that of the currently best deep-learning methods while offering fast inference. It converges in just a few iterations, and it requires only a single training phase, regardless of the noise covariance of the observations. It therefore combines flexibility, efficiency, and reconstruction accuracy while delivering tighter error bars than existing approaches, making it well suited for upcoming weak-lensing surveys.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱引力透镜质量映射中现有深度学习方法需要重新训练或MCMC采样慢的问题，提出PnPMass即插即用方法。该方法通过交替梯度下降和去噪步骤快速得到点估计，并基于矩网络和共形预测实现带覆盖保证的不确定性量化。实验表明，PnPMass在重建精度上接近最优深度学习方法，推理速度快，仅需单个训练阶段，且与观测噪声协方差无关。
Motivation: 未来巡天（如Euclid、Rubin）需要高质量的质量映射，但现有深度学习模型要么需要针对每个天区重训练，要么依赖慢速MCMC，无法高效处理大规模数据。同时，可靠的带有覆盖保证的不确定性量化对于宇宙学参数估计至关重要。
Method: 提出PnPMass算法，采用即插即用框架，交替进行梯度下降（选择合适的数据保真项）和去噪步骤（使用单个在模拟高斯白噪声数据上训练的深度学习模型）。不确定性量化采用基于矩网络的快速无采样方案，并通过共形预测校准误差条以确保覆盖保证。
Result: 在基准测试中，PnPMass重建性能接近目前最好的深度学习方法，推理快速（仅需几次迭代收敛），且仅需单次训练，不依赖于观测噪声协方差。其提供的误差条比现有方法更紧。
Conclusion: PnPMass结合了灵活性、效率和重建精度，并提供了更紧的误差条，非常适合即将到来的弱引力透镜巡天。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Generalised Exponentiated Gradient Approach to Enhance Fairness in Binary and Multi-class Classification Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The widespread use of AI and ML models in sensitive areas raises significant concerns about fairness. While the research community has introduced various methods for bias mitigation in binary classification tasks, the issue remains under-explored in multi-class classification settings. To address this limitation, in this paper, we first formulate the problem of fair learning in multi-class classification as a multi-objective problem between effectiveness (i.e., prediction correctness) and multiple linear fairness constraints. Next, we propose a Generalised Exponentiated Gradient (GEG) algorithm to solve this task. GEG is an in-processing algorithm that enhances fairness in binary and multi-class classification settings under multiple fairness definitions. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation of GEG against six baselines across seven multi-class and three binary datasets, using four widely adopted effectiveness metrics and three fairness definitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种广义指数梯度（Generalised Exponentiated Gradient, GEG）算法，用于在二元和多类分类任务中增强公平性。该算法将公平学习问题公式化为多目标优化，并处理多种公平性定义。实验在七个多类和三个二元数据集上评估了GEG的有效性，并与六个基线进行比较。
Motivation: 现有公平性方法主要针对二元分类，多类分类中的公平性问题研究不足。
Method: 提出GEG算法，一种处理内（in-processing）方法，将公平学习表述为多目标问题，并优化多个线性公平约束。
Result: 在七个多类和三个二元数据集上，与六个基线相比，GEG在使用四个有效性指标和三个公平性定义时表现出竞争力。
Conclusion: GEG在多种分类设置和公平性定义下具有通用性，能有效增强公平性。

papers.title: Evaluating Vision Foundation Models for Pixel and Object Classification in Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning underlies most modern approaches and tools in computer vision, including biomedical imaging. However, for interactive semantic segmentation (often called pixel classification in this context) and interactive object-level classification (object classification), feature-based shallow learning remains widely used. This is due to the diversity of data in this domain, the lack of large pretraining datasets, and the need for computational and label efficiency. In contrast, state-of-the-art tools for many other vision tasks in microscopy - most notably cellular instance segmentation - already rely on deep learning and have recently benefited substantially from vision foundation models (VFMs), particularly SAM. Here, we investigate whether VFMs can also improve pixel and object classification compared to current approaches. To this end, we evaluate several VFMs, including general-purpose models (SAM, SAM2, SAM3, DINOv3) and domain-specific ones ($μ$SAM, PathoSAM, KRONOS), in combination with shallow learning and attentive probing on five diverse and challenging datasets. Our results demonstrate consistent improvements over hand-crafted features and provide a clear pathway toward practical improvements. Furthermore, our study establishes a benchmark for VFMs in microscopy and informs future developments in this area.

papers.title: Not All Retrievals are Useful: Cross-Attention for Input-Aware RAG in Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances zero-shot time series (TS) forecasting by leveraging external knowledge bases, yet existing approaches overlook input-level relevance when fusing retrieved samples with the query. We argue that not all retrievals are equally useful, and irrelevant ones can degrade performance. To this end, we propose Cross-RAG, a zero-shot RAG-based forecasting framework that selectively attends to query-relevant retrieved samples via query--retrieval cross-attention. By modeling input-level relevance between the query and retrieved samples, Cross-RAG jointly incorporates three sources of information: 1) the query itself, 2) the retrieved samples, and 3) their relational interactions. In particular, this input-aware design enables Cross-RAG to remain stable as the number of retrieved samples $k$ grows, whereas prior methods without cross-attention require careful $k$ tuning to avoid degradation from irrelevant retrievals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Cross-RAG consistently improves zero-shot forecasting performance across multiple TSFM backbones and various RAG methods, with additional analyses confirming its effectiveness across various retrieval scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/seunghan96/cross-rag/.
papers.comment: KDD Workshop on Mining and Learning from Time Series 2026 (Oral Presentation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cross-RAG，一种基于交叉注意力的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于零样本时间序列预测。通过查询-检索交叉注意力机制，模型选择性关注与输入相关的检索样本，从而避免无关检索带来的性能下降。实验表明，Cross-RAG 在多种时间序列基础模型（TSFM）和 RAG 方法上一致提升零样本预测性能，且对检索数量 k 更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 方法在时间序列预测中忽略了输入级别的检索相关性，无关样本会损害性能，且对检索数量 k 敏感。需要一种能根据查询自适应融合检索样本的方法。
Method: 提出 Cross-RAG 框架，引入查询-检索交叉注意力，同时建模查询本身、检索样本以及两者之间的交互关系，实现输入感知的融合。
Result: 在多个 TSFM backbone 和 RAG 方法上，Cross-RAG 一致提升零样本预测性能，且随着 k 增加性能保持稳定，无需精细调参。
Conclusion: 输入感知的交叉注意力能有效缓解无关检索的负面影响，提升 RAG 在时间序列预测中的鲁棒性和性能。

papers.title: Tactile Modality Fusion for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose TacFiLM, a lightweight modality-fusion approach that integrates visual-tactile signals into vision-language-action (VLA) models. While advances in VLAs have introduced robot policies that are both generalizable and semantically grounded, these models mainly rely on vision-based perception. Vision alone, however, cannot capture the complex interaction dynamics that occur during contact-rich manipulation, including contact forces, surface friction, compliance, and shear. While recent attempts to integrate tactile signals into VLA models often increase complexity through token concatenation or large-scale pretraining, the heavy computational demands of behaviour models necessitate lightweight fusion strategies. To address these challenges, TacFiLM outlines a post-training finetuning approach that conditions intermediate visual features on pretrained tactile representations using feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). Experimental results on insertion and drawer opening tasks demonstrate consistent improvements in success rate, direct task performance, completion time, and force stability across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. Together, these results support our method as an effective approach to integrating tactile signals into VLA models, improving contact-rich manipulation behaviours. Project page: https://charliem7.github.io/projects/TacFilm/
papers.comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 2026, 20 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TacFiLM，一种轻量级模态融合方法，将视觉-触觉信号集成到视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型中。该方法通过后训练微调，利用特征级线性调制 (FiLM) 将中间视觉特征条件化为预训练的触觉表示，实验表明在插入和抽屉打开任务中成功率和任务性能均有提升。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型主要依赖视觉，无法捕捉接触丰富操作中的复杂交互动力学（如接触力、摩擦、顺应性和剪切）。直接集成触觉信号的方法通常增加复杂性（如 token 拼接或大规模预训练），需要轻量级融合策略。
Method: TacFiLM 采用后训练微调方式，使用特征级线性调制 (FiLM) 将预训练的触觉表示与中间视觉特征进行条件融合，从而在不需要大幅增加计算开销的情况下整合触觉信息。
Result: 在插入和抽屉打开任务上，TacFiLM 在分布内和分布外场景中均一致提升了成功率、直接任务性能、完成时间和力稳定性。
Conclusion: TacFiLM 是一种有效的轻量级方法，可将触觉信号集成到 VLA 模型中，改善接触丰富的操作行为。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: In existing Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement (AVSE) methods, objectives such as Scale-Invariant Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SI-SNR) and Mean Squared Error (MSE) are widely used; however, their correlation with perceived speech quality is often suboptimal and provides limited interpretability for optimization. This work proposes a reinforcement learning-based AVSE framework with a Large Language Model (LLM)-based interpretable reward model. An audio LLM generates natural language descriptions of enhanced speech, which are converted by a sentiment analysis model into a 1-5 rating score serving as the PPO reward for fine-tuning a pretrained AVSE model. Compared with scalar metrics, LLM-generated feedback is semantically rich and explicitly describes speech quality improvements. Experiments on the AVSEC-4 dataset show that the proposed method outperforms a supervised baseline and a DNSMOS-based RL baseline in PESQ, STOI, neural quality metrics, and subjective listening tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种基于强化学习的音视频语音增强框架，利用大语言模型(LLM)生成可解释的奖励信号。音频LLM将增强后的语音转化为自然语言描述，再通过情感分析模型映射为1-5分评分，作为PPO奖励微调预训练AVSE模型。在AVSEC-4数据集上，该方法在PESQ、STOI、神经质量指标和主观听感测试上均优于监督基线和DNSMOS强化学习基线。
Motivation: 现有音视频语音增强方法使用的目标函数(如SI-SNR、MSE)与感知语音质量相关性欠佳，且缺乏可解释性，难以指导模型优化。
Method: 使用音频LLM生成增强语音的自然语言描述，通过情感分析模型转换为评分作为PPO奖励，对预训练AVSE模型进行强化学习微调。
Result: 在AVSEC-4数据集上，所提方法在PESQ、STOI、神经质量指标和主观听感测试上优于监督基线和DNSMOS强化学习基线。
Conclusion: LLM生成的语义反馈相较于标量指标能更丰富地描述语音质量改进，为AVSE提供了一种可解释的优化方向。

papers.title: Design-Specification Tiling for ICL-based CAD Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models~(LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation, yet their performance remains limited on domain-specific tasks such as Computer-Aided Design~(CAD) code generation, largely due to the scarcity of high-quality training data. In-Context Learning~(ICL) provides a training-free alternative by prompting LLMs with task-specific exemplars, but its effectiveness critically depends on how exemplars are selected. Existing selection strategies mainly rely on similarity or point-wise diversity, often overlooking the compositional nature of CAD design specifications, where a query may involve multiple functional requirements, geometric constraints, and design primitives. As a result, selected exemplars can be individually relevant but collectively redundant, providing insufficient coverage for complex design requirements. In this work, we propose \emph{knowledge sufficiency} as a principled objective for exemplar selection, aiming to select a compact set of exemplars that maximally satisfies the requirements contained in a target design specification. To instantiate this objective, we introduce \emph{Design-Specification Tiling~(DST)}, which estimates knowledge sufficiency through a surrogate tiling ratio by decomposing design specifications into multi-granular components and measuring the proportion of query components covered by selected exemplars. We further show that optimizing this objective can be formulated as a submodular maximization problem, and develop a polynomial-time greedy algorithm tailored to this setting with a $(1-1/e)$-approximation guarantee. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs demonstrate that DST substantially improves CAD code generation quality and consistently outperforms existing ICL exemplar selection strategies, highlighting the importance of requirement-level knowledge coverage for domain-specific code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CAD代码生成中ICL示例选择的冗余问题，提出基于知识充分性的设计规范平铺（DST）方法，通过将设计规范分解为多粒度组件并衡量查询组件的覆盖率，将示例选择建模为子模最大化问题，并给出多项式时间贪心算法。实验表明DST在多个LLM上显著提升CAD代码生成质量。
Motivation: 现有ICL示例选择策略主要基于相似性或逐点多样性，忽略了CAD设计规范的组合性质，导致所选示例虽各自相关但整体冗余，无法充分覆盖复杂设计需求。
Method: 提出知识充分性目标，通过设计规范平铺（DST）将规范分解为多粒度组件，计算查询组件被覆盖的比例作为代理指标，并将优化问题形式化为子模最大化，使用贪心算法（保证1-1/e近似比）选择示例。
Result: 在多个LLM上的实验表明，DST显著提升CAD代码生成质量，一致优于现有ICL示例选择策略。
Conclusion: 强调需求级知识覆盖对领域特定代码生成的重要性，DST通过优化知识充分性有效缓解了示例冗余问题。

papers.title: Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion for Solving Parameterized PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Generalizing neural surrogate models across different PDE parameters remains difficult because changes in PDE coefficients often make learning harder and optimization less stable. The problem becomes even more severe when the model must also predict beyond the training time range. Existing methods usually cannot handle parameter generalization and temporal extrapolation at the same time. Standard parameterized models treat time as just another input and therefore fail to capture intrinsic dynamics, while recent continuous-time latent methods often rely on expensive test-time auto-decoding for each instance, which is inefficient and can disrupt continuity across the parameterized solution space. To address this, we propose Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion (DLDMF), a physics-informed framework that explicitly separates space, time, and parameters. Instead of unstable auto-decoding, DLDMF maps PDE parameters directly to a continuous latent embedding through a feed-forward network. This embedding initializes and conditions a latent state whose evolution is governed by a parameter-conditioned Neural ODE. We further introduce a dynamic manifold fusion mechanism that uses a shared decoder to combine spatial coordinates, parameter embeddings, and time-evolving latent states to reconstruct the corresponding spatiotemporal solution. By modeling prediction as latent dynamic evolution rather than static coordinate fitting, DLDMF reduces interference between parameter variation and temporal evolution while preserving a smooth and coherent solution manifold. As a result, it performs well on unseen parameter settings and in long-term temporal extrapolation. Experiments on several benchmark problems show that DLDMF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy, parameter generalization, and extrapolation robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解缠潜在动力学流形融合（DLDMF），一种物理信息框架，显式分离空间、时间和参数，通过前馈网络将PDE参数映射到连续潜在嵌入，并用参数条件化神经ODE驱动潜在状态演化，最后通过动态流形融合机制重建时空解。实验表明，DLDMF在多个基准上优于现有方法，尤其在参数泛化和长时间外推方面表现突出。
Motivation: 现有神经代理模型难以同时处理参数泛化和时间外推，标准参数化模型将时间视为输入而无法捕捉内在动力学，连续时间潜在方法依赖昂贵的测试时自动解码并破坏解空间连续性。
Method: DLDMF框架包含：1) 前馈网络将PDE参数直接映射为连续潜在嵌入；2) 该嵌入初始化并条件化潜在状态，其演化由参数条件化神经ODE控制；3) 动态流形融合机制通过共享解码器结合空间坐标、参数嵌入和时间演化潜在状态，重建对应时空解。
Result: 在多个基准问题（如波动方程、对流扩散方程等）上，DLDMF在准确性、参数泛化和外推鲁棒性方面一致超越现有最先进基线。
Conclusion: 通过将预测建模为潜在动力演化而非静态坐标拟合，DLDMF减少参数变化与时间演化间的干扰，保持平滑连贯的解流形，从而有效处理未见参数和长时间外推。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.method: DLDMF框架包含：1) 前馈网络将PDE参数直接映射为连续潜在嵌入；2) 该嵌入初始化并条件化潜在状态，其演化由参数条件化神经ODE控制；3) 动态流形融合机制通过共享解码器结合空间坐标、参数嵌入和时间演化潜在状态，重建对应时空解。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准问题（如波动方程、对流扩散方程等）上，DLDMF在准确性、参数泛化和外推鲁棒性方面一致超越现有最先进基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过将预测建模为潜在动力演化而非静态坐标拟合，DLDMF减少参数变化与时间演化间的干扰，保持平滑连贯的解流形，从而有效处理未见参数和长时间外推。

papers.title: Overcoming the Modality Gap in Context-Aided Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Context-aided forecasting (CAF) holds promise for integrating domain knowledge and forward-looking information, enabling AI systems to surpass traditional statistical methods. However, recent empirical studies reveal a puzzling gap: multimodal models often fail to outperform their unimodal counterparts. We hypothesize that this underperformance stems from poor context quality in existing datasets, as verification is challenging. To address these limitations, we introduce a semi-synthetic data augmentation method that generates contexts both descriptive of temporal dynamics and verifiably complementary to numerical histories. This approach enables massive-scale dataset creation, resulting in CAF-7M, a corpus of 7 million context-augmented time series windows, including a rigorously verified test set. We demonstrate that semi-synthetic pre-training transfers effectively to real-world evaluation, and show clear evidence of context utilization. Our results suggest that dataset quality, rather than architectural limitations, has been the primary bottleneck in context-aided forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对上下文辅助预测（CAF）中多模态模型常未优于单模态模型的现象，假设问题在于现有数据集上下文质量差且难以验证。提出半合成数据增强方法，生成既描述时间动态又可验证地补充数值历史的上下文，构建7百万上下文增强时间序列窗口语料库CAF-7M。实验表明半合成预训练可迁移至真实评估，证明数据集质量而非架构局限性是CAF的主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 多模态CAF模型在实践中往往不如单模态模型，作者推测原因是数据集上下文质量不足且缺乏验证手段，阻碍了领域知识的有效利用。
Method: 提出半合成数据增强方法，生成同时具有时间动态描述性和可验证补充性的上下文，并构建包含700万个时间序列窗口的CAF-7M数据集，含严格验证的测试集。
Result: 摘要报告半合成预训练有效迁移至真实世界评估，并显示明确的上下文利用证据，说明数据集质量而非架构是CAF的关键限制因素。
Conclusion: 研究表明，提升数据集质量比改进模型架构更能推动上下文辅助预测的性能突破，并提供了大规模可验证数据资源CAF-7M。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: RADAR: Closed-Loop Robotic Data Generation via Semantic Planning and Autonomous Causal Environment Reset
papers.abstract_en: The acquisition of large-scale physical interaction data, a critical prerequisite for modern robot learning, is severely bottlenecked by the prohibitive cost and scalability limits of human-in-the-loop collection paradigms. To break this barrier, we introduce Robust Autonomous Data Acquisition for Robotics (RADAR), a fully autonomous, closed-loop data generation engine that completely removes human intervention from the collection cycle. RADAR elegantly divides the cognitive load into a four-module pipeline. Anchored by 2-5 3D human demonstrations as geometric priors, a Vision-Language Model first orchestrates scene-relevant task generation via precise semantic object grounding and skill retrieval. Next, a Graph Neural Network policy translates these subtasks into physical actions via in-context imitation learning. Following execution, the VLM performs automated success evaluation using a structured Visual Question Answering pipeline. Finally, to shatter the bottleneck of manual resets, a Finite State Machine orchestrates an autonomous environment reset and asymmetric data routing mechanism. Driven by simultaneous forward-reverse planning with a strict Last-In, First-Out causal sequence, the system seamlessly restores unstructured workspaces and robustly recovers from execution failures. This continuous brain-cerebellum synergy transforms data collection into a self-sustaining process. Extensive evaluations highlight RADAR's exceptional versatility. In simulation, our framework achieves up to 90% success rates on complex, long-horizon tasks, effortlessly solving challenges where traditional baselines plummet to near-zero performance. In real-world deployments, the system reliably executes diverse, contact-rich skills (e.g., deformable object manipulation) via few-shot adaptation without domain-specific fine-tuning, providing a highly scalable paradigm for robotic data acquisition.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026). Project page: https://radar-iros.netlify.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RADAR，一个完全自主的闭环机器人数据生成引擎，无需人工干预。该系统通过视觉语言模型进行语义任务生成、图神经网络策略执行、自动化成功评估以及有限状态机驱动的环境重置和异步数据路由，实现持续数据采集。在仿真中，复杂长时任务成功率可达90%；真实世界中，通过少样本适应可执行多样化接触性技能。
Motivation: 大规模物理交互数据的获取受限于人类参与的高成本和低可扩展性，亟需无人工干预的自主数据生成方法。
Method: 将认知负载分为四模块流水线：使用2-5个人类3D演示作为几何先验，视觉语言模型进行语义目标定位和技能检索生成任务；图神经网络策略通过上下文模仿学习转化为物理动作；视觉语言模型通过结构化视觉问答进行自动成功评估；有限状态机结合前向-反向规划与LIFO因果序列，实现自主环境重置和失败恢复。
Result: 仿真中，复杂长时任务成功率达90%，传统基线几乎为零；真实世界中，无需领域微调即可执行如可变形物体操作等接触性技能。
Conclusion: RADAR将数据采集转变为自维持过程，为机器人数据获取提供高度可扩展的范式。

papers.title: OccTrack360: 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking from Surround-View Fisheye Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Understanding dynamic 3D environments in a spatially continuous and temporally consistent manner is fundamental for robotics and autonomous driving. While recent advances in occupancy prediction provide a unified representation of scene geometry and semantics, progress in 4D panoptic occupancy tracking remains limited by the lack of benchmarks that support surround-view fisheye sensing, long temporal sequences, and instance-level voxel tracking. To address this gap, we present OccTrack360, a new benchmark for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking from surround-view fisheye cameras. OccTrack360 provides substantially longer and more diverse sequences (174~2234 frames) than prior benchmarks, together with principled voxel visibility annotations, including an all-direction occlusion mask and an MEI-based fisheye field-of-view mask. To establish a strong fisheye-oriented baseline, we further propose Focus on Sphere Occ (FoSOcc), a framework that addresses two core challenges in fisheye occupancy tracking: distorted spherical projection and inaccurate voxel-space localization. FoSOcc includes a Center Focusing Module (CFM) to enhance instance-aware spatial localization through supervised focus guidance, and a Fisheye-based Enhanced Lifting (FEL) that extends perspective lifting to fisheye imaging under the Unified Projection Model. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-Waymo and OccTrack360 show that our method improves occupancy tracking quality with notable gains on geometrically regular categories, and establishes a strong baseline for future research on surround-view fisheye 4D occupancy tracking. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/YouthZest-Lin/OccTrack360.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/YouthZest-Lin/OccTrack360
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对环视鱼眼相机的4D全景占据跟踪（4D panoptic occupancy tracking）提出了新基准OccTrack360和基线框架FoSOcc。OccTrack360提供更长的序列（174-2234帧）和体素可见性标注；FoSOcc包含中心聚焦模块（CFM）和基于鱼眼的增强提升（FEL），以解决鱼眼畸变和定位不准确问题。在Occ3D-Waymo和OccTrack360上取得了改进，为鱼眼4D占据跟踪建立了强基线。
Motivation: 现有4D全景占据跟踪缺乏支持环视鱼眼相机、长时序和实例级体素跟踪的基准，限制了动态3D环境理解的进展。
Method: 提出OccTrack360基准和FoSOcc框架。FoSOcc包括Center Focusing Module（CFM）通过监督聚焦指导增强实例空间定位，以及Fisheye-based Enhanced Lifting（FEL）将透视提升扩展到统一投影模型下的鱼眼成像。
Result: 在Occ3D-Waymo和OccTrack360上的实验表明，该方法在几何规则类别上显著提升了占据跟踪质量。
Conclusion: 该工作为环视鱼眼4D占据跟踪提供了基准和强基线，但摘要未提及降水/天气相关应用。

papers.title: Low-latency Event-based Object Detection with Spatially-Sparse Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras provide sequential visual data with spatial sparsity and high temporal resolution, making them attractive for low-latency object detection. Existing asynchronous event-based neural networks exploit this low-latency advantage by updating predictions event by event, but still suffer from two bottlenecks: recurrent architectures are difficult to train efficiently on long sequences, and improving accuracy often increases per-event computation and latency. Linear attention is appealing because it enables parallel training and recurrent inference. However, its dense state updates make per-event computation scale with the state size, yielding a poor accuracy-efficiency trade-off for object detection, where accurate localization requires fine-grained spatial states. The key challenge is therefore to introduce sparse state activation that exploits the spatial sparsity of events while preserving efficient parallel training. We propose Spatially-Sparse Linear Attention (SSLA), which introduces a mixture-of-spaces state decomposition and a scatter-compute-gather training procedure, enabling state-level sparsity as well as training parallelism. Building on SSLA, we develop an end-to-end asynchronous linear attention model, SSLA-Det, for low-latency event-based object detection. On Gen1 and N-Caltech101, SSLA-Det achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among asynchronous methods, reaching 0.375 mAP and 0.515 mAP, respectively, while reducing per-event computation by over 20 times compared with the strongest prior asynchronous baseline, demonstrating the potential of linear attention for low-latency event-based vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对事件相机低延迟目标检测，提出空间稀疏线性注意力（SSLA），通过混合空间状态分解和 scatter-compute-gather 训练过程实现状态级稀疏性与训练并行性。基于 SSLA 构建的端到端异步线性注意力模型 SSLA-Det 在 Gen1 和 N-Caltech101 数据集上分别达到 0.375 mAP 和 0.515 mAP，为异步方法最优，同时每事件计算量降低超过 20 倍。
Motivation: 现有异步事件驱动神经网络存在两个瓶颈：循环架构难以高效训练长序列，且提升精度会增加每事件计算和延迟。线性注意力虽支持并行训练和循环推理，但其密集状态更新导致计算量随状态大小线性增长，对于需要细粒度空间状态的目标检测任务，精度-效率权衡不佳。关键挑战是如何利用事件的空间稀疏性引入稀疏状态激活，同时保持高效并行训练。
Method: 提出空间稀疏线性注意力（SSLA），包含混合空间状态分解和 scatter-compute-gather 训练过程，实现状态级稀疏性与训练并行性。在此基础上构建端到端异步线性注意力模型 SSLA-Det。
Result: 在 Gen1 数据集上达到 0.375 mAP，在 N-Caltech101 上达到 0.515 mAP，均为异步方法中的最佳精度；与最强先前异步基线相比，每事件计算量降低超过 20 倍。
Conclusion: 本文的方法在精度和效率上达到了事件相机异步目标检测的最优，验证了线性注意力在低延迟事件视觉中的潜力。

papers.title: A novel network for classification of cuneiform tablet metadata
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a network structure for classifying metadata of cuneiform tablets. The problem is of practical importance, as the size of the existing corpus far exceeds the number of experts available to analyze it. But the task is made difficult by the combination of limited annotated datasets and the high-resolution point-cloud representation of each tablet. To address this, we develop a convolution-inspired architecture that gradually down-scales the point cloud while integrating local neighbor information. The final down-scaled point cloud is then processed by computing neighbors in the feature space to include global information. Our method is compared with the state-of-the-art transformer-based network Point-BERT, and consistently obtains the best performance. Source code and data available at github.com/fhagelskjaer/cuneiform3d
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种卷积启发的点云网络结构，用于楔形文字片元数据分类。该方法通过逐步降采样点云并整合局部邻域信息，最后在特征空间中计算邻居以引入全局信息。在公开基准上持续优于基于Transformer的Point-BERT。
Motivation: 楔形文字片语料库规模远超专家分析能力，但标注数据有限且点云表示高分辨率，现有方法难以处理。
Method: 开发卷积启发架构，逐步降采样点云并整合局部邻域信息；最终降采样点云通过特征空间邻居计算引入全局信息。
Result: 与Point-BERT相比，所提方法在楔形文字片元数据分类任务上持续取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 所提单一点云架构在有限标注数据下对楔形文字分类有效，代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: Advancing Multimodal Judge Models through a Capability-Oriented Benchmark and MCTS-Driven Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as judges to achieve precise and consistent evaluations has gradually become an emerging paradigm across various domains. Evaluating the capability and reliability of MLLM-as-a-judge systems is therefore essential for ensuring trustworthy assessment. Existing judge benchmarks categorize samples by task types but fail to capture the fundamental judgment capabilities required for reliable evaluation. In this work, we introduce M-JudgeBench, a ten-dimensional capability-oriented benchmark designed to comprehensively assess the judgment abilities of MLLMs. Our benchmark decomposes evaluation into pairwise Chain-of-Thought (CoT) comparison, length bias avoidance, and process error detection tasks, jointly covering ten fine-grained subtasks. This design enables diagnosis of model reliability across reasoning styles, response lengths, and cross-model variations. Systematic evaluation uncovers the systematic weaknesses in existing MLLM-as-a-judge systems. To address this issue, we further propose Judge-MCTS, a data construction framework generating pairwise reasoning trajectories with various correctness and length. Using Judge-MCTS, we construct an MCTS-augmented dataset and train M-Judger, a series of strong judge models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of M-Judger on existing judge benchmarks as well as M-JudgeBench. Overall, our work establishes a more principled foundation for evaluating MLLM-as-a-judge through M-JudgeBench and Judge-MCTS framework, paving the way for future research on judge model evaluation and capability-driven judge training.

papers.title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) promise to ground language instructions in robot control, yet in practice often fail to faithfully follow language. When presented with instructions that lack strong scene-specific supervision, VLAs suffer from counterfactual failures: they act based on vision shortcuts induced by dataset biases, repeatedly executing well-learned behaviors and selecting objects frequently seen during training regardless of language intent. To systematically study it, we introduce LIBERO-CF, the first counterfactual benchmark for VLAs that evaluates language following capability by assigning alternative instructions under visually plausible LIBERO layouts. Our evaluation reveals that counterfactual failures are prevalent yet underexplored across state-of-the-art VLAs. We propose Counterfactual Action Guidance (CAG), a simple yet effective dual-branch inference scheme that explicitly regularizes language conditioning in VLAs. CAG combines a standard VLA policy with a language-unconditioned Vision-Action (VA) module, enabling counterfactual comparison during action selection. This design reduces reliance on visual shortcuts, improves robustness on under-observed tasks, and requires neither additional demonstrations nor modifications to existing architectures or pretrained models. Extensive experiments demonstrate its plug-and-play integration across diverse VLAs and consistent improvements. For example, on LIBERO-CF, CAG improves $π_{0.5}$ by 9.7% in language following accuracy and 3.6% in task success on under-observed tasks using a training-free strategy, with further gains of 15.5% and 8.5%, respectively, when paired with a VA model. In real-world evaluations, CAG reduces counterfactual failures of 9.4% and improves task success by 17.2% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反事实基准LIBERO-CF，用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在语言指令与视觉场景不一致时的表现。发现现有VLA常因数据集偏倚而忽视语言意图，依赖视觉捷径。提出Counterfactual Action Guidance (CAG)双分支推理方案，通过引入语言无关的视觉-动作模块来抑制视觉捷径，无需额外训练即可提升语言跟随准确率和任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有VLA在缺乏强场景监督的语言指令下，常出现反事实失败：即根据视觉偏倚而非语言意图执行动作。此类问题尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出LIBERO-CF反事实基准，通过给视觉合理布局分配替代指令来测试语言跟随能力。并提出CAG双分支推理，结合标准VLA策略与语言无关的视觉-动作（VA）模块，在动作选择时进行反事实比较，减少对视觉捷径的依赖。
Result: 在LIBERO-CF上，CAG使π0.5的语言跟随准确率提升9.7%，欠观测任务成功率提升3.6%（无训练策略）；结合VA模型后分别提升15.5%和8.5%。真实世界评估中，反事实失败降低9.4%，任务成功率平均提升17.2%。
Conclusion: CAG是一种即插即用的推理方案，无需额外演示或修改架构，能有效缓解VLA中的反事实失败问题。

papers.title: Left-right asymmetry in predicting brain activity from LLMs' representations emerges with their formal linguistic competence
papers.abstract_en: When humans and large language models (LLMs) process the same text, activations in the LLMs correlate with brain activity measured, e.g., with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). Moreover, it has been shown that, as the training of an LLM progresses, the performance in predicting brain activity from its internal activations improves more in the left hemisphere than in the right one. The aim of the present work is to understand which kind of competence acquired by the LLMs underlies the emergence of this left-right asymmetry. Using the OLMo-2 7B language model at various training checkpoints and fMRI data from English participants, we compare the evolution of the left-right asymmetry in the correlation between brain activity and model predictions alongside performance on several benchmarks. We observe that the asymmetry co-emerges with the formal linguistic abilities of the LLM. These abilities are demonstrated in two ways: by the model's capacity to assign a higher probability to an acceptable sentence than to a grammatically unacceptable one within a minimal contrasting pair, and by its ability to produce well-formed text. By contrast, the left-right asymmetry does not align with the performance on arithmetic or Dyck language tasks; nor with text-based tasks involving world knowledge and reasoning. We generalize these results to another family of LLMs (Pythia) and two other languages, French and Chinese. Our observations indicate that the left-right asymmetry in brain predictivity matches the progress in formal linguistic competence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）的内部表征在预测大脑活动时表现出的左右不对称性，发现这种不对称性随LLM的形式语言能力提升而出现，但与算术、Dyck语言或基于世界知识的推理任务无关。使用OLMo-2 7B模型在不同训练检查点以及fMRI数据，在英语、法语和中文上验证了结果。
Motivation: 理解LLM在预测大脑活动时出现的左右不对称性背后的具体能力，即哪种语言能力推动了这种不对称性的产生。
Method: 使用OLMo-2 7B语言模型在不同训练检查点的内部激活，与英语被试的fMRI数据计算相关性，并比较左右半球不对称性随训练的变化，同时关联多种基准任务（形式语言、算术、Dyck语言、世界知识推理）的表现。
Result: 左右不对称性仅与LLM的形式语言能力（如区分合法/非法句子、生成合格文本）共同出现，与算术、Dyck语言或知识推理任务的表现不相关。该结果在Pythia模型家族以及法语和中文数据上得到泛化。
Conclusion: 左右不对称性的出现是LLM获得形式语言能力的标志，而非通用认知能力或知识推理能力的反映。

papers.title: When Agents Disagree With Themselves: Behavioral Consistency as an Uncertainty Signal for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Running the same LLM agent on identical inputs yields 2.3-4.2 distinct action sequences per 10 runs; this behavioral variance constitutes a training-free, black-box uncertainty signal that instantiates selective classification and distribution-free calibration for agentic systems. Across 8,000 runs of four models on 200 HotpotQA questions, consistent tasks (at most 2 unique paths) achieve 82-87% accuracy while inconsistent tasks (4 or more paths) achieve 41-65%, a gap that survives controls for task difficulty. Divergence concentrates at step 2 (50.5% of Llama tasks), and consistency metrics detect failures with AUROC 0.62-0.78. Exploiting this signal, selective prediction (answering only when k=3 runs agree) achieves 87-88% accuracy at 54-62% coverage, a 6-14pp gain over single-run baselines, and matches a split-conformal baseline without a held-out calibration set. A cross-benchmark validation on SWE-bench (50 tasks, 1,000 runs) preserves the consistency hierarchy while revealing an ~8x spread in mean trajectory length across models, and bootstrap analysis shows single-run evaluations misrank models 29.3% of the time.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Statistical Frameworks for Uncertainty in Agentic Systems. 12 pages, 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究了同一LLM代理在相同输入下多次运行时行为不一致的现象，发现这种不一致性可作为无需训练的黑盒不确定性信号。通过在4个模型上对200个HotpotQA问题进行8000次运行，发现一致性任务（最多2条路径）准确率82-87%，不一致任务（4条以上路径）准确率41-65%；利用该信号进行选择性预测（k=3一致时输出）达到87-88%准确率，覆盖率54-62%，比单次运行基线提升6-14pp。在SWE-bench上验证了跨模型的一致性层次。
Motivation: 当前LLM代理对相同输入可能产生多种行为序列，这种内部不一致性未被系统利用，论文将其作为一种无需训练的不确定性信号用于提高代理可靠性。
Method: 多次运行同一LLM代理（如10次），统计输出行为序列的多样性（独特路径数），作为不确定性度量；基于该信号实现选择性分类（仅当多次运行结果一致时输出）以及分布自由校准。
Result: 在HotpotQA上，一致性任务准确率82-87%，不一致任务41-65%；选择性预测（k=3一致）准确率87-88%，覆盖率54-62%，比单次运行基线提升6-14pp，且匹配无需校准集的split-conformal基线。AUROC为0.62-0.78。在SWE-bench上，一致性层次保持，但模型间平均轨迹长度相差约8倍。
Conclusion: 行为一致性是一种有效的无需训练的不确定性信号，可用于提升LLM代理的可靠性和选择性预测，但存在计算开销和模型差异等局限性。

papers.title: Convergence Rates for Distribution Matching with Sliced Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We study the slice-matching scheme, an efficient iterative method for distribution matching based on sliced optimal transport. We investigate convergence to the target distribution and derive quantitative non-asymptotic rates. To this end, we establish Lojasiewicz-type inequalities for the Sliced-Wasserstein objective. A key challenge is to control along the trajectory the constants in these inequalities. We show that this becomes tractable for Gaussian distributions. Specifically, eigenvalues are controlled when matching along random orthonormal bases at each iteration. We complement our theory with numerical experiments and illustrate the predicted dependence on dimension and step-size, as well as the stabilizing effect of orthonormal-basis sampling.
papers.journal_ref: Conference On Learning Theory (COLT 2026), Jun 2026, San Diego, United States
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于切片最优传输 (sliced optimal transport) 的分布匹配迭代方法——切片匹配 (slice-matching) 的收敛性，推导了非渐近收敛速率。通过建立切片-瓦瑟斯坦目标函数的 Lojasiewicz 型不等式，并控制轨迹上的常数，在高斯分布情况下证明了特征值在随机正交基匹配时可控。数值实验验证了维度、步长的依赖关系以及正交基采样的稳定效果。
Motivation: 现有切片最优传输方法在分布匹配任务中缺乏理论收敛保证，特别是缺少非渐近速率和迭代过程中的常数控制。
Method: 推导切片匹配迭代的收敛速度，依赖于 Lojasiewicz 型不等式，并通过对高斯分布的分析展示如何控制不等式中的常数（利用随机正交基采样）。
Result: 给出了切片匹配方法收敛的非渐近速率，并在高斯分布上理论验证了维度与步长的影响，实验证实了正交基采样的稳定作用。
Conclusion: 本文提供了切片匹配方法收敛性的理论基础，但理论分析主要限于高斯分布，更一般分布的收敛性有待未来工作。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: With Argus Eyes: Assessing Retrieval Gaps via Uncertainty Scoring to Detect and Remedy Retrieval Blind Spots
papers.abstract_en: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems depend fundamentally on the retriever's ability to find relevant information. We show that neural retrievers used in RAG systems have blind spots, which we define as the failure to retrieve entities that are relevant to the query, but have low similarity to the query embedding. We investigate the training-induced biases that cause such blind spot entities to be mapped to inaccessible parts of the embedding space, resulting in low retrievability. Using a large-scale dataset constructed from Wikidata relations and first paragraphs of Wikipedia, and our proposed Retrieval Probability Score (RPS), we show that blind spot risk in standard retrievers (e.g., CONTRIEVER, REASONIR) can be predicted pre-index from entity embedding geometry, avoiding expensive retrieval evaluations. To address these blind spots, we introduce ARGUS, a pipeline that enables the retrievability of high-risk (low-RPS) entities through targeted document augmentation from a knowledge base (KB), first paragraphs of Wikipedia, in our case. Extensive experiments on BRIGHT, IMPLIRET, and RAR-B show that ARGUS achieves consistent improvements across all evaluated retrievers (averaging +3.4 nDCG@5 and +4.5 nDCG@10 absolute points), with substantially larger gains in challenging subsets. These results establish that preemptively remedying blind spots is critical for building robust and trustworthy RAG systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）系统中神经检索器的盲点问题，即无法检索与查询相关但嵌入相似度低的实体。作者通过Wikidata关系和维基百科首段构建大规模数据集，提出检索概率分数（RPS）来预测盲点风险，并引入ARGUS流水线，通过知识库定向文档增强来修复高风险实体的可检索性。实验在BRIGHT、IMPLIRET和RAR-B基准上显示，ARGUS在所有评估检索器上平均提升nDCG@5 3.4个绝对点和nDCG@10 4.5个绝对点。
Motivation: RAG系统依赖检索器找到相关信息，但神经检索器存在盲点，即无法检索到与查询嵌入相似度低但相关的实体，这源于训练导致的偏见使这些实体映射到嵌入空间的不可及区域。
Method: 提出检索概率分数（RPS）基于实体嵌入几何预测盲点风险，无需昂贵检索评估；并设计ARGUS流水线，通过知识库（本文使用维基百科首段）对高风险（低RPS）实体进行定向文档增强。
Result: 在BRIGHT、IMPLIRET和RAR-B基准上，ARGUS在所有评估检索器（CONTRIEVER、REASONIR等）上实现一致提升，平均nDCG@5和nDCG@10分别提高3.4和4.5绝对点，在困难子集上增益更大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预先主动修复盲点对于构建稳健可信的RAG系统至关重要。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Leveraging Differentiable PDE Solvers for Semi-Neural Spatial Reconstruction From Sparse Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Generating dense physical fields from sparse measurements is a fundamental question in sampling, signal processing, and many other applications. State-of-the-art approaches to this problem either rely on spatial statistics that ignore the governing physics, integrate the physics into a multiple-objective optimization process, or require examples of the complete, fully-resolved simulation state during training, which are frequently unavailable outside of synthetic benchmarks. Here, we present a novel alternative that leverages recent advances in the integration of numerical simulators with data-driven models. Namely, we propose a hybrid modeling pipeline that couples Radial Basis Function (RBF) reconstruction with a Neural Network (NN) correction and a Partial Differential Equation (PDE) solver, so that the numerical simulator itself is embedded directly in the training loop of the learned component. Notably, the NN is trained without assuming availability of examples of the fully-resolved simulation state. This is made possible by implementing the PDE solver so that it is end-to-end differentiable, allowing gradients to be backpropagated through the simulation step during training. This grey-box methodology is evaluated on three standard benchmarks from fluid mechanics, where it achieves superior results over statistical and machine-learning-based reconstruction methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合建模流水线，将径向基函数（RBF）重建与神经网络（NN）校正以及可微偏微分方程（PDE）求解器耦合，使数值模拟器直接嵌入学习组件的训练循环。该方法无需完整的仿真状态示例即可训练NN，并利用可微PDE求解器的端到端梯度反向传播。在流体力学三个标准基准上，该方法优于统计和机器学习重建方法。
Motivation: 现有从稀疏测量重建密集物理场的方法要么忽略物理规律，要么需要完整的仿真状态示例（在合成基准之外常不可得），要么依赖多目标优化。本文旨在利用可微PDE求解器实现端到端训练，降低对完整状态数据的依赖。
Method: 提出半神经空间重建流水线，包括三步：先进行RBF插值作为初步重建，再通过NN校正，最后将校正后的场输入可微PDE求解器。整个流水线端到端可微，通过最小化PDE求解器输出与稀疏观测之间的损失来训练NN，无需完整仿真状态。
Result: 在三个流体力学标准基准上，该方法在重建精度上优于统计方法和纯机器学习方法。具体数值未在摘要中给出，但声称取得“superior results”。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该灰箱方法有效融合了物理模拟与数据驱动模型，但未讨论局限性或扩展性。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: Policy of Thoughts: Scaling Test-Time Training for LLM Reasoning via Online Policy Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) struggle with complex, long-horizon reasoning due to instability caused by their frozen policy assumption. Current test-time scaling methods treat execution feedback merely as an external signal for filtering or rewriting trajectories, without internalizing it to improve the underlying reasoning strategy. Inspired by Popper's epistemology of "conjectures and refutations," we argue that intelligence requires real-time evolution of the model's policy through learning from failed attempts. We introduce Policy of Thoughts (PoT), a framework that recasts reasoning as a within-instance online optimization process. PoT first generates diverse candidate solutions via an efficient exploration mechanism, then uses Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to update a transient LoRA adapter based on execution feedback. This closed-loop design enables dynamic, instance-specific refinement of the model's reasoning priors. Experiments show that PoT dramatically boosts performance: a 4B model achieves 49.71% accuracy on LiveCodeBench, outperforming GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3 despite being over 50 smaller.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Policy of Thoughts (PoT)框架，将LLM推理转化为实例内的在线优化过程，通过生成候选解并用GRPO更新LoRA适配器，实现策略的动态演化。实验表明4B模型在LiveCodeBench上达到49.71%准确率，超越GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3。
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法将执行反馈仅作为外部信号，未内化以改进推理策略，导致复杂长程推理不稳定。受波普尔认识论启发，提出需通过失败尝试实时进化策略。
Method: PoT先通过高效探索生成多样化候选解，再利用GRPO基于执行反馈更新瞬态LoRA适配器，形成闭环在线优化，实现实例特定的推理先验动态调整。
Result: 4B模型在LiveCodeBench上达49.71%准确率，性能超过GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3，且模型规模小50倍以上。
Conclusion: PoT展示了通过在线策略演化可显著提升LLM复杂推理能力，且计算效率高。

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Action Rebinding Attacks against Android GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal model powered GUI agents are emerging as high-privilege operators on mobile platforms, entrusted to perceive screen content and inject inputs across application boundaries. While these agents aim to automate complex tasks, we demonstrate that their design introduces a fundamental conflict with Android's strict application sandboxing. We present a novel cross-application Action Rebinding attack, which allows a malicious application with zero dangerous permissions to hijack the agent's execution and perform privileged operations on behalf of the attacker. Our attack exploits the inevitable observation-action gap inherent in the agent's reasoning pipeline. A malicious app can render a benign ``contextual carrier'' to elicit a planned action, and then swap the foreground to a sensitive target application during the reasoning latency. The agent, unaware of the transition, unwittingly executes the action in the privileged context. We further advance this attack by weaponizing the agent's own task-recovery logic to create programmable, multi-step exploit loops , and introducing an Intent Alignment Strategy (IAS) that manipulates the agent's reasoning to rationalize the hijacked state. We evaluate our attack on six widely-used Android GUI agents. Our results demonstrate a 100% success rate for atomic action hijacking and the ability to orchestrate high-impact exploits, including unauthorized file deletion, SMS transmission, and app uninstallation, without the attacker holding any corresponding permissions. Furthermore, since the malicious application separates intent from capability and contains no privileged API calls, it achieves a 0% detection rate across commercial malware scanners (e.g., VirusTotal), highlighting a critical blind spot in current mobile security analysis. To access experimental logs and demonstration videos, please contact yi_qian@smail.nju.edu.cn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对Android GUI代理的跨应用Action Rebinding攻击。攻击利用代理推理过程中的观察-动作间隙，使恶意应用无需任何权限即可劫持代理执行特权操作。在六种主流Android GUI代理上，原子动作劫持成功率达100%，可执行未授权文件删除、短信发送、应用卸载等攻击。此外，恶意应用因不含特权API调用，在VirusTotal等商用扫描器中检测率为0%。
Motivation: 大模型驱动的GUI代理作为高权限操作者，其设计引入了与Android严格应用沙箱的根本冲突，现有安全机制无法防御此类攻击。
Method: 攻击者首先展示一个良性“上下文载体”诱使代理规划动作，然后在推理延迟期间将前景切换到敏感目标应用，代理无意识地在特权上下文中执行动作。进一步利用代理的任务恢复逻辑创建可编程多步利用循环，并引入Intent Alignment Strategy操纵代理推理以合理化被劫持状态。
Result: 在六种Android GUI代理上，原子动作劫持100%成功；实现了未授权文件删除、短信发送、应用卸载等高影响攻击；恶意应用在VirusTotal等扫描器上检测率为0%。
Conclusion: 该攻击揭示了移动安全分析的一个关键盲点：恶意应用通过分离意图与能力、避免特权API调用，可完全绕过当前检测。需要重新设计GUI代理的安全防护机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attentive multilayer fusion for vision transformers
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of large-scale foundation models, efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains a central challenge. Linear probing, which freezes the backbone and trains a lightweight head, is computationally efficient but often restricted to last-layer representations. We show that task-relevant information is distributed across the network hierarchy rather than encoded solely in the last layers. To leverage this distribution of information, we apply an attentive probing mechanism that dynamically fuses representations from all layers of a Vision Transformer. This attentive layer fusion (ALF) learns to identify the most relevant layers for a target task and combines low-level structural cues with high-level semantic abstractions. Across 20 diverse datasets and multiple pretrained foundation models, ALF achieves consistent, substantial gains over standard linear probes. Attention heatmaps further reveal that tasks different from the pre-training domain benefit most from intermediate representations. Overall, our findings underscore the value of intermediate layers and demonstrate a principled, task-aware approach for unlocking their potential for probing-based adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉Transformer中线性探测（linear probing）只利用最后一层表示的问题，提出注意力层融合（ALF）机制，动态融合所有层的表示，学习识别与目标任务最相关的层，结合低层结构线索和高层语义抽象。在20个数据集和多个预训练基础模型上，ALF相对于标准线性探测取得一致且显著的提升。注意力热图显示，与预训练领域不同的任务从中层表示获益最大。
Motivation: 线性探测冻结骨干网络，只训练轻量级头部，但局限于最后一层表示，而任务相关信息分布在整个网络层次中。
Method: 提出注意力层融合（ALF）机制，动态融合所有层的表示，学习识别最相关层，结合低层结构和高层语义。
Result: 在20个多样数据集和多个预训练基础模型上，ALF相对于标准线性探测取得一致且显著的增益。注意力热图表明，与预训练领域不同的任务从中层表示获益最大。
Conclusion: 强调中间层的价值，展示了面向任务的原则性方法来解锁探测适应中的潜力。
