papers.title: SARFA: Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated strong generalizability across a variety of segmentation tasks. However, SAM often struggles in situations where the target to be segmented is ambiguous. This poses a problem in medical imaging, where accurate delineation of targets such as tumors is vital, but even expert radiologists can disagree on the appropriate boundary for a target. Addressing this, we propose SARFA (Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment), a novel framework for improved medical image segmentation. Via probabilistic prompting, SARFA generates a diverse set of plausible masks for each input image and optimizes them with a radiomics-driven training objective based on Fréchet Radiomic Distance (FRD) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). By minimizing the FRD between masked predicted and ground truth regions within each image, SARFA encourages segmentation outputs whose anatomical and textural characteristics align with clinically meaningful ground truth representations, without relying solely on pixel-level overlap. Evaluated on computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) benchmarks, SARFA outperforms existing ambiguous segmentation methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of radiomic feature alignment and DPO-style candidate mask ranking as a training objective. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbwa233/SARFA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SARFA框架，通过概率提示（probabilistic prompting）生成多样化掩码，并利用基于Fréchet Radiomic Distance (FRD)和Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)的放射组学驱动训练目标优化医学图像分割。在CT和MRI基准上，SARFA优于现有模糊分割方法，验证了放射组学特征对齐和DPO排序训练目标的有效性。
Motivation: SAM在医学图像分割中常因目标边界模糊而产生歧义，专家放射科医师也可能对病灶边界有不同意见，亟需一种能处理歧义且符合临床特征的分割方法。
Method: 提出SARFA框架：通过概率提示生成多个合理掩码，使用Fréchet Radiomic Distance (FRD)衡量预测与真实掩码的放射组学特征距离，并结合Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)对候选掩码排序优化，不依赖像素级重叠。
Result: 在CT和MRI医学图像分割基准上，SARFA优于现有模糊分割方法，表明放射组学特征对齐和DPO训练目标的有效性。
Conclusion: SARFA通过放射组学特征对齐和DPO排序，提升了SAM在医学图像模糊分割中的表现，但未提及在非医学领域的适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adapting Generalist Vehicle Models for High-Speed MPC Across Terrains
papers.abstract_en: High-speed off-road autonomy requires precise closed-loop control for a target vehicle while remaining robust across changing terrains. Recent forward kinodynamic (FKD) prediction foundation models suggest a promising path, starting from a generalist model and specializing it to the target platform. However, effective specialization remains challenging, as it often requires substantial real-world data, and models adapted to one setting can still overfit to specific terrains or driving regimes. We present OptCar (Optimized Car), a recipe for bridging the gap from generalist to specialist FKD models that preserves cross-terrain generalization while optimizing performance for a specific vehicle. $\texttt{OptCar}$ introduces a history-conditioned dynamics adaptation module that encodes recent state-action observations into a dynamics context token, and then fine-tunes the generalist model using limited real-world data together with targeted synthetic rollouts from environment-specific system identification. In closed-loop model predictive control (MPC) experiments across three terrains and an out-of-distribution cart-pulling task, the largest gains appear at 6~m/s, the highest speed evaluated and the regime in which slip dominates tracking error. On vegetation and dirt, the most slip-diverse terrain, OptCar reduces 6~m/s trajectory tracking error by roughly 55% relative to a fine-tuned AnyCar baseline, and remains the most accurate even when an unseen cart payload changes the dynamics. With only 5 minutes of real data per terrain, OptCar is competitive on road with a specialist trained on 30 minutes of road data, and substantially outperforms it once the terrain changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OptCar框架，将通用前向动力学（FKD）基础模型适配到特定高速越野车辆，保持跨地形泛化能力的同时优化性能。通过引入历史条件动力学适配模块和环境特定系统辨识的合成轨迹，OptCar在植被和泥土等滑移显著的地形上，6米/秒的轨迹跟踪误差相比微调AnyCar基线降低约55%，且仅需每地形5分钟真实数据即可在道路上与30分钟数据训练的专家模型竞争。
Motivation: 高速越野自主驾驶需要精确的闭环控制，但将通用动力学模型适配到特定车辆时，常需大量真实数据且易过拟合于特定地形或驾驶模式。
Method: OptCar包含历史条件动力学适配模块，将近期状态-动作观测编码为动力学上下文令牌，然后利用有限真实数据和环境特定系统辨识生成的目标合成轨迹对通用模型进行微调。
Result: 在三个地形和拖车任务中，OptCar在6米/秒最高速度下，植被和泥土地形上轨迹跟踪误差较AnyCar降低约55%；拖车任务中仍保持最高精度；仅需5分钟真实数据即可在道路上与30分钟数据训练的专家竞争。
Conclusion: OptCar展示了利用少量真实数据和合成轨迹将通用动力学模型高效适配为特定车辆专家模型的能力，保持跨地形泛化并降低数据需求。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出OptCar框架，将通用前向动力学（FKD）基础模型适配到特定高速越野车辆，保持跨地形泛化能力的同时优化性能。通过引入历史条件动力学适配模块和环境特定系统辨识的合成轨迹，OptCar在植被和泥土等滑移显著的地形上，6米/秒的轨迹跟踪误差相比微调AnyCar基线降低约55%，且仅需每地形5分钟真实数据即可在道路上与30分钟数据训练的专家模型竞争。

papers.title: Reflecting Process Expertise in Procedural Material Generation
papers.abstract_en: Procedural material creation underpins applications in digital content creation, visual effects, and 3D asset design. Achieving high-quality results requires more than reproducing node graphs -- it demands understanding the process by which experts construct materials. We formulate procedural material generation as retrieval-time process reasoning over expert demonstrations, elevating process to a first-class representation beyond graph-only synthesis. Concretely, we represent expert workflows as process traces: textual records of construction steps, parameters, and design intent. To instantiate this idea, we use a pretrained LLM-based ProcessSynthesizer to synthesize a process trace aligned with a user's intent and a pretrained LLM-based Compiler to ground the process trace into an executable Blender material graph. Because procedural expertise is most naturally conveyed through demonstrations, we leverage tutorial videos as a source of process knowledge and extract textual, LLM-compatible traces using automated video analysis tools. In an expert study with five Blender artists (avg. 7.5 years of experience), materials generated by reflecting expert demonstrations were found to produce workflows requiring fewer edits, and more closely match professional design strategies than methods operating solely on static artifacts. A user study with 150 participants further shows that our approach achieves superior generation and editing performance compared to prior procedural systems. All code, models, and data will be available at https://materialapprentice.github.io
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://materialapprentice.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将程序化材质生成建模为检索时的过程推理（process reasoning），通过专家演示中的过程痕迹（process traces）来指导材质图生成。使用预训练的LLM-based ProcessSynthesizer合成与用户意图对齐的过程痕迹，再由预训练的LLM-based Compiler将其转换为可执行的Blender材质图。专家研究发现该方法生成的材质工作流需更少编辑，且更符合专业设计策略；150人用户研究显示其在生成和编辑性能上优于之前的程序化系统。
Motivation: 现有程序化材质生成仅关注节点图的复制，忽略了专家构建材质时的过程知识，导致生成结果缺乏可编辑性和设计意图的传递。
Method: 从教程视频中自动提取文本化的过程痕迹（construction steps, parameters, design intent），使用两个预训练LLM：ProcessSynthesizer将用户意图转为过程痕迹，Compiler将痕迹转换为Blender材质图。
Result: 专家研究（5名Blender艺术家，平均7.5年经验）表明，该方法生成的工作流需更少编辑；150人用户研究中，生成和编辑性能优于先前程序化系统。
Conclusion: 强调过程作为一等表征（first-class representation）对于程序化材质生成的重要性，并展示了利用专家演示视频作为知识源的有效性。

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models for Discrete Choice Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) generate predictions on structured data via in-context learning, without task-specific estimation. We ask whether TFMs can be effectively applied to discrete choice, a central demand estimation framework in marketing and operations, and find that directly applying TFMs yields limited performance. The gap is structural: TFMs assume row-independent observations, whereas discrete choice is inherently set-valued and subject to persistent consumer preference heterogeneity. We propose a reformulation that encodes both choice-set dependence and individual heterogeneity within a row-based learning framework. Evaluated on a yogurt scanner panel, individual-level heterogeneity encoding is the dominant driver of predictive accuracy. The best reformulation outperforms hierarchical Bayesian estimation by 8\% in holdout log-likelihood and 3.6\% in hit rate, running 16 times faster, a practical advantage for large-scale demand estimation. The advantage is largest in the medium-data regime (10--40 purchase occasions per consumer), where parametric Bayesian shrinkage most distorts estimates for atypical consumers. Fine-tuning on population choice data provides additional gains for consumers with shallow purchase histories, where in-context learning has limited individual-specific signal to condition on. These results establish a principled approach for applying foundation models to consumer choice problems more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将表格基础模型（TFM）应用于离散选择估计，发现直接应用效果有限，因为TFM假设行独立而离散选择具有选择集依赖和消费者异质性。作者提出一种重新表述，将选择集依赖和个体异质性编码到行学习框架中，并在酸奶扫描面板数据上验证。最佳方法在留出对数似然上比分层贝叶斯估计提升8%，命中率提升3.6%，计算速度快16倍。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在结构化数据上通过上下文学习预测，但离散选择估计是市场营销和运营中的核心需求估计框架，直接应用TFM效果不佳，原因是结构不匹配：TFM假设行独立，而离散选择是集合值的且存在持久消费者偏好异质性。
Method: 提出一种重新表述，将选择集依赖和个体异质性编码到基于行的学习框架中，使得TFM能够处理离散选择的特征。
Result: 在酸奶扫描面板数据上，个体异质性编码是预测精度的主要驱动因素；最佳重新表述在留出对数似然上优于分层贝叶斯估计8%，命中率高3.6%，运行速度快16倍。优势在中等数据场景（每消费者10-40次购买）最大，微调能进一步帮助购买历史短的消费者。
Conclusion: 该工作为将基础模型应用于消费者选择问题建立了原则性方法，尤其在大规模需求估计中具有实用优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accuracy Without Grounding: Diagnosing Visual Dependency Dissociation in Video LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark accuracy in video large language models (LLMs) is often treated as evidence of visual understanding. We audit this assumption across twenty models spanning 2-78B parameters and ten architecture families. We introduce the Visual Dependency Gap (VDG), the difference in per-question correctness between original-video and black-screen conditions. Paired McNemar tests on MVBench show that accuracy and visual dependency are separable: models differ on original video (p = 0.0003) but not on black screens (p = 0.53). Across models, task-type rankings are stable: Attribute Perception is strongly visual, whereas Temporal Reasoning approaches the language-only baseline. A diagnostic ladder from black screen to single frame, shuffled frames, and original video reveals that frame diversity supplies most of the visual benefit, while temporal order contributes near-zero accuracy across sixteen open-weight models. An ablation from 0.5 to 24 FPS rules out sparse sampling as the cause. H.264 experiments further show that stable aggregate accuracy conceals bidirectional question-level answer flips. The diagnostic also generalizes to four API-accessed models, whose VDG values range from 0.025 to 0.315. These results motivate VDG as a standard audit for whether video benchmarks measure visually grounded capability. Code is available at https://github.com/JaeLee18/accuracy-without-grounding.
papers.comment: Accepted, ACM International Conference on Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地审计了视频大语言模型（Video LLM）在基准测试中的准确率是否真正反映视觉理解。作者提出“视觉依赖差距”（VDG），即模型在原始视频与黑屏条件下每道题正确率的差异，并通过McNemar检验在MVBench上发现：模型在原始视频上表现有显著差异，但在黑屏条件下无差异。研究还通过从黑屏到单帧、打乱帧、原始视频的诊断阶梯表明，帧多样性提供了大部分视觉收益，而时间顺序贡献极小。实验覆盖20个模型（2-78B参数）及API模型，VDG值范围0.025-0.315。
Motivation: 当前视频LLM基准测试的准确率常被视为视觉理解的证据，但可能混杂语言先验或其他非视觉因素，缺乏对视觉依赖性的直接诊断。
Method: 引入Visual Dependency Gap (VDG)，即在黑屏和原始视频条件下模型正确率之差；采用配对McNemar检验进行统计显著性比较；构建诊断阶梯（黑屏→单帧→打乱帧→原始视频）分析视觉收益来源；并控制帧率（0.5-24 FPS）排除稀疏采样影响。
Result: 在MVBench上，模型在原始视频条件下差异显著（p=0.0003），而在黑屏条件下不显著（p=0.53）。属性感知任务强依赖视觉，时间推理接近纯语言基线。帧多样性贡献视觉收益的大部分，时间顺序几乎无增益。H.264实验发现聚合准确率稳定但存在双向答案翻转。
Conclusion: VDG可作为视频基准是否真正测量视觉基础能力的标准审计工具。代码开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faithful Autoformalization of Natural Language Assertions
papers.abstract_en: Formal contracts are essential for software testing and verification, yet writing them remains labor-intensive and error-prone. LLMs offer a promising path toward autoformalization: synthesizing executable assertions from natural-language specifications and thereby bridging the gap between informal developer intent and formal executable specifications. We present Monty: an autoformalization framework for assertions that tackles the challenges of expectations of validity of assertions and ambiguity in natural-language. Our techniques are based on filtering formalizations using a novel conformance score metric and validity scores obtained from testing the code against formalized assertions. We evaluate our approach on 541 assertion-generation tasks derived from 22 collection-like Java classes, and show that our technique produces the ground truth more reliably (improving upto 20 points in precision on average) than when using LLMs naively to translate assertions.
papers.comment: Code, data, and resources are publicly available for research purposes: https://github.com/Lhtie/llms-for-assertions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Monty框架，用于从自然语言规范自动生成形式化断言（autoformalization）。该方法通过一致性评分和从测试代码获得的合法性分数来过滤LLM生成的断言，在541个Java类断言生成任务上将精确率提升高达20个百分点。
Motivation: 形式化合约对软件测试和验证至关重要，但手工编写既费力又易错。LLM虽可自动形式化自然语言规范，但生成的断言往往不合法或存在歧义。
Method: 提出Monty框架，包含两个关键组件：新颖的一致性评分（conformance score）度量，以及通过对代码进行测试得到的合法性分数（validity score），用于过滤LLM生成的断言。
Result: 在从22个Java集合类派生的541个断言生成任务上，该技术比直接使用LLM翻译的基线方法在平均精确率上提升最多20个百分点，并更可靠地生成真实断言。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了通过结合一致性和合法性评分可以显著提升自动形式化断言的可靠性，但未提及在更广泛代码库或其它语言上的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Medical Image Generative Models with Fréchet Distance Loss
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion generative models have demonstrated immense potential for synthetic medical image generation. However, these models often struggle to capture complex morphological characteristics of heterogeneous tumors with irregular boundaries, limiting their utility for downstream clinical tasks such as segmentation. This limitation stems from the standard denoising objective: minimizing a per-pixel error, which smooths high-variance irregular structures characteristic of tumors. To address this, we propose finetuning these generative models with Fréchet Distance loss (FD-loss). FD-loss aligns the first and second order feature statistics of real and generated images in a pretrained encoder space, encouraging the generator to capture complex structural variations characteristic of heterogeneous tumors. We integrate FD-loss across diverse architectural settings, using both natural- and medical-image encoders on multiple liver and brain cancer datasets spanning CT and MRI modalities. Downstream segmentation networks trained on our FD-regularized synthetic data consistently achieve superior performance, improving tumor DSC by $>$$5\%$ over unregularized synthetic augmentation alone. Qualitative analysis suggests these gains are associated with more faithful tumor synthesis and fewer segmentation hallucinations. Our results show FD-loss as an effective regularizer for medical image generative models to improve clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用Fréchet距离损失（FD-loss）微调扩散生成模型，以改善医学图像中对异质肿瘤的合成质量。该损失对齐真实与生成图像在预训练编码器空间中的一阶和二阶特征统计，使生成器捕捉复杂结构变化。在多个肝和脑癌数据集（CT和MRI）上，使用FD损失正则化的合成数据训练的下游分割网络，肿瘤DSC提升超过5%，并减少分割幻觉。
Motivation: 标准扩散模型使用每像素误差最小化，会平滑肿瘤的高方差不规则结构，导致生成图像无法捕捉异质肿瘤的复杂形态特征，限制了在分割等临床任务中的效用。
Method: 在扩散模型微调阶段引入Fréchet距离损失（FD-loss），对齐真实和生成图像在预训练编码器（自然图像或医学图像）中的一阶和二阶特征统计。该损失可集成到多种架构设置中。
Result: 在多个肝和脑癌数据集（CT和MRI）上，使用FD-loss正则化生成的数据训练下游分割网络，肿瘤Dice相似系数（DSC）提升超过5%，定性分析表明肿瘤合成更真实，分割幻觉减少。
Conclusion: FD-loss可作为医学图像生成模型的有效正则化方法，改善临床工作流。

summary_sections.motivation: 标准扩散模型使用每像素误差最小化，会平滑肿瘤的高方差不规则结构，导致生成图像无法捕捉异质肿瘤的复杂形态特征，限制了在分割等临床任务中的效用。
summary_sections.method: 在扩散模型微调阶段引入Fréchet距离损失（FD-loss），对齐真实和生成图像在预训练编码器（自然图像或医学图像）中的一阶和二阶特征统计。该损失可集成到多种架构设置中。
summary_sections.result: 在多个肝和脑癌数据集（CT和MRI）上，使用FD-loss正则化生成的数据训练下游分割网络，肿瘤Dice相似系数（DSC）提升超过5%，定性分析表明肿瘤合成更真实，分割幻觉减少。
summary_sections.conclusion: FD-loss可作为医学图像生成模型的有效正则化方法，改善临床工作流。

papers.title: FOLIO: Focused Semantic Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: In online streaming video understanding, a video stream continues to arrive and queries may be issued at any time. Because streaming frames grow without bound, the system must continuously compress and retain information from the observed video prefix while future frames and future queries remain unknown. The core challenge is deciding what information to retain and how to organize the maintained history: as this history grows with the stream, memory cost increases and many redundant visual details are retained, whereas later queries often depend on specific entities, actions, and their temporal changes. To address this challenge, we introduce FOLIO, a training-free focused semantic memory system that records important parts of the stream in higher detail while keeping surrounding context compact. As the stream arrives, FOLIO updates memory at the segment level, guided by a dynamic focus state, combining a short-term visual buffer with a long-term semantic memory organized around observed entities and linked to a visual-evidence cache. At query time, lightweight hybrid retrieval combines direct matching over the structured memory with semantic query expansion. FOLIO achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 82.0/69.1 Perception/Backward accuracy on OVO-Bench with Qwen3-VL-8B and 74.5 overall accuracy on StreamingBench, while substantially reducing the cost of maintaining streaming memory by reserving detailed records for focused entities and storing surrounding context compactly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOLIO 提出了一种无需训练的聚焦语义记忆系统，用于在线流视频理解。该系统通过动态焦点状态，在段级别更新记忆，结合短期视觉缓冲和以实体为中心的长期语义记忆以及视觉证据缓存，在查询时使用轻量级混合检索。在 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上取得了当前最优性能，同时大幅降低了流式记忆的维护成本。
Motivation: 在线流视频理解中，视频流无限增长，系统需要持续压缩和保留信息，但现有方法保留了大量冗余视觉细节，而后续查询常依赖特定实体、动作及其时间变化，导致记忆成本高且效率低。
Method: 提出 FOLIO，一个无训练的记忆系统，包含：动态焦点状态指导的段级记忆更新；短期视觉缓冲与长期语义记忆（围绕观察实体组织，链接到视觉证据缓存）；查询时通过轻量级混合检索（结构记忆直接匹配与语义查询扩展）获取信息。
Result: 在 OVO-Bench 上使用 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到 82.0/69.1 的感知/回溯准确率，在 StreamingBench 上达到 74.5 总体准确率，均为当前最优，且大幅降低了记忆维护成本。
Conclusion: FOLIO 通过聚焦关键实体、压缩上下文，有效平衡了流视频理解中的信息保留与记忆成本，且无需训练即可直接应用。

papers.title: Theory-Level Autoformalization: From Isolated Statements to Unified Formal Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: Autoformalization translates informal natural language into formal, machine-verifiable languages. While most work focuses on individual statements, real formalization efforts are inherently theory-level: they require an entire web of axioms, definitions, and lemmas before target theorems can even be stated. In this position paper, we argue for theory-level autoformalization: formalizing complete theories, including all their inter-dependencies, as structured libraries. We examine the significance of this shift, address alternative views, identify open challenges, and propose three promising paths forward. Our survey of autoformalization is available at https://github.com/marcusm117/Awesome-Autoformalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张将自动形式化从孤立语句扩展到完整理论级，即形式化包含公理、定义和引理网络的结构化知识库。论文分析了此转变的意义、挑战，并提出了三条未来研究路径。
Motivation: 现有自动形式化工作仅处理孤立语句，而真实数学形式化需要依赖完整的理论框架；缺乏理论级形式化限制了自动形式化的实用性。
Method: 本文不提出具体方法，而是从宏观角度论证理论级自动形式化的必要性，分析反对观点，识别开放挑战，并建议三个有前景的方向。
Result: 本文未提供实验性结果，为概念性立场论文。
Conclusion: 强调自动形式化研究应从语句级转向理论级，以构建统一的、可验证的形式化知识库。

papers.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
papers.abstract_en: The capability of a modern AI agent depends not only on its foundation model but also on its harness, which constructs prompts, manages state, invokes tools, and coordinates execution. As models, APIs, environments, and requirements evolve, the harness must be continually modified. Before such a change can be made, a developer or coding agent must identify all code locations that implement the target behavior. This is difficult because production harnesses are large, tightly coupled, and behaviorally distributed, while modification requests describe what the system should do and repositories are organized by files and modules. Code search, repository indexing, and long-context processing ease inspection, but still leave this behavior-to-code mapping to be recovered by hand. Behavior localization is therefore a central bottleneck in harness evolution. We introduce the Harness Handbook, a behavior-centric representation synthesized automatically from a harness codebase via static analysis and LLM-assisted structuring, linking each behavior to its corresponding source. We also introduce Behavior-Guided Progressive Disclosure (BGPD), which guides agents from high-level behaviors to relevant implementation details and verifies candidate locations against the current source. On diverse modification requests from two open-source harnesses, Handbook-Assisted planning improves behavior localization and edit-plan quality while using fewer planner tokens, with the largest gains on scattered sites, rarely executed paths, and cross-module interactions. Evolving complex agentic systems thus depends not only on generating edits, but also on determining where those edits should be made.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Harness Handbook，一种从 agent harness 代码库自动合成的行为中心表示，通过静态分析和 LLM 辅助结构组织，将每个行为链接到对应源代码。同时提出行为引导渐进披露（BGPD），引导代理从高层行为到相关实现细节并验证候选位置。在多个修改请求上，该方法提高了行为定位和编辑计划质量，同时使用更少的规划 token。
Motivation: 现代 AI agent 的能力依赖于 harness（构造 prompt、管理状态、调用工具、协调执行），但 harness 代码庞大、紧耦合且行为分散，修改前需要手动定位所有实现目标行为的代码位置，成为演化瓶颈。
Method: 通过静态分析和 LLM 辅助自动合成行为中心表示 Harness Handbook，并引入行为引导渐进披露（BGPD）来引导代理从高层行为到实现细节并验证候选位置。
Result: 在来自两个开源 harness 的多样修改请求上，Handbook 辅助规划提高了行为定位和编辑计划质量，使用更少的规划 token，尤其在分散站点、罕见路径和跨模块交互上提升最大。
Conclusion: 演化复杂 agent 系统不仅需要生成编辑，还需要准确确定编辑位置。

papers.title: Deconstructing Actor-Critic: A Large-scale Empirical Study of Design Components for Practitioners
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is increasingly being considered for controlling real-world systems, from fusion plasma and autonomous vehicles to drug discovery and drinking water treatment, where reliability is essential and tuning budgets are limited. Actor-critic algorithms share a set of design decisions, such as how the policy is updated, how it represents the distribution over actions, how its gradient is estimated, and how often it is updated relative to the value estimator. Using a control task derived from a real water treatment plant, we analyze over 33,000 experiments to determine how these components affect variability across runs and sensitivity to hyperparameters. Common defaults, such as Gaussian action distributions with pathwise gradient estimators, are among the least reliable configurations, whereas bounded distributions with adaptive update schedules remain robust across a wide range of settings. These findings offer empirical guidance to practitioners across scientific and engineering domains for understanding and making component-level decisions when adapting actor-critic methods to new real-world control settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证研究（33,000+实验）分析了Actor-Critic算法中设计组件（策略更新、动作分布、梯度估计、更新频率等）对控制任务性能的影响，使用真实水处理厂的派生控制任务。研究发现常用默认配置（如高斯分布与路径梯度估计）可靠性最差，而有界分布与自适应更新策略在不同超参数下表现稳健。
Motivation: Actor-Critic算法在真实世界控制系统中应用日益广泛，但组件选择对可靠性和调参敏感性的影响缺乏系统理解，尤其在水处理等可靠性要求高、调参预算有限的实际场景下。
Method: 构建了一个基于真实水处理厂的派生控制任务，进行了超过33,000次实验，系统比较了不同动作分布（高斯、有界等）、梯度估计方法（路径梯度、似然比等）、更新频率等设计组件的表现和超参数敏感性。
Result: 常用的高斯动作分布与路径梯度估计组合是最不可靠的配置之一；而有界分布配合自适应更新策略在广泛超参数范围内保持稳健，且运行间变异性显著降低。
Conclusion: 论文为从业者在适应Actor-Critic方法到新真实世界控制场景时，提供了关于组件选择的实证指导，强调了避免某些默认配置、采用更鲁棒的替代方案的重要性。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Differentiable Polarized Path Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Physically based differentiable rendering has proven to be a powerful tool for inverse rendering problems (e.g., 3D reconstruction, reflectance estimation, lighting estimation). However, most existing methods operate solely on radiometric intensity, discarding valuable polarization cues that constrain scene geometry and material properties. While forward simulation of polarized light is well-defined via Mueller-Stokes calculus, extending reverse-mode differentiation to this domain presents significant challenges. The rank-deficient nature of common polarimetric operators, such as linear polarizers and diffuse reflections, violates the invertibility assumptions of standard gradient estimators like path replay backpropagation and results in numerical instability. We address this by proposing a robust, polarization-aware differentiable path tracing method. Our approach estimates unbiased gradients through a combination of path replay and local caching. This formulation enables efficient and stable optimization of material and lighting parameters in complex scenes, broadening the applicability of physically based inverse rendering. Project page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/DPPT/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可微分的偏振路径追踪方法，通过Mueller-Stokes微积分和路径重放反向传播，在考虑偏振信息的情况下实现无偏梯度估计，用于逆渲染中的材质和光照优化。
Motivation: 现有可微渲染方法仅基于辐射强度，丢弃了偏振信息，而偏振能约束几何和材质属性；将反向模式微分扩展到偏振领域存在数值不稳定性问题。
Method: 提出偏振感知的可微分路径追踪，结合路径重放和局部缓存来估计无偏梯度。
Result: 摘要称该方法能在复杂场景下高效稳定地优化材质和光照参数，拓宽了基于物理的逆渲染的应用范围。
Conclusion: 该方法解决了偏振算子秩亏导致的数值不稳定性，提供了稳健的梯度估计，适用于多种逆渲染问题。

papers.title: Discourse-Aware Policy Analysis with Argumentation: A Hybrid LLM-Symbolic Framework for Disaster Governance
papers.abstract_en: Policy documents shape governance outcomes, but their reasoning is often implicit. Participatory commitments and managerial control routinely coexist in the same text, and the tensions between them are rarely stated directly. Existing computational approaches to policy discourse cannot express the frame-mediated relations that drive these tensions, where one argument narrows or instrumentalizes another rather than rejecting it. End-to-end summarization by large language models produces fluent text but offers little structure that domain experts can inspect or contest. We present Apaf, a hybrid LLM--symbolic pipeline that operationalizes critical discourse analysis as a quantitative bipolar argumentation framework over policy text. Arguments are first classified into deliberative or managerial frames. Four frame-mediated relation subtypes (agency reduction, agenda shift, instrumental support, and normative support) are then produced by deterministic rules over LLM-extracted features. We release a novel dataset of 100 sub-documents of disaster-risk-reduction policy from the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia, and show that the resulting argument graphs are accurate, interpretable, and stable across jurisdictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Apaf，一种混合LLM-符号推理流水线，将批评话语分析转化为定量的双极论证框架，用于揭示政策文本中审慎性与管理性框架之间的隐性紧张关系。该方法首先将论点分类为审慎性或管理性框架，再通过确定性规则基于LLM提取的特征生成四种框架中介的关系子类型（机构缩减、议程转移、工具支持、规范支持）。在来自美、英、加、澳四国的100个减灾政策子文档上验证，论证图具有准确性、可解释性和跨司法管辖区的稳定性。
Motivation: 政策文档的推理常隐含，现有计算方法无法表达框架中介的关系，而LLM端到端摘要虽流畅但缺乏可检查的结构，领域专家难以审计。
Method: Apaf流水线：使用LLM进行论点分类（审慎性/管理性），然后应用确定性规则从LLM提取的特征中生成四种框架中介的关系子类型，构建定量双极论证图。
Result: 在100个跨国减灾政策子文档上，生成的论证图在准确性、可解释性和跨辖区的稳定性上均表现良好。
Conclusion: 该混合框架为领域专家提供了可审计的结构化政策分析，能够明确表达政策文本中隐含的框架间紧张关系。

papers.title: AffectFlow-DINO: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Task Affect Estimation via Conditional Rectified Flow
papers.abstract_en: We present \textbf{AffectFlow-DINO}, a multi-task learning system for the 11th ABAW challenge that extends a standard deterministic architecture with a conditional rectified-flow head to model the inherent ambiguity of in-the-wild facial behavior. Instead of predicting a single affect estimate, the model learns a conditional generative distribution, enabling uncertainty-aware one-to-many predictions through Monte Carlo sampling. The system jointly estimates continuous valence-arousal, classifies eight facial expressions, and detects twelve Action Units from static face images. Built on a frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 backbone, extensive ablation studies show that rectified-flow decoding consistently improves deterministic prediction, particularly for valence-arousal estimation (CCC-V $+0.058$). We further show that post-hoc threshold calibration effectively recovers performance on severely imbalanced rare classes (e.g., Fear: $3.8\% \rightarrow 33.1\%$) without retraining. Combined with backbone fine-tuning and flow retuning, the final model achieves $\mathbf{P_{MTL}=1.177}$, substantially outperforming the official challenge baseline of $P_{MTL}=0.45$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AffectFlow-DINO多任务学习系统，用于ABAW挑战，使用条件整流流（conditional rectified flow）头部来建模野外面部行为的固有模糊性。系统联合估计连续效价-唤醒度，分类八种面部表情，并检测十二个动作单元。基于冻结的DINOv3 ViT-S/16骨干网络，消融实验显示整流流解码一致改进确定性预测，特别是效价-唤醒度估计（CCC-V +0.058）。通过事后阈值校准有效恢复严重不平衡的罕见类别的性能（如Fear: 3.8% -> 33.1%）。结合骨干微调和流重调，最终模型达到P_MTL=1.177，显著优于官方基线P_MTL=0.45。
Motivation: 野外面部行为存在固有模糊性，传统的确定性预测不能捕获不确定性，需要不确定性感知的多任务学习系统。
Method: 使用条件整流流（conditional rectified flow）生成分布，通过蒙特卡洛采样实现一对多预测。基于DINOv3 ViT-S/16骨干，扩展多任务头部。
Result: 在ABAW挑战上，效价-唤醒度估计CCC-V提升0.058，罕见类别Fear的准确率从3.8%提升到33.1%，最终P_MTL=1.177。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知整流流解码改善了多任务情感估计，尤其是在模糊和罕见类别上。

papers.title: Reassessing Muon for Matrix Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large-scale deep learning, where it reshapes gradient updates through approximate orthogonalization and has been reported to outperform Adam and AdamW in large language model training. Its empirical success has motivated a growing body of theoretical work that interprets Muon as steepest descent under the spectral norm. Yet it remains unclear which of Muon's advantages stem from its update rule itself and which are artifacts of the scale, architecture, and data of modern deep networks. In this work, we isolate the optimizer from these confounding factors by studying Muon on a simple, well-understood, and spectrally structured problem: low-rank matrix factorization. Through a controlled comparison against carefully tuned adaptive baselines, we find that Muon does not consistently outperform AdamW in this setting and that several previously reported advantages are sensitive to hyperparameter choices. Our results provide a more nuanced picture of when spectrum-aware orthogonalization is beneficial and argue for evaluating modern optimizers on controlled problems in addition to end-to-end benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文在低秩矩阵分解的简单可控问题中重新评估Muon优化器，发现其并不总能优于精心调参的AdamW，且之前报告的优势对超参数敏感。
Motivation: Muon在大规模深度学习中被报道优于Adam和AdamW，但其优势是来自更新规则本身还是深度网络的规模、架构和数据尚不清楚。
Method: 在低秩矩阵分解这一谱结构清晰的问题上，通过控制变量比较Muon与调优的自适应基线。
Result: Muon在此设置下并未持续优于AdamW，且部分先前报告的优势对超参数选择敏感。
Conclusion: 对谱感知正交化何时有益提供了更细致的理解，并主张在端到端基准之外、在受控问题上评估现代优化器。

papers.title: Just-In-Time Scene Graph Growth: Combating Perceptual Saturation in Long-Horizon Robotics
papers.abstract_en: While 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) provide crucial structured representations for embodied agents, conventional Ahead-of-Time, build-everything-then-filter pipelines conflict with the real-time, low-latency demands of edge platforms, inducing a perceptual saturation effect via severe observation redundancy. To resolve this, we present JITOMA (Just-In-Time On-demand Memory Activation), a closed-loop framework that unifies task reasoning, perception, and memory into a just-in-time growth process. Instead of exhaustively mapping the entire environment, JITOMA leverages a top-down task heatmap at the frontend to filter continuous observations, routing minimal streams to maintain a global foundation of low-cost, dormant anchors. Upon a cognitive query, the backend Large Language Model (LLM) parses the robotic intent to dynamically awaken task-relevant anchors, triggering resource-intensive operations -- such as dense node captioning and functional inference -- exclusively within the activated local subgraph. To evaluate these dynamic capabilities and study perceptual saturation trade-offs, we introduce JITOMA-Bench, a comprehensive suite for long-horizon multi-tasking and complex multi-step reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that JITOMA substantially reduces active graph size and captioning latency, while maintaining stable processing time under long-horizon task switching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JITOMA (Just-In-Time On-demand Memory Activation) 框架，用于克服长时域机器人任务中的感知饱和问题。该框架通过前端任务热图过滤连续观测，后端大语言模型 (LLM) 按需唤醒任务相关的场景图节点，仅在激活的子图上执行密集节点描述和功能推理。在 JITOMA-Bench 基准上的实验表明，方法显著减小活跃图大小和描述延迟，并在长时域任务切换下保持稳定处理时间。
Motivation: 传统前馈式（Ahead-of-Time）场景图构建方式在边缘平台上会因观测冗余导致感知饱和，无法满足实时、低延迟要求。
Method: 提出闭环框架 JITOMA，前端利用自上而下的任务热图过滤连续观测，仅维护低成本、休眠的全局锚点；后端 LLM 解析机器人意图后动态唤醒任务相关锚点，仅在激活的局部子图上执行密集描述和功能推理。
Result: 实验表明 JITOMA 大幅减少活跃图大小和描述延迟，在长时域任务切换下保持稳定处理时间。
Conclusion: JITOMA 通过按需增长场景图的方式有效缓解感知饱和，为长时域机器人任务提供实时结构化表示。

papers.title: EMAGN: Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network via Learned Clustering for Scalable Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting is highly challenging due to complex and nonlinear spatial and temporal dependencies. Self-attention mechanisms have been widely adopted to model dynamic and long-range dependencies, achieving state-of-the-art performance, but suffer from limited scalability due to quadratic computational and memory complexity. To address this, we propose an Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network (EMAGN) that linearises the spatial attention mechanism itself, inspired by the theory of fast high-dimensional Gaussian filtering. Two learned clustering matrices C_k and C_v adaptively group key and value vectors into M super-clusters, reducing complexity from O(N^2 d) to O(NMd) without sacrificing the flexibility of attention for dynamic dependency modelling. Experimental results on PEMS-BAY and METR-LA show that EMAGN achieves accuracy within 2.7-3.2% MAE of full-attention GMAN while reducing training time by 32%, inference time by 38%, and GPU memory by 58%. Critically, at K=16 attention heads, full-attention GMAN runs out of memory on a standard 11 GB GPU entirely while EMAGN continues to operate, demonstrating a categorical expansion of feasible model configurations. EMAGN also surpasses Linformer and Performer in both accuracy and efficiency within the same backbone, owing to its traffic-network-aware adaptive clustering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种高效多注意力图网络 (EMAGN)，通过可学习的聚类矩阵将键和值向量分组为超簇，将空间注意力的复杂度从 O(N^2 d) 降至 O(N M d)。在 PEMS-BAY 和 METR-LA 交通预测数据集上，EMAGN 的 MAE 仅比全注意力 GMAN 高 2.7-3.2%，同时训练时间减少 32%、推理时间减少 38%、GPU 内存减少 58%。在 16 个注意力头时，全注意力 GMAN 在标准 11GB GPU 上内存不足，而 EMAGN 仍可运行，显著扩展了可行模型配置。
Motivation: 交通预测中自注意力机制具有二次复杂度，难以扩展到大规模数据。现有线性化注意力方法（如 Linformer、Performer）未针对交通网络结构进行优化。
Method: 受快速高维高斯滤波理论启发，引入两个可学习的聚类矩阵 C_k 和 C_v，将键和值向量自适应地分组为 M 个超簇，实现线性化空间注意力，复杂度假 O(N^2 d) 降至 O(N M d)。
Result: 在 PEMS-BAY 和 METR-LA 上，EMAGN 的 MAE 与全注意力 GMAN 的差距在 2.7-3.2% 以内，但训练时间降低 32%，推理时间降低 38%，GPU 内存降低 58%。当注意力头数 K=16 时，全注意力 GMAN 在 11GB GPU 上内存不足，而 EMAGN 正常运行。
Conclusion: EMAGN 在保持接近全注意力精度的同时大幅提升效率和可扩展性，并在相同骨干网络下优于 Linformer 和 Performer，表明针对交通网络的自适应聚类是有效的。

papers.title: Cost-Optimal Foundation Model Deployment Portfolio for Transportation Management
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), are increasingly used for transportation management center (TMC) tasks such as anomaly detection, incident reporting, and traveler information. Deploying multiple such models across TMC functions raises a portfolio question: which model should serve each function, in which deployment mode, and under what shared hardware budget? We formulate this as the Foundation Model Deployment Portfolio (FMDP) problem, a mixed-integer program minimizing total cost of ownership (TCO) subject to per-function quality, latency, and safety constraints over shared GPU capacity. We prove the problem NP-hard by reduction from the 0-1 knapsack problem and propose a polynomial-time greedy heuristic. In an illustrative case study with five TMC functions and 19 candidate (model, mode) pairs, FMDP identifies a mixed portfolio costing $34/mo (97% below the cheapest feasible all-closed-API baseline) by routing four functions to open-source APIs and the one function whose quality floor no open-source model meets to a closed API. Break-even analysis shows that on-premise GPU investment becomes reasonable only above approximately 309 vision queries/hour or if API prices double.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基础模型部署组合（FMDP）问题，为交通管理中心（TMC）在共享GPU预算下选择模型和部署模式（闭源API、开源API、本地部署）以最小化总拥有成本（TCO）。作者将问题建模为混合整数规划，证明NP难，提出贪心启发式。案例研究显示混合组合（4个开源API+1个闭源API）月成本34美元，比最便宜的纯闭源方案低97%，并给出本地GPU投资的盈亏平衡点。
Motivation: 交通管理中心面临多个基础模型部署选择，需要平衡成本、质量、延迟和安全约束，现有研究缺乏系统性的多模型组合优化框架。
Method: 将FMDP建模为混合整数规划，目标是最小化TCO，约束包括每项功能的质量、延迟和安全要求以及共享GPU容量。证明问题NP难（归约自0-1背包），提出多项式时间贪心启发式。
Result: 在包含5项TMC功能和19个候选（模型，模式）对的案例研究中，FMDP得到的混合组合月成本34美元，比最便宜的纯闭源方案降低97%。盈亏平衡分析表明，只有当视觉查询率超过约309次/小时或API价格翻倍时，本地GPU投资才合理。
Conclusion: 本文首次将多模型部署组合问题形式化，为TMC提供成本优化决策支持，并指出开源API在当前场景下具有显著成本优势，但需注意质量不满足所有功能需求。

papers.title: Active Learning for Efficient Annotation of Surgical Videos with Weak Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Precise spatial-temporal annotation of laparoscopic videos is time-consuming and requires expert knowledge. We propose a human-in-the-loop knowledge acquisition framework that combines active learning with dual-loss optimization to significantly reduce the annotation effort needed for automatic localization and segmentation of objects in the surgical field. Our method employs a foundation model to generate temporally consistent class activation maps (CAMs) from video using two complementary training objectives: a weak supervision loss on video-level tool presence labels for weakly annotated data, and an image-level mask loss on human-corrected annotations obtained through active learning. Rather than requiring dense pixel-level annotation upfront, our pipeline iteratively proposes pseudo-masks that guide the expert annotator to refine the knowledge previously captured by the model. We demonstrate that our framework reduces the effort of surgical video annotation by 50% by the end of training in comparison to fully manual annotation. Through eliminating the need for large, fully annotated datasets from the start, this framework enables scalability to the development of surgical tool segmentation models. This iterative human-in-the-loop refinement supports efficient knowledge acquisition with minimal expert input, providing a practical and deployable strategy for expanding tool segmentation to larger, more diverse datasets and real-world clinical settings.

papers.title: Continuously Evolving Deepfake Detection: An Architecture and Public-Benchmark Evaluation of a Dynamic Detection System
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detectors that achieve near-perfect scores on academic benchmarks collapse on real-world content: recent in-the-wild evaluations report AUC drops of 45-50% for state-of-the-art open-source models. We argue this gap is structural: static detectors are trained once against a moving generative frontier. We present BitMind Forensics (BMF), trained through Bittensor SN34, an open adversarial competition that continually refreshes the training distribution. We evaluate one dated export comprising image, general-video, and human-video checkpoints across nineteen public datasets: the canonical face-swap suites (FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v1/v2/++, DFDC, DFD, UADFV, DF40) and recent in-the-wild and AI-generated-media benchmarks (Sumsub, Deepfake-Eval-2024, WildRF, Community Forensics, AIGCDetectBench, GenImage, AI-GenBench, AIGIBench, RAID, GenVidBench, GenVideo-100K). BMF reaches 0.936 AUC on Sumsub's original images and 0.872 pooled AUC over its full four-condition manipulation battery (1.4M images), staying robust under perturbation (0.855 JPEG, 0.799 downscaled), while GPEN enhancement improves detection (0.996). On Deepfake-Eval-2024, it matches the best commercial detector on images (0.915 vs 0.90) and exceeds it on video (0.822 vs 0.79), far above the best open-source detectors (0.56 and 0.63). It reaches 0.991 AUC on a 21-generator AI-image panel and 0.918 on GenVidBench, and exceeds the FF++-trained frontier on DFDC (0.947 vs 0.843) and Celeb-DF v2 (0.9985 vs 0.956), both contamination-audited, with statistical parity on Celeb-DF++. In a temporal study, successive dated exports improve on held-out media from generators absent from the static baseline's training (image 0.842 to 0.902; video 0.864 to 0.936). Our evaluation harness is public, and at publication the production API serves the exact evaluated snapshot for independent verification.

papers.title: AI-Native Insurance for Agentic AI: Pricing, Underwriting, and End-to-End Automation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI introduces new insurance challenges because autonomous AI systems can make decisions, invoke tools, modify external environments, and interact with third-party services. This paper develops an AI-native mathematical framework for underwriting, pricing, and contract design for agentic AI deployments. A deployment is represented by a risk state that captures autonomy level, operational authority, permission exposure, governance maturity, and dependency concentration. The framework maps the risk state to event probabilities, loss severities, governance costs, premiums, deductibles, coverage allocation, and policy covenants, and formulates an optimization problem for insurance contract design under participation, profitability, and incentive compatibility constraints. The paper establishes structural properties of insurability, including characterization of an insurability region, monotone deterioration of feasibility with increasing exposure, and governance certification thresholds. Insurance is further interpreted as both an operational cost and a regulatory mechanism for AI deployment. A healthcare case study illustrates contract optimization, sensitivity analysis, and automated claims processing for agentic AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主AI系统带来的保险挑战，构建了一个AI原生的数学框架，用于承保、定价和合同设计。框架将部署表示为风险状态，涵盖自主性水平、操作权限、权限暴露、治理成熟度和依赖集中度，并映射到事件概率、损失严重性等变量，优化保险合同设计。论文建立了可保险性的结构性质，并以医疗案例展示了合同优化和自动理赔处理。
Motivation: 自主AI系统能够做出决策、调用工具、修改外部环境并与第三方服务交互，带来了新的保险挑战，现有保险框架难以适应。
Method: 开发了一个AI原生的数学框架，通过风险状态（自主性水平、操作权限等）映射到事件概率、损失严重性、治理成本、保费、免赔额、覆盖分配和政策约定，并在参与、盈利和激励兼容约束下优化保险合同设计。
Result: 建立了可保险性的结构性质，包括可保险区域的表征、可行性随暴露增加单调恶化以及治理认证阈值。医疗案例展示了合同优化、敏感性分析和自动理赔处理。
Conclusion: 保险被解释为AI部署的运营成本和监管机制。框架支持端到端自动化。

papers.title: Audited Selective Verification for Risk-Controlled N-1 Thermal Contingency Screening under Deployment Shift
papers.abstract_en: Real-time N-1 contingency screening in an energy management system trades assurance against cost: verifying every credible outage with full power flow is too slow, while fast linear-sensitivity screening gives no statistical guarantee and can silently pass unsafe operating points, especially when a controller drives the system into unfamiliar regimes. This paper introduces Audited Selective Verification, a risk-budgeted screening and triage layer for any controller's output (optimization, model-predictive, or learned). A cheap surrogate proposes which outages to skip; an online audit runs full power flow on a small random sample each window; and a calibrated threshold certifies a thermal-violation-rate bound for the skipped set at a chosen budget and confidence, with a corresponding bound for the unverified trusted subset. Validity rests on real verification and the audit rather than on surrogate accuracy, so it holds under arbitrary deployment shift. It is a risk-budgeted screen, not a replacement for deterministic verification when policy requires checking every credible contingency. On three public transmission systems up to 1354 buses, the realized violation rate stays within budget, standard deterministic and calibrated screens become unsafe under shift, and the method cuts full power-flow studies by 29 to 75 percent per real-time operating point.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Systems (under review)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出审计选择性验证（Audited Selective Verification）方法，用于电力系统能量管理系统中的实时N-1热约束筛选。该方法通过廉价代理选择跳过部分故障，在线审计随机抽样并校准阈值，在任意部署偏移下保证被跳过故障集的热违规率在有界风险内。在三个公开输电系统（最大1354母线）上，实际违规率保持在预算内，而标准确定性和校准筛选在偏移下不安全，该方法将全潮流计算减少29%-75%。
Motivation: 实时N-1故障筛选在保证安全性与计算成本之间权衡：对每个可信故障进行全潮流验证太慢，而快速线性灵敏度筛选缺乏统计保证，可能在控制器将系统推入陌生工况时无声地通过不安全运行点。
Method: 提出审计选择性验证层，包含三个组件：廉价代理选择跳过哪些故障；在线审计（每个时间窗口随机采样少量故障运行全潮流）；校准阈值，以给定预算和置信度认证被跳过故障集的热违规率上界，同时对未被验证的可信子集给出对应界。有效性基于真实验证和审计而非代理精度，因此适用于任意部署偏移。
Result: 在三个公开输电系统（最大1354母线）上，实际违规率保持在预算内；标准确定性筛选和校准筛选在部署偏移下变得不安全；该方法将每个实时运行点的全潮流计算减少29%-75%。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种风险预算筛选工具，而非替代需要检查每个可信故障的确定性验证。

papers.title: Networked Intelligence: Active Shared Context Graphs for Human-AI Team Science
papers.abstract_en: Most AI-for-science systems focus on scaling a single reasoning process through better models, larger context windows, long-horizon agentic execution, or digital co-scientists working with one principal user. However, challenging scientific problems are rarely solved by one reasoner alone. They are solved by teams whose members bring different priors, experimental backgrounds, tacit knowledge, and domain-trained intuitions. The open problem is therefore not only how to scale models, but how to cultivate networked intelligence: scaling the connections between humans and AI systems so that a result or hypothesis produced in one context reaches another person, agent, instrument, or robot that can act on it. We introduce Mycelium, an active shared workspace that automatically connects researchers and AI agents as a multi-user co-scientist. As human users and agents work, the system captures important observations and hypotheses, tracks how they relate to the team's evolving model, and routes them to the person or agent whose next decision they can inform. We evaluate Mycelium in its first empirical test, a biological multi-omics campaign in which routed shared context turned a local analytical finding into a cross-expert mechanistic constraint and ultimately into an experimental design. We also give networked intelligence a computational account as sparse conditional computation over distributed scientific contexts. This account distinguishes when a scaled standalone agent can match the network from when independent expertise and non-mergeable contexts make the network irreducible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mycelium 系统，一个主动共享上下文图谱，用于支持人类与 AI 代理组成的多用户协作科学研究。系统自动捕获关键观察和假设，追踪它们与团队演化模型的关系，并将信息路由给相关的人或代理。首次在生物多组学战役中测试，路由的共享上下文将局部分析发现转化为跨专家机制约束并最终形成实验设计。
Motivation: 现有 AI-for-science 系统主要扩展单个推理过程，但科学问题往往由多成员团队解决，需要连接不同背景、隐性知识和领域直觉。因此，需要扩展人与人、人与 AI 系统之间的连接，实现网络智能。
Method: 提出 Mycelium 主动共享工作空间，通过构建活动共享上下文图谱，自动捕获和关联研究过程中的观测和假设，并根据上下文关系将信息路由给最需要的人或代理。
Result: 在生物多组学战役中，路由的共享上下文将局部分析发现转化为跨专家机制约束，并进一步转化为实验设计，验证了网络智能的有效性。
Conclusion: 网络智能可以视为分布式科学上下文上的稀疏条件计算，当独立专业知识和不可合并上下文存在时，网络不可被单一大模型替代。

papers.title: CayleyR: Solving the TopSpin puzzle via cycle intersection
papers.abstract_en: We present cayleyR, an R package for solving permutation puzzles by detecting cycle intersections in Cayley graphs. The core algorithm performs an iterative bidirectional search: from both the initial and target permutation states, random operation sequences generate cycles in the Cayley graph of the symmetric group Sn; their intersection yields a connecting path. When no direct intersection is found, a distance-guided bridge selection narrows the gap, and the process repeats. The package targets the TopSpin(n,k) puzzle, whose state space is a Cayley graph of Sn generated by a cyclic shift and a prefix reversal. We describe the mathematical framework, the algorithm, and its implementation, which combines a C++ hash-indexed state store with optional Vulkan GPU acceleration. The software is publicly available on CRAN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个R包cayleyR，通过检测Cayley图中的循环交点来求解排列谜题。算法使用迭代双向搜索，从初始和目标状态随机生成操作序列，寻找循环交点，并用距离引导的桥选择缩小差距。目标应用是TopSpin(n,k)谜题，状态空间是循环置换和前缀反转生成的对称群Cayley图。实现包括C++哈希索引状态存储和可选的Vulkan GPU加速。
Motivation: 排列谜题（如TopSpin）的求解需要高效的状态空间搜索，现有方法可能计算开销大。本文旨在提供一个通用的、基于Cayley图循环交点的求解框架。
Method: 提出迭代双向搜索算法，从初始和目标状态随机生成操作序列，在Cayley图中产生循环，检测循环交点获得路径；若无直接交点，则使用距离引导的桥选择缩小差距并重复。实现包含C++哈希状态存储和Vulkan GPU加速。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数字或基准结果，仅描述了算法和实现。软件已在CRAN公开发布。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个基于Cayley图循环交点的排列谜题求解包，适用于TopSpin谜题，并支持GPU加速。

papers.title: Graph Partitioning with Demands: Generalized Conductance and its Applications
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study various graph partitioning problems under a general demand model. In each such task, we are given a graph $G=(V,E,c,w)$ with a capacity function $c\colon E\to \mathbb{N}$ and a demand function $w\colon V\times V\to \mathbb{N}$. Our main focus is the problem of finding a cut $(S, \bar{S})$ minimizing the quantity \[ ψ_w( S ) = \frac{c( S, \bar{S} )}{w( S, V )\cdot w( \bar{S}, V )}. \] Here, $c( S, \bar{S} )$ is the cost of edges between $S$ and the complement of $S$, $\bar{S}$, and $w( S, V )=w( S )+w( S, \bar{S} )$ is the sum of the internal demand within $S$, $w( S )$, and the demand between vertices of $S$ and $\bar{S}$, $w( S, \bar{S} )$. We call $ψ_w( S )$ the \emph{generalized conductance} of the cut $(S, \bar{S})$, and the task of minimizing $ψ_w( S )$ the Generalized Conductance Problem. Our main contribution is an algorithm with an $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation guarantee for this objective. Our result is achieved via a two-way reduction: first to the well-known Generalized $k$-Multicut Problem, and then to a constrained variant of the classic Sparsest-Cut Problem, with an additional upper-bound constraint on the amount of demand that may be cut. Moreover, we show that the above procedure can be used to obtain an $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-bicriteria approximation for Graph Partitioning with Demands, where the goal is to find a minimum-cost subset of edges $C$ such that for every component $H$ of $G\setminus C$, $w( H )\leq ρ\cdot w( V )$. This, in turn, yields an $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation for Hierarchical Clustering with Demands, the problem of finding a hierarchy of cuts that partitions the graph into increasingly refined clusters. For multiplicative demand functions, we improve these guarantees to $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{\log n})$ and for trees we get an $\mathcal{O}(1)$-approximation for all of our objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在需求模型下的图划分问题，提出了广义电导（generalized conductance）概念，并给出了一个O(log n)近似算法。通过双向归约，将问题转化为广义k-多割问题和带约束的稀疏割问题，进而得到图划分和层次聚类问题的近似保证。对于乘性需求函数，改进到O(√log n)；对于树，得到常数近似。
Motivation: 现有图划分问题通常忽略节点之间的需求关系，而实际应用中（如网络设计、聚类）需求是重要的。本文旨在统一处理带一般需求的图划分，提出广义电导作为目标，并设计有效的近似算法。
Method: 提出广义电导最小化问题，通过两步归约：首先归约到广义k-多割问题，再归约到带需求上界约束的稀疏割问题，从而利用已知的O(log n)近似算法。对于乘性需求，利用更先进的稀疏割近似改进到O(√log n)。
Result: 对于一般需求函数，得到O(log n)近似算法；对于乘性需求函数，改进到O(√log n)；对于树结构，得到常数近似。这些结果直接导出图划分和层次聚类问题（带需求）的相同近似比。
Conclusion: 本文的广义电导框架为带需求的图划分问题提供了统一的近似算法，且证明了树上的常数近似，展示了该框架的广泛适用性。

papers.title: Hierarchical $\mathcal{F}$-Clustering: Approximation and Hardness of Clustering into Trees and Bounded Diameter Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Consider the following variation on the Hierarchical Clustering problem: Usually, while building a hierarchical clustering, one recursively partitions the data until each cluster becomes a singleton. We relax the halting condition of the recursive process to stop whenever the remaining cluster is a graph belonging to a class $\mathcal{F}$. We call this problem Hierarchical $\mathcal{F}$-Clustering and we measure the quality of any solution using adapted Dasgupta's clustering objective. We study two natural choices of $\mathcal{F}$: trees and graphs of bounded diameter. We present the first polynomial time $\mathcal{O}(\log n\cdot\log\log n)$ and $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation algorithms for clustering into trees and bounded diameter graphs respectively. Our main technical contribution is a framework for approximating such problems based on linear programming. In fact, we characterize graphs classes $\mathcal{F}$ for which our approach can be applied and show that it includes both trees and bounded diameter graphs. However, our ideas are not limited to them and might be useful for other structures as well. Broadly speaking, our framework applies whenever the corresponding flat clustering problem, which we call $p_{\mathcal{F}}$-Partitioning, admits a natural ILP formulation together with a rounding procedure with provable approximation guarantees. Intuitively, given a set of vertices called terminals, the problem is to find an edge set whose removal results in satisfying certain vertex-dependent structural predicate for each terminal. We then use these ingredients to build clustering trees with the aforementioned approximation guarantees. To complement these results, we show that both Hierarchical Clustering into trees and into bounded diameter graphs cannot be approximated within any constant factor under the Small Set Expansion Hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层次聚类的一个变体问题：层次 ℱ-聚类，其中递归过程在剩余簇属于某个图类 ℱ 时停止。针对 ℱ 为树和有界直径图两种情况，提出了基于线性规划的近似算法，分别达到 O(log n·log log n) 和 O(log n) 的近似比。同时证明了在 Small Set Expansion 假设下，这两个问题无法在常数因子内近似。
Motivation: 经典层次聚类要求递归直到单点，而放松终止条件允许簇为某类图更具一般性。然而该变体的算法和复杂性尚未被充分研究，特别是针对树和有界直径图这两类自然结构。
Method: 提出一个统一的基于线性规划的框架，将问题归约到所谓的 p_{\mathcal{F}}-Partitioning 问题，该问题有整数线性规划表述和可证的 rounding 过程。利用该框架分别构造了树和有界直径图的聚类树。
Result: 对于树和基于直径的图，分别得到了多项式时间的 O(log n·log log n) 和 O(log n) 近似算法。此外，在 Small Set Expansion 假设下，证明了这两个问题不存在常数因子近似算法。
Conclusion: 本文为层次 ℱ-聚类提供了第一个具有理论保证的近似算法，并刻画了框架适用的图类条件。局限性在于近似比仍有对数因子，且不可近似性结果基于强假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Classifying daily activities needs posture, reconstructing them needs motion
papers.abstract_en: Humans recognize movements effortlessly, even from noisy and complex visual input. But what information in the stimulus allows humans to rapidly classify movements? No framework has systematically compared different strategies of movement analysis to address this question. Here, we used videos of 16 daily activities from the MoVi dataset and compared three strategies: Temporal Movement Primitives (TMPs), which decompose movements into weighted sums of temporally smooth basis functions; Legendre polynomial coefficients, which project joint-coordinate trajectories onto an orthogonal polynomial basis; and Autoencoder latent embeddings. Legendre coefficients and TMPs achieved the highest classifier accuracy, followed by autoencoders. We found two discriminative features for movement classification. The most informative is the general posture of the body, the average spatial configuration that distinguishes one activity from another. Additionally, we identified 9 critical joints that are most predictive for movement classification. Interestingly, good classification accuracy did not automatically lead to good movement generation: when we reconstructed movements for each activity, TMPs preserved the temporal dynamics and produced perceptually natural motion, whereas reconstructions from Legendre coefficients retained only the average posture and appeared frozen. These results reveal a dissociation in how movement information is organized: the static configuration of the body suffices to classify what activity is performed, but the temporal dynamics of movement are required to reconstruct how it unfolds. This distinction clarifies which features the visual system may rely upon for rapid action recognition, and suggests that postural features could enable efficient movement screening in clinical applications, while dynamic information remain essential wherever movement generation is the goal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用MoVi数据集的16种日常活动视频，比较了时间运动基元（TMPs）、勒让德多项式系数和自编码器潜在嵌入三种运动分析策略。勒让德系数和TMPs在活动分类上准确率最高，但分类性能与运动生成能力脱钩：TMPs能保留时间动态并生成自然运动，而勒让德系数只能重建静态姿势。结果表明，静态身体配置足以分类活动，但运动的时间动态是重建运动过程的必要条件。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏系统性框架来比较不同运动分析策略，以确定视觉刺激中哪些信息支持人类快速运动识别。
Method: 使用MoVi数据集的16种日常活动视频，提取三种表示：时间运动基元（TMPs）、勒让德多项式系数和自编码器潜在嵌入，评估它们在分类和运动重建中的表现。
Result: 勒让德系数和TMPs分类准确率最高，且发现一般姿势（平均空间配置）和9个关键关节是最具判别性的特征。但勒让德系数重建的运动仅保留平均姿势，呈冻结状；TMPs则能生成自然运动。
Conclusion: 静态姿势足以分类活动，但动态时间信息对运动重建不可或缺；该发现暗示视觉系统可能依赖静态特征进行快速动作识别，而动态信息在运动生成中仍至关重要。

papers.title: Adaptive Filtering of the KV Cache: Diagnosing and Correcting Structural-Role Bias in LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Attention-based KV cache eviction (H2O and its descendants) compresses the memory-constrained state of a long-context model by ranking tokens on accumulated attention mass, treated here as signal energy, and keeping the heaviest. On schema-dense input streams such as nested JSON, this score acts as a non-stationary filter that disproportionately retains noise: a non-content sink role (delimiters or whitespace) carries an order of magnitude more energy than any content role, and structural KEY tokens are over-retained at roughly 1.8x the rate of the answer-carrying VALUE tokens, collapsing exact-match accuracy from 88% to 0% at a 5% budget as the signal-to-noise ratio of the retained state degrades. A counterfactual experiment establishes that suppressing KEY tokens is the best deployable filter. Our retraining-free, role-conditional allocation over SnapKV's windowed score, governed by a single tuned hyperparameter, closes 63-98% of the H2O gap at sub-20% budgets and, at higher budgets, modestly matches or exceeds full-cache accuracy -- a small, seed-sensitive denoising effect (borderline significant at B=0.50; not distinguishable from zero at B=0.30 over four seeds). A 15 MB linear role probe supplies these labels at negligible inference cost, though matching parser-level downstream accuracy remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM推理中KV缓存压缩（如H2O）的结构-角色偏差问题。在嵌套JSON等密集输入流中，基于注意力分数的驱逐策略会过度保留结构标记（如分隔符和KEY），导致信号噪声比下降，使精确匹配准确率从88%骤降至0%（5%预算）。作者提出一种无需重新训练的角色条件分配方法，通过线性角色探针（15MB）提供标签，结合单超参数控制，在低预算下缩小H2O差距63-98%，高预算下略微提升或持平全缓存准确率。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐方法（如H2O）在结构化密集输入（如嵌套JSON）上存在偏差，非内容角色（分隔符/空格）能量远高于内容角色，且结构KEY令牌被过度保留，导致准确率严重下降。
Method: 提出基于角色条件的自适应过滤：利用线性角色探针（15MB）为SnapKV的窗口化注意力分数添加角色标签，并通过单个超参数调整保留策略，抑制结构KEY令牌并保护VALUE令牌。该方法无需重新训练。
Result: 在sub-20%预算下，该方法缩小了H2O与全缓存准确率差距的63-98%；在更高预算下，略微匹配或超过全缓存准确率（去噪效果在B=0.50时接近显著，B=0.30时不可区分）。角色探针推理成本可忽略。
Conclusion: 论文强调，注意力分数作为非平稳滤波器会导致结构-角色偏差，而角色条件分配可有效校正。但与解析器级下游准确率匹配仍有差距，且去噪效果对随机种子敏感。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Computing for Medical Image Acquisition and Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging systems such as CT, MRI, PET, and SPECT do not directly acquire images. Instead, they measure physical signals that encode anatomical or physiological information, and image reconstruction recovers the underlying image by solving an inverse problem. Although these imaging modalities are governed by different imaging physics, they share a common computational framework that naturally connects medical physics, linear algebra, probability, numerical optimization, and efficient computing. As medical imaging systems acquire increasingly large and higher-dimensional datasets, image reconstruction has become one of the primary computational bottlenecks in modern medical imaging. Advanced reconstruction methods, including analytical reconstruction, iterative optimization, and statistical model-based reconstruction, substantially improve image quality while reducing radiation dose or scan time, but at significantly increased computational cost. Efficient computing has therefore become essential for achieving clinically practical reconstruction times. This chapter presents a unified computational perspective on medical image acquisition and reconstruction across CT, MRI, PET, and SPECT. It first reviews the imaging physics and data acquisition process for each modality and derives a generalized mathematical framework for image reconstruction. Building on this framework, the chapter discusses analytical, iterative, and statistical reconstruction methods together with their computational characteristics. Finally, it examines efficient computing considerations, including optimization algorithms, physics-aware forward operators, memory-efficient implementations, and parallel computing strategies. Together, these topics demonstrate how the integration of imaging physics, mathematical modeling, and efficient computing enables accurate and scalable medical image reconstruction.

papers.title: BARS: Benign-Anchored Ranking and Selection for False Alarm Reduction in Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: False alarms remain a major barrier to deploying network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). In high-volume environments, even a sub-1% false positive rate can generate tens of thousands of daily alerts. Filter-based feature selection is attractive because it operates upstream of the classifier and adds no inference-time cost. However, classical filters use class-symmetric criteria that ignore the asymmetry of intrusion detection, where benign traffic defines the baseline and attacks are deviations from it. A recent class-asymmetric filter, Classwise Mean Deviation (CMD), addresses this issue but anchors its score to a global mean that shifts toward attack distributions under class imbalance, weakening the deviations it aims to capture. We propose Benign-Anchored Ranking and Selection (BARS), a two-stage filter that replaces CMD's global anchor with the benign-class mean and applies an order-preserving decorrelation step. We evaluate BARS on CICIDS2017, CICDDoS2019, and UNSW-NB15 using feature budgets k = {5, 10, 20, 30, 40}. On attack-majority datasets, where global-anchor bias is strongest, BARS reduces false positive rate relative to CMD by 15.4% on UNSW-NB15 at k = 20 and by 21% to 23% on CICDDoS2019 at small feature budgets while preserving true positive rate and macro-F1. On benign-majority data, BARS and CMD converge, consistent with the theoretical limit where global- and benign-anchored scores coincide. BARS is a principled refinement of CMD rather than a universally dominant filter. Although Pearson Correlation and Mutual Information often achieve lower false positive rates, they exceeded 1 TB of memory on the largest benchmarks in our evaluation. BARS retains linear-time scoring and a low memory footprint, making it suitable for resource-constrained deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）中假警报率高的问题，本文提出基于良性锚点的排序与选择（BARS）过滤器。BARS用良性类均值替代全局均值作为评分锚点，并加入保序去相关步骤，在三个基准数据集上相比同类非对称过滤器CMD降低了假阳性率，同时保持真正例率和宏F1，且内存占用低。
Motivation: 现有类不对称过滤器CMD使用全局均值锚点，在类别不平衡下锚点偏向攻击分布，削弱了对偏差的捕获能力，导致假阳性率偏高。
Method: 提出BARS两阶段过滤器：第一阶段用良性类均值代替全局均值计算特征得分；第二阶段施加保序去相关步骤，消除特征间冗余。
Result: 在攻击占多数的数据集上，BARS相比CMD将假阳性率降低15.4%（UNSW-NB15, k=20）至21-23%（CICDDoS2019, 小特征预算），同时保持真正例率和宏F1；在良性占多数时两者收敛。Pearson Correlation和Mutual Information虽假阳性率更低，但内存需求超过1TB，BARS保持线性时间和低内存。
Conclusion: BARS是对CMD的原则性改进，适用于特征预算有限且资源受限的NIDS部署场景，但并非在所有条件下都优于其他过滤器。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning: Pretrain-Finetuning or Joint Training?
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervision is a powerful technique for learning visual representations from unlabeled data. Existing techniques primarily adopt a two-stage approach for self-supervised learning (SSL): a pretraining stage on unlabeled data followed by a finetuning stage on labeled data. While this pipeline has demonstrated extreme effectiveness, the interaction between self-supervised and supervised learning objectives remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we systematically investigate whether jointly optimizing the self-supervised and supervised objectives during training provides a better alternative. We compare two training paradigms: (1) the aforementioned pretraining followed by finetuning (PFT) and (2) joint training (JT), where self-supervised and supervised losses are optimized simultaneously in the same network. Across eight representative SSL methods and diverse computer vision tasks on natural, medical, crisis response, and remote sensing data, we evaluate performance under varying percentages of labeled data. Our results reveal that the relative effectiveness of PFT and JT depends strongly on the task at hand, the availability of labeled data, and the complexity of the domain. We find that JT consistently improves data and training efficiency while being robust in low-label settings, while PFT is more reliable in more specialized domains. We further analyze representation quality, robustness, and cross-domain generalization, providing new insights into how self-supervised and supervised objectives interact during optimization. We establish a comprehensive empirical benchmark for hybrid SSL-based semi-supervised learning and offer practical guidance for selecting appropriate training strategies across diverse vision applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了自监督视觉表示学习中两种训练范式：预训练-微调（PFT）和联合训练（JT）。在八个代表性自监督方法和多种视觉任务上，发现PFT和JT的相对有效性取决于任务、标签数据量和领域复杂度。JT在低标签设置下更鲁棒且数据效率更高，而PFT在专业领域更可靠。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习主要采用两阶段方法（预训练+微调），但自监督与监督目标之间的交互尚未充分理解，缺乏对联合训练范式的系统比较。
Method: 系统比较了预训练-微调（PFT）和联合训练（JT）两种范式，在自然、医学、危机响应和遥感数据上评估了八种自监督方法，并分析不同标签比例下的性能。
Result: JT在低标签设置下持续提升数据和训练效率，而PFT在更专业领域更可靠；相对有效性取决于任务、标签可用性和领域复杂度。
Conclusion: 为混合自监督半监督学习建立了实证基准，并为不同视觉应用选择训练策略提供了实用指导。

papers.title: RAGthoven at SemEval-2026 Task 1: A Multi-Stage Pipeline Walks Into a Benchmark and Barely Clears the Bar
papers.abstract_en: We present RAGthoven, our system for SemEval-2026 Task 1 (MWAHAHA), Subtask A (multilingual constrained humor generation in English, Spanish, and Chinese). RAGthoven decomposes creative text generation into a multi-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline (Planner, Best-of-N Writer, Reflector for self-critique, LLM-as-a-judge Judge) grounded in computational humor theory (Benign Violation Theory, Script-based Semantic Theory of Humor) and refined across ten experiments. In our final configuration, we augment the Planner with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from a curated joke corpus, seeding generation with diverse joke mechanisms. We also evaluate two agentic variants -- ReAct-style sequential tool-calling (Exp09) and autonomous multi-branch orchestration (Exp10) -- that expose the same four stages with a deterministic ConstraintAudit checker. Across four frontier models on a held-out 12-instance English sample, neither agentic variant produced outputs we judged superior to the non-agentic pipeline despite substantially higher tool-call budgets. RAGthoven shares Rank 1 with the Gemini 2.5 Flash baseline in all three languages, with overlapping organizer-reported confidence intervals. In Spanish, it leads the baseline by 42 raw Elo points (1182 vs. 1140), while in English (1045 vs. 1081) and Chinese (1045 vs. 1053) the baseline holds the higher raw rating within the same statistical tie. Together, these results suggest language-dependent diminishing returns from elaborate multi-stage prompt engineering and agentic scaffolding once a strong frontier model is in the loop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAGthoven 系统，用于 SemEval-2026 Task 1（多语言受限幽默生成），采用多阶段LLM流水线（Planner、Best-of-N Writer、Reflector、Judge），结合检索增强生成（RAG）和计算幽默理论。在英语、西班牙语和汉语上，系统与Gemini 2.5 Flash基线并列第一，但统计上无显著差异。实验表明，在强基础模型上增加复杂的多阶段提示工程和智能体框架的收益递减。
Motivation: 多语言幽默生成任务中，如何通过结构化流水线和检索增强生成提升生成质量是一个挑战，特别是需要满足受限约束。
Method: 使用四阶段LLM流水线：Planner规划幽默机制、Best-of-N Writer生成多个候选、Reflector自我批判、Judge评分；并通过RAG从笑话语料库检索种子。还测试了ReAct风格和自主多分支智能体变体。
Result: 在12个样本的测试中，智能体变体未优于非智能体流水线。RAGthoven在三语言中与基线并列第一，西班牙语领先42 Elo点，英语和汉语略低于基线但统计上持平。
Conclusion: 复杂的多阶段提示工程和智能体框架在强基础模型上带来语言依赖的递减收益。

papers.title: Concurrent Image Understanding and Generation: Self-Correcting Coupled Markov Jump Processes
papers.abstract_en: Human cognition does not separate understanding and generation. A teacher at a whiteboard speaks and draws $\textit{together}$, each modality reshapes the other. In this paper, we bring this coupled loop to artificial systems. Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) are ideally suited to this task, yet existing samplers either decode text and image interleavedly or independently update them in parallel branches that share only previous-step history, but not the other modality's latest decisions $\textit{within}$ the same step; combined with MDMs' inability to remask, cross-modal contradictions are neither detected nor repaired. We introduce $\textbf{Self-Correcting Coupled Markov Jump Processes (SC-CMJP)}$, a framework in which one modality's transition rates are functionals of the other modality's confidence score, as weighted by cross-modal attention. Furthermore, a remasking jump retracts commitments the moment cross-modal evidence turns against them. In conjunction with SC-CMJP, we introduce $\texttt{CO}_\texttt{2}\texttt{Jump}$ (Self-$\underline{\text{CO}}$rrecting $\underline{\text{CO}}$upled $\underline{\text{Jump}}$), a novel training-free single-pass sampler for joint multimodal geneneration. For training and evaluation purposes, we have created and will release three large-scale joint multimodal generation corpora: $\text{JEdit-1M}$, $\text{JMaze-200K}$, $\text{JNono-200K}$, with matching in- and out-of-distribution benchmarks. $\texttt{CO}_\texttt{2}\texttt{Jump}$ achieves best joint performance for image understanding and editing as well as visual reasoning (maze and nonogram solving). The performance of the sampler scales monotonically with the number of denoising steps, evidence that the benefits of cross-modal coupling $\textit{compound}$ across the trajectory. Project page: https://coupled-jump.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自纠正耦合马尔可夫跳跃过程（SC-CMJP）框架，通过跨模态注意力和置信度分数耦合图像与文本生成，并引入remasking jump实现自纠正。基于该框架设计了无需训练的单遍采样器CO2Jump，在图像理解、编辑和视觉推理任务上达到最佳联合性能，且性能随去噪步数单调提升。同时发布了三个大规模多模态生成语料库。
Motivation: 现有掩码扩散模型在联合生成中无法在同一时间步内利用另一模态的最新决策，且缺乏remasking能力，导致跨模态矛盾无法检测和修复。受人类认知中理解与生成相互耦合的启发，本文旨在构建一个让两个模态实时互相重塑的闭环系统。
Method: 提出SC-CMJP框架，其中一个模态的转移速率是另一模态置信度分数的函数（通过跨模态注意力加权）。当跨模态证据出现矛盾时，通过remasking jump撤销先前的生成承诺。基于此设计训练-free的单遍采样器CO2Jump，无需额外训练即可执行联合多模态生成。
Result: CO2Jump在图像理解、图像编辑以及视觉推理任务（迷宫求解和非图解算）上取得最佳联合性能。实验表明，采样器的性能随去噪步数增加而单调提升，验证了跨模态耦合在整个生成轨迹中的累积益处。
Conclusion: SC-CMJP框架有效解决了跨模态矛盾问题，使生成过程能够自我纠正。所提出的CO2Jump采样器在不需训练的情况下实现了高质量多模态联合生成，并且性能随计算量增加而提升。

papers.title: MGFace: Mask-Gated Face Matching via Conditional Similarity Routing
papers.abstract_en: Face identification has achieved remarkable performance under normal conditions. Yet, its accuracy often degrades significantly when query faces are partially occluded, especially by facial masks. Existing re-ranking approaches improve robustness by exploiting patch-level similarities. Still, they often rely on costly, fine-grained matching mechanisms, which limit their efficiency in large-scale retrieval scenarios. In this paper, we propose MGFace, a mask-gated face identification pipeline that predicts the mask status of a query face and conditionally routes the similarity computation accordingly. Specifically, MGFace distinguishes between masked and unmasked queries, applies global embedding matching to unmasked queries, and activates mask-aware patch-level re-ranking only for masked queries. This design focuses on reliable upper-face regions while avoiding unnecessary fine-grained computation. Experiments on the extended LFW-Mask dataset show that MGFace achieves over 80% identification accuracy with the FaceNet backbone and over 90% with the ArcFace backbone. Compared with a previous EMD-based re-ranking method, MGFace achieves better identification performance while reducing query time by approximately 20x. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of MGFace in improving masked-face identification accuracy with low computational overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/chequanghuy/MGFace.

Method: MGFace包含一个口罩状态预测器，根据预测结果进行条件路由：未遮挡查询使用全局嵌入匹配，遮挡查询则激活口罩感知的块级重排序，仅关注可靠的上半脸区域。
Result: 在扩展LFW-Mask数据集上，FaceNet骨干准确率超80%，ArcFace骨干超90%；与EMD重排序相比，查询时间降低约20倍，且识别性能更优。
Conclusion: MGFace通过门控机制在保持低计算开销的同时显著提升口罩遮挡人脸识别准确率，代码已开源。

papers.title: A Masked Autoencoder Approach to Unsupervised Steel Surface Defect Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automated visual inspection of steel surface defects is a recurring quality control task in which labeled defect data is scarce and costly to obtain, while unlabeled surface images are abundant, which motivates self supervised methods that learn useful representations without class labels. A Transformer based Masked Autoencoder is used here to learn representations of steel surface defects for unsupervised grouping. During pretraining, 75% of the input image patches are randomly masked, and a lightweight decoder reconstructs the masked regions from the visible 25%. The encoder is trained jointly with an auxiliary defect localization objective, used only as a training signal and not evaluated as a detector. The decoder reaches a structural similarity score of 0.92 and a mean squared error of 0.47. Features from the pretrained encoder are then clustered using UMAP for dimensionality reduction and Agglomerative clustering, reaching a Hungarian matched accuracy of 91.3% against the six known defect categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于掩码自编码器（Masked Autoencoder）的无监督方法，用于钢铁表面缺陷识别。预训练时随机遮蔽75%的图像块，轻量解码器重建缺失区域，同时辅助缺陷定位目标。编码器特征经UMAP降维和凝聚聚类后，在六类缺陷上达到91.3%的匈牙利匹配准确率。
Motivation: 钢铁表面缺陷标注数据稀缺且昂贵，而无标注图像丰富，因此需要自监督方法学习有效表示。
Method: 采用Transformer掩码自编码器，预训练时遮蔽75%输入块，解码器重建；编码器联合训练辅助缺陷定位目标（仅训练信号）。特征通过UMAP降维后使用凝聚聚类。
Result: 解码器结构相似性得分0.92，均方误差0.47；聚类匈牙利匹配准确率91.3%（六类缺陷）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明无监督掩码自编码器可有效学习钢铁表面缺陷表示，聚类效果良好。

papers.title: SteinGate: Tail-Sensitive Safe Reinforcement Learning via Stein Discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: Safe reinforcement learning typically enforces safety by bounding expected cumulative costs, a criterion that often fails to detect rare but catastrophic tail events. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces SteinGate, a boundary-aware distributional safety certificate that replaces fragile tail fitting with a robust consistency check using Kernelized Stein Discrepancy while accounting for boundary atoms induced by clipped costs. SteinGate evaluates whether observed policy rollout costs remain consistent with a safe reference distribution, providing a non-parametric safety certificate. This certificate is used to dynamically adapt the learning regime: favoring reward-improving policy updates when rollouts remain consistent with the safe reference and switching to recovery behavior when the cost tail deviates. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate that SteinGate significantly reduces both the frequency and severity of constraint violations during training while maintaining competitive returns relative to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted for Publication at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SteinGate，一种基于核化Stein差异（Kernelized Stein Discrepancy）的边界感知分布安全证书，用于安全强化学习。该方法通过检查策略 rollout 成本是否与安全参考分布一致，动态调整学习策略：当一致时鼓励奖励提升，偏离时切换到恢复行为。连续控制基准实验表明，该方法在维持竞争性回报的同时显著降低了训练期间的约束违反频率和严重程度。
Motivation: 传统安全强化学习通过约束期望累积成本来保证安全，但难以检测罕见灾难性尾事件。需要一种能够鲁棒检测成本尾部分布偏差的方法。
Method: 提出SteinGate，利用核化Stein差异对策略 rollout 成本与安全参考分布进行非参数一致性检验，并处理由截断成本引起的边界原子。根据一致性动态调整学习策略，在奖励提升与安全恢复之间切换。
Result: 在连续控制基准上，SteinGate显著降低训练期间约束违反的频率和严重程度，同时保持与最先进基线相当的回报。
Conclusion: SteinGate提供了一种无需显式拟合尾部分布的安全证书，通过分布一致性检查实现尾部敏感的安全强化学习。

papers.title: Learning Safe Agent Behaviour from Human Preferences and Justifications via World Models
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of safely training an agent policy and deploying a good and safe policy, in settings where the environment dynamics are unknown and no suitable reward function is available. In the context of safety-critical environments, we consider traditional reinforcement learning impractical and resort to the resource of human input. We introduce DROPJ, a human-centred method for both safe training and deployment. We first learn a world model (a learned simulator) from a dataset of prior real-world trajectories. A human then plays the game in this learned simulator to extract several informative simulated trajectories. From these, we sample pairs of simulated trajectory segments and elicit from a human their preference over these segments, as well as a reason (justification) for their choice. We then train a reward model from these justified preferences and use it, together with the world model, to directly deploy the agent using model predictive control. Running real-user experiments, we find that generating informative simulated trajectories from a user significantly reduces the computational cost during training compared to other strategies, and can also improve the performance during deployment. In the context of training within a learned simulator, we show that the use of preferences rather than other types of feedback substantially improves the performance during deployment. We further demonstrate that safety justifications accompanying preferences can significantly enhance safety or prioritise user-prescribed aspects of safety associated with them during deployment.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 18 figures. Extended version of a paper presented at ICAART 2026; submitted for consideration in the ICAART 2026 post-publication selected-papers volume in Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DROPJ方法，结合世界模型、人类偏好和理由来安全训练和部署智能体。人类在学到的世界模型中生成模拟轨迹，提供偏好和理由，训练奖励模型后使用模型预测控制部署。实验表明，生成信息丰富的模拟轨迹可降低计算成本，偏好反馈优于其他反馈类型，安全理由可提升部署安全性。
Motivation: 在环境动态未知且无合适奖励函数的安全关键场景中，传统强化学习不可行，需要利用人类输入来安全训练和部署策略。
Method: 先从真实轨迹数据集学习世界模型（模拟器）；人类在模拟器中生成信息丰富的模拟轨迹；从轨迹段对中收集人类偏好及其理由；用有理由的偏好训练奖励模型；结合世界模型和奖励模型，通过模型预测控制直接部署智能体。
Result: 用户实验表明，从用户生成信息丰富的模拟轨迹显著降低训练计算成本，并在部署中提升性能；偏好反馈优于其他反馈类型；安全理由可显著增强部署安全性或优先考虑用户指定的安全方面。
Conclusion: 本文展示了利用人类偏好和理由结合世界模型可以安全有效地训练和部署智能体，特别是安全理由能显著提升安全性。

papers.title: Text2Sign: A Single-GPU Diffusion Baseline for Text-to-Sign Language Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Sign language is a primary communication channel for millions of Deaf and hard-of-hearing people, yet text-to-signer video generation remains costly because video diffusion models are expensive to train and evaluate. This paper presents Text2Sign, a text-conditioned diffusion model for short sign-language clips that runs on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. It combines a frozen vision-language text encoder with a 3D encoder-decoder and factorized spatiotemporal attention to reduce the cost of full-video attention while preserving motion coherence. We compare convolution-only and transformer-style backbones, frozen pretrained and task-specific text encoders, and factorized versus full attention. On a signer-disjoint How2Sign split, the best short-run ablation reaches a validation loss of 0.0648, while a longer-run checkpoint reaches 0.00999. On a compact evaluation slice, the latter achieves an SSIM of $0.2403 \pm 0.0238$, a PSNR of $15.11 \pm 0.42$ dB, and temporal consistency of $1.0000 \pm 0.0000$ using 8-step DDIM sampling with a guidance scale of 5.0. It generates a 32-frame, $64 \times 64$ clip in 12.60 seconds, or 2.54 frames per second, with peak inference memory of 3.12 GB. A held-out denoising audit shows only weak prompt sensitivity: removing text increases late-timestep loss from 0.9875 to 0.9891, while shuffled prompts perform similarly to correct prompts. Frozen text conditioning therefore improves short-budget validation loss, but prompt-specific separation remains limited. The system is restricted to low-resolution, short clips and lacks expert linguistic evaluation, so it should be viewed as a single-GPU research baseline rather than a complete sign-language production system. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaruize0911/text2sign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Text2Sign，一个在单张 NVIDIA L4 GPU 上运行的文本条件扩散模型，用于生成短的手语视频片段。它结合冻结的视觉语言文本编码器、3D 编码器-解码器和分解的时空注意力，降低全视频注意力成本。在 How2Sign 数据集上的实验显示，最佳长运行检查点达到 SSIM 0.2403、PSNR 15.11 dB，并能在 12.60 秒内生成 32 帧 64×64 视频。但方法受限于低分辨率、短片段，且缺乏专家语言学评估。
Motivation: 手语是聋人和听障人士的主要交流方式，但文本到视频生成成本高昂，现有视频扩散模型训练和评估昂贵，需要更高效的基线。
Method: 使用冻结的 CLIP 文本编码器、3D U-Net 结构的编码器-解码器、分解的时空注意力（先空间后时间），并比较不同骨干网络和文本编码器配置。
Result: 在 How2Sign 数据集的 signer-disjoint 划分上，最佳短运行消融实验验证损失 0.0648，长运行检查点验证损失 0.00999。评估切片上 SSIM 0.2403±0.0238，PSNR 15.11±0.42 dB，时间一致性 1.0000±0.0000（8步 DDIM，guidance scale 5.0）。生成 32帧 64×64 视频需 12.60 秒，峰值推理内存 3.12 GB。文本条件对损失影响微弱，表明提示特异性有限。
Conclusion: Text2Sign 可作为单 GPU 研究基线，但受限于低分辨率、短片段和缺乏专家评估，不应视为完整的手语生产系统。
