papers.title: What Models Express, Suppress, and Resist: Auditing Open-Weight LLMs with Persona Vectors
papers.abstract_en: What a language model will and will not do is largely set during post-training, but which behaviors it expresses, hides, or resists is not revealed by prompting alone. Persona vectors, behavioral directions in activation space, can probe this organization, but prior work covers only a handful of traits. We present the first systematic application of persona vectors at this scale, compiling a 53-trait inventory across four behaviorally distinct domains and labeling every trait in two open-weight models as natural (expressed at baseline), steerable latent but amplifiable, or intractable (resistant to standard extraction). Both models default to helpful, task-oriented behavior: all nine agentic traits are natural, and their default clinician behavior matches a board-certified psychologist's independent desirability judgments on 16 of 17 traits. Steering produces its largest gains on traits these defaults exclude: hyperbole, hallucination, and sycophancy. The same asymmetry holds across all 171 generic-trait pairs: two steerable traits can collapse the composition, but pairs involving a default never do. Where standard extraction fails on a trait like "evil," a vector transferred from a fine-tuned variant still recovers it, with the residual refusals appearing inside the model's chain-of-thought. Persona vectors are most informative not as a set of controls but as a probe of behavioral organization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对开放权重大语言模型（LLMs）进行大规模人格向量（persona vectors）审计，构建了包含53种特质的清单，并在两个模型中标记每种特质为自然表达、可操纵但潜在可放大、或难以提取。研究发现模型默认表现为有帮助、任务导向的行为，操纵主要增强默认排除的特质（如夸张、幻觉、谄媚），且特质对组合存在不对称性。人格向量作为行为组织探针比作为控制手段更有用。
Motivation: 现有方法仅通过提示无法揭示模型在训练后表现、隐藏或抗拒哪些行为，而人格向量的研究局限于少量特质。本文旨在系统性地大规模应用人格向量，以理解模型行为组织方式。
Method: 构建53种特质的清单，涵盖4个行为不同的领域，并使用两种开放权重模型进行实验。通过探测激活空间中的人格向量方向，将特质分类为自然、可操纵但潜在可放大、或难以提取；并利用微调变体进行向量迁移实验。
Result: 所有9种代理特质（agentic traits）均为自然表达；模型默认临床医生行为与持有执照的心理学家在17种特质中的16种上判断一致；操纵最大增益出现在默认排除的特质上；171种通用特质对中，两个可操纵特质能打破组合，但涉及默认特质的组合从不打破；对于“邪恶”等难以提取的特质，从微调变体迁移的向量仍能恢复。
Conclusion: 人格向量作为行为组织探针比作为控制手段更有价值，揭示了模型行为表现的内部组织。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文对开放权重大语言模型（LLMs）进行大规模人格向量（persona vectors）审计，构建了包含53种特质的清单，并在两个模型中标记每种特质为自然表达、可操纵但潜在可放大、或难以提取。研究发现模型默认表现为有帮助、任务导向的行为，操纵主要增强默认排除的特质（如夸张、幻觉、谄媚），且特质对组合存在不对称性。人格向量作为行为组织探针比作为控制手段更有用。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法仅通过提示无法揭示模型在训练后表现、隐藏或抗拒哪些行为，而人格向量的研究局限于少量特质。本文旨在系统性地大规模应用人格向量，以理解模型行为组织方式。
summary_sections.method: 构建53种特质的清单，涵盖4个行为不同的领域，并使用两种开放权重模型进行实验。通过探测激活空间中的人格向量方向，将特质分类为自然、可操纵但潜在可放大、或难以提取；并利用微调变体进行向量迁移实验。
summary_sections.result: 所有9种代理特质（agentic traits）均为自然表达；模型默认临床医生行为与持有执照的心理学家在17种特质中的16种上判断一致；操纵最大增益出现在默认排除的特质上；171种通用特质对中，两个可操纵特质能打破组合，但涉及默认特质的组合从不打破；对于“邪恶”等难以提取的特质，从微调变体迁移的向量仍能恢复。
summary_sections.conclusion: 人格向量作为行为组织探针比作为控制手段更有价值，揭示了模型行为表现的内部组织。

papers.title: Active Beyond-Diagonal RIS Empowered Heterogeneous Edge Computing: A Distributional Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Active beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RISs) enables hybrid transmitting and reflecting mode to achieve effective signal amplification and full-space coverage, thus providing a promising solution for blockage-aware uplink offloading in heterogeneous mobile edge computing (MEC) systems. However, practical hybrid mode active BD-RIS are realized by reciprocal devices, which inherently generate cross-sector energy leakage that will reshape the system-level energy-latency tradeoff. This paper studies energy-aware offloading and resource allocation for reciprocal active BD-RIS-assisted heterogeneous MEC, where offloading decisions, CPU/GPU computation allocation, transmit powers, receive processing, and active BD-RIS are tightly coupled. The resulting problem is a high-dimensional mixed integer nonconvex problem and is difficult to solve efficiently by conventional per-instance optimization. To address this challenge, we develop an end-to-end joint optimization framework based on a refined version of the distributional soft actor--critic algorithm, named as DSAC-T. By modeling return distributions rather than only expected values, DSAC-T improves policy stability under reward heterogeneity and feasibility-boundary sensitivity. Compared with other baseline algorithms, DSAC-T achieves the best energy-latency reward, the highest feasibility ratio of 81.67%, and a fast online decision time of 0.0267 s per scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于主动超对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）的异构移动边缘计算（MEC）系统中的能量感知卸载与资源分配问题，提出一种基于分布软演员-评论家（DSAC-T）的端到端联合优化框架。DSAC-T通过建模回报分布而非仅期望值，提高了在奖励异质性和可行性边界敏感性下的策略稳定性。实验表明，DSAC-T实现了81.67%的可行率和每场景0.0267秒的快速在线决策时间。

Method: 提出基于分布软演员-评论家（DSAC-T）的端到端联合优化框架，通过建模回报分布而非期望值来改进策略稳定性。

Conclusion: DSAC-T能有效解决主动BD-RIS辅助异构MEC中的资源分配问题，在可行性和决策速度上具有优势。

papers.title: Oracle Agent Memory as an Enterprise Memory Substrate for Long-Horizon AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory is a systems problem for long-horizon agents. Practical deployments require retention of task state across extended conversations, recovery of user-specific facts and preferences across sessions, and accumulation of procedural knowledge from prior outcomes. These requirements extend beyond document retrieval: a memory layer must determine which interactions become durable state, how that state is scoped, how it is retrieved under latency constraints, and how it is revised or removed over time. This report studies Oracle Agent Memory as a database-native memory substrate built on Oracle Database. Three themes organize the discussion: memory as a lifecycle spanning ingestion, extraction, consolidation, retrieval, summarization, and revision or removal; a layered architecture that separates an active memory core from a passive memory-store interface with explicit scope control across users, agents, and threads; and evaluation methodology in which downstream task accuracy is complemented by memory-centric measures such as evidence retrieval, recall, latency, and estimated token use. The report summarizes LongMemEval results, reaching 93.8% accuracy, compares Oracle Agent Memory against flat-history baselines, using about 10.7x fewer tokens, and published or reported external baselines where available, and closes with implementation-oriented appendix material covering setup, thread lifecycle, and search semantics.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Technical report on Oracle Agent Memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Oracle Agent Memory，这是一个基于 Oracle 数据库的数据库原生内存基板，用于长周期 AI 代理。它处理内存生命周期（摄入、提取、整合、检索、摘要、修订/移除），采用分层架构分离主动内存核心和被动存储接口，并提供评估方法。在 LongMemEval 上达到 93.8% 准确率，使用约 10.7 倍更少的 tokens。
Motivation: 长周期代理部署需要跨扩展对话保留任务状态、跨会话恢复用户特定事实和偏好、累积先前结果的过程知识。现有文档检索方法无法满足这些需求，需要专用的内存层。
Method: 提出 Oracle Agent Memory，基于 Oracle 数据库构建，实现内存生命周期管理与分层架构，包含主动内存核心和被动存储接口，支持跨用户、代理和线程的显式范围控制。
Result: 在 LongMemEval 上达到 93.8% 准确率，与平坦历史基线相比，使用约 10.7 倍更少的 tokens，并发布了与公开基线的比较。
Conclusion: 摘要表明数据库原生内存基板能有效支持长周期 AI 代理，并提供了实现导向的附录资料（包括设置、线程生命周期和搜索语义）。

papers.title: HEDGEHOG: Hierarchical Evaluation of Drug Generators Through Rigorous Filtration
authors: (2) Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Generative molecular models can support early drug discovery by proposing new candidate compounds de novo. In practice, useful candidates must balance target-relevant activity, synthetic accessibility, physicochemical properties, and other multiparameter design constraints. However, metrics commonly used to evaluate molecular generators only weakly reflect whether the generated compounds are medicinally plausible and suitable for downstream computation. This can produce false positives in model evaluation, incorrect assumptions, and inefficient use of computational resources. We introduce HEDGEHOG, a unified six-stage filtration benchmark that is inspired by industrial hit identification workflows: (i) preprocessing; (ii) physicochemical descriptor screening; (iii) structural alerts and graph-sanity checks; (iv) synthesis feasibility; (v) docking and binding affinity estimation; and (vi) three-dimensional pose and interaction checks. We evaluate 23 molecular generators across three model classes under a standardized protocol. Across 230,000 generated molecules, only 0.65% of initial molecules survive all stages. Our results expose a central limitation of current molecular generators: molecules that appear acceptable under isolated criteria rarely satisfy medicinal chemistry, synthesis, docking, and 3D pose filters simultaneously.
papers.comment: 29 pages (including References and Appendix sections), 8 tables, 7 figures, 2 supplementary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了HEDGEHOG，一个六阶段过滤基准，用于评估分子生成模型生成药物候选分子的质量。该基准模仿工业先导化合物发现流程，包括预处理、理化性质筛选、结构警报和分子图完整性检查、合成可行性、对接和结合亲和力估计以及三维构象和相互作用检查。对23个分子生成器生成的23万个分子进行评估，只有0.65%的分子通过了所有阶段，表明现有生成器难以同时满足药物化学、合成和对接等多方面要求。
Motivation: 当前用于评估分子生成器的指标难以反映生成化合物是否具有药物合理性和适用于下游计算，导致模型评估中的假阳性和计算资源浪费。
Method: 提出六阶段过滤基准HEDGEHOG：预处理、理化描述符筛选、结构警报和图合理性检查、合成可行性、对接和结合亲和力估计、三维姿势和相互作用检查。
Result: 在23个分子生成器生成的23万个分子中，仅0.65%的分子通过了所有六个阶段的过滤。
Conclusion: 评估表明，当前分子生成器生成的分子在独立标准下看似可接受，但很难同时满足药物化学、合成、对接和三维姿势过滤的要求。

papers.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, comprising Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants. It delivers competitive performance in high-quality text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. Closed-source multimodal systems like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 achieve strong performance through system-level integration rather than a single model, yet their internal practices remain largely undisclosed. In this work, we demonstrate that targeted improvements in model understanding, data quality, and training pipelines, coupled with agentic inference-time scaling, can substantially enhance generation and editing performance even under highly constrained compute budgets. Comprehensive evaluations show that Boogu-Image-0.1 consistently matches or surpasses other open-source models across standard benchmarks, and achieves results approaching leading closed-source systems. Notably, this is accomplished with only 208.62 million unique images. The base model's theoretical training cost is only approximately \$400K. We share practical discussions that we believe are valuable to the broader research community, and release weights, code, and recipes under Apache 2.0 to advance the open ecosystem for unified multimodal understanding and generation. Our code is available here: https://github.com/Boogu-Project/Boogu-Image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Boogu-Image-0.1，一个开源统一多模态理解与生成模型家族，包括Base、Turbo、Edit和Edit-Turbo变体。该模型在高质量文本到图像生成、快速推理、基于指令的编辑以及中英双语文本渲染上表现出竞争力。仅使用2.0862亿张独特图像，基础模型理论训练成本约40万美元。综合评估显示，其在标准基准上匹配或超越其他开源模型，并接近领先闭源系统。作者开源了权重、代码和配方，并分享了对研究社区有价值的实践讨论。
Motivation: 闭源多模态系统（如Nano-Banana-Pro、GPT-Image-2）通过系统级集成实现强性能，但其内部实践大多未公开。本文旨在展示在有限计算预算下，通过针对性改进模型理解、数据质量和训练流程，并配合推理时agentic scaling，可以显著提升生成和编辑性能。
Method: 通过提升模型理解能力、优化数据质量、改进训练流程，并结合推理时agentic scaling（agentic inference-time scaling）来增强生成和编辑效果。具体架构和训练细节未在摘要中详述。
Result: 在标准基准评估中，Boogu-Image-0.1一致地匹配或超越其他开源模型，并且结果接近领先闭源系统。该模型仅使用2.0862亿张图像训练，基础模型理论训练成本约40万美元。
Conclusion: 作者认为其实践经验对研究社区有价值，并选择在Apache 2.0许可证下开源权重、代码和配方，以推进统一多模态理解与生成的开放生态系统。

papers.title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning is a hardware-friendly way to compress LLMs, but it is mostly validated on multiple-choice recognition tasks, while the same compressed checkpoints can collapse on the free-form generation that deployment actually requires. Two observations trace this gap. First, greedy \textsc{pass}@$1$ nearly vanishes after compression, yet \textsc{pass}@$k$ recovers substantially under repeated sampling: useful generations are demoted, not erased. Second, the recoverable regime fails mainly through suffix repetition. Recovery should therefore train on the compressed model's own on-policy states with dense token-level supervision, which On-Policy Distillation (OPD) provides by reusing the pre-compression model as a frozen teacher. However, long on-policy rollouts spend early recovery budget on low-information repetitive suffixes, delaying loss descent. To mitigate this waste, we propose \textbf{\shortopd}, a short-to-long OPD schedule that detects teacher-confirmed repetitive suffixes, treats the surviving prefix as each rollout's effective length, and allocates future rollout budgets to the effective lengths the policy can currently use. Across math, code, and open-ended generation, \shortopd\ raises the compressed model's score to about $9\times$ its unrecovered value and $1.6$--$4.4\times$ standard recovery recipes (SFT w/o KD, KD, and SeqKD), and it matches a fixed $8192$-token rollout horizon within two points using a quarter of the training time ($8.5$ vs.\ $35.9$ hours) and $71\%$ fewer rollout tokens. We hope this recipe helps move structured pruning beyond marginal gains on perplexity and multiple-choice benchmarks, a step closer to deployment-ready generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对结构化剪枝后大语言模型在自由生成任务中性能崩溃的问题，提出短到长的在线策略蒸馏（ShortOPD）方法。通过检测教师模型确认的重复后缀，将幸存前缀作为有效长度，并动态分配训练预算，该方法在数学、代码和开放生成任务上将压缩模型分数提升约9倍，相比标准恢复方法加速4倍。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝虽能压缩LLM，但在实际部署所需的自由生成任务中容易崩溃，表现为贪婪采样性能消失而重复采样可恢复，且失败主要由后缀重复导致。现有恢复方法在长rollout中浪费大量预算在低信息重复后缀上。
Method: 提出ShortOPD，一种短到长的在线策略蒸馏调度：利用预压缩模型作为教师，检测学生模型生成的重复后缀，将幸存前缀作为每次rollout的有效长度，并根据当前策略能力分配未来预算。
Result: 在数学、代码和开放生成基准上，ShortOPD将压缩模型得分提升至未恢复值的约9倍，优于标准恢复方法（SFT、KD、SeqKD）1.6-4.4倍；使用固定8192 token rollout 1/4的训练时间（8.5小时 vs 35.9小时）和71%更少的rollout token达到相近性能。
Conclusion: ShortOPD通过避免低信息后缀训练浪费，显著提升压缩模型生成质量，有望使结构化剪枝超越困惑度和多选题基准，接近部署就绪的生成质量。

summary_sections.motivation: 结构化剪枝虽能压缩LLM，但在实际部署所需的自由生成任务中容易崩溃，表现为贪婪采样性能消失而重复采样可恢复，且失败主要由后缀重复导致。现有恢复方法在长rollout中浪费大量预算在低信息重复后缀上。
summary_sections.method: 提出ShortOPD，一种短到长的在线策略蒸馏调度：利用预压缩模型作为教师，检测学生模型生成的重复后缀，将幸存前缀作为每次rollout的有效长度，并根据当前策略能力分配未来预算。
summary_sections.result: 在数学、代码和开放生成基准上，ShortOPD将压缩模型得分提升至未恢复值的约9倍，优于标准恢复方法（SFT、KD、SeqKD）1.6-4.4倍；使用固定8192 token rollout 1/4的训练时间（8.5小时 vs 35.9小时）和71%更少的rollout token达到相近性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: ShortOPD通过避免低信息后缀训练浪费，显著提升压缩模型生成质量，有望使结构化剪枝超越困惑度和多选题基准，接近部署就绪的生成质量。

papers.title: AI in Cyberpsychology: A systematic literature review of Cybersecurity enhancement by using AI for analyzing psychology of Victims, Attackers, and Defenders
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting systems, networks, and data from digital attacks. Cyberpsychology (CPSY) is defined as the use of psychology to enhance cybersecurity applications. Since the early 2010s, the evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has increasingly integrated with CPSY, leveraging advanced data analysis to decode the distinct personality traits and behavioral patterns of victims, attackers, and defenders. In this systematic literature review (SLR), we carefully analyze 34 collected research studies of AI usage in cyberpsychology (AI-CPSY) using the preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA) methodology. The review presents a comprehensive taxonomy of the cyber-security applications, the AI methodologies used, and the psychological concepts employed across the studies . We sort the research studies into four cybersecurity applications: Anomaly Detection (AD), Vulnerability Risk Prediction (VRP), Security Awareness Training (SAT), and Authentication/Identity Verification (AIV). Within each application area, studies are further sorted according to the AI method used including machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), natural language processing (NLP), and reinforcement learning (RL). Furthermore, the review identifies the most commonly utilized psychological concepts, quantify the datasets used in the field, and present their current implementation and deployment status. At last, it detect research gaps, present open challenges, and deduce the trending and most effective and emerging methodologies used across the AI-CPSY landscape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是关于人工智能在网络安全心理学（AI-CPSY）中的系统文献综述，遵循PRISMA方法分析了34项研究。综述将研究按网络安全应用分类为异常检测、漏洞风险预测、安全意识培训、认证/身份验证，并进一步按AI方法（ML、DL、NLP、RL）分类。识别了常用心理概念、数据集和部署现状，最后指出研究空白和未来挑战。
Motivation: 网络安全心理学结合心理学增强网络安全，AI的融入为分析受害者、攻击者和防御者的个性特征与行为模式提供了新手段，但缺乏系统的文献梳理。
Method: 采用PRISMA系统回顾方法，收集并分析了34篇AI在网络安全心理学中的研究，构建了包含网络安全应用、AI方法和心理概念的分类法。
Result: 综述给出了四个网络安全应用域的详细分类，并量化了数据集和部署状态，识别了研究空白和有效方法论。
Conclusion: 论文总结了AI-CPSY领域的研究趋势和开放挑战，指出现有方法中哪些最有效和新兴。

papers.title: CoDiffGRN: Rethinking Gene Regulatory Network Inference via the BEELINE-KGC Benchmark and Co-evolutionary Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Inferring gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell transcriptomic data is crucial for biological discovery, yet existing approaches suffer from a fundamental misalignment with real-world needs. Researchers typically seek a small set of high-confidence regulatory interactions for experimental validation, often involving previously unseen genes. However, current benchmarks rely on transductive splits with global classification metrics, while prevailing models struggle to generalize under inductive settings. To bridge this gap, we reformulate GRN inference as an inductive, ranking-centric graph completion problem and introduce \textbf{\benchmark}, a new benchmark that incorporates an inductive gene-holdout split together with knowledge graph completion metrics to better evaluate top-ranked predictions. Building on this, we propose \textbf{\method}, the first co-evolutionary discrete diffusion framework that jointly models biologically coherent discretized gene expression states and regulatory interactions for robust inductive generalization and improved top-ranked regulatory discovery. We further introduce TF-ALL Subgraph Sampling (TASS) for scalable training. Extensive experiments on {\benchmark} show that {\method} establishes new state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods in novel regulatory discovery, and ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of our design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了基因调控网络（GRN）推断问题，指出现有基准和模型与真实需求存在根本性错位。作者提出了一个新的基准BEELINE-KGC，采用归纳式基因保留划分和知识图谱补全指标来评估排名靠前的预测。在此基础上，提出了CoDiffGRN，首个共进化离散扩散框架，联合建模生物上一致的离散基因表达状态和调控相互作用，以实现鲁棒的归纳泛化和改进的顶级调控发现。在BEELINE-KGC上的广泛实验显示，CoDiffGRN在新型调控发现方面显著优于现有方法，设立了新的最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有GRN推断方法在归纳设置下泛化能力差，且基准使用转导划分和全局分类指标，未能反映研究者期望获得高置信度调控交互以进行实验验证的实际需求。
Method: 提出CoDiffGRN，一个共进化离散扩散框架，联合建模离散化的基因表达状态和调控相互作用；同时引入TF-ALL子图采样（TASS）实现可扩展训练。
Result: 在BEELINE-KGC基准上，CoDiffGRN在新型调控发现任务中显著超越现有方法，达到新的最佳性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过重新定义GRN推断为归纳的、以排序为中心的图补全问题，并结合共进化离散扩散模型，可以更有效地发现高置信度的调控关系。

papers.title: Mixed-Timescale Differential Coding for Downlink Model Broadcast in Wireless Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: In standard federated learning systems, the parameter server broadcasts the global model to the participating devices in every iteration. Motivated by the temporal correlation between consecutive global models, differential coding can be applied to global model dissemination to reduce the information magnitude, thereby enabling communication with fewer quantization bits. However, due to wireless link failures, devices may occasionally miss differential updates and consequently fail to reconstruct the global model. As a result, they either continue local training based on an outdated model or remain idle until the next full-model broadcast becomes available. To address this challenge, we propose a mixed-timescale differential coding (MTDC) scheme that performs differential coding at two different levels by adjusting the reference model. With MTDC, a device can reconstruct the latest global model between two full-model broadcasts even if it misses a differential update. We provide a convergence analysis that motivates the design of an age-aware variant of MTDC, along with a device scheduling policy to further improve communication efficiency. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed MTDC schemes achieve superior learning performance compared to baseline methods under similar communication resource budgets in the presence of downlink transmission failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无线联邦学习中设备因下行链路失败而丢失差分更新导致无法重构全局模型的问题，提出混合时间尺度差分编码（MTDC）方案。MTDC通过在不同层次调整参考模型进行差分编码，使设备在两次完整模型广播之间即使错过一次差分更新也能重构最新全局模型。仿真结果表明，在下行传输失败场景下，MTDC在相似通信资源预算下优于基线方法。
Motivation: 标准联邦学习中，设备可能因无线链路失败错过全局模型的差分更新，导致使用过时模型或闲置，影响学习效率和收敛。
Method: 提出混合时间尺度差分编码（MTDC），通过调整参考模型在两种时间尺度上进行差分编码；还设计了年龄感知变体（age-aware variant）和相应的设备调度策略以进一步提升通信效率。
Result: 仿真结果证明，在下行传输失败的情况下，所提MTDC方案在相似的通信资源预算下取得了比基线方法更优的学习性能。
Conclusion: 论文提供了收敛分析，表明年龄感知MTDC及调度策略能有效改善通信效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: C-Norm: Cell-Distribution Normalization Enables Precision Recognition of Medical-Cell Image
papers.abstract_en: ThinPrep Cytologic Test (TCT) enables early cervical cancer screening, but manual reading is time-consuming and yields inconsistent diagnostic results among cytopathologists. Existing AI detection models perform poorly under real clinical conditions, primarily restricted by two key constraints: unbalanced spatial distribution of cell populations in TCT slides, and limited high-quality annotated cytology data relying on professional pathologist labeling. To address these limitations, we propose a Cell-Distribution Normalization (C-Norm) method. By decoupling abnormal and normal cells from the original TCT images and re-synthesizing them, this method ensures a uniform distribution of cell populations, thereby mitigating generalization degradation caused by distribution bias. Building upon this, we integrate the YOLOv12 framework with a DINOv3 module. This hybrid architecture leverages the advanced detection capability of YOLO models and the superior feature representations of DINOv3 to capture subtle morphological nuances essential for precise recognition of TCT images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming mainstream detection algorithms. The complete implementation is available at: https://github.com/ddw2AIGROUP2CQUPT/Cell-Norm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种细胞分布归一化方法 (C-Norm)，用于解决TCT宫颈细胞图像中细胞分布不均和标注数据有限的问题。通过解耦异常与正常细胞并重新合成，使细胞群均匀分布，并集成YOLOv12与DINOv3模块以捕捉细微形态差异。实验表明该方法在TCT图像识别上达到SOTA性能，显著优于主流检测算法。
Motivation: 现有AI模型在真实临床条件下表现差，主要受限于TCT玻片上细胞空间分布不均以及高质量标注数据稀缺。
Method: 提出C-Norm方法，从原始TCT图像中分离异常和正常细胞并重新合成，保证细胞群均匀分布；同时集成YOLOv12检测框架与DINOv3特征提取模块，利用YOLO的检测能力和DINOv3的精细特征表示。
Result: 实验表明该方法达到SOTA性能，显著优于主流检测算法。
Conclusion: 通过解决分布偏差和数据稀缺问题，该方法提升了TCT图像识别的精度；代码已开源。

papers.title: Improving Molecular Property Prediction in Small Language Models Using Graph-based Tools
papers.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) have shown promise for zero-shot molecular property prediction from SMILES strings, yet they often suffer from structural blindness because sequence representations under-specify key graph-topological cues. We propose a modular Context-Augmented Prompting framework that enables agentic tool use at inference time: a trained GNN expert model provides a predictive hint with confidence, and a GNN extracts an instance-specific explanatory subgraph (e.g., a subgraph SMILES and an accompanying explanatory paragraph). We evaluate three commonly used SLMs on MUTAG and Tox21 under five prompting configurations ranging from SMILES-only to using all available tools at hand. Across two datasets, enriching prompts with graph-derived context yields substantial accuracy gains, often exceeding 25% relative improvement and up to 74% on Tox21. We further validate the functional relevance of the extracted motifs via a necessity-based edge-drop intervention. Despite the observed gains, a persistent gap remains to specialized GNN models, highlighting both the value and limits of text-conditioned reasoning for molecular structure.
papers.comment: Presented at the 2nd Causal Neuro-symbolic Artificial Intelligence (Causal NeSy): Toward Agentic LLMs with Neuro-Symbolic and Graph Based Reasoning Workshop @ ESWC2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化的上下文增强提示框架，在推理时结合GNN专家模型和子图解释，提升小语言模型（SLM）从SMILES序列预测分子性质的能力。在MUTAG和Tox21数据集上，相比纯SMILES提示，结合图上下文的方法准确率相对提升超过25%，最高达74%。尽管如此，专用GNN模型仍表现更优。
Motivation: 小语言模型由于序列表示忽略图拓扑结构，存在结构盲点，导致零样本分子性质预测性能不足。
Method: 提出Context-Augmented Prompting框架：一个训练好的GNN专家模型提供带置信度的预测提示，另一个GNN提取实例特定的解释性子图（含子图SMILES和解释段落），作为提示的上下文。
Result: 在MUTAG和Tox21上评估三种SLM，五种提示配置。结合图上下文后准确率相对提升超过25%，Tox21上最高达74%。通过必要性边删除干预验证了提取基序的功能相关性。
Conclusion: 文本条件推理对分子结构有价值但有限，与专用GNN模型仍有差距。

papers.title: SemaDiff: Identifying Semantic-Changing Commits with Generated Code and Tests
papers.abstract_en: Distinguishing semantic-preserving commits from changing ones remains an open challenge in software repository mining. While existing approaches detect refactoring commits accurately, they cannot ensure that a commit is purely semantic-preserving, without any interleaving behaviour-changing modification. This limitation can impact several tasks, such as debugging, fault localisation, bug dataset construction, rollback analysis, and bug fixes backporting. To fill this gap, we propose SemaDiff, a novel approach for identifying semantic-preserving commits through behaviour-based analysis; comparison of similar test execution on pre- and post-commit versions. As code impacted by the refactoring is often hard to test and different accross both versions, we propose generating additional calling methods to that code, which serve as testing target. Given a commit, SemaDiff analyses the diff to identify modified code and extracts unchanged dependent code that calls it. It then generates an additional dependent class using a large language model to exercise the changed code in both versions, and automatically generates tests for the dependent code. This way, we obtain the same tests for the different code versions, enabling the behavioural-difference detection. The commit is classified as semantic-preserving only if all generated tests produce identical outcomes across the two versions. To evaluate SemaDiff, we construct and annotate manually a dataset of 183 commits, gathered from well-known open-source Java projects. The obtained results show that SemaDiff distinguishes accurately semantic-preserving from -- changing commits in about 76% of the cases, with a 100% precision in semantic-changing commit detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SemaDiff方法，通过行为分析（比较提交前后相似测试的执行结果）来区分语义保持型提交和语义改变型提交。该方法利用大语言模型生成额外的调用代码和测试，以检测行为差异。在183个Java开源项目提交上评估，准确率约76%，语义改变型提交检测精度100%。
Motivation: 现有工具能准确检测重构提交，但无法保证提交纯语义保持（无行为改变），影响调试、故障定位、错误数据集构建等任务。
Method: SemaDiff分析diff找出修改代码，提取未修改的依赖调用代码，用LLM生成额外的依赖类来测试修改代码在两个版本上的行为，自动生成测试；若所有测试输出一致则判定为语义保持型提交。
Result: 在手动标注的183个Java提交数据集上，准确区分语义保持/改变提交约76%，语义改变提交检测精度100%。
Conclusion: SemaDiff能准确识别语义改变提交，但语义保持提交的识别精度可能有限（未明确给出），且依赖于代码生成质量。

papers.title: A Hybrid Mamba for Audio-Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Since the paradigm centered on convolutional neural networks and recurrent architectures was established in 2020, the fundamental backbone networks for audio-visual navigation have undergone no essential changes for more than five years, making them inadequate to support efficient representation of dynamic multimodal sequences. This paper proposes Samba(A Hybrid Mamba for Audio-Visual Navigation). It uses the adaptive selection-enabled Mamba State Encoder (M-SE) to replace conventional GRUs for temporal aggregation, and constructs an Audio Mamba Encoder (AME) to remedy the limitations of convolutional operators in capturing global time-frequency dependencies in spectrograms. Experiments demonstrate that Samba exhibits exceptional generalization performance when facing unheard sound sources and unseen scenes. On the Matterport3D dataset, it improves the navigation success rate (SR) by 11.3\% compared with existing state-of-the-art models, and the performance gain is even more pronounced on the Replica dataset, which features finer scene structures. Such modernized architectural reconstruction unlocks stronger embodied representation capabilities at a lower computational cost, thereby providing a highly robust technical pathway for paradigm evolution in the field of audio-visual navigation.
papers.comment: Main paper (6 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE International Conference on Systems and Man and Cybernetics 2026 (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Samba，一种用于音频-视觉导航的混合Mamba架构。它利用自适应选择的Mamba状态编码器（M-SE）替代传统GRU进行时间聚合，并构建音频Mamba编码器（AME）以克服卷积算子在全频谱时频依赖上的局限。在Matterport3D数据集上，导航成功率（SR）相较现有最优模型提升11.3%，在场景结构更精细的Replica数据集上提升更为显著。实验表明Samba在面对未听过声源和未见场景时具有出色的泛化能力。
Motivation: 自2020年以来，基于CNN和循环架构的音频-视觉导航骨干网络未发生本质变化，难以高效表示动态多模态序列。
Method: 提出Samba，核心组件包括用于时间聚合的自适应选择Mamba状态编码器（M-SE），以及用于捕获频谱图全局时频依赖的音频Mamba编码器（AME）。
Result: 在Matterport3D数据集上，导航成功率（SR）相比现有最优模型提升11.3%；在Replica数据集上性能增益更为明显。
Conclusion: 通过现代架构重构，Samba以更低计算成本实现更强的具身表示能力，为音频-视觉导航领域的范式演变提供了高鲁棒性的技术路径。

papers.title: STKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world traffic data exhibit heterogeneous spatial correlations and nonlinear temporal dynamics, posing substantial challenges for accurate spatio-temporal forecasting. Existing approaches have developed increasingly sophisticated graph, attention, and decomposition architectures, while the influence of the underlying nonlinear function approximator has received comparatively less attention. In this work, we propose STKAN, a spatio-temporal forecasting architecture that introduces Taylor-polynomial Kolmogorov--Arnold Network modules into spatial and temporal token mixing. STKAN first constructs high-level spatial representations through a learnable soft node-group assignment mechanism, applies group-wise spatial mixing, and subsequently models temporal dependencies over the compressed sequence. Spatial and temporal self-attention layers are further employed to capture long-range interactions. Experiments on five traffic forecasting benchmarks show that STKAN achieves competitive performance and performs better than the evaluated MLP-based variant in the tested settings. These results suggest that the design of nonlinear function approximators can serve as a useful complement to architectural design in spatio-temporal forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STKAN，一种将泰勒多项式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络模块集成到时空预测架构中的方法。通过可学习的软节点分组机制进行空间混合，再通过压缩序列建模时间依赖，并辅以自注意力层捕获长程交互。在五个交通预测基准上取得有竞争力的性能，优于MLP变体，表明非线性函数逼近器的设计可作为架构设计的有益补充。
Motivation: 现有时空预测方法侧重图、注意力或分解架构，但对底层非线性函数逼近器的影响关注不足。
Method: 引入泰勒多项式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络模块，通过可学习软节点分组机制构建高层空间表示，进行分组空间混合，然后对压缩序列建模时间依赖，并采用时空自注意力层捕获长程交互。
Result: 在五个交通预测基准上，STKAN取得有竞争力的性能，并在测试设置中优于所评估的MLP变体。
Conclusion: 非线性函数逼近器的设计可作为时空预测中架构设计的有益补充。

papers.title: DeepCormack: Fermi surface tomography using model-based data-driven algorithms
papers.abstract_en: The experimental reconstruction of the 3D two-photon momentum density (TPMD) via angular correlation of electron-positron annihilation radiation (ACAR) is a particularly useful method for studying material Fermi surfaces. It does not rely on low temperatures, UHV conditions, or strong magnetic fields, and enables the study of the spin-resolved electronic structure of materials. Yet, it remains a challenging inverse problem. Typically, 10^8 positron annihilation events are measured for 3--6 projections of the TPMD at different angles. The standard reconstruction approach is an ACAR adaptation of Cormack's method (the MCM) that leverages the inherent symmetry in the crystal's structure. However, the poor signal-to-noise ratio means collecting data of sufficient quality for Fermi surface studies can take months per sample. We present DeepCormack, a family of data-driven model-based reconstruction algorithms that augments the MCM by integrating supervised deep-learning models (CNN, MLP, and UNet) at various stages. To overcome the lack of large experimental training sets, we propose a method which leverages singular value decomposition with dynamic mode decomposition to generate realistic synthetic TPMD volumes, requiring only a single reference momentum density computed via density functional theory. On test data, DeepCormack improves reconstruction quality over MCM by about 8.5 dB PSNR at 200M counts and remains stable at reduced counts, enabling significantly faster acquisition times. Generalisation to experimental data depends strongly on how well the training distribution from the reference momentum density matches the sample. We therefore recommend pairing DeepCormack with a DFT calculation of the target material to create sample-specific training data. Our proposed method offers either much higher quality reconstructions, or enables significantly faster ones, on the order of weeks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeepCormack，一种结合深度学习与模型驱动的重建算法，用于从角关联电子-正电子湮灭辐射(ACAR)数据中重建三维双光子动量密度(TPMD)，以提高费米面断层扫描的质量和速度。该方法在标准Cormack方法(MCU)中集成CNN、MLP和UNet等深度学习模型，并利用奇异值分解与动态模式分解生成合成训练数据。实验表明，在200M计数下PSNR提升约8.5 dB，且低计数下仍保持稳定，可将数据采集时间从数月缩短至数周。
Motivation: ACAR实验采集费米面数据信噪比低，标准重建方法（MCU）需要数月才能获得足够质量的数据，严重限制了研究效率。
Method: 提出DeepCormack算法族，在MCU的多个阶段集成监督深度学习模型（CNN、MLP、UNet），并利用奇异值分解与动态模式分解从单个DFT参考动量密度生成逼真的合成TPMD训练数据，解决实验训练数据匮乏的问题。
Result: 在测试数据上，DeepCormack在200M计数下相比MCU的PSNR提升约8.5 dB，且在减少计数时仍保持稳定重建质量，从而将采集时间从数月缩短至数周量级。
Conclusion: DeepCormack能显著提高ACAR费米面重建质量或加速采集，但泛化性依赖于训练分布与目标材料的匹配，推荐与对应材料的DFT计算结合生成样本特定训练数据。

papers.title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving autonomous agents are moving from research prototypes to deployed systems. The primary goal is controllable evolution, or adaptation, from experience with minimal or even no human input. This survey frames modern self-improving agents as adaptive systems that convert experience into accumulated capability gains. We offer a system-level framework that represents a modern agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and control logic. Within this framework, self-improvement is formalized as a self-induced update operator that obtains and commits updates to model parameters or scaffold components. We organize prior work by update target and by the signals that drive change, then review applications and discuss evaluation, before closing with open problems and future directions. For convenience, we track technical updates on https://github.com/selfimproving-agent/awesome-Self-Improving-Agents.
papers.comment: 97 pages, 12 figures. Project page: https://selfimproving-agent.github.io/ Repository: https://github.com/selfimproving-agent/awesome-Self-Improving-Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述将现代自改进自主智能体定义为自适应系统，通过经验累积能力增益。作者提出一个系统级框架，将智能体表示为基座模型与操作支架（提示、记忆、工具、控制逻辑）的组合，并将自改进形式化为自诱导更新算子。该综述按更新目标和驱动信号组织相关工作，讨论应用和评估，并指出开放问题和未来方向。
Motivation: 自改进自主智能体正从研究原型走向部署系统，但缺乏统一的系统性框架来理解其设计空间和原理。
Method: 提出系统级框架，将现代自主智能体建模为基座模型与操作支架的耦合，并将自改进形式化为自诱导更新算子，该算子获取并提交对模型参数或支架组件的更新。按更新目标和驱动信号进行分类。
Result: 综述组织了大量相关工作，涵盖不同更新目标和信号，并讨论了应用场景和评估方法。
Conclusion: 该综述框架有助于系统化理解和设计自改进智能体，同时指出开放问题和未来研究方向，如可控制进化、最小人工输入等。

papers.title: Disentangling Knowledge States with Ability and Proficiency Modeling for Knowledge Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge tracing (KT) aims to predict students' future performance by modeling their evolving knowledge states from historical interactions. Existing KT methods usually treat the raw interaction sequence as a unified behavioral process, overlooking the phase-specific nature of learning behaviors. Our preliminary observations show that students are more likely to correctly answer previously failed knowledge concepts after sufficient practice, suggesting a transition from ability-building to proficiency-oriented learning. Motivated by this, we propose Phase-Aware Knowledge Tracing (PAKT), a KT framework that decomposes student interactions into ability and proficiency phases based on the tailored decomposition mechanism. To effectively exploit the decomposed sequences, we design a multi-branch Transformer with a type-aware readout module to jointly capture phase-specific and holistic knowledge states. We further provide a causal analysis to reveal the confounding bias caused by entangling complex learning behaviors in phase-agnostic KT models. Extensive experiments on six public benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms representative baselines, with a maximum AUC gain of 1.33% and an average gain of 0.82%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出阶段感知知识追踪（PAKT）框架，将学生历史交互序列分解为能力构建阶段和熟练度导向阶段，以更精细地建模知识状态变化。PAKT采用多分支Transformer架构和类型感知读出模块，分别捕捉阶段特异性和全局知识状态，并通过因果分析揭示混合阶段建模带来的混淆偏差。在六个公共基准上，PAKT平均AUC提升0.82%，最高达1.33%。
Motivation: 现有知识追踪方法将原始交互序列视为统一行为过程，忽略了学习行为中能力构建与熟练度训练的阶段性差异，导致模型难以准确刻画学生知识状态的真实演变。
Method: 提出PAKT框架，包含基于定制分解机制将交互序列分为能力阶段和熟练度阶段；设计多分支Transformer网络，每个分支处理一个阶段序列，并通过类型感知读出模块融合阶段特定表示与整体状态。
Result: 在六个公共知识追踪基准上，PAKT一致优于代表性基线，AUC最高提升1.33%，平均提升0.82%。
Conclusion: 将学习行为分解为能力与熟练度阶段可有效解耦混杂偏误，提升知识追踪的预测精度；PAKT为阶段感知的时序建模提供了可行框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSSM: Triaxial State Space Model for Global Station Weather Forecasting with Temporal-Variable-Historical Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Global Station Weather Forecasting (GSWF) is pivotal for localized and extreme weather prediction over key regions. Despite efforts to exploit look-back windows, existing methods show limited accuracy gains and struggle with extreme events and error accumulation. These limitations stem from overreliance on short-term patterns, which are insufficient to capture chaotic weather dynamics, especially under partial observations. To address this problem, we propose a novel Triaxial State Space Model (TSSM) with a history-enhanced Temporal-VariableHistorical paradigm, which incorporates period-aligned historical weather data to compensate for long-term, large-scale periodic, and full-window weather patterns beyond the temporal lookback window. Specifically, TSSM stacks historical samples into period-aligned batches, where forecasting is causally supported by historical and current observations. Temporal, variable, and historical scanning are designed to capture axial temporal dependencies, variable correlations, and historical evolution. This structure is hierarchically shared to model seasonal to extreme events while alleviating misalignment across historical patterns. TSSM achieves SOTA performance on Weather-5K, the largest station weather dataset to date, with 10% and 61% gains in accuracy and extreme event metrics, and obtains 95% best or second-best results on human-involved datasets. Its advantages are more pronounced in long-horizon and iterative forecasting, reaching a 37.5% gain at 240h and up to 103.5% under a 48h times 5 iterative setting. Moreover, TSSM retains > 90% performance under up to 80% missing observations, compared with < 43% for baselines, demonstrating robustness and practical potential for reliable GSWF in global in-situ observation networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全球站点天气预报（GSWF）中过度依赖短期模式、难以捕捉混沌天气动态和极端事件的问题，提出了三轴状态空间模型（Triaxial State Space Model, TSSM）。该模型采用历史增强的时间-变量-历史（Temporal-Variable-Historical）范式，通过将历史样本组织成周期对齐的批次，并设计时间、变量和历史三个轴向的扫描，分别捕获时间依赖、变量相关性和历史演变，以弥补长周期和大尺度天气模式。TSSM在最大站点天气数据集Weather-5K上达到最优性能，准确率提升10%，极端事件指标提升61%；在人机协作数据集上获得95%的最佳或次佳结果。在长时预报（240小时）和迭代预报（48小时×5次）中分别获得37.5%和103.5%的增益，且在高达80%缺失观测下仍保持>90%性能，远超基线（<43%）。
Motivation: 现有GSWF方法过度依赖短期回溯窗口，难以捕捉混沌天气动态，尤其在部分观测下表现不佳，且对极端事件和误差累积缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出TSSM，核心为历史增强的Temporal-Variable-Historical范式：将历史样本堆叠为周期对齐的批次，使预测同时受历史和当前观测的因果支持。设计时间、变量和历史三个轴向扫描，分别建模时间依赖、变量相关性和历史演化，并通过层次共享结构对齐季节性到极端事件的不同模式。
Result: 在Weather-5K数据集上，准确率提升10%，极端事件指标提升61%；在人工参与数据集上95%的指标为最佳或次佳。长时预报（240h）增益37.5%，迭代预报（48h×5）增益103.5%。在80%缺失观测下性能保持>90%，基线均<43%。
Conclusion: TSSM通过历史增强的三轴建模显著提升了GSWF的准确性和鲁棒性，尤其适用于长时预报和极端事件，并在高缺失率下保持稳定，展示了在全球实地观测网络中可靠应用的潜力。
Relevance: 85

papers.title: WaterMoE: Expert-Routing-based Watermarking for High Fidelity and Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success but raise growing concerns about content provenance and misuse, motivating the need for reliable watermarking techniques. However, these techniques have rarely been adopted in practice mainly for two reasons: i) severely degraded model performance, and ii) additional inference overhead. To confirm the problem, we construct a comprehensive benchmark spanning different generation tasks to systematically evaluate 9 representative watermarking methods. We found almost all existing methods are designed for text fluency, but not for restricted and complicated tasks, and their overhead prevents them from deployment in latency-critical systems. To address i) and ii), we propose an LLM watermarking scheme \textit{WaterMoE} for the growingly popular Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs. WaterMoE embeds watermarking signals through controlled perturbation into the expert selection at each router, which accumulates to token selection shift at the final output. In contrast to watermarking as a post-processing token-sampling approach, WaterMoE embeds watermark within the inference loop incurring negligible quality degradation and computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a fidelity performance close to the unwatermarked and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art watermarking methods on the benchmark, with up to $4\times$ speedup, incurring merely 1\% additional inference latency compared to native generation. The results demonstrate the capability of WaterMoE to be deployed in real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaterMoE，一种针对混合专家模型（MoE）的高保真低开销水印方案。现有水印技术会严重降低模型性能并增加推理延迟，因此很少实际部署。WaterMoE 通过在 MoE 的路由器中选择性地扰动专家选择来嵌入水印信号，该扰动累积到最终的 token 选择偏移，无需后处理。实验表明，WaterMoE 的生成质量接近无水印模型，在多个基准上一致优于现有方法，并实现最高 4 倍的速度提升，额外推理延迟仅约 1%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 水印技术很少被实际采用，主要因为两个原因：严重降低模型性能（如文本流畅性）和增加推理开销。尤其是对于受限复杂任务，现有方法效果不佳且难以部署于延迟敏感系统。
Method: WaterMoE 针对 MoE 架构，通过受控扰动在每个路由器的专家选择过程中嵌入水印信号，该信号积累后影响最终输出的 token 选择。这是嵌入推理循环内的水印，而非后处理的 token 采样方式，因此引入的质量损失和计算开销极小。
Result: 在涵盖多种生成任务的综合基准上，WaterMoE 的保真度接近无水印模型，并一致优于现有最先进水印方法。推理速度最高提升 4 倍，额外延迟仅约 1%。
Conclusion: 本文表明，WaterMoE 能够在保持生成质量的同时实现高效水印，具备实际部署的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Limit
papers.abstract_en: We present a full-pipeline inference optimization for the MiMo-V2.5 model family, which combines Hybrid Sliding Window Attention (Hybrid SWA), sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and multimodal encoders. While Hybrid SWA can ideally reduce both attention compute and KVCache storage significantly compared to Full Attention, realizing these gains in production requires substantial engineering effort. We systematically optimize the KVCache system with layerwise prefetch, SWA-aware prefix cache trees, and specialized placement strategies, achieving strict $O(W)$ SWA storage and high cache hit rates. We further build GCache, a high-performance distributed cache infrastructure with RDMA-optimized networking, and develop a KVCache-affinity router to reduce computation while preserving load balancing. We also optimize for multimodal inputs, including GPU image preprocessing, parallel video decoding, and multimodal cache sharing. Together, these optimizations constitute the first large-scale LLM serving system in production that efficiently covers the Hybrid SWA + MoE + multimodal composite architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为MiMo-V2.5系列模型提出了全流水线推理优化方案，该模型结合了混合滑动窗口注意力（Hybrid SWA）、稀疏混合专家（MoE）和多模态编码器。作者系统优化了KVCache系统，包括层预取、SWA感知前缀缓存树和专门放置策略，实现了严格的O(W) SWA存储和高缓存命中率。此外，构建了基于RDMA优化的分布式缓存基础设施GCache，并开发了KVCache亲和性路由器以减少计算同时保持负载均衡。针对多模态输入也进行了优化，如GPU图像预处理、并行视频解码和多模态缓存共享。这些优化构成了首个在生产环境中高效覆盖Hybrid SWA + MoE + 多模态组合架构的大规模LLM服务系统。
Motivation: Hybrid SWA相比全注意力可显著减少注意力计算和KVCache存储，但在生产中实现这些收益需要大量工程努力。现有系统难以高效支持Hybrid SWA、MoE和多模态编码器的复合架构，导致推理效率瓶颈。
Method: 提出全流水线推理优化，包括：1) KVCache系统优化：层预取、SWA感知前缀缓存树、专门放置策略；2) GCache：基于RDMA优化的分布式缓存基础设施；3) KVCache亲和性路由器；4) 多模态输入优化：GPU图像预处理、并行视频解码、多模态缓存共享。
Result: 摘要宣称实现了严格的O(W) SWA存储和高缓存命中率，但未给出具体数值或基准结果。该系统是首个在生产中覆盖Hybrid SWA+MoE+多模态架构的大规模LLM服务系统。
Conclusion: 本文的优化方法使得Hybrid SWA、MoE和多模态编码器的复合架构在实际生产部署中成为可能，但缺乏定量评估和与现有系统的对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analyzing Curricular Pattern Complexity Using AI to Improve On-Time Graduation Rates
papers.abstract_en: The rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) enables automatic analysis of large amounts of data. Previously time-consuming and labor-intensive tasks can be completed much more efficiently with the use of AI. This work uses AI techniques to analyze and revise curricular patterns in an undergraduate degree for Software Engineering. Curricula often have long sequences where failure to pass a class within the sequence may jeopardize completion of the degree within four years. Manual analysis and revision of curricula by university faculty is a lengthy and labor-intensive process, causing changes to occur rarely and making it impossible to keep up with the changing needs of students. This work reduces the time-to-change for curricula and reduces bottlenecks and graduation delays by using Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze curricular patterns and suggest revisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文利用大语言模型（LLMs）自动分析软件工程本科课程模式，识别出可能导致毕业延迟的课程序列瓶颈，并生成修订建议。传统人工课程分析耗时且更新缓慢，该方法旨在缩短课程变更周期，提升四年按时毕业率。
Motivation: 课程模式分析依赖人工审查，流程漫长且更新频率低，无法及时响应学生需求，导致毕业延迟问题难以解决。
Method: 使用大语言模型（LLMs）分析课程模式，识别导致毕业延迟的长序列瓶颈，并自动生成课程修订建议。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅陈述了方法预期能减少课程变更时间、缓解瓶颈、提升按时毕业率。
Conclusion: AI自动化分析可显著提升课程修订效率，使课程体系更灵活地适应学生需求变化，减少毕业延迟。

papers.title: Efficient and Privacy Aware Edge Cloud Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-device LLM inference faces a trilemma of response latency, limited hardware resources and user privacy. Full cloud inference delivers strong computing power but exposes user prompts and dialogue data, while standalone on-device inference is unfeasible for most consumer and embedded edge devices. This paper presents a privacy-centric edge-cloud collaborative LLM inference framework built on endpoint-authenticated KV cache. Local endpoints handle input preprocessing, embedding computation, adaptive feature optimization, KV cache authentication, speculative decoding and low-dimensional model head calculation, while the cloud conducts authenticated decoder inference, KV cache management, token verification and high-dimensional vocabulary projection. Endpoints fuse partial outputs, apply language-adaptive masking and sample target tokens. All transmitted data and truncated logits are quantized and AES-GCM encrypted for privacy, with core lightweight modules, draft parameters and cache access policies kept local to avoid leakage. The framework supports heterogeneous devices including CPU-only, GPU-equipped and embedded devices via optimized streaming, batching and quantized ONNX deployment. Evaluations demonstrate that the framework reduces per-token latency by up to 46.1\% and downlink payloads by up to 67.4\% over baseline split inference, retaining comparable performance to full cloud inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种隐私保护的边缘-云协作大语言模型推理框架，基于端点认证的KV缓存。本地设备处理输入预处理、嵌入计算、自适应特征优化、KV缓存认证、推测解码和低维模型头计算，云端负责认证的Decoder推理、KV缓存管理、令牌验证和高维词汇投影。所有传输数据经量化和AES-GCM加密，核心轻量模块和缓存访问策略保持本地。该框架支持CPU、GPU和嵌入式设备。实验表明，与基线拆分推理相比，每令牌延迟降低46.1%，下行负载降低67.4%，性能接近全云推理。
Motivation: 设备端大语言模型推理面临响应延迟、硬件资源有限和用户隐私的三难困境。全云推理计算能力强但暴露用户提示和对话数据，纯设备端推理在消费级和嵌入式边缘设备上不可行。
Method: 提出基于端点认证KV缓存的边缘-云协作推理框架，本地执行输入预处理、嵌入计算、自适应特征优化、KV缓存认证、推测解码和低维模型头计算；云端执行认证Decoder推理、KV缓存管理、令牌验证和高维词汇投影。使用量化传输和AES-GCM加密保护隐私，核心模块和缓存策略本地存储。
Result: 实验表明，每令牌延迟降低46.1%，下行负载降低67.4%，性能与全云推理相当。

papers.title: Wasserstein gradient flows for Coulomb discrepancies
papers.abstract_en: We study the long-time behavior of the Wasserstein gradient flow of the squared Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between a probability measure $ρ$ and a target measure $μ$, where the underlying kernel is given by a Coulomb potential. First, we establish the existence of global weak solutions starting from arbitrary Borel probability measures and prove an ultracontractive estimate, showing that the density $ρ_t$ becomes instantly bounded in $L^\infty$ for $t>0$. We also investigate the regularity of these solutions, showing that the Hölder norm can grow exponentially in time. Second, on the flat torus $\mathbb T^\mathsf{d}$, we prove exponential decay of the squared MMD along the flow toward a uniformly positive target $μ$, without requiring a lower bound on the initial data. This result is based on a ''defective Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) inequality'' whose defect term accounts for possible vacuum regions in the evolving density. We also prove that the usual PL inequality may fail when the target vanishes only at one point, and, in dimensions at least two, that no coercivity constant can depend only on a prescribed positive lower bound for the target. Finally, on $\mathbb R^\mathsf{d}$, we identify an obstruction at spatial infinity. For a compactly supported target, uniformly localized sources initially separated from the target by distance $D$ retain a fixed fraction of their initial squared MMD for times of order $D$. Consequently, neither a multiplicative squared-MMD decay modulus uniform over the initial datum nor a global PL inequality can hold on the unrestricted whole-space class. By contrast, under radial symmetry, source-support inclusion, and target-positivity assumptions, we establish a PL inequality and exponential convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究平方最大均值差异（MMD）的Wasserstein梯度流在库仑势核下的长时间行为。证明了任意Borel概率测度下全局弱解的存在性和超收缩估计，并在平坦环面上建立了指数衰减。在欧氏空间中，当目标测度紧支撑时，初始远离的源会保持初始MMD的固定比例直到时间量级D，从而否定全局乘性衰减模量。
Motivation: 现有Wasserstein梯度流理论对一般核函数（如库仑势）的长时间行为理解不足，特别是MMD的Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) 不等式何时成立尚未清楚。
Method: 通过分析平方MMD的梯度流，建立缺陷型PL不等式，并考虑真空区域的影响。在环面和欧氏空间中分别研究，利用超收缩估计和对称性假设。
Result: 在环面上，证明了对一致正目标测度的指数衰减；在欧氏空间中，发现了空间无穷远处的障碍，导致乘性衰减模量无法全局成立，但径向对称等条件下可建立PL不等式和指数收敛。
Conclusion: 库仑势核下的MMD梯度流具有复杂的长时间行为，环面上的指数衰减依赖于缺陷型PL不等式，而欧氏空间中的全局衰减受初始支持与目标距离限制。

papers.title: Verifier-Guided Twelve-Tone Composition: A Generate-Verify-Repair Harness for Symbolic Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce superficially legal twelve-tone scores that collapse into degenerate textures. We introduce a neuro-symbolic harness that wraps a language-model proposer in a generate-verify-repair-trace loop with symbolic verification. The complete pipeline improves event-local consistency without claiming whole-piece legality. Across 40 controlled tasks and four paired models, constraint-checked delivery rises from 13.3% under raw generation to 48.1% with the harness; it abstains on the remaining 51.9% of runs. The pass rate of a narrower collision and serialisation-consistency check rises from 33.5% to 58.3%, while degeneracy remains near 0.05, including under adversarial prompting. A blinded evaluation by five experts also shows a descriptive aggregate preference for harness candidates over raw generation in adherence, perceived legality, coherence, and overall quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型生成的十二音音乐谱在表面合法但易退化为稀疏纹理的问题，提出一个神经符号框架（generate-verify-repair-trace harness），将语言模型提议器与符号验证器结合。在40个控制任务和4对模型测试中，约束检查交付率从原始生成的13.3%提升至48.1%，通过率从33.5%提升至58.3%，退化率保持在0.05附近。专家盲评显示框架候选在一致性、合法性和整体质量上优于原始生成。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型可生成看似合法的十二音乐谱，但常退化为稀疏纹理，缺乏局部一致性。
Method: 提出一个神经符号框架，在生成-验证-修复-追踪循环中包装语言模型提议器，并引入符号验证器进行约束检查。
Result: 摘要报告约束检查交付率从13.3%提升至48.1%，通过率从33.5%提升至58.3%，退化率稳定在0.05附近，且专家盲评显示框架候选在合法性和质量上更优。
Conclusion: 该框架有效提升局部一致性，但未声称整曲合法性；专家偏好框架生成结果，但仍有51.9%的生成被弃权。

papers.title: M+Adam: Low-Precision Training via Additive-Multiplicative Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Training with quantized weights can reduce costs but often results in degraded accuracy, especially when optimization is carried out in low precision, without storing high-precision copies. We identify a key failure mode: under low precision, standard optimizers can get stuck and not make progress, especially at large weight magnitudes due to coarse mantissa resolution. To overcome this, multiplicative updates have been previously proposed, in place of additive updates in standard optimizers. While successful under extremely low precision, such as under the logarithmic number system, they suffer from failures near zero and across sign changes. The failure modes of additive and multiplicative updates are therefore complementary. To exploit this, we propose M+Adam, which combines both update types: additive steps handle sign changes and small magnitudes, while multiplicative steps ensure progress at large magnitudes when additive updates are zeroed out under rounding. We prove monotone descent for M+Adam under standard smoothness assumptions. Across LLaMA-style pretraining with 60M-1B models, 1x-8x Chinchilla budgets, and using only BF16, FP8, and FP4 master weights, M+Adam consistently improves low-precision training.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 45 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M+Adam优化器，结合加法与乘法更新，解决低精度训练中标准优化器在大权重时因尾数精度粗糙而停滞的问题。在LLaMA风格预训练（60M-1B参数）和BF16/FP8/FP4精度下，M+Adam一致提升训练性能。
Motivation: 低精度训练中标准优化器（如Adam）在大权重时因尾数精度粗糙而无法更新，而此前提出的乘法更新在接近零及符号变化时失效，两种失败模式互补。
Method: 提出M+Adam，融合加法更新（处理符号变化和小幅度）与乘法更新（在加法更新被舍入清零时确保大幅度进展），并在标准光滑性假设下证明单调下降。
Result: 在LLaMA风格预训练60M-1B参数模型、1x-8x Chinchilla计算预算下，使用BF16、FP8、FP4主权重，M+Adam一致提升低精度训练性能。
Conclusion: M+Adam通过融合加法与乘法更新有效解决了低精度优化中互补的失败模式，为低精度训练提供了改进方案。

papers.title: BiLoG-Net: A Bi-Context Location-Guided Network for Breast Mass Segmentation and Malignancy Classification in Mammography
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer remains the most commonly diagnosed malignancy among women worldwide, yet accurate detection and characterization of breast masses in mammography remain challenging due to subtle intensity variations, heterogeneous tissue densities, and indistinct lesion boundaries that complicate radiological interpretation. To address these limitations, we propose BiLoG-Net, a deep learning framework that jointly performs breast mass segmentation and malignancy classification through bi-context location-aware feature modeling and segmentation-guided attention mechanisms. Our architecture integrates a novel encoder-decoder paradigm with Fire-based feature extraction, lightweight global and local feature enhancement modules, and adaptive location-aware gating to simultaneously capture long-range contextual dependencies and fine-grained boundary-sensitive details. Unlike conventional multi-stage pipelines, our tightly coupled multi-task design enables mutual reinforcement between pixel-level localization and image-level diagnosis, reducing error propagation while producing spatially grounded malignancy predictions. Evaluated on CBIS-DDSM and INBreast benchmarks, BiLoG-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance with Dice scores of 94.20% and 93.10%, classification accuracies of 95.20% and 93.60%, and AUC values of 97.10% and 96.00%, respectively, substantially outperforming existing CNN and transformer-based baselines. By combining precise boundary delineation with reliable malignancy assessment in a single end-to-end model, this work holds strong potential for clinical computer-aided detection systems, helping radiologists prioritize suspicious cases and improve screening efficiency in busy clinical settings.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Under review at Computer Modeling in Engineering & Sciences
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiLoG-Net是一个联合进行乳腺肿块分割和恶性分类的深度学习框架，通过双上下文位置感知特征建模和分割引导的注意力机制，在CBIS-DDSM和INBreast基准上分别达到94.20%和93.10%的Dice分数、95.20%和93.60%的分类准确率以及97.10%和96.00%的AUC，优于现有CNN和Transformer基线。
Motivation: 乳腺X线摄影中肿块检测面临强度变化细微、组织密度多样和边界模糊等挑战，现有方法难以同时精准分割和分类。
Method: 提出BiLoG-Net，采用编码器-解码器架构结合Fire特征提取、轻量级全局和局部特征增强模块以及自适应位置感知门控，通过紧耦合多任务学习实现像素级定位与图像级诊断的相互增强。
Result: 在CBIS-DDSM和INBreast上Dice分别为94.20%和93.10%，分类准确率95.20%和93.60%，AUC为97.10%和96.00%。
Conclusion: 该端到端模型可同时提供精确边界分割和可靠恶性评估，有望用于临床计算机辅助检测系统，提高筛查效率。

papers.title: Reconfigurable Radiology Labels Without Relabeling
papers.abstract_en: Public chest-radiograph (CXR) datasets are typically released with small, fixed label schemas such as CheXpert-14. However, the underlying free-text reports describe far more findings -- and which findings matter depends on the task, site, and reader. We release a pipeline that converts free-text reports into multi-label matrices and then reconfigures the label schema through dictionary edits rather than new inference passes, i.e., without relabeling the corpus. After this one-time pass, reconfiguring MIMIC-CXR (223K reports) from cached annotations takes 196 seconds with no API cost, compared to \$6.6K for an equivalent relabeling pass with Claude Opus 4.7. Using a 58-label taxonomy, we show that 43\% of CXR studies contain at least one finding outside CheXpert-14. Image probes trained on these labels match CheXpert-14 probes on shared targets while also reaching 0.78 AUROC on expert-reviewed long-tail labels that CheXpert-14 cannot represent. These results suggest a different unit of work for radiology labeling: once reports are structured, the label schema becomes a configuration to edit, not a corpus to relabel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需重新标注即可重新配置放射学标签的流程。通过一次性将自由文本报告转换为多标签矩阵，后续仅需编辑字典即可改变标签模式，避免了昂贵的重新标注。在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，重新配置耗时196秒且无API成本，而等效的重新标注需要6600美元。使用58标签分类法发现43%的CXR研究包含CheXpert-14之外的内容。基于新标签训练的模型在共享目标上匹配CheXpert-14探针，并在长尾标签上达到0.78 AUROC。研究表明放射学标注的工作单元应转向结构化报告后的配置编辑。
Motivation: 公共胸部X光数据集通常使用固定且较小的标签模式，但自由文本报告中包含更多发现，且所需标签依赖于任务、站点和读者。现有方法需要重新标注整个语料库，成本高昂。
Method: 开发一个流程，将自由文本报告转换为多标签矩阵，然后通过字典编辑重新配置标签模式，无需新的推理或重新标注。一次转换后，后续配置更改仅需编辑映射关系。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR（223K报告）上，重新配置耗时196秒且无API成本，而等效的重新标注（使用Claude Opus 4.7）需花费6600美元。使用58标签分类法，43%的CXR研究包含CheXpert-14之外的内容。基于新标签训练的模型在共享目标上与CheXpert-14探针性能匹配，并在专家审查的长尾标签上达到0.78 AUROC。
Conclusion: 放射学标注的工作单元应改变：一旦报告被结构化，标签模式就成为可编辑的配置，而无需重新标注语料库。

papers.title: Piercing Gilbreath's Conjecture: From Deep Number Theory Insights to Fintech and Cybersecurity
papers.abstract_en: I propose a new methodology to attack the fascinating Gilbreath's conjecture about prime numbers, first posted in 1878 and unsolved to this day. The problem statement is rudimentary: kids can understand it. However, despite decades of research, almost no progress has been made. This paper changes the game by presenting a new approach based on sieving, a number of new results with proof, a precise path to the solution, and solid references. It also introduces the concept of reverse sieving, along with applications to testing randomness, pattern and fraud detection, cybersecurity, synthetic data, sequence categorization and normalization, or to detect and quantify a new type of chaos in time series including Brownian motions. Magic primes, forbidden prime number constellations, cellular automata, and reduction via classes of equivalent sequences, are some of the innovative and promising topics discussed in the paper.

papers.title: ECHO: Prune To Act, Trace To Learn With Selective Turn Memory In Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by simplifying past interactions through deletion, folding, or memory editing. However, when useful history is collapsed into compressed states, the reconstructed context may no longer reveal which earlier observations support a successful final answer. This creates a mismatch between bounded-context acting and outcome-based reinforcement learning: the policy acts on reconstructed context, while the learner lacks source-level provenance for assigning credit to the evidence that mattered. We propose ECHO, a selective turn-memory framework for traceable context reconstruction in Agentic RL. ECHO compresses each completed environment turn into a compact source-indexed memory record, reconstructs bounded policy contexts by selecting useful records, and reuses the selected source indices to route positive outcome credit to the final trajectory segment, reused evidence turns, memory findings, and memory-selection actions. On BrowseComp-Plus, ECHO reaches 43.4% held-out accuracy, outperforming GRPO at 28.9% and the rolling-summary baseline SUPO at 36.1%, while using fewer turns and lower trajectory volume than SUPO. The trained policy also improves zero-shot generalization across multi-objective QA, code generation, and deep information-seeking benchmarks on both dense and MoE backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ECHO，一种选择性回合记忆框架，用于代理强化学习中的可追溯上下文重建。ECHO将每个环境回合压缩为源索引记忆记录，通过选择有用记录重建策略上下文，并将正结果信用路由到相关轨迹部分。在BrowseComp-Plus上达到43.4%留出准确率，优于GRPO和SUPO，同时使用更少回合和轨迹量。训练后的策略在多个零样本泛化基准上有所提升。
Motivation: 长程语言代理在有限上下文窗口中压缩历史后，难以追溯哪些早期观测支持最终答案，导致策略行动与基于结果的强化学习之间的信用分配不匹配。
Method: ECHO将每个完整环境回合压缩为紧凑的源索引记忆记录，通过选择有用记录重建有界策略上下文，并重用所选源索引将正结果信用路由到最终轨迹段、重用的证据回合、记忆发现和记忆选择动作。
Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus上达到43.4%留出准确率，优于GRPO的28.9%和滚动摘要基线SUPO的36.1%，同时使用更少的回合和更低的轨迹量。
Conclusion: ECHO解决了上下文管理与信用分配之间的不匹配，并提高了零样本泛化能力，适用于多目标QA、代码生成和深度信息检索等基准。

papers.title: MedDiffuseMix: Preserving Diagnostic Evidence with Saliency-Aware Diffusion Medical Image Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Limited data availability, class imbalance, and domain variability remain major barriers to reliable medical image classification. Conventional augmentation can improve training diversity but may distort diagnostically informative structures, whereas unconstrained generative augmentation may introduce label-inconsistent content. This paper proposes MedDiffuseMix, a saliency-guided diffusion mixing framework for controlled medical image augmentation. The method uses classifier-derived saliency maps to separate high-saliency diagnostic regions from low-saliency background areas and applies diffusion-guided mixing mainly to regions with lower diagnostic importance. Adaptive mixing, Gaussian boundary blending, and a saliency-preservation constraint reduce semantic distortion and reject or attenuate samples that shift model attention away from clinically relevant evidence. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks: the Radiological Society of North America pneumonia chest radiography dataset, Musculoskeletal Radiographs, PatchCamelyon, and the Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Classification dataset. Experiments with convolutional and transformer-based classifiers show that MedDiffuseMix improves accuracy, F1-score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve compared with standard augmentation, Mixup, GenMix, SaliencyMix, and diffusion-based augmentation baselines. Ablation studies confirm the importance of saliency guidance, adaptive region mixing, and smooth boundary blending. Visual attribution analysis further indicates that MedDiffuseMix better preserves diagnostically salient regions. These results suggest that saliency-guided diffusion mixing is an effective augmentation strategy for limited-data medical image classification.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedDiffuseMix，一种基于显著性的扩散混合框架，用于受控的医学图像数据增强。该方法利用分类器生成的显著性图分离高显著性诊断区域和低显著性背景区域，对低显著性区域应用扩散引导混合，并引入自适应混合、高斯边界融合和显著性保持约束以减少语义失真。在四个公共医学图像数据集上的实验表明，与标准增强、Mixup、GenMix、SaliencyMix 和基于扩散的增强基线相比，MedDiffuseMix 提高了准确率、F1 分数和 AUC。消融研究证实了显著性引导、自适应区域混合和平滑边界融合的重要性。视觉归因分析表明，MedDiffuseMix 更好地保留了诊断显著性区域。
Motivation: 医学图像分类中有限的可用数据、类别不平衡和领域变异性是主要障碍。传统增强可能扭曲诊断信息，而无约束的生成增强可能引入与标签不一致的内容。
Method: 提出 MedDiffuseMix，使用分类器导出的显著性图区分高、低显著性区域，对低显著性区域进行扩散引导混合，结合自适应混合、高斯边界融合和显著性保持约束。
Result: 在四个公共基准上（RSNA 肺炎胸片、骨骼放射影像、PatchCamelyon 和乳腺癌组织病理图像分类数据集），与多种基线相比，提高了准确率、F1 分数和 AUC；消融研究验证了各组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 显著性引导的扩散混合是有限数据医学图像分类的有效增强策略，能更好地保留诊断显著性区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autonomous Video Generation with Counterfactual Controllability for Self-Evolving World Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly described as world models because they can learn rich spatiotemporal regularities from visual data. However, we argue that an ideal world model should benefit in a self-evolving generative character. Traditional visually plausible predictions alone are not enough to establish whether an imagined future is physically actionable for a particular embodied agent, failing to provide informative feedback from environments for self-evolving improvement. To realize self-evolving world models, this article proposes the concept of autonomous video generation, which is evaluated through counterfactual controllability, i.e., the ability to i) generate intervention-conditioned futures, ii) bind these future frames to embodiment constraints, iii) verify them under distribution shifts, and iv) distil surviving branches into compact variables for decision-making. We formalize a four-stage closed-loop optimization of Generation, Binding, Verification and Distillation, together with four corresponding evaluation metrics: novelty, consistency, out-of-distribution (OOD) and efficiency. We further discuss two examples, i.e., drones and manipulators, as early embodied testbeds where wind, sensing limits, actuation delay, contact dynamics and recovery constraints can be systematically perturbed and verified. The central claim is that the framework of autonomous video generation for self-evolving world models should not be judged by video fidelity alone, but by whether the generated frames improve valid action under counterfactual interventions and various embodiment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出基于反事实可控性的自主视频生成框架，用于自演进世界模型。通过生成、绑定、验证和蒸馏四个阶段的闭环优化，使视频生成模型不仅产生视觉合理的预测，还能测试反事实干预下的可行动性。论文以无人机和机械臂为例，提出新颖性、一致性、分布外和效率四个评估指标。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽被视为世界模型，但缺乏自演进能力，无法确保生成的未来对特定具身代理是物理可行的，也无法从环境获取反馈以自我改进。
Method: 提出四阶段闭环优化：生成干预条件化的未来帧、将帧绑定到具身约束、验证分布偏移下的有效性、蒸馏存活的路径为决策用紧凑变量。
Result: 以无人机和机械臂为测试床，系统扰动风、感知限制、执行延迟、接触动力学和恢复约束进行验证。
Conclusion: 强调自演进世界模型的视频生成不应仅以视频保真度评判，而应看生成帧能否在反事实干预和具身约束下改进有效行动。

papers.title: Boltzmann MapReduce: A Partition-Function Reduce for Forkable Sandboxes
papers.abstract_en: To leading order under local asymptotic normality (LAN), the confidence density a worker emits over a chunk of size $n$ is a Gibbs--Boltzmann measure $\exp\{-βE(θ)\}$ whose inverse temperature is the sample size, $β=n$. Three consequences are exact in the Gaussian/linear case and first-order otherwise: disjoint chunks carry independent Boltzmann factors, so the MapReduce \emph{reduce}, read literally, is a partition function $Z=\int\prod_k h_k\,dθ$ whose mode is precision-weighted (inverse-variance) pooling; frequentist consistency is the zero-temperature limit $T=1/n\to0$
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在局部渐近正态性（LAN）下，将工作者发出的置信密度近似为吉布斯-玻尔兹曼测度，温度由样本量决定。MapReduce的reduce操作被解释为配分函数，其模式对应精度加权平均，频率一致性对应零温极限。
Motivation: 现有MapReduce框架在统计推断中的reduce步骤缺乏概率解释，本文从统计物理角度重新定义reduce操作，使其与玻尔兹曼分布和配分函数对应。
Method: 利用局部渐近正态性，将每个工作者对数据块的置信密度写作吉布斯-玻尔兹曼形式，温度与块大小成反比。将reduce操作建模为配分函数的积分，其众数为精度加权平均。
Result: 在正态/线性情况下精确成立，其他情况一阶近似成立。频率一致性等价于零温极限T→0。
Conclusion: 提出的玻尔兹曼MapReduce为分布式统计推断提供了物理视角，但理论结果仅限于一阶近似。

papers.title: Learning Red Agent Policy from Observations for Neurosymbolic Autonomous Cyber Agents
papers.abstract_en: With sophisticated cyber-attacks becoming increasingly prevalent, modern networks require intelligent autonomous cyber-defense agents trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL). These agents employ neurosymbolic approaches such as behavior trees with learning-enabled components (LECs) to learn, reason, adapt, and implement security rules while maintaining critical operations. However, these autonomous networks are partially observable systems, i.e., the cyber-attacker's (red agent's) actions are not observable, making it difficult for the defender to predict red actions, learn red policies, or assess the attacker's intrusion levels. To address this, we propose a Policy Learning Technique using imitation learning to learn policies for partially observable RL agents with discrete states and discrete actions. We apply this technique in an autonomous cyber environment to predict red agent's actions from network observations and defender actions. Integrated with a neurosymbolic cyber-defense agent, our method effectively handles different red policies and achieves high prediction accuracy across diverse simulated scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络攻击者动作不可观测的问题，提出一种基于模仿学习的策略学习技术，用于部分可观测的强化学习智能体，以预测红色代理的动作。该方法集成到神经符号自主网络防御代理中，在多种模拟场景下实现了高预测准确率。
Motivation: 现代网络需要智能自主防御代理，但攻击者（红色代理）的动作不可观测，导致防御者难以预测其策略或评估入侵级别。
Method: 提出一种策略学习技术，使用模仿学习从网络观测和防御者动作中学习红色代理的策略，适用于离散状态和离散动作的部分可观测强化学习智能体。
Result: 在自主网络环境中，该方法有效处理不同的红色策略，并在模拟场景中实现高预测准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法可增强神经符号防御代理对攻击者策略的预测能力，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: A Causal Model of Theory of Mind in Conflict for Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Theory of mind (ToM), the capacity to ascribe mental states to others and use those ascriptions for prediction and inference, is widely assumed to be essential for effective human-machine integration. Existing AI-ToM models address \emph{how} to mentalize, but leave the question of when largely unaddressed. The central question is: under what situational and agent-level conditions is ToM engagement causally warranted in conflict? This paper presents a structural causal model formalized as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), treating ToM as a mechanism activated by situational and agent-level conditions rather than as an always-on capacity. The model specifies four exogenous variables capturing situational and agent-level conditions, five endogenous mediators, and a mechanistic ToM node producing engagement states through three distinct causal pathways: a tractability pathway, a reasoning-depth pathway, and an enabling-cause pathway. The primary outcome is epistemic accuracy, which decouples social reasoning from behavioral policy and generalizes across social phenomena beyond conflict. The framework gives AI systems a principled, resource-rational decision procedure for mentalizing, with implications for efficiency, trust, and the development of robust artificial social intelligence. Simulation validation, empirical human-machine teaming studies, and ethical considerations arising from conflict-optimized mentalizing are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结构因果模型（DAG），将心智理论（ToM）视为在冲突情境下由情境和代理级条件激活的机制，而非始终开启的能力。模型包含四个外生变量、五个内生中介和三种因果通路，主要输出是认知准确性，旨在为AI系统提供资源理性的心理化决策程序。
Motivation: 现有AI-ToM模型聚焦于如何心理化，但忽略了何时应启动心理化的问题，尤其在冲突情境下缺乏因果合理性判断。
Method: 通过结构因果模型（DAG）形式化ToM的激活条件，定义四种外生变量（情境与代理级条件）、五种内生中介，以及三条因果通路（可处理性、推理深度、致因通路），最终输出认知准确性。
Result: 该框架为AI系统提供了一个原则性的、资源理性的心理化决策程序，模拟验证和人类-机器团队研究支持其有效性。
Conclusion: 该模型将社会推理与行为策略解耦，对提升人机交互效率、信任和鲁棒人工智能社会智能具有意义，但需注意冲突优化心理化带来的伦理问题。

papers.title: Unlocking Latent Dimensions: Exploring Representations of Large-Scale X-ray Scattering Data using Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Scientific user facilities generate X-ray scattering data faster than traditional workflows can process them. We address this challenge across two settings, offline dataset exploration and live on-the-fly analysis. We train a domain-specific attention-based Convolutional Variational Autoencoder (C-VAE) on 1.5 million X-ray scattering images to learn low-dimensional representations capturing structural variation across diverse experimental conditions. The learned latent space reveals well-organized clusters and smooth trajectories reflecting experimental progression. It further supports controlled synthetic scattering image generation across diverse structural states. When deployed without retraining, the model organizes time-resolved film formation experiments at two synchrotron facilities into interpretable latent structures. Benchmarking against DINOv3 (ViT-7B), a general-purpose vision foundation model, demonstrates that domain-specific training yields more interpretable latent organization for scattering data. Both workflows are integrated within Latent Space Explorer, a component of the MLExchange platform, supporting interactive structural exploration across archived datasets and live experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对X射线散射数据的高通量处理问题，训练了一个基于注意力的卷积变分自编码器（C-VAE），在150万张散射图像上学习低维表示，捕捉不同实验条件下的结构变化。学得的潜空间展现出良好组织的聚类和反映实验进程的平滑轨迹，并支持可控的合成散射图像生成。该模型无需重新训练即可直接应用于两个同步辐射设施的时间分辨薄膜形成实验，产生可解释的潜结构。与通用视觉基础模型DINOv3（ViT-7B）的对比表明，领域特定训练能提供更可解释的潜空间组织。两个工作流均集成在MLExchange平台的Latent Space Explorer中，支持存档数据集和实时实验的交互式结构探索。
Motivation: 科学用户设施产生的X射线散射数据速率远超传统工作流处理能力，亟需高效的数据探索与实时分析方法。
Method: 提出基于注意力的卷积变分自编码器（C-VAE），在150万张X射线散射图像上进行领域特异性训练，学习低维潜空间表示；潜空间用于数据组织、合成图像生成以及在线分析部署。
Result: 潜空间展现出清晰聚类和光滑轨迹，有效反映实验进程；未重新训练即可在两个同步辐射设施的时间分辨薄膜实验中生成可解释的潜结构；与DINOv3对比，领域特定训练获得更可解释的潜组织。
Conclusion: 该方法同时支持离线数据集探索与实时分析，已集成在MLExchange平台的Latent Space Explorer中。

papers.title: Intention Driven Identification of In-Possession Match Phases in Association Football through Temporal Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding tactical organisation in association football requires identifying in-possession match phases that are shaped by evolving tactical intentions rather than by spatial patterns alone. This study proposes an intention-driven framework for identifying phases from tracking data. Seven German Bundesliga matches recorded at 25 Hz with TRACAB were analysed. A hierarchical model was defined with three tactical intentions (Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring) and six phases (Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing). A Temporal Graph Attention Network (T-GAN) combined frame-level player-interaction graphs, contextual features, and Transformer-based temporal modelling. Performance was evaluated using frame-level F1 and temporal Intersection over Union (tIoU). T-GAN achieved macro-average frame-level F1 scores of 0.87 at the intention level, 0.76 for invasion-related phases, and 0.79 for scoring phases. After filtering, mean class-wise tIoU increased from 0.44 to 0.67 for intentions and from 0.40 to 0.57 for phases, showing that sequence-level evaluation captured fragmentation and boundary errors missed by frame-level metrics. Model comparisons indicated that Transformer-based sequence modelling drove coherent segmentation, while graph-based relational modelling was most beneficial for Counter Attack. Misalignment analysis revealed common sequence level misalignments, mainly Build Up/Progression ambiguity, Build Up/Maintenance confusion, Counter Attack/Progression inconsistency, and shortened pre-shot Finishing segments. Overall, the framework translates tracking data into tactically interpretable phase representations for automated annotation, tactical analysis, and playing-style profiling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种意图驱动的框架，利用时间图注意力网络从足球追踪数据中识别控球阶段，辨明三种战术意图（入侵对手空间、保持控球、得分）和六种阶段（建立进攻、推进、反击、维持、持续威胁、完成）。在七场德甲比赛数据上，帧级F1在意图层达0.87，入侵相关阶段0.76，得分阶段0.79；序列级tIoU通过过滤后提升至意图0.67、阶段0.57。
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖空间模式识别比赛阶段，忽略了战术意图的动态变化，导致阶段划分与真实战术意图脱节。
Method: 提出时间图注意力网络（T-GAN），融合帧级球员交互图、上下文特征和Transformer时序建模，采用分层模型识别三种战术意图和六种控球阶段。
Result: T-GAN在意图层面宏平均帧级F1为0.87，入侵相关阶段0.76，得分阶段0.79；过滤后类别平均tIoU从0.44提升至0.67（意图）和0.40至0.57（阶段）。
Conclusion: 该框架能将追踪数据转化为战术可解释的阶段表示，用于自动标注、战术分析和打法特征刻画，且序列级评估揭示了帧级指标忽略的分割边界错误。

papers.title: A Multi-Model Metric-based Selection Framework for Abstractive Text summarization
papers.abstract_en: Automatic text summarization has become increasingly important due to the rapid growth of digital textual information. This paper presents a Multi-Model Summarization Framework designed to improve the robustness and quality of abstractive text summarization. Relying on a single model often leads to inconsistent summarization quality across articles with varying structures and topics. To address this limitation, the proposed framework integrates multiple fine-tuned transformer-based summarization models and introduces a metric-based selection mechanism. In this framework, each model independently generates a candidate summary for the same input article. The generated summaries are then evaluated using automatic evaluation metrics that capture both lexical similarity and semantic relevance. Based on these scores, the framework selects the highest-quality summary as the final output. The models are fine-tuned and evaluated on the widely used CNN/DailyMail news summarization dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the highest BERTScore among all compared methods with a score of 88.63%. It also outperforms several LLMs such as GPT3-D2, Falcon-7b, and Mpt-7b, highlighting its effectiveness and robustness. These findings highlight the effectiveness of leveraging multiple transformer-based models within a metric-based selection strategy to improve the quality and robustness of automatic text summarization systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模型摘要框架，集成多个微调后的transformer-based摘要模型，并通过基于指标的选择机制从候选摘要中选出最佳输出。在CNN/DailyMail数据集上，该框架的BERTScore达到88.63%，优于GPT3-D2、Falcon-7b、Mpt-7b等大语言模型，提升了摘要的鲁棒性和质量。
Motivation: 依赖单一模型的抽象式摘要在不同结构和主题的文章上质量不一致，亟需一种更鲁棒的框架来稳定生成高质量摘要。
Method: 集成多个微调的transformer摘要模型，各自生成候选摘要，然后使用同时考虑词汇相似性和语义相关性的自动评估指标进行评分，选择得分最高的摘要作为最终输出。
Result: 在CNN/DailyMail数据集上，框架的BERTScore达到88.63%，超过GPT3-D2、Falcon-7b和Mpt-7b等大模型。
Conclusion: 基于指标选择的多模型策略可以有效提升自动文本摘要的质量和鲁棒性，尤其在多样化文本上表现更稳定。

papers.title: DIVE: Embedding Compression via Self-Limiting Gradient Updates
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional language-model embeddings increase storage and search costs, while supervised compressors can overfit when relevance labels are scarce. We present DIVE (Dimensionality reduction with Implicit View Ensembles), a residual compression adapter codesigned with a self-limiting hinge loss, geometry distillation, and head-wise NT-Xent over implicit coordinate views. The hinge stops updating satisfied ranking constraints, while the dense objectives stabilize the compressed representation; only the first head is retained at inference. Under query-disjoint evaluation with two LLM2Vec backbones, five BEIR benchmarks, 128d and 256d outputs, and six baselines, DIVE is the strongest adapter on all five primary benchmarks. It also outperforms PCA and an autoencoder in comparisons against unsupervised compressors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DIVE（Dimensionality reduction with Implicit View Ensembles），一种用于高维语言模型嵌入压缩的残差压缩适配器。该方法结合自限位 hinge loss、几何蒸馏和隐式坐标视图上的头式 NT-Xent 对比学习，推理时仅保留第一个头。在两种 LLM2Vec 骨干、五个 BEIR 基准、128d 和 256d 输出下，DIVE 在全部五个主基准上超越所有基线，且优于 PCA 和自编码器等无监督压缩器。
Motivation: 高维语言模型嵌入导致存储和搜索成本高昂，而有监督压缩器在相关性标签稀缺时容易过拟合。
Method: 提出 DIVE 残差压缩适配器，核心包括自限位 hinge loss（停止更新已满足的排序约束）、几何蒸馏（稳定压缩表示）以及头式 NT-Xent（在隐式坐标视图上对比学习），推理时仅保留第一个头。
Result: 在 query-disjoint 评估下，使用两种 LLM2Vec 骨干、五个 BEIR 基准、128d 和 256d 输出，DIVE 在所有五个主基准上均为最强适配器，且优于 PCA 和自编码器等无监督压缩器。
Conclusion: 自限位梯度更新机制能有效压缩嵌入并保持检索性能，避免了监督压缩器在标签稀缺时的过拟合问题。
