papers.title: TuxBot: Semantic-Aware Online OS Tuning with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Online OS tuning can improve long-running services, but existing controllers are poorly matched to live hosts. They treat scheduler, power, memory, and I/O controls as black-box variables and optimize a scalar reward. This view ignores cross-knob policy structure, breaks down when application metrics are unavailable, and can send a running service into degraded regions that persist after the bad setting is removed. We present TuxBot, a host-side framework for steady-state OS tuning with bounded language-model guidance. TuxBot turns knob schemas, telemetry, current configuration, recent action--response history, and retrieved prior runs into a compact decision context. A fast loop proposes low-latency updates, a slower loop periodically revises the search strategy, and every proposed change passes through typed validation before reaching kernel or sysctl interfaces. This lets the controller reason about OS-control meaning and indirect performance signals while keeping model cost, latency, and authority constrained. We evaluate TuxBot on 13 live workloads from five benchmark suites while tuning up to 41 Linux parameters. Across the suite, TuxBot improves stable-phase performance by 72.5% over default settings and by 153.3% relative to the strongest non-LLM baseline. A 30-window session costs about $0.20 in model calls. With only host-level metrics, TuxBot still outperforms baselines given direct application objectives by 93.7 percentage points, while avoiding severe degraded regions reached by structure-blind exploration.

papers.title: Test-Time Learning with an Evolving Library
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EvoLib, a test-time learning framework that enables large language models to accumulate, reuse, and evolve knowledge across problem instances without parameter updates or external supervision. Instead of adapting model parameters, our approach maintains a shared library of knowledge abstractions, including modular skills and reflective insights, automatically extracted from the model's own inference trajectories. To support continual improvement, we introduce a principled weighting and consolidation mechanism that jointly optimizes for immediate utility and long-term value. This allows simple, instance-specific abstractions to evolve into more general and reusable ones over time. Across challenging benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn agentic environments, EvoLib improves substantially over the top test-time scaling and learning methods without ground-truth feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoLib，一个测试时学习框架，使大语言模型能在不更新参数或外部监督的情况下，跨问题实例积累、重用和演化知识。该方法维护一个共享的知识抽象库，包括模块化技能和反思性见解，并从模型自身的推理轨迹中自动提取。通过引入加权和巩固机制，联合优化即时效用和长期价值，使简单的实例特定抽象随时间演化为更通用可重用的知识。在数学推理、代码生成和多轮代理环境等基准上，EvoLib 显著优于现有的测试时缩放和学习方法。

papers.title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems
papers.abstract_en: Robust explanations are increasingly required for user trust in enterprise NLP, yet pre-deployment validation is difficult in the common case of black-box deployment (API-only access) where representation-based explainers are infeasible and existing studies provide limited guidance on whether explanations remain stable under real user noise, especially when organizations migrate from encoder classifiers to decoder LLMs. To close this gap, we propose a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion, and operationalize explanation robustness with top-token flip rate under realistic perturbations (swap, deletion, shuffling, and back-translation) at multiple severity levels. Using this protocol, we conduct a systematic cross-architecture comparison across three benchmark datasets and six models spanning encoder and decoder families (BERT, RoBERTa, Qwen 7B/14B, Llama 8B/70B; 64,800 cases). We find that decoder LLMs produce substantially more stable explanations than encoder baselines (73% lower flip rates on average), and that stability improves with model scale (44% gain from 7B to 70B). Finally, we relate robustness improvements to inference cost, yielding a practical cost-robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业NLP系统中黑盒部署（仅API访问）的鲁棒解释问题，提出基于leave-one-out遮挡的统一鲁棒性评估框架，并通过交换、删除、打乱、回译等多种扰动测试不同模型范式的解释稳定性。实验覆盖BERT、RoBERTa、Qwen 7B/14B、Llama 8B/70B等6个模型和3个基准数据集，发现解码器LLM的解释稳定性显著优于编码器模型（平均翻转率降低73%），且稳定性随模型规模提升（7B到70B提升44%），最后给出了鲁棒性与推理成本的权衡曲线。
Motivation: 现有研究对企业NLP黑盒部署场景下的解释稳定性缺乏系统评估，尤其是从编码器分类器迁移到解码器LLM时，表示类解释器不可行，且实际用户噪声下的解释鲁棒性未知。
Method: 提出统一的黑盒鲁棒性评估框架：基于leave-one-out遮挡生成token级解释，通过top-token翻转率度量鲁棒性，并在多种扰动（交换、删除、打乱、回译）和多个严重级别下进行系统评估。
Result: 解码器LLM的解释稳定性远优于编码器基线（平均翻转率低73%）；模型规模从7B增至70B时稳定性提升44%；并给出了成本-鲁棒性权衡曲线。
Conclusion: 该框架和实验结果为企业合规敏感应用中选择模型和解释方法提供了实用指导，强调了黑盒条件下解码器LLM在解释稳定性上的优势。

papers.title: Post-Deployment Accountability in AI Governance: A Cross-Regulatory Empirical Analysis of AI Incidents
papers.abstract_en: Post-deployment accountability has become central to AI governance, yet little empirical evidence shows whether monitoring, incident reporting, and impact assessment obligations are visible when AI systems fail. This study analyzes real-world AI incidents from the AI Incident Database (2020--2026) and codes them against nine post-deployment provisions from the EU AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and the GDPR. The findings show substantial accountability gaps: 77.1\% of incidents lack evidence of EU AI Act post-market monitoring, and 99.6\% lack documented Data-Protection Impact Assessment evidence. Governance gaps are also systemic, with 9.8\% of incidents simultaneously non-compliant under two or more regimes. Incidents detected through internal monitoring show much higher compliance than externally detected incidents (87.5\% vs 5.3\% under the EU AI Act; 95.8\% vs 58.1\% under NIST), suggesting that monitoring capacity is a key condition for effective post-deployment governance. Building on these findings, the paper proposes the Proactive AI Governance Compliance Framework (PAGCF), a four-phase lifecycle for pre-deployment assessment, continuous monitoring, incident preparedness, and cross-framework verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对AI Incident Database (2020-2026)中的真实AI事故进行实证分析，将其对照欧盟AI法案、NIST AI风险管理框架和GDPR的9项部署后规定进行编码。结果显示问责存在显著差距：77.1%的事故缺乏欧盟AI法案上市后监控证据，99.6%缺乏数据保护影响评估记录。内部监控检测到的事故合规率远高于外部检测（欧盟AI法案下87.5% vs 5.3%）。基于此提出主动AI治理合规框架（PAGCF）。
Motivation: AI治理中部署后问责至关重要，但缺乏关于监控、事故报告和影响评估义务在实际AI系统失败时是否可见的实证证据。
Method: 该研究分析AI Incident Database中的现实世界AI事故（2020-2026），并对照欧盟AI法案、NIST AI风险管理框架和GDPR的九项部署后规定进行编码。
Result: 发现重大问责差距：77.1%事故缺乏欧盟AI法案上市后监控证据，99.6%缺乏数据保护影响评估证据；9.8%事故同时违反两个或以上制度；内部监控检测到的事故合规率远高于外部（87.5% vs 5.3%）。
Conclusion: 论文强调监控能力是有效部署后治理的关键条件，并提出了包含预部署评估、持续监控、事故准备和跨框架验证四个阶段的主动AI治理合规框架（PAGCF）。

papers.title: Too Polite to Disagree: Understanding Sycophancy Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophancy: agreement with user stance even when it conflicts with the model's opinion. While prior work has mostly studied this in single-agent settings, it remains underexplored in collaborative multi-agent systems. We ask whether awareness of other agents' sycophancy levels influences discussion outcomes. To investigate this, we run controlled experiments with six open-source LLMs, providing agents with peer sycophancy rankings that estimate each peer's tendency toward sycophancy. These rankings are based on scores calculated using various static (pre-discussion) and dynamic (online) strategies. We find that providing sycophancy priors reduces the influence of sycophancy-prone peers, mitigates error-cascades, and improves final discussion accuracy by an absolute 10.5%. Thus, this is a lightweight and efficient way to reduce model sycophancy during discussions and subsequently improve downstream accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体系统中大语言模型（LLM）的谄媚行为（sycophancy），即模型倾向于同意用户立场而忽视自身观点。通过向智能体提供同伴的谄媚程度排名（基于静态和动态策略），实验表明该方法可减少谄媚倾向智能体的影响、缓解错误级联，并将最终讨论准确率绝对提升10.5%。
Motivation: 现有谄媚行为研究多聚焦单智能体场景，但多智能体协作系统中该现象尚未得到充分探索，可能导致群体错误传播。
Method: 使用六种开源LLM构建受控实验，为每个智能体提供基于多种静态（讨论前）和动态（在线）策略计算的同伴谄媚评分排名。
Result: 引入谄媚先验信息后，讨论准确率绝对提升10.5%，同时降低了谄媚倾向智能体的影响力。
Conclusion: 提供同级智能体的谄媚程度是一种轻量级、高效的方法，可减轻多智能体讨论中的谄媚现象并提升下游任务准确性。

papers.title: NanoGS: Training-Free Gaussian Splat Simplification
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splat (3DGS) enables high-fidelity, real-time novel view synthesis by representing scenes with large sets of anisotropic primitives, but often requires millions of Splats, incurring significant storage and transmission costs. Most existing compression methods rely on GPU-intensive post-training optimization with calibrated images, limiting practical deployment. We introduce \textbf{NanoGS}, a training-free and lightweight framework for Gaussian Splat simplification. Instead of relying on image-based rendering supervision, NanoGS formulates simplification as local pairwise merging over a sparse spatial graph. The method approximates a pair of Gaussians with a single primitive using mass preserved moment matching and evaluates merge quality through a principled merge cost between the original mixture and its approximation. By restricting merge candidates to local neighborhoods and selecting compatible pairs efficiently, NanoGS produces compact Gaussian representations while preserving scene structure and appearance. NanoGS operates directly on existing Gaussian Splat models, runs efficiently on CPU, and preserves the standard 3DGS parameterization, enabling seamless integration with existing rendering pipelines. Experiments demonstrate that NanoGS substantially reduces primitive count while maintaining high rendering fidelity, providing an efficient and practical solution for Gaussian Splat simplification. Our project website is available at \href{https://saliteta.github.io/NanoGS/}{https://saliteta.github.io/NanoGS/}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NanoGS，一种无需训练的 3D 高斯泼溅简化框架，通过局部成对合并减少原语数量，保持渲染质量。方法直接在已有模型上运行，CPU 高效，不改变标准参数化，实现了高保真度下的紧凑表示。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 模型需要数百万个原语，存储和传输成本高，而大多数压缩方法依赖 GPU 密集的后训练优化，限制了实际部署。
Method: 将简化问题转化为稀疏空间图上的局部成对合并，使用质量保留的矩匹配近似一对高斯分布为单个原语，并通过合并代价评估合并质量，仅选择局部邻域内的兼容对进行合并。
Result: 实验表明，NanoGS 在显著减少原语数量的同时，保持了高渲染保真度，且无需训练数据和 GPU。
Conclusion: NanoGS 提供了一种高效、实用的高斯泼溅简化方案，可直接集成现有渲染流水线，适用于存储和传输受限的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PC-Diffuser: Path-Consistent Capsule CBF Safety Filtering for Diffusion-Based Trajectory Planner
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving in complex traffic requires planners that generalize beyond hand-crafted rules, motivating data-driven approaches that learn behavior from expert demonstrations. Diffusion-based trajectory planners have recently shown strong closed-loop performance by iteratively denoising a full-horizon plan, but they remain difficult to certify and can fail catastrophically in rare or out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this challenge, we present PC-Diffuser, a safety augmentation framework that embeds a certifiable, path-consistent barrier-function structure directly into the denoising loop of diffusion planning. The key idea is to make safety an intrinsic part of trajectory generation rather than a post-hoc fix: we enforce forward invariance along the rollout while preserving the diffusion model's intended path geometry. Specifically, PC-Diffuser (i) evaluates collision risk using a capsule-distance barrier function that better reflects vehicle geometry and reduces unnecessary conservativeness, (ii) converts denoised waypoints into dynamically feasible motion under a kinematic bicycle model, and (iii) applies a path-consistent safety filter that eliminates residual constraint violations without geometric distortion, so the corrected plan remains close to the learned distribution. By injecting these safety-consistent corrections at every denoising step and feeding the refined trajectory back into the diffusion process, PC-Diffuser enables iterative, context-aware safeguarding instead of post-hoc repair...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PC-Diffuser 是一种将可认证的势垒函数安全结构嵌入扩散轨迹规划器去噪循环的框架。通过胶囊距离势垒函数评估碰撞风险、运动学自行车模型保证动态可行性，以及路径一致安全过滤器消除约束违规，实现在每个去噪步骤中注入安全一致的修正。该方法旨在使安全成为轨迹生成的内在部分，而非事后修复。
Motivation: 扩散轨迹规划器在复杂交通场景中表现良好，但难以认证，在罕见或分布外场景中可能灾难性失效。现有方法缺乏可证明的安全保证，需要一种将安全直接融入生成过程的方法。
Method: 提出 PC-Diffuser，在扩散规划的去噪循环中嵌入路径一致的势垒函数结构。包括：(i) 使用胶囊距离势垒函数评估碰撞风险，减少不必要的保守性；(ii) 将去噪路径点转换为运动学自行车模型下的动态可行轨迹；(iii) 应用路径一致安全过滤器消除残差约束违规而不扭曲几何形状。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称该方法能实现迭代、上下文感知的安全保障，而非事后修复，并保持生成轨迹接近学习分布。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过在每个去噪步骤注入安全一致的修正，PC-Diffuser 使安全成为轨迹生成的内在部分，提高了扩散规划器的可认证性。

papers.title: When Audio Separation Hurts Zero-Shot ASR: Evaluating SAM-Audio with Whisper on Bengali and English Speech
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech enhancement have strengthened the common belief that cleaner audio should lead to more accurate transcription. In this work, we examine whether this assumption holds for modern zero-shot ASR systems. We conduct a structured empirical study of SAM-Audio as a preprocessing step for zero-shot transcription with OpenAI Whisper. Five Whisper variants are evaluated on noisy Bengali and English speech datasets. On the English dataset, SAM-Audio increases the average PSNR from 32.28 dB to 35.99 dB and achieves higher PSNR for 71.84% of the utterances. However, WER and CER increase in every evaluated model-dataset configuration. On the Bengali dataset, Whisper large-v3 WER increases from 65.83% to 77.35%, while CER increases from 24.13% to 34.74%. On the English dataset, Whisper base WER increases from 10.53% to 21.66%, while CER increases from 4.48% to 12.50%. Utterance-level analysis further shows that the degradation affects a substantial portion of the evaluated samples, although its severity varies across Whisper variants. These findings demonstrate that improved signal-level quality does not necessarily lead to better zero-shot ASR performance and that denoising can reduce recognition accuracy.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. IEEE 3rd International Conference on Computing, Applications and Systems (COMPAS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过结构化实验评估SAM-Audio作为OpenAI Whisper零样本语音识别（ASR）的前处理步骤的效果。在带噪孟加拉语和英语数据集上，SAM-Audio虽然提升了PSNR等信号质量指标，但所有Whisper变体的词错误率（WER）和字符错误率（CER）均显著上升。结果表明，改善信号级质量并不必然提升零样本ASR性能，甚至可能损害识别准确性。
Motivation: 挑战“更清晰的音频应带来更准确转录”的普遍假设，验证现代零样本ASR系统中语音增强预处理的实际效果。
Method: 在五组Whisper变体（large-v3、base等）上，使用SAM-Audio对带噪英语和孟加拉语语音进行预处理，然后比较预处理前后的PSNR、WER和CER变化，并进行语句级分析。
Result: 在英语数据集上，SAM-Audio使平均PSNR从32.28 dB提升至35.99 dB，但Whisper base的WER从10.53%升至21.66%、CER从4.48%升至12.50%；在孟加拉语数据集上，Whisper large-v3的WER从65.83%升至77.35%、CER从24.13%升至34.74%。所有模型-数据集组合均出现WER和CER增加。
Conclusion: 改进信号级质量（如PSNR）并不保证零样本ASR性能提升，降噪预处理可能反而降低识别准确性，且影响程度因Whisper变体而异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comparative Evaluation of Large Vision-Language Models for 2D Object Detection under SOTIF Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Reliable environmental perception remains one of the main obstacles for safe operation of automated vehicles. Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) concerns safety risks from perception insufficiencies, particularly under adverse conditions where conventional detectors often falter. While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate promising semantic reasoning, their quantitative effectiveness for safety-critical 2D object detection is underexplored. This paper presents a systematic evaluation of ten representative LVLMs using the PeSOTIF dataset, a benchmark specifically curated for long-tail traffic scenarios and environmental degradations. Performance is quantitatively compared against two specialized detectors: the anchor-based YOLOv5 and the transformer-based RT-DETRv4. Experimental results reveal a critical trade-off: top-performing LVLMs (e.g., Gemini 3) surpass the YOLOv5 in recall by over 25% and closely match RT-DETRv4 under natural visual degradation, while specialized detectors retain an advantage in geometric precision for handcrafted perturbations. These findings highlight the complementary strengths of semantic reasoning versus geometric regression, supporting the use of LVLMs as high-level safety validators in SOTIF-oriented automated driving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了十个大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在SOTIF条件下的2D目标检测性能，使用PeSOTIF数据集，并与YOLOv5和RT-DETRv4对比。实验发现顶级LVLM（如Gemini 3）在自然视觉退化下召回率比YOLOv5高25%以上，接近RT-DETRv4，但专用检测器在手制扰动上几何精度更优。结果表明语义推理与几何回归具有互补优势，支持LVLM作为安全验证器。
Motivation: SOTIF关注感知不足带来的安全风险，尤其在恶劣条件下传统检测器常失效。LVLM虽展现语义推理潜力，但其在安全关键2D目标检测中的定量有效性尚未被充分探索。
Method: 使用PeSOTIF数据集（针对长尾交通场景和环境退化）对十个代表性LVLM进行系统评估，并与锚点式YOLOv5和基于Transformer的RT-DETRv4进行定量比较。
Result: 顶级LVLM（如Gemini 3）在自然视觉退化下召回率超过YOLOv5 25%以上，与RT-DETRv4相当；但专用检测器在手制扰动上保持几何精度优势。
Conclusion: 研究表明LVLM与专用检测器存在互补优势：LVLM擅长语义推理，专用检测器擅长几何回归，建议将LVLM用作SOTIF自动驾驶系统中的高层安全验证器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not All Needles Are Found: How Fact Distribution and Don't Make It Up Prompts Shape Retrieval, Reasoning, and Hallucination in Long-Context LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly utilize massive context windows as working memory for autonomous tasks, their reliability fluctuates significantly depending on how information is distributed in real-world corpora. We investigate how fact placement, corpus-level distributions, and anti-hallucination ("Don't Make It Up") prompts influence model behavior by introducing a model-agnostic extended needle-in-a-haystack benchmark designed for scalability, which we apply to evaluate Gemini-2.5-flash, ChatGPT-5-mini, Claude-4.5-haiku, and Deepseek-v3.2-chat. Unlike prior work, we separately evaluate literal extraction, logical inference, and hallucination risk. We identify two critical failure modes: Distributional Collapse, where performance degrades significantly when evidence is dispersed; and a Safety Tax, where anti-hallucination prompts cause over-conservative refusal of present facts and evidence, sharply reducing accuracy. Our results suggest that many failures stem from ineffective context utilization, as models struggle to prioritize relevant information even when it is present. These findings highlight the need for model-specific robustness and effective context management to ensure reliable deployment in long-horizon agentic workflows.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the FAGEN Workshop @ ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展的模型无关的长上下文基准测试，研究事实分布和反幻觉提示如何影响LLM的检索、推理和幻觉。使用Gemini-2.5-flash等四个模型，发现两种关键失败模式：分布性崩溃（证据分散时性能下降）和安全税（反幻觉提示导致过度拒绝已存在的事实）。
Motivation: LLM在长上下文中作为工作记忆时，其可靠性会因信息分布方式而波动，现有工作未系统评估事实放置、语料分布和反幻觉提示的联合影响。
Method: 引入一个可扩展的模型无关的长上下文针尖堆测试，分别评估文字提取、逻辑推理和幻觉风险，并分析证据分散程度和反幻觉提示的影响。
Result: 发现分布性崩溃：当证据分散时性能显著下降；安全税：反幻觉提示导致模型过度拒绝已存在的事实，准确率大幅降低。
Conclusion: 许多失败源于无效的上下文利用，模型即使信息存在也难以优先关注相关部分，需要针对特定模型的鲁棒性和有效的上下文管理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeCo: Evaluating Geometric Consistency for Video Generation via Motion and Structure
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GeCo, a geometry-grounded metric for jointly detecting geometric deformation and occlusion-inconsistency artifacts in static scenes. By fusing residual motion and depth priors, GeCo produces interpretable, dense consistency maps that reveal these artifacts. We use GeCo to systematically benchmark recent video generation models, uncovering common failure modes, and further employ it as a training-free guidance loss to reduce deformation artifacts during video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeCo 是一种基于几何的度量，用于联合检测静态场景中视频生成的几何变形和遮挡不一致伪影。它融合残差运动和深度先验，生成可解释的密集一致性图，并用于系统基准测试和训练免费引导损失以减少伪影。
Motivation: 现有视频生成评估缺乏对几何一致性的系统量化，无法检测变形和遮挡不一致等常见伪影。
Method: 提出 GeCo 度量，通过融合残差运动和深度先验，生成密集的一致性图来定位伪影，并可作为训练免费引导损失。
Result: 系统评估了多个视频生成模型，揭示了常见失败模式；作为引导损失可减少生成中的变形伪影。
Conclusion: GeCo 提供了一种可解释的几何一致性评估方法，有助于改进视频生成模型的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Track and Caption Any Motion: Open-Vocabulary Spatiotemporal Captioning via Trajectory-Conditioned Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present TCAM (Track and Caption Any Motion), a generative framework that watches a video and with no text query and no region prompt decides what is moving, describes each motion in open vocabulary, locates it in time, and points to the exact trajectories that carry it. Two mature lines of work make this possible yet leave it unsolved: dense point trackers follow pixels with sub-object precision but emit no language, while video-language models produce fluent descriptions only when handed a query and only from clip-level features that cannot resolve which pixels move. Object-level captioners narrow the gap but still reason over detector boxes or masks, never reaching individual trajectories. TCAM couples tracking and language at point granularity through a Caption-Aware Resampler, where a small set of learnable queries cross-attends to dense point trajectory tokens and distills them into a fixed-length motion context that conditions a language decoder. The decoder generates an entire video's events in a single pass, each with a free-form caption, a start and end time, and a pointer to the trajectories it refers to, for sequential events and several subjects active at once. Training uses only existing segmentation annotations, with no extra event labeling, to supervise caption quality, pointer-mask alignment, and pointer diversity. On over 50K clips, TCAM outperforms dense video captioning baselines and matches dedicated, query-based grounding and point-tracking methods despite using no query, showing that trajectory-conditioned generation is a direct route to motion-driven video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TCAM是一个生成式框架，无需文本查询或区域提示，即可自动检测视频中的运动，为每个运动生成开放词汇的自然语言描述，并定位其在时间和轨迹上的位置。它通过捕捉感知重采样器将密集点轨迹令牌蒸馏成运动上下文，条件化语言解码器，一次性生成整个视频的事件描述、时间戳和轨迹指针。在超过50K片段上的实验表明，TCAM在无查询条件下超越了密集视频字幕基线，并与专用查询定位和点跟踪方法性能相当。
Motivation: 现有密集点跟踪器能精确跟踪像素但无语言输出，视频语言模型需要查询且仅从片段级特征描述，无法定位具体像素运动；目标级描述器局限于检测框或掩码，无法达到轨迹粒度。TCAM旨在填补这一空白，实现无查询、轨迹级别的开放词汇运动描述。
Method: 提出Caption-Aware Resampler，通过一组可学习查询对密集点轨迹令牌进行交叉注意力操作，将其蒸馏为固定长度的运动上下文，用于条件化语言解码器。解码器在单次前向中生成整个视频的事件序列，每个事件包含自由形式的描述、起始时间戳和指向相关轨迹的指针。训练仅使用现有分割标注，无需额外事件标签，通过描述质量、指针掩码对齐和指针多样性损失进行监督。
Result: 在超过50K视频片段上，TCAM在密集视频字幕任务上优于基线方法，且在不使用任何查询的情况下，性能与基于查询的专用定位和点跟踪方法相匹配。
Conclusion: 轨迹条件生成是实现运动驱动视频理解的一种直接有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Space-Time Transformer for Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.abstract_en: Until recently, numerical weather prediction (NWP) models have stood rivalless in operational forecasting despite a few limitations. Namely, physically-based models are computationally demanding and struggle at short lead times, reducing their utility for nowcasting. Motivated by these shortcomings, recent work proposes AI-weather prediction (AI-WP) alternatives that emulate analysis data with neural networks. While these data-driven approaches have achieved high skill for medium-range forecasting-applications of AI-WP to precipitation and to nowcasting are less explored. To these ends, this paper discusses \textit{SaTformer}: a video transformer adapted for precipitation nowcasting. To ameliorate some problems related to what is essentially a fat-tailed regression task, we find it prudent to formulate nowcasting as a classification problem and employ a frequency-weighted loss. This straightforward approach scored first on the NeurIPS Weather4Cast 2025 ``Cumulative Rainfall'' challenge. Code and model weights are available: \texttt{\href{github.com/leharris3/w4c-25}{github.com/leharris3/satformer}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SaTformer，一种基于视频 Transformer 的降水临近预报模型，将临近预报视为分类问题并使用频率加权损失，在 NeurIPS Weather4Cast 2025“累积降雨”挑战赛中取得第一名。
Motivation: 数值天气预报模型计算成本高且短时预报能力有限，而现有 AI 天气预报方法主要针对中期预报，对降水临近预报关注不足。
Method: 将临近预报构建为分类任务（而非回归），并采用频率加权损失函数处理降水数据的肥尾分布；模型基于视频 Transformer 架构。
Result: 在 NeurIPS Weather4Cast 2025“累积降雨”挑战赛中排名第一。
Conclusion: 将临近预报重新定义为分类问题并配合频率加权损失，能有效提升降水临近预报性能。

papers.title: Error Analysis of Triangular Optimal Transport Maps for Filtering
papers.abstract_en: We present a systematic analysis of estimation errors for a class of optimal transport based algorithms for filtering and data assimilation. Along the way, we extend previous error analyses of Brenier maps to the case of conditional Brenier maps that arise in the context of simulation based inference. We then apply these results in a filtering scenario to analyze the optimal transport filtering algorithm of Al-Jarrah et al. (2024, ICML). An extension of that algorithm along with numerical benchmarks on various non-Gaussian and high-dimensional examples are provided to demonstrate its effectiveness and practical potential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对一类基于最优传输的滤波与数据同化算法进行系统误差分析，将Brenier映射的误差分析扩展到条件Brenier映射，并应用于Al-Jarrah等人(2024)的最优传输滤波算法，提供了非高斯和高维数值例子。
Motivation: 现有最优传输滤波算法的误差分析不完整，特别是条件Brenier映射在仿真推断中的误差行为未知。
Method: 扩展Brenier映射的误差分析到条件Brenier映射，并基于此分析Al-Jarrah等人的滤波算法，同时提出该算法的扩展版本。
Result: 通过非高斯和高维数值实验展示了算法的有效性和实际潜力。
Conclusion: 这项理论分析为最优传输滤波算法的可靠性提供了基础，并证明了其在实际问题中的适用性。

papers.title: Benefits and Limitations of Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought prompting has popularized step-by-step reasoning in large language models, yet model performance still degrades as problem complexity and context length grow. By decomposing difficult tasks with long contexts into shorter, manageable ones, recent multi-agent paradigms offer a promising near-term solution to this problem. However, the fundamental capacities of such systems are poorly understood. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework to analyze the expressivity of multi-agent systems. We apply our framework to three algorithmic families: state tracking, recall, and $k$-hop reasoning. We derive bounds on (i) the number of agents required to solve the task exactly, (ii) the quantity and structure of inter-agent communication, and (iii) the achievable speedups as problem size and context scale. Our results identify regimes where communication is provably beneficial, delineate tradeoffs between agent count and bandwidth, and expose intrinsic limitations when either resource is constrained. We complement our theoretical analysis with a set of experiments on pretrained LLMs using controlled synthetic benchmarks. Empirical outcomes confirm the tradeoffs between key quantities predicted by our theory. Collectively, our analysis offers principled guidance for designing scalable multi-agent reasoning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架来分析多智能体推理系统的表达能力，应用于状态跟踪、召回和k跳推理三类算法。推导了精确求解所需智能体数量、通信量和结构以及可实现的加速比的理论界限，并基于预训练语言模型的实验验证了理论预测的权衡关系。
Motivation: 链式思维提示虽已普及，但随问题复杂度和上下文长度增加，模型性能仍会下降。多智能体范式通过分解任务提供潜在解决方案，但其基本能力（如智能体数量与通信的权衡）尚不清晰。
Method: 提出理论框架，对状态跟踪、召回和k跳推理三类算法推导了精确求解所需智能体数量、通信量（数量与结构）和可达加速比的理论界限，并设计合成基准实验用预训练LLM验证。
Result: 理论识别了通信有益的场景，揭示了智能体数量与带宽之间的权衡，以及资源受限时的固有限制。实验证实了理论预测的关键量之间的权衡关系。
Conclusion: 分析为设计可扩展的多智能体推理系统提供了原则性指导。

papers.title: Interaction Protocol Shapes Moral Judgment in Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sensitive everyday contexts -- offering personal advice, mental health support, and moral guidance -- understanding their behavior in navigating complex moral reasoning is essential. Most evaluations study this sociotechnical alignment through single-turn prompts, but it is unclear if these findings extend to multi-turn settings, and even less clear how they depend on the interaction protocols used to coordinate agentic systems. We address this gap using LLM debate to examine deliberative dynamics and value alignment in multi-turn settings by prompting subsets of three models (GPT-4.1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Gemini 2.0 Flash) to collectively assign blame in 1,000 everyday dilemmas from Reddit's ``Am I the Asshole'' community. To test order effects and assess verdict revision, we use both synchronous (parallel responses) and round-robin (sequential responses) deliberation structures, mirroring how multi-agent systems are increasingly orchestrated in practice. Our findings show striking behavioral differences. In the synchronous setting, GPT-4.1 showed strong inertia (0.6-3.1\% revision rates) while Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Gemini 2.0 Flash were far more flexible (28-41\% revision rates). Value patterns also diverged: GPT-4.1 emphasized personal autonomy and direct communication (relative to its deliberation partners), while Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Gemini 2.0 Flash prioritized empathetic dialogue. We further find that deliberation format had a strong impact on model behavior: GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.0 Flash stood out as highly conforming relative to Claude 3.7 Sonnet, with their verdict behavior strongly shaped by order effects. We provide additional results on open-source models (DeepSeek-V3.2 and Llama 3.1).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过多智能体辩论研究LLM在道德判断中的行为，使用1,000个Reddit dilemmas测试同步和轮询两种讨论协议。结果显示不同模型在罪责分配上存在显著差异，且辩论格式对模型行为影响很大。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注单轮提示下LLM的道德对齐，但多轮交互中的动态行为及其对交互协议的依赖性尚不明确。
Method: 使用GPT-4.1、Claude 3.7 Sonnet和Gemini 2.0 Flash三个模型子集进行多智能体辩论，对1,000个日常道德困境分配责任；对比同步（并行响应）和轮询（序列响应）两种结构。
Result: 同步设置下，GPT-4.1修订率仅0.6-3.1%，而Claude和Gemini达到28-41%；价值模式也有差异，GPT-4.1强调个人自主性，其他模型更重视移情对话；辩论格式显著影响模型行为，GPT-4.1和Gemini表现出高度从众性，受顺序效应影响大。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这些发现揭示了交互协议对多智能体系统中价值对齐和决策动态的重要影响。

papers.title: Smooth Quasar-Convex Optimization with Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Quasar-convex functions form a broad nonconvex class with applications to linear dynamical systems, generalized linear models, and Riemannian optimization, among others. Current nearly optimal algorithms work only in affine spaces due to the loss of one degree of freedom when working with general convex constraints. Obtaining an accelerated algorithm that makes nearly optimal $\widetilde{O}(1/(γ\sqrt{\varepsilon}))$ first-order queries to a $γ$-quasar convex smooth function \emph{with constraints} was independently asked as an open problem in Martínez-Rubio (2022); Lezane, Langer, and Koolen (2024). In this work, we solve this question by designing an inexact accelerated proximal point algorithm that we implement using a first-order method achieving the aforementioned rate and, as a consequence, we improve the complexity of the accelerated geodesically Riemannian optimization solution in Martínez-Rubio (2022). We also analyze projected gradient descent and Frank-Wolfe algorithms in this constrained quasar-convex setting. To the best of our knowledge, our work provides the first analyses of first-order methods for quasar-convex smooth functions with general convex constraints.

papers.title: Deep Unrolling of Sparsity-Induced RDO for 3D Point Cloud Attribute Coding
papers.abstract_en: Given encoded 3D point cloud geometry available at the decoder, we study the problem of lossy attribute compression in a multi-resolution B-spline projection framework. A target continuous 3D attribute function is first projected onto a sequence of nested subspaces $\mathcal{F}^{(p)}_{l_0} \subseteq \cdots \subseteq \mathcal{F}^{(p)}_{L}$, where $\mathcal{F}^{(p)}_{l}$ is a family of functions spanned by a B-spline basis function of order $p$ at a chosen scale and its integer shifts. The projected low-pass coefficients $F_l^*$ are computed by variable-complexity unrolling of a rate-distortion (RD) optimization algorithm into a feed-forward network, where the rate term is the sparsity-promoting $\ell_1$-norm. Thus, the projection operation is end-to-end differentiable. For a chosen coarse-to-fine predictor, the coefficients are then adjusted to account for the prediction from a lower-resolution to a higher-resolution, which is also optimized in a data-driven manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在多分辨率B样条投影框架下的有损属性压缩问题，通过将稀疏诱导的率失真优化深度展开为前馈网络，实现端到端可微的投影操作，并优化粗到细预测器。
Motivation: 现有3D点云属性压缩方法在率失真优化中未充分利用稀疏性，且投影与预测步骤不可联合优化。
Method: 将稀疏诱导的率失真优化（RDO）深度展开为前馈网络，使用ℓ1范数作为率项，使投影操作端到端可微，并数据驱动地优化粗到细预测器。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法在3D点云属性编码中实现了率失真性能提升。

papers.title: RF-Informed Graph Neural Networks for Accurate and Data-Efficient Circuit Performance Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurately predicting the performance of active radio frequency (RF) circuits is essential for modern wireless systems but remains challenging due to highly nonlinear behavior and the high computational cost of traditional simulation tools. Existing machine learning (ML) surrogates often require large datasets to generalize across various topologies or are not accurate on held-out circuits. This work presents a lightweight, data-efficient, and topology-aware graph neural network (GNN) framework for predicting key performance metrics of active RF circuit classes, such as low-noise amplifiers (LNAs), mixers, voltage-controlled oscillators (VCOs), power amplifiers (PAs), and voltage amplifiers (VAs). The proposed framework employs RFIC domain-informed feature indexing to enable cross-topology adaptability by cheap encoding of functional device semantics (e.g., differential pair and varactor transistors) and efficient knowledge transfer. The surrogate model represents circuits using device-terminal graph abstractions to preserve fine-grained connectivity and transistor-level symmetry. The final model is generalized to a wide variety of classes by being trained in parallel. Experimental results demonstrate accurate modeling of multimodal and heavy-tailed RF performance distributions, achieving an average mean relative error (MRE) of 2.71% across nineteen topologies, an improvement of 3.3x and 20x faster in training over prior art, and the generalization to held-out topologies is improved by ~26.2x. Furthermore, this work shows ~36x training data efficiency compared to state-of-the-art, demonstrating its effectiveness for scalable and deployment-ready RF design automation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级、数据高效且拓扑感知的图神经网络（GNN）框架，用于预测有源射频（RF）电路（如低噪声放大器、混频器、压控振荡器等）的关键性能指标。该框架利用RFIC领域信息特征索引实现跨拓扑适应性，通过设备终端图抽象保留细粒度连接和晶体管级对称性，并在多种拓扑上并行训练。实验表明，该模型在十九种拓扑上平均相对误差为2.71%，训练速度相比先前工作提升20倍，对未见过拓扑的泛化能力提升约26.2倍，且训练数据效率提升约36倍。
Motivation: 传统仿真工具计算成本高，现有机器学习代理模型需要大量数据或难以泛化到不同电路拓扑，亟需一种准确且数据高效的RF电路性能预测方法。
Method: 提出基于GNN的代理模型，采用RFIC领域知识指导的特征索引编码功能器件语义（如差分对、变容管），并将电路表示为设备终端图以保持连接细节和晶体管级对称性。模型通过并行训练实现跨拓扑泛化。
Result: 在十九种RF电路拓扑上，平均相对误差为2.71%；训练速度比现有方法快20倍；对未见过拓扑的泛化性能提升约26.2倍；训练数据效率提升约36倍。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了数据高效且拓扑感知的GNN框架在RF设计自动化中的有效性，能够在低数据需求下实现高精度预测和跨拓扑泛化，适用于可扩展的RF设计自动化。

papers.title: Self-Improving AI Coding Agents Through Accumulated Behavioral Rules: A Closed-Loop Framework
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents repeat the same classes of mistakes across sessions because they lack a mechanism to retain corrections from human review feedback. We present a closed-loop framework in which every accepted review comment is codified as a persistent behavioral rule, progressively expanding the set of error classes the agent can self-detect. The framework combines an accumulating rule set in a version-controlled instruction file, a self-review checklist executed before code submission, and automated validation that ensures rule set integrity as it grows. In deployment across a 35+ service microservices platform, the rule set grew from 5 to 18 behavioral rules, 15+ language-specific standards, and a 15-item self-review checklist, all derived from real review feedback. We present empirical results from 11 recorded working sessions spanning code generation, PR review, incident investigation, and cross service refactoring. We observe that accumulated rules shift review effort from low-level correctness toward design-level validation, achieve a measured 0% recurrence rate for ruled-against error classes, and transfer across heterogeneous agent interfaces. We compare our approach against related work in experiential LLM learning (Reflexion, ExpeL, Voyager) and automated code review (CodeReviewer, SWE-bench agents), showing that our framework achieves persistent cross-session learning without weight updates, operates on production codebases rather than synthetic benchmarks, and addresses an orthogonal dimension (behavioral consistency over time) that existing benchmarks do not measure. The result is a coding agent that improves with every review cycle, accumulating the engineering wisdom of its human collaborators without changing a single model weight.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种闭环框架，让基于LLM的编码智能体通过将人类审查反馈转化为持久行为规则，实现跨会话的自我改进。在35+服务微服务平台上，规则从5条增长到18条，实现了针对规则禁止的错误类别的0%复发率，并将审查焦点从低级正确性转向设计级验证。
Motivation: 现有LLM编码智能体在跨会话中重复相同类型的错误，因为它们缺乏机制来保留从人类审查反馈中学到的修正。
Method: 提出闭环框架，将每个接受的审查评论编码为持久行为规则，通过版本控制的指令文件累积规则集，结合提交前的自我审查清单和自动化验证来保证规则集完整性。
Result: 在35+服务微服务平台部署中，规则集从5条行为规则增长到18条，外加15+语言特定标准和15项自查清单。实测显示对规则禁止的错误类别达到0%复发率，审查努力从低级正确性转向设计级验证，且规则可跨异构代理接口迁移。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了无需权重更新的持久跨会话学习，在生产代码库上运行，解决了现有基准未测量的行为一致性维度，使编码智能体随每次审查周期改进。

papers.title: Securing LLMs in the Wild: Privacy and Security Challenges at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly moving from research settings into the wild, deployed on enterprise infrastructure, personal devices, and edge platforms. While cloud deployments offer scalable compute, concerns over data sovereignty, compliance, latency, and third-party dependence are driving organizations toward edge and on-premise LLMs. This shift introduces new security and privacy challenges: limited compute and memory force aggressive optimizations, including quantization, pruning, model partitioning, and parameter-efficient adaptation, each of which can introduce vulnerabilities and reshape the threat landscape. We describe this tension as the Security-Efficiency Paradox, mechanisms that improve efficiency may weaken robustness, expose new attack surfaces, or increase privacy risks. We examine how compression can degrade safety alignment, how partitioned inference enables reconstruction attacks, and how continuous local adaptation may cause privacy leakage and model drift. To analyze these risks, we introduce a deployment-centric taxonomy organized around three architectural constraints: the Memory Wall, the Quadratic Wall, and the Compute Wall. We derive a unified constraint model that quantifies when unsafe optimizations become unavoidable, linking each wall to specific attack surfaces. Building on this model, we propose the Secure Operational Efficiency Score (SOES), a holistic metric balancing task accuracy, jailbreak resistance, and privacy against energy, memory, and latency, enabling practitioners to configure edge LLMs under real-world hardware limits. We further present a practical decision procedure and targeted mitigations for each optimization-induced vulnerability. Together, these contributions provide a co-designed framework for jointly evaluating security, privacy, and efficiency, laying a foundation for securing edge-native intelligent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）从云端向边缘和本地部署过程中面临的新安全与隐私挑战，提出了安全-效率悖论概念，系统分析了量化、剪枝、模型分区和参数高效适配等优化手段引入的漏洞。作者构建了以内存墙、二次方墙和计算墙为核心的部署分类法，并推导出统一约束模型量化不安全优化何时不可避免。在此基础上提出安全操作效率评分（SOES）综合指标，以及决策程序和针对性缓解措施，为边缘智能系统的安全评估与配置提供了协同设计框架。
Motivation: LLM在边缘部署时面临数据主权、合规和延迟等压力，但有限的计算和内存迫使采用量化、剪枝等优化，这些优化可能削弱安全性、暴露新攻击面或增加隐私风险。现有研究缺乏系统性的框架来评估这些安全-效率权衡。
Method: 引入部署为中心的漏洞分类法，围绕内存墙（存储容量限制）、二次方墙（注意力机制计算复杂度）和计算墙（算力限制）三种架构约束；推导统一约束模型将每个墙与特定攻击面关联；提出安全操作效率评分（SOES），综合平衡任务准确性、越狱抵抗和隐私与能耗、内存、延迟；并给出决策程序和缓解措施。
Result: 论文为理论分析框架，未报告具体实验数据。摘要指出压缩可能削弱安全对齐，分区推理可导致重构攻击，连续本地适应可能引发隐私泄露和模型漂移。SOES被提出用于在硬件限制下配置边缘LLM。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个协同设计框架，联合评估安全性、隐私和效率，为保障边缘原生智能系统安全奠定基础。框架强调优化带来的漏洞需通过针对性缓解措施应对。

papers.title: Baselines Before Architecture: Evaluating Coding Agents for Autonomous Penetration Testing
papers.abstract_en: Recent autonomous penetration testing papers report high benchmark scores while adding multi-component security harnesses around frontier LLMs. Because these systems often change both architecture and backbone model, it is difficult to tell how much performance comes from the harness rather than from the underlying model. This paper presents a controlled study on the 104-task XBOW benchmark using default coding CLI agents as plain-agent baselines. We first run Codex, OpenCode, and Pi with the same GPT-5 model, budget, target interface, and scoring rule. This phase identifies the strongest same-model baseline and tests whether security-specific prompt variants improve its observed score. We then compare the default Codex scaffold with published MAPTA and PentestGPT V2 results under the closest available model matches. Finally, we repeat the plain-agent experiment with GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.5 to measure model scaling inside the same scaffold. The results show a mixed but practical picture. Specialised harnesses can add measurable benchmark lift and may improve cost efficiency, but plain coding agents already solve a large share of the benchmark; repeated plain-agent runs can match or exceed some published architecture scores in union coverage, and newer models substantially improve the same scaffold. Future evaluations should report model-matched plain-agent baselines before attributing benchmark gains to architecture design alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验，在XBOW基准上比较了默认编码CLI智能体与专门的安全框架（如MAPTA、PentestGPT V2）在自主渗透测试中的表现。研究发现，尽管专门框架能带来基准提升，但普通编码智能体已能解决大部分任务，且多次运行可匹配或超过某些架构得分；新模型显著改进了同一框架的性能。
Motivation: 现有自主渗透测试论文常同时改变架构和骨干模型，难以区分性能提升来自安全框架还是基础模型。需要分离这两个因素进行公平比较。
Method: 采用XBOW 104任务基准，使用默认编码CLI智能体（Codex、OpenCode、Pi）作为基线，控制相同GPT-5模型、预算、目标接口和评分规则；随后将默认Codex框架与MAPTA和PentestGPT V2的结果对比；最后在相同框架下测试GPT-5.2和GPT-5.5以观察模型缩放效果。
Result: 专门框架能带来可衡量的基准提升并可能提高成本效率，但普通编码智能体已解决大部分基准；多次普通智能体运行可以匹配或超过某些已报道架构的联合覆盖率；更先进的模型显著改进了同一框架的得分。
Conclusion: 未来评估应在将基准增益归因于架构设计之前，报告模型匹配的普通智能体基线。

papers.title: SingGuard-NSFA: Extensible Guardrails for Agentic AI via Generative Reasoning and Real-Time Classification
papers.abstract_en: We present nsfaguard, a guardrail framework for securing agentic AI systems against operational threats, such as prompt injection, sensitive information extraction, malicious code requests, dangerous tool misuse, and resource exhaustion. We first introduce the NSFA taxonomy, which organizes 185 risk variants into a CIA-triad-grounded hierarchy and is cross-validated against three well-established OWASP guidelines. Based on this taxonomy, we construct a benchmark suite spanning 133 languages, comprising over 93K purpose-built samples targeting both user queries and agent responses, along with 3,435 cross-source samples adapted from five public agent-security datasets. To detect these operational threats in practice, we develop a dual-mode approach combining SFT-based generative reasoning for interpretable offline auditing with discriminative classification heads on the frozen backbone, enabling real-time detection at approximately 50,ms. We release four models with 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B parameters, all achieving $\geq$94% F1 on purpose-built benchmarks and surpassing the strongest competing guardrails by 6 to 12 absolute points. On cross-source evaluation, the 9B model attains 91.29% F1 with a more balanced precision--recall trade-off. Moreover, ablation experiments show that classification heads can equip a guardrail with risk detection capabilities beyond its original scope and achieve state-of-the-art performance. These results demonstrate the extensibility of the approach and its generality as a plug-in enhancement.

papers.title: Inference Economics of Enterprise Coding Agents: A Case Study of Cloud vs. On-Premise LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous coding agents force engineering organizations to choose between API-based frontier models -- strong reasoning at high token cost -- and on-premise quantized open-weights models, which promise low-marginal-cost scaling and data sovereignty at some loss of reasoning fidelity. We study this trade-off through a single-developer, non-randomized longitudinal case study over two contiguous 28-day periods on a production monorepo: an API-based Claude Opus 4.7/4.8 configuration using Claude Code versus an on-premise GLM-5.1/5.2 configuration using Opencode, quantized to NVFP4, on NVIDIA Blackwell hardware. Analyzing LLM telemetry and Git history, we find that prompt caching (99.3% hit rate) cuts realized API cost by 88.6% to an effective \$0.57 per million tokens -- below even the \$2.83 amortized unit cost of the shared on-premise slice (a utilization-dependent inversion; total realized spend and total cost of ownership (TCO) are the robust quantities). At comparable gross code churn, the local configuration was associated with a far higher defect-repair burden: a Fix Commit Ratio (FCR) of 74.9% versus 45.9%, with the odds of a commit being a repair 2.6 to 4.9 times higher within every difficulty tier (Mantel-Haenszel OR = 3.61). Under Taiwan-market parameters and a symmetric labor model, on-premise deployment nonetheless saves 40.1% of true TCO under shared GPU allocation, whereas dedicated reservation costs 43.8% more than the cached API. Under shared allocation, the genuine penalty is not monetary but a measurable developer-experience burden -- timestamp indicators show more work trapped in debugging spirals and a slower commit cadence -- and an offline replay shows hybrid routing gateways trade defect rate for infrastructure savings along a cost-quality frontier rather than dominate the pure-API baseline.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Industrial longitudinal case study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过单开发者28天生产环境纵向案例研究，比较了企业编码代理使用云端API模型（Claude Opus 4.7/4.8）与本地量化模型（GLM-5.1/5.2 on NVFP4）的经济性和开发体验。发现提示缓存（99.3%命中率）使实际API成本降至每百万token 0.57美元，低于本地共享分片的摊销成本；但本地配置的修复提交比（FCR）高达74.9%，远高于API配置的45.9%，且每个难度等级下修复概率高出2.6至4.9倍。在台湾市场参数下，本地部署在共享GPU分配下节省40.1%的总拥有成本，但带来更高的缺陷修复负担和开发体验损失。
Motivation: 企业需要权衡云端前沿模型的高推理成本与本地量化模型的数据主权和低边际成本，但缺乏基于实际生产数据的定量比较。
Method: 采用非随机化纵向案例研究，设置两个连续28天周期：API配置（Claude Code + Claude Opus）和本地配置（Opencode + GLM-5.1/5.2，NVFP4量化，NVIDIA Blackwell硬件），分析LLM遥测和Git历史。
Result: 提示缓存将API成本降低88.6%至0.57美元/百万token，低于本地共享分片的2.83美元；本地配置的FCR为74.9% vs 45.9%，修复优势比3.61；共享分配下本地部署节省40.1% TCO，但专用预留成本比缓存API高43.8%。
Conclusion: 本地部署在共享资源下具有成本优势，但以显著增加的缺陷修复负担和开发体验恶化为代价；混合路由网关存在成本-质量权衡，而非绝对优于纯API基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Operational Evidence Gaps for LLMs in Fraud Detection and Trust-and-Safety Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are now proposed for fraud detection, scam investigation, content moderation, and other trust-and-safety workflows. Much of the public literature still evaluates them as models, with less attention to their behavior as components in operational pipelines. This creates a practical evidence question: what would justify placing an LLM inside a live workflow with latency, cost, escalation, human-review, and adversarial-risk constraints? We address this question through a fraud-first survey of deployment evidence. We code 49 operationally relevant sources on LLM use in fraud detection, investigation support, content moderation, and cross-cutting robustness (18 fraud, 14 moderation, 17 cross-cutting), supplemented by 15 contextual references that establish the survey boundaries. These sources include systems, benchmarks, frameworks, and deployment-relevant surveys, not 49 production deployments. The main finding is an evidence imbalance. Fraud supplies the largest task-specific portion of the coded corpus. The moderation papers, however, include more explicit public evidence on latency, cost, governance, and fairness. Among the 18 fraud and investigation sources, none report clean per-decision latency, per-decision dollar cost, or calibration evidence; most report offline task performance, retrieval gains, or case-study accuracy instead. The survey contributes a role-and-evidence organizing frame, FORTE, for locating LLMs as classifiers, retrieval interfaces, explanation generators, reviewer assistants, agents, feature extractors, or escalation components. It also contributes a minimum deployment-evidence checklist covering latency budget, cost per decision, decision threshold, explanation integrity, and adversarial pressure. The resulting agenda identifies studies needed to support deployment claims for LLM-based fraud and trust-and-safety work.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Ancillary files include the evidence matrix, search note, and numeric claim check
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过文献调查，评估了LLM在欺诈检测、信任与安全（trust-and-safety）工作流中作为组件部署的操作证据。作者编码了49个操作相关来源，发现证据分布不均：欺诈相关文献最多但缺乏延迟、每决策成本和校准等部署关键数据，而内容审核文献包含更多此类公共证据。论文提出了一个角色与证据组织框架FORTE，以及一份最小部署证据检查清单，并指出了未来需要的研究方向。
Motivation: 现有文献多将LLM作为模型评估，较少关注其作为操作流水线组件的实际行为，而部署面临延迟、成本、升级、人工审核和对抗风险等约束。需要明确什么证据能证明将LLM放入实时工作流的合理性。
Method: 采用欺诈优先的文献调查方法，对49个操作相关来源进行编码（其中18个欺诈、14个审核、17个交叉），并补充15个背景参考文献。提出FORTE框架，将LLM角色分为分类器、检索接口、解释生成器、审核助手、代理、特征提取器或升级组件等，并提供包含延迟预算、每决策成本等要素的部署证据检查清单。
Result: 欺诈类文献占比最大，但无一报告干净的每决策延迟、美元成本或校准证据；多数仅报告离线任务性能、检索增益或案例研究准确率。相比之下，内容审核文献包含更多关于延迟、成本、治理和公平性的公开证据。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在欺诈检测和信任与安全工作流中的部署证据存在显著缺口，尤其缺乏延迟、成本和鲁棒性等操作指标。论文提出了一份研究议程，以支持基于LLM的部署声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Monoculture
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often produce homogeneous outputs, raising concerns that AI coding assistants may lead to convergence in the software artifacts that developers create. Whether this occurs in practice is unclear because developers interactively prompt, evaluate, modify, and reject model outputs, and because outputs vary with prompt and repository context. I examine code homogenization using Kaggle contest submissions from 2019 to mid-2026. I first document widespread convergence toward the random seed value 42, consistent with LLMs reinforcing a longstanding convention in programming culture. I then study homogenization more broadly, at two levels of aggregation and abstraction. At the submission level, I measure the average pairwise similarity of submissions within contests. At the contest level, I measure the conceptual span of submitted code, motivating distinct measures for each: TF-IDF representations, which capture surface syntax, and Voyage 3 code embeddings, which capture code intent and semantics. The results demonstrate substantial syntactic homogenization at both the individual and collective levels: individual submissions have become more alike in literal syntax and code structure, while the latent dimensionality of syntactic variation has narrowed. In contrast, I find little evidence of semantic homogenization, individually and collectively. Average semantic distance remains essentially flat, and the contest-level latent dimensional span of semantic approaches remains stable, with evidence suggesting it has even expanded modestly. These findings suggest that AI coding assistants are certainly standardizing implementation details, yet they have not yet produced evidence of homogenization in the approaches and problem-solving strategies coders employ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）编码助手是否导致软件代码同质化。通过分析2019年至2026年中期的Kaggle竞赛提交，发现代码在表面语法和结构层面显著趋同（例如随机种子值42的使用增加），但代码意图和语义层面未出现同质化，语义距离保持平稳甚至略有扩展。
Motivation: LLM常生成同质化输出，但实际开发中开发者会互动式修改模型输出，因此真实环境中代码是否同质化尚不清楚。
Method: 使用Kaggle竞赛提交数据（2019-2026），从两个层级（提交级和竞赛级）和两个抽象级别（语法：TF-IDF；语义：Voyage 3代码嵌入）测量同质化，包括平均成对相似度和潜维跨度。
Result: 个体和集体层面均观察到显著的语法同质化（提交间相似度上升，语法变化潜维变窄）；但语义同质化证据微弱，平均语义距离稳定，竞赛级语义潜维甚至略有扩展。
Conclusion: AI编码助手确实标准化了实现细节，但尚未导致问题解决策略层面的同质化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Entanglement Wall: Activation-Space Probes as Risk Detectors, Not Context Adjudicators
papers.abstract_en: Context can change whether a request is harmful without changing its topic or surface form. We ask whether residual-stream probes distinguish harmful requests from surface-matched benign controls at a useful operating point. Across three 7-8B model families, an activation sensor blocks 95.5-97.7 percent of judge-classified compliant attacks in a taxonomy-selected set. It also blocks 59.6-68.4 percent of XSTest prompts. A fully disjoint audit reconstructs near-ceiling source-contrast AUROC (0.996-0.999), but fixed transfer to matched pairs is weaker: 0.656-0.819 on the guard-selected Twin-n70 subset and 0.590-0.690 on the full Twin-n163 cohort. We test ten axes on the reference family and seven across all families with leakage, hold-out, and permutation controls. On Twin-n163, no axis evaluated without direct pair-boundary fitting reaches the specified numerical threshold. Requiring persistence on that full cohort was added at analysis time. A separately specified 24B/32B extension gives the same result. Pair-trained classifiers weaken under category and generation-batch hold-out and false-block 79.6-100 percent of XSTest at 95 percent in-corpus TPR. At the tested read points, these activation scores behave as broad-risk detectors rather than standalone context adjudicators.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 30 tables. Code and supporting artifacts: https://github.com/dschwarz32/entanglement-wall
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究残差流探针能否在有用操作点区分有害请求与表面匹配的无害控制。在三个7-8B模型家族上，激活传感器阻断了95.5-97.7%的分类合规攻击，但跨类别和生成批次保留时性能下降。在给定的读数点上，激活分数表现为广义风险检测器，而非独立上下文裁决器。
Motivation: 上下文可以改变请求是否有害，而不改变其主题或表面形式。现有方法难以在有用操作点可靠区分有害请求与表面匹配的无害控制。
Method: 使用残差流探针作为激活传感器，在多个模型家族上测试其区分有害请求与无害控制的能力，并进行泄漏、保留和置换控制实验。
Result: 在三个7-8B模型上，激活传感器阻断了95.5-97.7%的符合分类的攻击，但XSTest提示仅阻断59.6-68.4%。完全独立审计达到接近上限的AUROC（0.996-0.999），但固定转移到匹配对时较弱（0.656-0.819）。在Twin-n163上，没有直接对边界拟合的评估达到指定阈值。
Conclusion: 激活分数在测试的读数点上表现为广义风险检测器，而非独立上下文裁决器。跨类别和生成批次保留时性能下降，且在95%域内TPR下误报率高达79.6-100%。

summary_sections.method: 使用残差流探针作为激活传感器，在多个模型家族上测试其区分有害请求与无害控制的能力，并进行泄漏、保留和置换控制实验。
summary_sections.result: 在三个7-8B模型上，激活传感器阻断了95.5-97.7%的符合分类的攻击，但XSTest提示仅阻断59.6-68.4%。完全独立审计达到接近上限的AUROC（0.996-0.999），但固定转移到匹配对时较弱（0.656-0.819）。在Twin-n163上，没有直接对边界拟合的评估达到指定阈值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 激活分数在测试的读数点上表现为广义风险检测器，而非独立上下文裁决器。跨类别和生成批次保留时性能下降，且在95%域内TPR下误报率高达79.6-100%。

papers.title: When is the combined load identifiable from a stress-intensity profile? A coupled forward-inverse study on SIFBench finite-element data
papers.abstract_en: This work studies the inverse problem of recovering the relative magnitudes of the tension, bending, and bearing loads acting on a crack from its stress-intensity-factor profile along the crack front, using the public SIFBench finite-element data. The central claim is not forensic load recovery on field cases, but a rigorous characterization of when the combined load is identifiable at all, together with an estimator that returns calibrated uncertainty precisely in the regimes where it is not. For a known geometry the forward map from loads to profile is exactly linear, and identifiability reduces to a single geometric question: whether the three elementary load profiles are linearly independent as functions along the front. When they are nearly dependent, many different load combinations produce almost the same profile and the inverse problem is illposed; the analysis shows that the degree of ill-posedness is controlled by an intrinsic stability margin, not by the conditioning number alone. A single crack-front operator serves both as a structured forward surrogate and as the differentiable map required by a simplex-constrained, set-valued inverse estimator. On the SIFBench corner-crack scenario the empirical behaviour matches the theory: the typical geometry is well posed while a sizable minority is genuinely ill-posed, so a point estimate is reliable on the majority and provably uninformative on the rest. Validation is on controlled synthetic noise; no real fracture cases are used or claimed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从裂纹前沿的应力强度因子（SIF）分布反演拉伸、弯曲和轴承载荷相对大小的逆问题，使用公开SIFBench有限元数据。核心贡献是严格刻画组合载荷可识别性条件，并给出一个在不可识别区间返回校准不确定性的估计器。结果表明典型几何是适定的，但相当一部分是真正病态的。
Motivation: 不同载荷组合可能产生几乎相同的SIF分布，导致逆问题病态，需要明确可识别性条件以确保估计的可靠性。
Method: 利用正向映射的线性性质，将可识别性简化为三个基本载荷剖面沿裂纹前沿是否线性独立；分析表明病态程度由内在稳定性裕度控制，并提出单纯形约束的集值逆估计器。
Result: 在SIFBench角裂纹场景中，多数几何适定，但相当一部分病态；点估计在适定情形可靠，在病态情形无信息。验证基于合成噪声，未使用真实断裂案例。
Conclusion: 载荷可识别性完全由几何决定，病态程度由稳定性裕度量化，无需依赖真实案例即可进行理论分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Extension of Neuro-Symbolic AGI Robots based on Belnap's Typed Intensional FOL
papers.abstract_en: Neuro-symbolic AI based on $IFOL_B$ is a way to combine neural learning and symbolic reasoning to overcome limitations of purely neural systems (like lack of interpretability and logical structure) with formal logical machinery for self-reference. In this paper we expand the cognitive power of $IFOL_B$ by using the probability computation for the currently unknown sentences, based on Nilsson's probability structure for the $IFOL_B$. We introduce the global symmetry transformation that preserves the current knowledge database and logical deduction, and the local one used for real-time decisions about concrete (sub)problems that involve only a very strict subset of $IFOL_B$ predicates. The computation of probability density function $KI$ in both cases, based on the Shannon's maximum information entropy, is provided by neural networks of this probabilistic neuro-symbolic AGI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Belnap类型内涵一阶逻辑（IFOL_B）的神经符号AI基础上引入概率扩展，利用Nilsson概率结构处理未知语句，并通过全局和局部对称变换保持知识库与逻辑推理。基于Shannon最大信息熵的概率密度函数KI计算由神经网络实现，形成概率神经符号AGI系统。
Motivation: 纯神经AI系统缺乏可解释性和逻辑结构，而现有神经符号方法在自指性、未知事实处理方面存在局限。
Method: 在IFOL_B框架中加入Nilsson概率结构，定义全局对称变换（保持知识库与逻辑演绎）和局部对称变换（针对子问题的实时决策），利用神经网络计算基于最大信息熵的概率密度函数KI。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，仅描述了理论扩展框架。
Conclusion: 该概率扩展增强了神经符号AGI的认知能力，但未涉及具体应用验证，属于理论构建。

papers.title: HRO: Hierarchical Room-to-Object Framework for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation aims to enable an intelligent agent to explore and navigate to objects of unknown categories in an unfamiliar environment without specific target training. In zero-shot navigation tasks, pre-trained large models are usually employed to leverage their prior knowledge for guiding the agent's navigation. However, existing zero-shot object-goal navigation methods based on large language models (LLMs) merely utilize LLMs as flat reasoning tools to directly associate objects or regions. They lack the hierarchical spatial cognition modeling of human-like room semantics to object localization, which leads to strong blindness in exploration, insufficient accuracy in semantic association, and failure to fully unleash the common-sense reasoning potential of LLMs. This paper proposes an LLM-driven hierarchical room-to-object (HRO) framework for zero-shot object-goal navigation, which guides the agent to explore and navigate to the target object in a coarse-to-fine manner. Experiments on Gibson and HM3D datasets verify that our HRO framework achieves superior success rate and generalization over existing LLM-based methods, underscoring LLMs' strong potential for zero-shot object-goal navigation.
papers.comment: Main paper (6 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics 2026 (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对零样本物体目标导航任务，提出一种基于大语言模型的分层房间到物体（HRO）框架，通过粗到细的方式引导智能体探索并导航到未知目标物体。实验在Gibson和HM3D数据集上验证了该方法在成功率和泛化性上优于现有基于LLM的方法。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的零样本导航方法仅将LLM作为平面推理工具，缺乏类似人类的分层空间认知建模，导致探索盲目、语义关联不准确，未能充分发挥LLM的常识推理潜力。
Method: 提出HRO框架，利用LLM进行分层推理：首先在房间层面进行粗粒度定位，再到物体层面细粒度导航，实现从宏观到微观的逐步引导。
Result: 在Gibson和HM3D数据集上，HRO框架取得了优于现有LLM方法的成功率和泛化性能。
Conclusion: HRO框架验证了在零样本物体目标导航中引入分层空间认知的有效性，展示了LLM在该领域的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Compaction as Epistemic Failure: How Agentic LLM Tools Fabricate Confirmed Results from Killed Processes
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLM coding tools compress long session histories into compaction summaries that subsequent sessions inherit as ground truth. This paper documents a failure mode in Claude Code where partial standard output from timed-out commands (exit code 143) is recorded in compaction summaries as confirmed results, propagating false positives across sessions and model versions without re-verification. The underlying mechanism is a conflation of observation and persistence, where information that appeared in the terminal is treated as equivalent to information written to durable storage. This finding extends the analysis of LLM self-evaluation failures reported in prior work on non-determinism in LLM-as-judge grading by showing that agentic tools exhibit analogous reliability deficits when reporting on their own operational outcomes. The failure has direct implications for any workflow that relies on agentic session continuity for data processing, scientific computation, or multi-step automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示Agentic LLM编码工具（如Claude Code）在压缩会话历史时，会将超时命令的部分标准输出记录为确认结果，导致假阳性跨会话传播。作者将这一失败模式归因于将终端观察等同于持久化存储信息。该发现扩展了对LLM自我评估失败的分析。
Motivation: 现有Agentic LLM工具存在将未完成命令的部分输出视为已确认结果的缺陷，导致工作流中错误积累。
Method: 通过分析Claude Code中timeout命令（exit code 143）的压缩总结行为，展示假阳性传播机制。
Result: 记录到超时命令的部分输出被错误地作为已确认结果写入压缩总结，并在后续会话中继承。
Conclusion: 该失败机制对依赖会话连续性的数据处理、科学计算和多步骤自动化工作流有直接影响。

papers.title: Interventional Grounding Audits: Black-Box Premise-Dependency Tests for LLM Chain-of-Thought via Predicate Substitution
papers.abstract_en: Large language models produce chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that appears logically sound yet may not genuinely depend on its stated premises. We introduce interventional grounding audits, a black-box, step-level test of premise dependency: we intervene on a single premise by substituting its target predicate with a fresh symbol, re-run the model, and check whether each reasoning step's normalized conclusion (canonical predicate form) changes. We evaluate on ProntoQA, a synthetic multi-hop deductive reasoning benchmark with gold proof trees, where step-level premise dependencies are known. Applied to 50 ProntoQA problems with GPT-4o, our method achieves F1 = 0.806 on detecting proof-tree dependencies (F1 = 0.885 on predicate-determining dependencies; Recall = 100%), significantly outperforming a self-consistency baseline (F1 = 0.343; 95% bootstrap CIs non-overlapping). We further identify that 66% of correctly-solved problems contain at least one aligned step insensitive to a direct proof-tree dependency under consistent substitution -- all involving entity-introduction premises, a documented blind spot of the consistent-substitution evaluator -- a "right answer, wrong reasoning" signal invisible to passive methods. All audit certificates, raw outputs, and reproduction scripts are available in a public GitHub repository, and we discuss scope limits beyond formal, parsable benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models (https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/10017466)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种黑盒、步骤级的干预式前提依赖审计方法，通过替换谓词符号并观察推理步骤结论是否变化，来检验LLM链式思维是否真实依赖其声称的前提。在ProntoQA基准上对GPT-4o的测试表明，该方法在检测证明树依赖上F1=0.806，显著优于自一致性基线(F1=0.343)；还发现66%正确解答的问题中存在“正确答案但错误推理”的现象。
Motivation: LLM的链式思维推理表面合理却可能并不真正依赖其陈述的前提，现有方法无法有效检测这种虚假相关性。
Method: 对单个前提的目标谓词替换为新符号，重新运行模型，检查每个推理步骤的规范化结论是否改变，从而判断前提依赖关系。
Result: 在ProntoQA上对GPT-4o的审计达到F1=0.806（前提决定依赖F1=0.885，召回率100%），远优于自一致性基线（F1=0.343）。66%正确解答的问题中存在对齐步骤对直接证明树依赖不敏感的情况。
Conclusion: 该审计方法能揭示被动方法无法发现的“正确答案但错误推理”信号，但适用范围限于形式化、可解析的基准测试。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Circuit Vision: Cost-Aware Evaluation of Visual AI Agents for Quantum Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Can AI agents visually comprehend quantum circuit diagrams and generate verified executable code--and at what cost? We present Quantum Circuit Vision, a cost-aware evaluation framework for multimodal AI agents on quantum circuit visual understanding. We construct a 132-circuit benchmark spanning 13 categories ($1$--$10$ qubits) with executable Amazon Braket code and unitary-fidelity verification. Evaluating three frontier Claude-family models at different capability-cost tiers with $n=5$ repeated trials, we find that the mid-tier model (Sonnet 4.6, $1.30\times$ credits) offers the most favorable balance on the cost-accuracy frontier: 91% pass rate on the core subset at 18% of the per-call cost of the strongest model (Opus 4.6), whose accuracy advantage is not statistically significant (paired $t$: $p=0.083$). Logistic regression confirms that circuit depth--not qubit count--is the primary predictor of failure ($p<0.001$). Chain-of-thought prompting shows no statistically significant effect (all $p>0.18$, $n=5$), suggesting that visual pattern recognition outweighs explicit reasoning strategy for structurally coupled diagrams. We propose a cascade routing strategy (cheap $\rightarrow$ expensive models) that achieves 84% accuracy at 38% of single-model cost, demonstrating that model routing dominates prompt engineering as a cost lever. We release QCV-Dataset (132 circuits, 5 modalities, 1,931 files) on Hugging Face Hub as an open evaluation infrastructure with structured metadata for discoverability, interoperability, and responsible AI documentation, and all evaluation code, cost logs, and verification scripts on GitHub for full reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Quantum Circuit Vision，一个面向多模态 AI 代理在量子电路视觉理解上的成本感知评估框架。构建了包含 132 个电路的基准测试，跨越 13 个类别（1-10 量子比特），并配有可执行的 Amazon Braket 代码和保真度验证。评估了三款不同能力-成本等级的 Claude 系列模型，发现中等模型（Sonnet 4.6）在成本-准确率前沿上最为平衡：核心子集通过率 91%，成本仅为最强模型（Opus 4.6）的 18%，且精度差异无统计显著性。逻辑回归表明电路深度是失败的主要预测因素，而非量子比特数。链式思维提示无显著效果。提出了廉→贵模型的级联路由策略，在 38% 的单模型成本下达到 84% 准确率。已发布数据集和代码。
Motivation: 现有 AI 代理在理解量子电路图并生成可执行代码方面的视觉能力尚未得到系统评估，且缺乏对成本效益的关注。
Method: 构建 132 电路基准（1-10 量子比特，13 类别），包含可执行 Braket 代码和保真度验证；评估三款 Claude 模型（Opus, Sonnet, Haiku），进行 n=5 次重复试验；应用逻辑回归分析失败预测因素；测试链式思维提示效果；提出级联路由策略。
Result: 中等模型 Sonnet 4.6 在成本-准确率前沿上最优：核心子集通过率 91%，成本为最强模型 Opus 4.6 的 18%，且精度差异不显著（p=0.083）。电路深度是失败的主要预测因子（p<0.001），链式思维无显著效果。级联路由策略达到 84% 准确率，成本为单模型 38%。

papers.title: Risk assessment of muon single-event effects for low-altitude aircraft
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of low-altitude economy, the radiation environment safety of low-altitude aircraft such as drones and electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft has attracted increasing attention. Although the dense lower atmosphere traditionally serves as an effective shield against cosmic radiation, the shrinking feature sizes of modern integrated circuits greatly enhance their vulnerability to single-event effects (SEEs). This study quantitatively evaluates muon-induced SEE risks for low-altitude aircraft in various regions of China under both static cosmic-ray background and ground-level enhancement (GLE) events, aiming to provide critical guidance for the next-generation low-altitude aviation platforms.Using city-specific atmospheric models within the CORSIKA framework, we simulate atmospheric shower processes and obtain reliable energy spectra for low-energy muons (10-100 MeV). We also employ simulation data from other research groups to estimate muon-induced SEE cross sections for transistors at different process nodes, including bulk, FD-SOI, and FinFET technologies. By incorporating solar energetic particle spectra associated with GLE events, we assess muon-induced SEE risks under both static and GLE conditions. Our results show that under static conditions, flight control systems with 1 MB memory using advanced nodes below 45 nm and bulk transistors face non-negligible muon-induced SEE risks in all Chinese cities. In contrast, systems with FD-SOI transistors can effectively mitigate these risks. For large-memory systems (1 GB), redundancy or other hardening measures are essential regardless of the process technology. Regarding GLE events, we introduce the concept of muon hazard levels to evaluate regional risk variations. During GLEs, the increase in muon-induced SEE risk is negligible in mid-to-low latitude regions but becomes significant at high latitudes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定量评估了中国不同地区低空飞行器在静态宇宙射线背景和地面增强事件（GLE）下的缪子（muon）诱导单粒子效应（SEE）风险。利用CORSIKA框架和城市大气模型模拟大气簇射，获得低能缪子能谱，并估计不同工艺节点晶体管的SEE截面。结果表明，静态条件下45nm以下节点且采用体硅晶体管的1 MB内存飞行控制系统面临不可忽略的缪子诱导SEE风险，而FD-SOI晶体管可有效缓解；1 GB大内存系统无论工艺均需加固。GLE事件下，中低纬度风险增加可忽略，高纬度显著增加。
Motivation: 低空经济发展使无人机等飞行器的辐射环境安全受到关注，现代集成电路特征尺寸缩小增强了其对单粒子效应的敏感性，但传统大气屏蔽作用可能不足，需要定量评估缪子诱导SEE风险。
Method: 使用CORSIKA框架结合城市特定大气模型模拟大气簇射，得到10-100 MeV低能缪子能谱；利用其他研究组的模拟数据估计不同工艺节点（bulk、FD-SOI、FinFET）晶体管的缪子诱导SEE截面；结合太阳高能粒子谱评估静态和GLE条件下的风险。
Result: 静态条件下，45nm以下节点且采用体硅晶体管的1 MB内存飞行控制系统在所有中国城市均面临不可忽略的缪子诱导SEE风险；FD-SOI可有效缓解；1 GB大内存系统无论工艺均需加固。GLE事件下，中低纬度风险增加可忽略，高纬度显著增加，并引入缪子危险等级概念。
Conclusion: 本文为中国低空飞行器的缪子诱导SEE风险评估提供了定量依据，强调了工艺选择和加固措施的必要性。

papers.title: HRIBench: Benchmarking Interaction-Centric Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Current vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks primarily evaluate isolated manipulation skills while leaving human-robot interaction structure largely unmodeled. However, real-world collaboration fundamentally requires coordination under shared agency, including intent understanding, temporal synchronization, protocol adherence, and safe interaction in dynamic environments. To address this gap, we introduce HRIBench, a diagnostic benchmark for intent-aware human-robot collaboration based on executable interaction scenarios. HRIBench represents collaborative tasks as structured scenario scripts that explicitly model agent roles, temporal dependencies, coordination constraints, and human behavior distributions. Building on this abstraction, HRIBench defines three representative interaction roles: Instructor, Collaborator, and Intruder, covering intent communication, joint coordination, and robustness under human intervention. The benchmark contains 13 role-conditioned tasks with over 650 evaluation episodes generated from diverse interaction trajectories and scene variations. Beyond binary task success, HRIBench introduces interpretable interaction-centric metrics spanning synchronization, responsiveness, protocol compliance, and safety. We evaluate adapted policies based on GR00T, pi0.5, and ACT under a unified protocol. Results show that current foundation robot policies struggle substantially in collaborative settings despite strong manipulation ability, revealing major limitations in temporal coordination and intent-aware behavior. Fine-tuning on HRIBench consistently improves collaborative performance. In a real-world adaptation study, simulation data generated by HRIBench improves GR00T N1.5's physical-task success rate from 0.10 to 0.43, demonstrating the benchmark's value for advancing interaction-centric robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HRIBench，一个面向意图感知人机协作的诊断基准，通过结构化场景脚本建模协作任务，包含13个角色条件任务和超过650个评估场景，引入可解释的交互中心指标。实验表明现有基础机器人策略在协作设置中表现欠佳，微调可提升协作性能，并在真实世界迁移中显著提高任务成功率。
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言-动作基准主要评估孤立操作技能，未建模人机交互结构，而真实协作需要共享代理下的协调。
Method: 提出HRIBench，基于可执行交互场景，将协作任务表示为结构化场景脚本，明确建模角色、时间依赖、协调约束和人类行为分布。定义了三种交互角色（指导者、协作者、入侵者），包含13个任务和超过650个评价场景。
Result: 基于GR00T、pi0.5和ACT的适应策略在统一协议下评估，结果显示当前基础机器人策略在协作设置中表现不佳，但在HRIBench上微调持续改进协作性能。真实世界迁移实验中将GR00T N1.5的成功率从0.10提升到0.43。
Conclusion: HRIBench为以交互为中心的机器人学习提供了有价值的基准，揭示了当前策略在时间协调和意图感知行为上的主要局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autonomous UAV Route Planning for Coverage Maximization in Environmental Monitoring: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract_en: Environmental monitoring with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) requires route planning methods that maximize covered area while handling energy limits, operational constraints, and geometric complexity. This paper reports the protocol and preliminary results of an ongoing systematic literature review (SLR) on autonomous UAV route planning for coverage-oriented environmental monitoring. The review follows the PRISMA 2020 framework and searches Scopus and Web of Science for studies published between 2015 and 2026. The protocol focuses on path planning, coverage path planning, and informative path planning, with emphasis on algorithmic families, coverage and energy metrics, obstacle handling, geometric environment representations, and environmental constraints. At the current stage, 562 records have been identified, 161 duplicates have been removed, and 401 unique records have been screened by title, abstract, and keywords. From these, 247 studies were retained for full-text eligibility assessment (235 eligible and 12 borderline records to be resolved during full-text review). A preliminary analysis of the retained studies suggests strong concentration on coverage-oriented formulations, multi-UAV coordination, and energy-aware optimization, while fewer studies explicitly address weather, uncertainty, or obstacle-rich environments. Most retained studies rely on simulation-based validation, highlighting a potential simulation-to-reality gap, and recent publications show increasing interest in reinforcement learning, hybrid optimization, and geometry-aware planning. These early findings indicate an active but fragmented research landscape and support the need for a structured synthesis to identify mature techniques and unresolved gaps for realistic environmental monitoring missions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项关于自主无人机（UAV）路径规划用于环境监测中覆盖最大化的系统文献综述（SLR），遵循PRISMA 2020框架，检索2015-2026年间Scopus和Web of Science上的相关研究。初步筛选后保留247篇论文进行全文评估，初步分析表明现有研究集中在覆盖导向公式、多无人机协调和能量感知优化，而较少涉及天气、不确定性或障碍物环境；多数研究基于仿真验证，存在仿真到现实的差距；近年对强化学习、混合优化和几何感知规划兴趣增加。
Motivation: 环境监测中无人机路径规划需要最大化覆盖面积，同时处理能量限制、操作约束和几何复杂性，但该领域研究分散，缺乏系统性综述来识别成熟技术和未解决的差距。
Method: 按照PRISMA 2020框架进行系统文献综述，搜索Scopus和Web of Science数据库，筛选2015-2026年间关于自主无人机覆盖导向路径规划的研究，包括路径规划、覆盖路径规划和信息路径规划，重点关注算法家族、覆盖和能量指标、障碍处理、几何环境表示和环境约束。
Result: 初步检索获得562条记录，去除161条重复后，401条记录经标题、摘要和关键词筛选，保留247篇进行全文评估（235篇合格，12篇边界）。初步分析显示研究集中于覆盖导向、多无人机协调和能量感知优化，但明确处理天气、不确定性和障碍物环境的研究较少；多数研究基于仿真验证。
Conclusion: 该领域活跃但碎片化，需结构化综合以识别用于实际环境监测任务的成熟技术和未解决缺口。

papers.title: Precomputing the Future-Offset Average in TriAttention
papers.abstract_en: TriAttention is a recent method for shrinking the KV cache of long-reasoning LLMs: it scores each cached key by how much attention it is likely to receive and evicts the lowest-scoring ones. Because a key does not know how far away its future queries will sit, the score is averaged over a ladder of 17 possible future distances. We point out that this average is free: the future distance enters the score only through the position-dependent rotation, so the whole 17-fold average collapses--exactly, by a one-line algebraic identity--into a single per-band weight that is computed once, offline. Scoring a key then costs one evaluation instead of seventeen, with no change to which keys get pruned. The saving is modest and lives entirely in TriAttention's pruning-score computation, not in the attention kernel; we present it as a small, exact complement to their method, and we confirm the identity numerically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出TriAttention中通过代数恒等式可以将17种未来距离的评分平均计算简化为单一离线权重，每次评分只需一次计算而非十七次，且不改变剪枝结果。该优化仅影响修剪分数计算，不涉及注意力核本身，数值验证了恒等式成立。
Motivation: TriAttention通过平均17种未来距离的注意力分数来评分KV缓存键，导致计算开销较大。作者发现可以利用位置相关的旋转特性，通过代数恒等式精确地化简该平均过程。
Method: 利用位置相关的旋转（position-dependent rotation）特性，将17折平均归约为单个离线计算的每波段权重（per-band weight），使得每次评分只需一次计算而非十七次。
Result: 该方法在保持修剪结果完全不变的前提下，将评分计算成本降低为原来的1/17。
Conclusion: 这是一个小的精确优化，作为TriAttention方法的补充，数值验证了恒等式成立。

papers.title: SPINE: Bridging the Cyber-Physical Gap with Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have given robots a sophisticated brain for complex decision-making, yet deploying that intelligence into a physical platform still demands tedious, expert-driven calibration. This deployment gap, the robot's spinal cord, remains a primary bottleneck to scalable Embodied AI. Hence, we propose SPINE (Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise): an agentic framework for systematically debugging and deploying bimanual robots with minimal robotics expertise. SPINE's harness comprises two orchestrated multi-agent workflows: a profile builder that creates robot-specific context, and a debugger that cycles through diagnosis, repair, and validation until teleoperation works. Across seven DOBOT X-Trainer debugging scenarios, a robotics novice using SPINE outperformed human operators using Claude Code with the same reference materials, but without SPINE's structured workflow, improving operationalization success from 75% to 100% and reducing mean time-to-teleoperation from 16 min 45 s to 13 min 47 s. On AgileX PiPER, a distinct ROS/CAN bimanual arm, SPINE resolved all 10 implanted bugs, versus 9 out of 10 for the expert baseline, in nearly the same amount of time. Together, these results show that SPINE can transfer across bimanual platforms, reduce dependence on expert calibration, and move embodied AI closer to scalable real-world deployment.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Sequential Decision Rules for Event-Triggered LLM Invocation in Streaming Systems
papers.abstract_en: Streaming inference pipelines increasingly pair lightweight fast models with Large Language Models (LLMs) that provide rich semantic understanding at substantial cost. The central question of when to invoke the LLM has received limited formal treatment. We cast this as a risk-based sequential stopping problem, where a trigger policy fires when a risk functional over the observation history exceeds a threshold. Within this framework, we prove six results: a minimum inter-event time bound excluding trigger chattering; optimality of threshold policies via smooth pasting; approximate SPRT guarantees under estimated parameters; O(sqrt(T log T)) regret for stationary streams, extending to O(sqrt((C_T + 1) T log T)) under C_T changepoints; O(1/sqrt(T)) convergence of online gradient descent for adaptive thresholds; and a calibration-to-miss-rate transfer inequality. Several classical trigger families, including event-triggered, optimal stopping, SPRT, CUSUM, and Bayesian triggers, can be expressed as special cases of this framework. On turbofan degradation data (CMAPSS) with real LLM calls, we empirically verify the theoretical assumptions, ablate the risk function design, compare against six baselines including a RouteLLM-style router and contextual bandits, and analyze cost sensitivity and LLM failure modes. The results confirm sublinear regret, with alpha < 1 for all principled triggers; high diagnostic quality, with 92.9 percent of 1600 LLM diagnoses reaching grounding score >= 0.75 under our rubric; and that anomaly-score-driven risk functions dominate alternatives by roughly an order of magnitude on the Pareto AUC.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the ECML PKDD 2026 Research Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了流式推理流水线中何时调用大语言模型（LLM）的决策问题，将其形式化为一个基于风险函数的序列最优停止问题。作者提出了一个统一框架，涵盖事件触发、最优停止、SPRT、CUSUM和贝叶斯触发器，并证明了六条理论结果，包括最小事件间隔、阈值策略最优性、近似SPRT保证、次线性遗憾界、在线梯度下降收敛性以及校准到误报率的转移不等式。在CMAPSS涡扇退化数据上结合真实LLM调用进行实验，验证了理论假设，并表明异常分数驱动的风险函数在Pareto AUC上比替代方案优越约一个数量级。
Motivation: 流式推理流水线中，轻量模型与LLM配对使用，但何时调用LLM的问题缺乏严格形式化处理，现有方法多为启发式。
Method: 将LLM调用决策建模为基于风险函数的序列最优停止问题，提出统一框架，涵盖事件触发、最优停止、SPRT、CUSUM和贝叶斯触发器，并设计自适应阈值学习算法。
Result: 理论上证明了最小事件间隔、阈值策略最优性、O(sqrt(T log T))遗憾界等结果；实验上在CMAPSS数据上验证了亚线性遗憾（alpha<1），1600次LLM诊断中92.9%达到接地分数>=0.75，异常分数驱动风险函数在Pareto AUC上比替代方案优越约一个数量级。
Conclusion: 该框架为流式系统中LLM调用提供了统一的理论基础，并经验证在成本-效果权衡上优于现有基线。
