papers.title: Targeted Recovery of Weight-Space Mechanisms From Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Parameter decomposition (PD) decomposes neural networks into interpretable computational components that faithfully reflect the original network's operations. However, scaling PD to large models requires vast compute, making it a costly and risky endeavor. Here we propose targeted PD (tPD), which identifies only the components that process specific inputs of interest -- from isolated prompts to large subtasks -- by introducing a high-rank catch-all component that handles all non-target data. We validate tPD on toy models and on transformer language models trained on The Pile, where it recovers reproducible, mechanistically faithful circuits. We extract a CSS-only submodel of a 4-block transformer using 7% of the FLOPs of its published decomposition, and in a 12-block transformer we surgically ablate and rewire memorized sequences, with negligible side effects on other inputs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出定向参数分解（tPD）方法，通过引入高秩的“catch-all”组件处理非目标数据，从而仅恢复神经网络中处理特定输入的可解释计算组件。在玩具模型和基于The Pile训练的Transformer语言模型上验证，tPD能够以更低的计算成本（例如针对4层Transformer仅需原分解7%的FLOPs）恢复可重复、机制上忠实的电路，并在12层Transformer中实现针对记忆序列的精准消融和重连，对其他输入影响极小。
Motivation: 参数分解（PD）方法可以将神经网络分解为可解释的计算组件，但扩展到大型模型需要巨大的计算资源，成本和风险很高。
Method: 提出定向参数分解（tPD），通过引入一个高秩的“catch-all”组件来吸收所有非目标数据，从而仅提取处理特定输入（从单个prompt到大型子任务）的相关组件。
Result: 在玩具模型和基于The Pile训练的Transformer上验证，tPD以较少计算量（4层Transformer仅用原分解7%的FLOPs）恢复出可重复、机制忠实的电路，并在12层Transformer中成功消融和重连记忆序列，对无关输入的副作用可忽略。
Conclusion: tPD通过定向提取目标输入对应的组件，显著降低了参数分解的计算成本，为理解大型神经网络中特定行为对应的权重空间机制提供了更实用的工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Your Model Threw Away and Why You'll Want It Back: Masking, Fingerprinting, and Privacy from Discarded Geometry
papers.abstract_en: We develop a framework for the information discarded by machine learning models whose inputs carry a Lie group action. Given a representation $π$ of a Lie group $G$ on a space $V$ and a learned function $f\colon V \to \mathbb{R}$, we define two objects measuring the symmetry invisible to $f$. The null fiber at a point $x \in V$ is the set $N_G(f,x) = \{g \in G : f(π(g^{-1}) \cdot x) = f(x)\}$ of group elements whose inverse action on $x$ is undetectable by $f$. When $N_G(f,x)$ is independent of $x$, it coincides with the stabilizer $\mathrm{Stab}_G(f)$, the largest subgroup of $G$ under which $f$ is invariant. For smooth maps to $\mathbb{R}$, the preimage theorem guarantees that null fibers have dimension at least $\dim G - 1$ at generic inputs, regardless of architecture. For compact groups acting on themselves, the Peter--Weyl theorem yields a spectral characterization of both objects in terms of the Fourier coefficient matrices of $f$. We show that null fiber elements can be computed efficiently via Newton iteration on the orbit map, at a cost comparable to a few gradient evaluations. Applications to data masking, model fingerprinting, and privacy-preserving computation are developed and tested experimentally on molecular property prediction under $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ and spherical image classification under the Möbius group $\mathrm{PSL}(2, \mathbb{C})$. The framework applies uniformly to classical neural networks and variational quantum circuits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个研究机器学习模型丢弃的对称性信息的理论框架，针对输入数据带有李群作用的情形。定义并分析了零纤维和稳定子群，证明了零纤维维数至少为群维数减一，并利用Peter-Weyl定理给出谱特征。实验在SO(3)分子性质预测和PSL(2,C)球面图像分类上验证了框架在数据掩码、模型指纹识别和隐私保护中的应用。
Motivation: 现有机器学习模型常忽略输入中隐含的对称性，导致信息浪费和潜在隐私泄露；缺乏统一的理论来刻画被丢弃的几何信息。
Method: 基于李群表示论和微分几何，定义零纤维和稳定子群，通过牛顿迭代在轨道映射上高效计算零纤维元素，并利用Peter-Weyl定理进行谱分析。
Result: 理论给出零纤维维数的下界（至少dim(G)-1），实验表明该方法可用于数据掩码、模型指纹识别和隐私保护，且适用于经典神经网络和变分量子电路。
Conclusion: 框架统一描述了机器学习模型丢弃的对称性信息，并提供计算工具和应用途径，但实验规模有限，实际隐私保护效果需进一步评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Federated Explainable Artificial Intelligence: Roles, Architectures, Evaluation, and Open Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a key paradigm for privacy-preserving collaborative model training across distributed and heterogeneous data sources. By keeping raw data local, FL addresses data confidentiality concerns, yet it does not resolve the opacity of modern machine learning models. In parallel, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has gained attention for improving transparency, trust, and accountability, particularly in high-stakes domains. Their intersection has given rise to Federated Explainable Artificial Intelligence (FedXAI) paradigm, which aims to jointly satisfy privacy and explainability requirements. This survey provides a systematic review of FedXAI, highlighting the transition of explainability from a post-hoc tool to an integral component of the FL lifecycle. We show how explainability supports aggregation, personalization, robustness, coordination, and system-level decision making. To organize the literature, we introduce a taxonomy that classifies FedXAI methods by the role of explainability, model and explainer types, explanation scope, integration level, FL settings, and data heterogeneity. We review approaches ranging from model-agnostic explanations to interpretable federated models and explainability-aware aggregation mechanisms. We also examine evaluation practices and discuss the lack of standardized benchmarks and metrics for measuring explanation quality, stability, privacy leakage, and computational overhead. Finally, we identify key challenges, including explainability under non-IID data, explanation-centric security threats, communication-efficient XAI, continual FedXAI, and the integration of domain knowledge and regulatory constraints. By consolidating existing work and identifying key gaps, this survey serves as a reference framework for designing trustworthy, transparent, and privacy-preserving federated AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本综述系统回顾了联邦可解释人工智能（FedXAI）领域，指出可解释性正从事后工具转变为联邦学习全生命周期的重要组成部分。摘要介绍了分类法，涵盖可解释性的角色、模型类型、解释范围、集成级别、FL设置和数据异质性。还讨论了评估实践和标准化基准的缺失。最后指出了关键挑战，如非IID数据下的可解释性、安全威胁、通信高效XAI等。
Motivation: 联邦学习虽然保护隐私，但模型不透明；可解释性需求与隐私需求交织，FedXAI应运而生，但缺乏系统性综述和标准化评估。
Method: 提出分类法，按可解释性的角色、模型与解释器类型、解释范围、集成级别、FL设置、数据异质性对FedXAI方法进行分类。综述了从模型无关解释到可解释联邦模型和可解释性感知聚合机制的方法。
Result: 无具体数值结果，但指出缺乏标准化基准和度量来评估解释质量、稳定性、隐私泄漏和计算开销。
Conclusion: 该综述作为设计可信、透明、隐私保护的联邦AI系统的参考框架，并指出面临的关键挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Perplexity Trap: When Patent Law Makes Human Writing Look Like AI
papers.abstract_en: The European Patent Office (EPO) reported record filings in 2025, and the 2026 EPO Guidelines hold applicants strictly responsible for LLM-assisted content under Article 83 and Rule 42, creating pressure to triage suspected AI-generated patent text. Two constraints make this hard. First, realistic prosecution settings often have only consumer GPUs with about 8 GB VRAM, not datacenter-class scoring stacks. Second, Article 84 of the European Patent Convention requires claims to be clear and concise, pushing human drafting onto the same low-perplexity, low-burstiness manifold that LLMs occupy. We benchmark three open-source zero-shot detectors on 500 granted EPO H04 telecom patents versus 500 LLM-generated counterparts using five prompting strategies, all under the consumer hardware envelope. At claim level, all detectors exceed 60 percent false-positive rate: Binoculars 78.3 percent, Fast-DetectGPT 61.3 percent, DetectGPT 80.5 percent. The failure persists under Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct regeneration, LoRA-adapted Pythia-2.8B scoring heads, cross-IPC replication on A61K, C07D, and F03D (mean FPR 84.6 percent), and H100 re-evaluation with published Falcon-7B and GPT-J-6B heads, arguing the issue is structural rather than substitute-model capacity. A seven-feature linguistic-complexity logistic regression reaches 74.0 percent accuracy at 28.1 percent FPR, a 13 percentage-point gain over a perplexity-only baseline at a comparable operating point, without using likelihood at inference and within the same hardware budget.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了欧洲专利局（EPO）对LLM辅助专利文本的严格审查要求下，现有AI文本检测器在消费级硬件上的失效问题。实验表明，在500件EPO H04电信专利与LLM生成文本的对比中，Binoculars等零样本检测器在权利要求层面的假阳性率（FPR）超过60%。作者提出一个基于七项语言复杂度特征的逻辑回归模型，在28.1% FPR下达到74.0%准确率，优于仅使用困惑度的基线模型，且不依赖推理时的似然计算。
Motivation: EPO 2026年指南依据EPC第83条和细则42条要求申请人严格负责LLM辅助内容，但现有检测器在专利文本上误报率极高，且受限于消费级GPU硬件（约8GB VRAM）。此外，EPC第84条要求权利要求清晰简洁，导致人类起草文本与LLM输出的低困惑度、低突发性特征趋同，增加了检测难度。
Method: 在消费级硬件上使用五种提示策略，对500件EPO H04电信专利与500件LLM生成文本，评估三种开源零样本检测器（Binoculars、Fast-DetectGPT、DetectGPT）。并构建一个包含七个语言复杂度特征的逻辑回归模型，仅使用文本统计量而不依赖模型似然。
Result: 在权利要求层面，所有检测器FPR超过60%：Binoculars 78.3%、Fast-DetectGPT 61.3%、DetectGPT 80.5%。该失败模式在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct再生、LoRA适配Pythia-2.8B评分头、跨IPC类别（A61K、C07D、F03D）复制（平均FPR 84.6%），以及H100上使用Falcon-7B和GPT-J-6B评分头时依然存在。提出的七特征逻辑回归模型在28.1% FPR下达到74.0%准确率，比仅用困惑度的基线提升13个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为检测失败是结构性问题而非模型容量限制，并展示了无需大型模型似然的轻量特征方法在专利语言检测中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Backbone Backpropagation: A Decoupled Strategy for Efficient Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models achieve state-of-the-art image classification but face deployment challenges due to computational costs and energy demands. We propose a lightweight training strategy that adapts normalization layers of the model to the new domain and decouples feature extraction from classifier optimization, reducing overhead by precomputing features only once. A redesigned classifier head with margin-based weighted loss further minimizes ambiguity without end-to-end backpropagation. Evaluated across four CNN architectures (ResNet18, ResNet50, MobileNet, DenseNet121), three Transformer models (ViT, Swin and DeiT) and three medical datasets (Brain Cancer MRI, BreakHis and PatchCamelyon), our approach significantly reduces the required training time with only a marginal accuracy trade-off, often matching or surpassing baseline performance. This efficiency translates to reducing CO2 by orders of magnitude, offering a practical and environmentally sustainable solution for resource-constrained clinical or prototyping environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级迁移学习策略，通过冻结骨干网络、仅适配归一化层并解耦特征提取与分类器优化（预计算特征一次），同时重新设计基于margin加权损失的分类器头，无需端到端反向传播。在多种CNN和Transformer架构以及三个医学图像数据集上，该方法显著减少训练时间，准确率仅略有下降，常匹配或超越完整微调基线，并将训练过程的CO₂排放降低数个数量级。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在图像分类中虽性能优异，但全参数微调的计算成本和高能耗限制了其在资源受限环境下的部署。
Method: 提出解耦策略：冻结骨干网络，仅适配归一化层参数；预计算特征并存储，避免重复前向传播；设计带margin-based加权损失的分类器头，在特征空间直接优化分类器。
Result: 在ResNet18/50、MobileNet、DenseNet121及ViT、Swin、DeiT上，使用Brain Cancer MRI、BreakHis、PatchCamelyon三个数据集，训练时间大幅缩短，准确率与完整微调基线相当或更高，CO₂排放减少几个数量级。
Conclusion: 该方法为资源受限的临床或原型环境提供了实用且环境可持续的迁移学习方案，在效率与性能间取得良好平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automatic Differentiation from Scratch: How PyTorch Computes Gradients in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper traces, with explicit numerical values, how PyTorch's automatic differentiation (AD) engine computes gradients for Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) training -- a setting that requires two levels of differentiation: computing the physics derivative $\hat{y}'(t)=d\hat{y}/dt$ through the network, and computing parameter gradients $\nabla_θL$ of a loss that itself depends on $\hat{y}'(t)$. Using a 1-3-3-1 multilayer perceptron and the initial value problem $y'(t)+y(t)=0$, $y(0)=1$, we trace the complete pipeline at every node: the computational graph built during the forward pass, the reverse-mode backward traversal that computes all 22 parameter gradients in a single pass, and the graph-on-graph mechanism by which \texttt{create\_graph=True} enables correct differentiation through the physics-informed residual. Every adjoint value is verified against the hand derivations of Tahimi (2026), connecting the $P/Q$ sensitivity framework to the vector--Jacobian products used by PyTorch's autograd engine.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures. Educational tutorial on automatic differentiation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) using PyTorch. Includes complete numerical derivations and computational graph analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文详细追踪了PyTorch自动微分引擎在物理信息神经网络（PINN）训练中计算梯度的过程，使用1-3-3-1多层感知机和初值问题y'(t)+y(t)=0, y(0)=1作为示例，展示了从计算图构建到反向传播的完整流程，并验证了所有22个参数梯度的解析值。
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络需要两层微分：通过网络计算物理导数ŷ'(t)以及计算损失相对于参数∇θL，现有教程缺乏详尽的数值追踪。
Method: 使用一个简单的PINN示例和PyTorch的autograd引擎，逐步绘制计算图、执行反向模式求导，并利用create_graph=True机制实现通过物理残差的正确微分。
Result: 展示了所有22个参数梯度的数值验证，并与Tahimi (2026)的P/Q敏感性框架和向量-雅可比积联系起来。
Conclusion: 该教程提供了自动微分在PINN中应用的完整数值示例，有助于理解PyTorch的autograd机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LessonBench-V1: A Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating AI Lesson Generation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) based AI educational content generation systems are increasingly being developed, yet no standardised benchmark exists to systematically evaluate them. This study introduces LessonBench-V1, a benchmark dataset comprising 647 human-written lessons paired with LLM-based reverse-engineered lesson plans across 240 STEM topics spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, and computer science. The lessons are drawn from 97 trusted open sources, including LibreTexts, Brilliant.org and GeeksForGeeks. Each lesson plan is human-reviewed and produced through a pedagogically grounded methodology that synthesises Bloom's Taxonomy, Gagné's Events, Merrill's First Principles, and the 5E Instructional Model. The lesson plans capture 3,620 learning objectives with pedagogical metadata, enabling systematic, reproducible evaluation of lesson-generation AI agents and supporting further research. The study further proposes a three-dimensional evaluation pipeline for use with the dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍LessonBench-V1，一个用于评估AI课程生成智能体的基准数据集，包含647份人工编写的课程和对应的逆向工程教案，覆盖数学、物理、化学和计算机科学240个STEM主题。教案基于布鲁姆分类法、加涅的教学事件等教学理论设计，包含3620个学习目标及其教学元数据，并提出了三维评估流水线。
Motivation: 目前缺乏标准化的基准来系统评估基于LLM的AI教育内容生成系统。
Method: 构建包含647份人工课程和逆向工程教案的数据集，教案由人类审核并融合多种教学理论（布鲁姆分类法、加涅教学事件等），同时提出三维评估流水线。
Result: 数据集包含3620个学习目标及教学元数据，支持可重复的课程生成智能体评估。
Conclusion: LessonBench-V1为AI课程生成提供了标准化基准，但对其他领域（如天气预报）无直接相关性。

papers.title: Final Authority in AI Governance: Frontier-Provider Sovereignty and Action-Centered Deployer Governance
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines where final authority should sit once capable AI systems are embedded in organizational workflows. It compares two governance models. The first, frontier-provider sovereignty, assigns privileged authority to the provider of the most capable models and is reflected in contemporary arguments for frontier-model testing, release gating, transparency duties, and compute-related controls. The second, action-centered deployer sovereignty, places final authority over high-impact actions with the organization that authorizes the action, embeds it in a business process, and bears the downstream legal, operational, and commercial consequences. The paper combines comparative reading of public governance frameworks with implementation-informed analysis of runtime heterogeneity and enterprise control requirements. It compares EU AI Act guidance, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI, recent Japanese AI policy instruments, and Canada's voluntary code and managerial guidance. Across these materials, the paper finds stronger support for distributed operational accountability than for unilateral frontier-provider control. It further argues that rapid enterprise adoption, declining provider transparency, and widening control gaps increase the value of a portable governance layer centered on governed action rather than on provider-native session objects. The conclusion is layered rather than absolutist: strong upstream authority remains justified for frontier capability gating, but final authority over concrete enterprise action is better located with the deployer and consequence-bearer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在AI系统嵌入组织工作流时最终权威应归属于谁，比较了前沿提供者主权（frontier-provider sovereignty）和以行动为中心的部署者主权（action-centered deployer sovereignty）两种治理模型。通过分析欧盟AI法案、NIST AI风险管理框架等多国治理框架，发现分布式运营问责制的支持度高于单边前沿提供者控制。文章提出，对于前沿能力把关仍需要强大的上游权威，但具体企业行动的最终权威应归属于部署者和后果承担者。
Motivation: 当前AI系统在组织中的深度嵌入引发了最终决策权威归属的争议，现有治理框架对这一问题缺乏明确共识，特别是当提供者透明度下降、控制缺口扩大时亟需厘清治理责任。
Method: 通过比较阅读EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF、新加坡代理AI治理模型、日本政策工具及加拿大自愿守则等多国治理框架，结合运行时异质性和企业控制需求的分析，论证分布式运营问责制的优势。
Result: 研究发现各治理框架对分布式运营问责的支持强于单边前沿提供者控制，且企业快速采纳、提供者透明度下降等因素增加了以受治理行动为中心的可移植治理层的价值。
Conclusion: 文章主张分层而非绝对化的结论：前沿能力把关仍需上游权威，但具体企业行动的最终权威应归属部署者和后果承担者。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safeguard-Conditioned Uplift: Measuring Utility-Risk Frontiers for Dual-Use Biology Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations for dual-use biology assistants often measure base-model capability, refusal behavior, or jailbreak success. These metrics miss a deployment question: for a fixed base model, how does the access condition users actually see change benign utility and harmful actionable assistance? I introduce safeguard-conditioned uplift, a protocol for comparing deployed access conditions through a human-judged utility-risk frontier. I evaluate Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 3.5 Flash under helpful prompting, safety prompting, and an external safeguarded assistant on a 108-task surrogate benchmark, with the headline claim restricted to a locked 18-task held-out split. In a 600-row blinded human audit, the safeguarded assistant reduces harmful actionability relative to helpful prompting by -0.063 over 49 matched response pairs, with bootstrap 95% interval [-0.117, -0.011], while correctness changes by +0.009 with interval [-0.057, +0.077]. Adaptive, Test-B, cue-ablation, and controller-baseline checks support the measurement story but also show non-dominance: safety prompting is often strongest for Claude, while external control helps more for Gemini and can reduce benign utility. The contribution is not a universal defense. It is a deployment-level evaluation target, plus a learned risk-budgeted calibration procedure, for measuring how user-facing access conditions move the utility-risk frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为“safeguard-conditioned uplift”的评估协议，用于衡量双用生物学助手在不同访问条件下的效用-风险前沿。通过在108任务代理基准（锁定18任务测试）上评估Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 3.5 Flash，发现安全助手能减少有害行动能力（-0.063），但对正确性影响不显著。不同模型表现各异，不存在通用防御。
Motivation: 现有安全评估多关注基线能力或拒答行为，忽略了部署时不同访问条件对良性效用和有害帮助的实际影响。
Method: 引入safeguard-conditioned uplift协议，通过人工判断的效用-风险前沿比较不同访问条件（如助人提示、安全提示、外部安全助手）的效果，并采用锁定测试集和自适应检验。
Result: 在600行盲审中，安全助手相比助人提示将有害行动能力降低-0.063（95%置信区间[-0.117, -0.011]），而良性正确性变化+0.009（区间[-0.057, +0.077]）。安全提示对Claude更有效，外部控制对Gemini更有效但可能降低良性效用。
Conclusion: 本文不提出通用防御，而是提供一种部署级评估目标和风险预算校准方法，用于衡量用户访问条件如何移动效用-风险前沿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Designing Safety-Constrained LLM Systems for Public Health Information Access
papers.abstract_en: We present the design and implementation of a safety constrained large language model (LLM) system for public health information access, focusing on maternal and child health (MCH) resource navigation. While LLM based systems offer flexible and natural interfaces for information retrieval, their deployment in healthcare contexts introduces risks related to safety, trust, and uncontrolled generation. This work explores practical design patterns for constraining LLM behavior in safety critical environments. We introduce a multi-layered architecture that integrates domain-restricted retrieval augmented generation (RAG), strict boundary enforcement to prevent medical advice, anonymous multiuser session management, and comprehensive audit logging for monitoring and compliance. A key aspect of the design is a controlled data pipeline that grounds all responses in curated public health resources, avoiding reliance on the model pretrained medical knowledge. We implement the system in a real world public health setting and conduct scenario-based validation across in scope, out of scope, and emergency queries. Results show consistent enforcement of safety constraints, reliable resource grounding, and stable system performance, with an average response time of 5.3 seconds. Beyond the specific application, we discuss design trade offs and lessons learned in balancing safety, usability, and system flexibility. Our findings provide practical guidance for deploying LLM based systems in healthcare and other domains where strict information boundaries and accountability are required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个面向公共健康信息访问的安全约束LLM系统，聚焦于妇幼健康资源导航。系统采用多层架构，包括领域受限的RAG、严格边界执行、匿名多用户会话管理和审计日志。摘要报告在真实场景中验证了安全约束一致性和可靠资源基础，平均响应时间5.3秒。
Motivation: LLM在医疗信息检索中带来安全、信任和不可控生成风险，需要设计安全约束模式。
Method: 提出多层架构：领域受限RAG、严格边界禁止提供医疗建议、匿名多用户会话管理、全面审计日志，以及控制数据管道只基于策划的公共健康资源。
Result: 在真实公共健康环境中验证，结果显示一致的安全约束执行、可靠资源基础和稳定性能，平均响应时间5.3秒。
Conclusion: 本文讨论了安全、可用性和系统灵活性的设计权衡和经验教训，为医疗等领域部署LLM系统提供实用指导。

papers.title: OriginBlame: Record- and Token-Level Data Provenance for AI Training Datasets
papers.abstract_en: When a data contributor requests removal, model trainers face a practical gap: unlearning algorithms require a forget set, yet no tool can locate which training records belong to a given author. Existing provenance systems operate at file or dataset level, forcing catastrophic over-deletion. We present ob, a record- and token-level data provenance system that propagates author identity through data processing pipelines and resolves revocation requests into precise forget sets via deterministic queries. Evaluation on 219,555 Wikipedia pages demonstrates that record-level provenance eliminates dataset-level over-deletion (from 101x to 1.3x), while integration adds 1.3-4.0% throughput overhead (HuggingFace) and 2.1-19.0% (Datatrove) on wiki data. On a 1.7B model, provenance-based forget sets improve unlearning by 42% over random baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OriginBlame (ob)，一个记录级和令牌级的数据溯源系统，用于AI训练数据集。系统通过数据管道传播作者身份，并将撤销请求解析为精确的遗忘集。在219,555个Wikipedia页面上的评估表明，记录级溯源将过度删除从101倍降低到1.3倍，集成开销为1.3-4.0%（HuggingFace）和2.1-19.0%（Datatrove）。在1.7B模型上，基于溯源的遗忘集比随机基线提高了42%的遗忘性能。
Motivation: 现有数据溯源系统仅在文件或数据集级别操作，导致数据贡献者请求移除时，训练者需要过度删除大量数据，因为没有工具能够定位具体记录。
Method: 提出ob系统，实现记录级和令牌级数据溯源，通过数据管道传播作者身份，并使用确定性查询解析撤销请求为精确遗忘集。
Result: 在219,555个Wikipedia页面上的评估显示，记录级溯源将数据集级过度删除从101倍降至1.3倍；集成开销为1.3-4.0%（HuggingFace）和2.1-19.0%（Datatrove）。在1.7B模型上，基于溯源的遗忘集比随机基线提升遗忘性能42%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明ob系统有效解决了数据移除请求中的精确遗忘问题，但未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: Ask Before You Diagnose: Safe-Psych, a Sequential Evaluation Benchmark for LLMs in Psychiatry
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision support in healthcare, but clinical evidence is often incomplete or evolving. When the available information is insufficient to support a reliable answer, models should request clarification or abstain rather than provide unsupported responses. Existing medical benchmarks, however, typically assume that complete information is available upfront. We introduce Safe-Psych, a sequential benchmark for evaluating how LLMs handle evolving diagnostic uncertainty in clinical psychiatry. Safe-Psych contains over 1,000 real-world psychiatric clinical notes segmented to simulate incremental evidence disclosure, with psychiatrist-derived action labels at each stage: DIAGNOSE, CLARIFY, or ABSTAIN. We evaluate multiple state-of-the-art LLMs in full-information and sequential settings. Our findings show that capability does not ensure calibration: even strong models struggle under incomplete clinical information, with under-abstention exceeding 60% for most models and safety-aware prompting reducing premature commitment only by shifting errors toward excessive abstention. In sequential evaluation, models frequently diagnose before sufficient evidence is available and rarely seek clarification unless explicitly prompted; these premature diagnoses are less accurate than on-time diagnoses. Overall, Safe-Psych reveals a limitation across the evaluated models: recognizing when clinical evidence is incomplete and additional information is needed. We release Safe-Psych to support research on improving LLM safety in healthcare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Safe-Psych是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在精神病学中处理渐进诊断不确定性的顺序基准测试。该基准包含超过1000份真实临床记录，模拟逐步证据披露，并由精神科医生标注每个阶段应执行的动作：诊断、澄清或放弃。评估显示，即使强模型在信息不完整时也表现不佳，过度诊断率超过60%，且安全提示仅将错误转移到过度放弃。
Motivation: 现有医疗基准假设完整信息立即可用，但临床实践中证据往往是逐步出现的，模型应在信息不足时请求澄清或放弃诊断，而非给出不支持的答案。Safe-Psych旨在填补这一评估空白。
Method: 构建包含1000+份真实精神病学临床记录的基准，将记录分段以模拟逐步证据披露，并由精神科医生为每个阶段标注动作标签（DIAGNOSE、CLARIFY、ABSTAIN）。在完整信息和顺序设置下评估多个SOTA LLM。
Result: 发现能力不等于校准：强模型在信息不完整时表现挣扎，大部分模型过度诊断率超过60%；安全提示减少过早承诺但转向过度放弃。顺序评估中，模型常在证据不足时诊断，且这些过早诊断的准确性低于适时诊断。
Conclusion: 评估的所有模型在识别临床证据不完整并需要额外信息方面存在局限。Safe-Psych的发布旨在支持提高LLM在医疗领域安全性的研究。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: FixItFlow: Automated Troubleshooting Guide Generation from Cloud Incidents
papers.abstract_en: Cloud services experience frequent incidents that require rapid diagnosis and resolution. Troubleshooting guides help engineers respond consistently, but creating them manually is labor-intensive, resulting in incomplete coverage and outdated documentation. We present FixItFlow, an automated system that generates troubleshooting guides from historical incident data using large language models. The system extracts diagnostic patterns from engineer actions, synthesizes structured guides with verified commands, and enforces strict validation to prevent fabricated content. In our evaluation with 26 engineers, generated guides achieved 61.5\% positive ratings for clarity and demonstrated a 2.3x reduction in mitigation time for incidents with associated guides. These results indicate that automated guide generation can improve incident response while reducing documentation burden on engineering teams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对云服务故障排除指南的手动创建耗时且易过时的问题，提出 FixItFlow 系统，利用大语言模型从历史事故数据中自动生成指南。评估显示生成的指南在清晰度上获得 61.5% 的正面评价，并将平均缓解时间降低 2.3 倍。
Motivation: 手动编写和更新故障排除指南劳动密集，覆盖不全且易过时，影响工程师响应一致性和效率。
Method: 基于大语言模型从历史事故数据中提取诊断模式，合成带有验证命令的结构化指南，并执行严格验证以防止内容幻觉。
Result: 26 名工程师评估中，指南清晰度获 61.5% 好评；与未使用指南的事故相比，缓解时间降低 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 自动化指南生成可改善云服务事故响应效率并减少团队文档负担。
Relevance: 0
